plugin_asdk_app_694a52cfaa3c819192bea84e.longDescription:
Windsor.ai connects your marketing and business data sources to your AI assistant, so you can ask questions and take action in plain English.

It pulls performance data from any connected source, and on supported ad and marketing platforms it can make changes directly, such as pausing or enabling a campaign, setting a budget, creating a Google Business Profile post, or replying to a review, always after you confirm.

Common workflows:
- Compare spend, clicks, and conversions across every connected ad account
- Find and pause an underperforming Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or Microsoft Ads campaign
- Post or reply as your Instagram, Threads, Facebook, or Google Business Profile account
- Pull GA4, Google Search Console, or YouTube Analytics data straight into the conversation
- Sync HubSpot, Salesforce, or Shopify records
- Update a Klaviyo flow or an Amazon Seller Central listing

Connects to 350+ sources across advertising, analytics, organic social, CRM, e-commerce, email, and payments, including Google Ads, Meta (Facebook) Ads, Instagram, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, LinkedIn Company Pages, Microsoft Ads (Bing), GA4, Google Search Console, YouTube, Google Business Profile, HubSpot, Salesforce, Shopify, Klaviyo, Amazon Ads, Google Merchant Center, Stripe, and GoHighLevel.

Reading data only requires connecting the relevant account once. Making a change (pausing a campaign, posting content, replying to a review) always asks for your confirmation first, and it is only available on platforms Windsor explicitly supports write access for. Every other connected source is read-only. Free plan available, no credit card required.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
plugin_asdk_app_694a52cfaa3c819192bea84e.longDescriptionZh:
Windsor.ai 将您的营销和业务数据源连接到您的 AI 助手，以便您可以用简单的英语提出问题并采取行动。

它从任何连接的来源提取效果数据，并且在受支持的广告和营销平台上，它可以直接进行更改，例如暂停或启用广告系列、设置预算、创建 Google 商家资料帖子或回复评论（始终在您确认后）。

常见工作流程：
- 比较每个关联广告帐户的支出、点击次数和转化次数
- 查找并暂停表现不佳的元广告、Google Ads、TikTok 广告、LinkedIn 广告或 Microsoft 广告活动
- 作为您的 Instagram、Threads、Facebook 或 Google Business Profile 帐户发帖或回复
- 将 GA4、Google Search Console 或 YouTube Analytics 数据直接引入对话中
- 同步 HubSpot、Salesforce 或 Shopify 记录
- 更新 Klaviyo 流程或亚马逊卖家中心列表

连接到广告、分析、有机社交、CRM、电子商务、电子邮件和支付领域的 350 多个来源，包括 Google Ads、Meta (Facebook) 广告、Instagram、TikTok 广告、LinkedIn 广告、LinkedIn 公司页面、Microsoft 广告 (Bing)、GA4、Google Search Console、YouTube、Google Business Profile、HubSpot、Salesforce、Shopify、Klaviyo、Amazon Ads、Google Merchant Center、Stripe 和 GoHighLevel。

读取数据只需连接一次相关账户即可。进行更改（暂停活动、发布内容、回复评论）始终会首先要求您确认，并且仅在 Windsor 明确支持写入访问的平台上可用。所有其他连接的源都是只读的。提供免费计划，无需信用卡。

Windsor.ai 是一个独立的产品，不隶属于其所连接的平台，也不受其认可。

plugin_asdk_app_69e5f69b54d8819185e1638e.longDescription:
Connect Lusha to ChatGPT for B2B sales intelligence, prospecting, and go-to-market data, including verified contacts, decision-makers, and company enrichment, straight into your chat. Lusha is the B2B data layer behind 300M+ verified contacts, used by sales, marketing, RevOps, and recruiting teams for lead generation, CRM enrichment, account research, and outbound campaigns. Backed by GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2 Type II, and ISO 27701 compliance.

Use Lusha to:

Find contacts and decision-makers by title, seniority, industry, or location: "Find 10 VPs of RevOps at Series B SaaS companies in NYC"
Pull verified work emails, direct dials, and mobile numbers with 98% email deliverability and 85% phone accuracy: "Get the verified email and mobile number for the Head of Marketing at Notion"
Surface the decision-making buying committee at target accounts: "Find the decision makers I should reach out to at Notion and Figma"
Enrich CRM records, leads, and inbound signups with firmographics, technographics, headcount, and revenue: "Enrich these 25 webinar signups with industry, tech stack, and hiring signals"
Track buying signals like funding, leadership hires, and tech stack changes: "Show me the buying signals from the last 90 days for these 15 accounts"
Get ranked company and contact recommendations scored by lead fit and intent: "Recommend companies that match our best customer profile, ranked by buying signals"
Find lookalike accounts based on closed-won customers: "Find 20 companies that look like these 5 customers"
plugin_asdk_app_69e5f69b54d8819185e1638e.longDescriptionZh:
将 Lusha 连接到 ChatGPT，直接在聊天中获取 B2B 销售情报、勘探和上市数据，包括经过验证的联系人、决策者和公司丰富信息。 Lusha 是超过 3 亿个经过验证的联系人背后的 B2B 数据层，供销售、营销、RevOps 和招聘团队用于潜在客户开发、CRM 丰富、客户研究和对外营销活动。符合 GDPR、CCPA、SOC 2 Type II 和 ISO 27701 合规性。

使用 Lusha 可以：

按职位、资历、行业或地点查找联系人和决策者：“在纽约市的 B 系列 SaaS 公司中查找 10 位 RevOps 副总裁”
以 98% 的电子邮件送达率和 85% 的电话准确率提取经过验证的工作电子邮件、直拨电话和手机号码：“获取 Notion 营销主管的经过验证的电子邮件和手机号码”
展示目标客户的决策购买委员会：“找到我应该在 Notion 和 Figma 联系的决策者”
通过公司统计、技术统计、员工人数和收入丰富 CRM 记录、潜在客户和入站注册：“通过行业、技术堆栈和招聘信号丰富这 25 个网络研讨会注册”
跟踪购买信号，例如资金、领导力聘用和技术堆栈变化：“向我显示这 15 个帐户过去 90 天的购买信号”

plugin_asdk_app_6947eaa4edd081919561e4ee.longDescription:
Build your entire site and buy a domain right from the chat. Just ask Wix for the website you want, including all the functionality you need, and get a complete, business-ready site generated for you in minutes. You can also connect the perfect custom domain to your site and manage everything seamlessly in one place. If you like, you can continue editing it inside the Wix Harmony editor using tons more AI tools and smooth drag and drop.

For developers: build and deploy Wix apps with the Wix CLI, including dashboard extensions, backend APIs, site widgets, service plugins and data collections. Build headless sites with Wix Headless, fully hosted on Wix or self-hosted in any framework, powered by Wix backend services for eCommerce, bookings, CMS, events and members. Manage your store, bookings, contacts and site settings programmatically.
plugin_asdk_app_6947eaa4edd081919561e4ee.longDescriptionZh:
构建您的整个网站并直接通过聊天购买域名。只需向 Wix 询问您想要的网站，包括您需要的所有功能，几分钟内即可为您生成一个完整的、可用于业务的网站。您还可以将完美的自定义域连接到您的网站，并在一处无缝管理一切。如果您愿意，您可以使用更多 AI 工具和流畅的拖放功能在 Wix Harmony 编辑器中继续编辑它。

对于开发人员：使用 Wix CLI 构建和部署 Wix 应用程序，包括仪表板扩展、后端 API、站点小部件、服务插件和数据收集。使用 Wix Headless 构建无头网站，完全托管在 Wix 上或在任何框架中自托管，由用于电子商务、预订、CMS、活动和会员的 Wix 后端服务提供支持。以编程方式管理您的商店、预订、联系人和网站设置。

plugin_asdk_app_69e6af3297d88191b4925772.description: 给你的代理人一个电话
plugin_asdk_app_69e6af3297d88191b4925772.productIntro: Quo 是下一代商务电话系统，可帮助团队与客户互动、内部协作并利用人工智能扩展沟通，同时又不失个人风格。连接 Quo 使 ChatGPT 可以通过电话、短信和联系人访问您的客户对话。您可以询问有关这些互动的问题，以发现客户所说的模式以及可能会失去机会的地方。 ChatGPT 可以搜索、分析和总结对话，以揭示诸如为什么我们会失去交易？客户喜欢我们服务的哪些方面？最常出现哪些投诉？

Connecting Quo gives ChatGPT access to your customer conversations across calls, text messages, and contacts.
plugin_asdk_app_69e6af3297d88191b4925772.longDescription: Quo is a next-generation business phone system that helps teams engage customers, collaborate internally, and scale communication with AI — without losing the personal touch. ChatGPT can search, analyze, and summarize conversations to surface insights like Why are we losing deals? What do customers love about our service? What complaints show up most often?

plugin_asdk_app_69bd664f2a908191a3a0a47e.productIntro: Apollo 的 io 连接器可让 ChatGPT 在您的 Apollo 工作空间内安全地工作，以加速勘探和出站执行。使用 Apollo 的数据搜索和限定客户和联系人，丰富记录，总结关键上下文，并使用团队的规则和权限采取行动（例如，创建列表、记录笔记、生成任务以及使用序列起草或组装出站）。专为速度和控制而设计：ChatGPT 只能提取您所要求的内容，尊重工作区访问权限，并生成可供审核、个性化和交付的输出。
plugin_asdk_app_69bd664f2a908191a3a0a47e.productIntroEn: Apollo’s io connector lets ChatGPT safely work inside your Apollo workspace to accelerate prospecting and outbound execution. Search and qualify accounts and contacts using Apollo’s data, enrich records, summarize key context, and take action (e.g., create lists, log notes, generate tasks, and draft or assemble outbound using sequences) using your team’s rules and permissions.
plugin_asdk_app_69bd664f2a908191a3a0a47e.longDescription: Apollo’s io connector lets ChatGPT safely work inside your Apollo workspace to accelerate prospecting and outbound execution. plugin_asdk_app_69d954576c8081919b329f17.description: 将 ChatGPT 连接到 NetSuite
plugin_asdk_app_69d954576c8081919b329f17.productIntro: 快速轻松地将 NetSuite 集成到 ChatGPT。 NetSuite AI 连接器服务提供支持模型上下文协议 (MCP) 的协议驱动集成服务，为客户提供灵活且可扩展的方式将 AI 助手连接到 NetSuite。连接后，ChatGPT 可以直接访问 NetSuite 数据和功能并与之交互 - 快速解锁见解、生成报告、简化流程等。一套全面的工具可实现交互并维护 NetSuite 现有的基于角色的安全模型。
plugin_asdk_app_69d954576c8081919b329f17.productIntroEn: Quickly and easily integrate NetSuite to ChatGPT. The NetSuite AI Connector Service provides a protocol-driven integration service supporting Model Context Protocol (MCP), that gives customers a flexible and scalable way to connect AI assistants to NetSuite.
plugin_asdk_app_69d954576c8081919b329f17.longDescription: Quickly and easily integrate NetSuite to ChatGPT. The NetSuite AI Connector Service provides a protocol-driven integration service supporting Model Context Protocol (MCP), that gives customers a flexible and scalable way to connect AI assistants to NetSuite. Once connected, ChatGPT can directly access and interact with NetSuite data and functionality – quickly unlocking insights, generating reports, streamlining processes., and more. A comprehensive set of tools enable interactions and maintains NetSuite’s existing role-based security model.

plugin_asdk_app_6943c7d34d94819182a0b9ac.name: Hunter
plugin_asdk_app_6943c7d34d94819182a0b9ac.productIntro: 无需离开 ChatGPT 即可查找和组织公司。该应用程序直接连接到 Hunter，帮助您发现符合您条件的企业，利用可靠的公司级数据丰富它们，并保存您关心的企业。
plugin_asdk_app_6943c7d34d94819182a0b9ac.productIntroEn: Find and organize companies without leaving ChatGPT. This app connects directly to Hunter to help you discover businesses that match your criteria, enrich them with reliable company-level data, and save the ones you care about.
plugin_asdk_app_6943c7d34d94819182a0b9ac.longDescription:
Find and organize companies without leaving ChatGPT. This app connects directly to Hunter to help you discover businesses that match your criteria, enrich them with reliable company-level data, and save the ones you care about.

You can search for companies using natural language (for example, by location, industry, size, or technologies), review results with domain-level insights, and enrich any company to get structured information such as industry, headcount range, headquarters location, and tech stack. When a company looks relevant, you can save it straight to your Hunter Leads for later use.

Designed for sales, marketing, and research workflows, the app focuses on fast exploration and clean company data. No personal data, no guesswork, just actionable company insights inside ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6943c7d34d94819182a0b9ac.longDescriptionZh:
无需离开 ChatGPT 即可查找和组织公司。该应用程序直接连接到 Hunter，帮助您发现符合您条件的企业，利用可靠的公司级数据丰富它们，并保存您关心的企业。

您可以使用自然语言（例如，按位置、行业、规模或技术）搜索公司，通过领域级见解查看结果，并丰富任何公司以获取结构化信息，例如行业、员工范围、总部位置和技术堆栈。当一家公司看起来相关时，您可以将其直接保存到您的 Hunter Leads 中以供以后使用。

该应用程序专为销售、营销和研究工作流程而设计，专注于快速探索和清理公司数据。 ChatGPT 中没有个人数据，没有猜测，只有可操作的公司见解。

Find companies in the travel industry

plugin_asdk_app_6947c583d8308191844af621.name: AI Vibe Prospecting
plugin_asdk_app_6947c583d8308191844af621.description: 查找潜在客户和 B2B 联系数据
plugin_asdk_app_6947c583d8308191844af621.productIntro: Vibe Prospecting 将实时 B2B 数据引入 ChatGPT，以进行勘探、领先研究和数据丰富。它利用了从 50 多个来源汇总的 1.5 亿多家公司和 8 亿多个专业联系人的数据库，因此您可以在不离开对话的情况下构建潜在客户列表、研究帐户并填写缺失的联系人数据。
plugin_asdk_app_6947c583d8308191844af621.productIntroEn: Vibe Prospecting brings live B2B data into ChatGPT for prospecting, lead research, and data enrichment. It draws on a database of 150M+ companies and 800M+ professional contacts aggregated from 50+ sources, so you can build lead lists, research accounts, and fill in missing contact data without leaving the conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6947c583d8308191844af621.longDescription:
Vibe Prospecting brings live B2B data into ChatGPT for prospecting, lead research, and data enrichment. It draws on a database of 150M+ companies and 800M+ professional contacts aggregated from 50+ sources, so you can build lead lists, research accounts, and fill in missing contact data without leaving the conversation.

Search for companies. Describe your ideal customer profile in plain language and filter by industry (including LinkedIn industry, NAICS, and SIC classifications), employee count, revenue range, location, funding stage, and the technologies a company uses. Results come back as structured lists you can refine, rank, and export.

Find the right people. Search professional contacts by job title, seniority, department, location, skills, and work history. Look up a specific person by name and company, or map the decision-makers across a target account, including org structure and reporting lines, to plan multi-threaded outreach.

Get contact details. Retrieve business emails and phone numbers for the contacts you find, with verification status included, so outreach lists are ready to use. Fill gaps in partial records, for example a name and company with no email. Verify email addresses you already have before a send, and flag records that need replacing.

Track buying signals. See which companies raised funding, announced news, grew headcount, opened relevant job listings, or had key people change roles. Use these events to time outreach, score leads, and prioritize accounts.

Enrich your existing records. Paste or upload a list of companies or contacts and append firmographics, technographics, contact details, and recent signals. The app matches records to the right company or person, flags duplicates, and returns a clean table you can export to CSV for your CRM, ATS, or outreach tools.

Who it's for. Sales teams and SDRs building qualified pipeline. Recruiters sourcing candidates by role, skills, and location. RevOps and marketing teams segmenting accounts, sizing markets, and improving CRM data quality. It also supports market sizing and TAM analysis, lead scoring, territory planning, and account-based marketing list building.

Try prompts like:

"Find US SaaS companies with 100 to 1,000 employees that use HubSpot."
"Identify VP-level decision-makers at these accounts and get verified work emails."
"Enrich this list with industry, employee count, revenue, and tech stack."
"Which of these companies raised funding or grew headcount in the last 6 months?"
"Find backend engineers in Austin with fintech experience and get their profiles."
"Build a target account list for my ICP and rank it by fit."
"Map the sales leadership org chart at this company."
"Verify the emails in this list and flag the risky ones."
"Estimate how many US companies match this ICP."
"Write a personalized cold email opener for each contact based on their company's recent news."
Vibe Prospecting is built on Explorium's B2B data platform. Data is retrieved live at query time, not from a static export, so results reflect current company and contact information.
plugin_asdk_app_6947c583d8308191844af621.longDescriptionZh:
Vibe Prospecting 将实时 B2B 数据引入 ChatGPT，以进行勘探、领先研究和数据丰富。它利用了从 50 多个来源汇总的 1.5 亿多家公司和 8 亿多个专业联系人的数据库，因此您可以在不离开对话的情况下构建潜在客户列表、研究帐户并填写缺失的联系人数据。

搜索公司。用通俗易懂的语言描述您理想的客户档案，并按行业（包括 LinkedIn 行业、NAICS 和 SIC 分类）、员工人数、收入范围、位置、融资阶段以及公司使用的技术进行筛选。结果以结构化列表的形式返回，您可以对其进行细化、排名和导出。

找到合适的人。按职位、资历、部门、地点、技能和工作经历搜索专业联系人。按姓名和公司查找特定人员，或在目标客户中映射决策者，包括组织结构和报告关系，以规划多线程外展。

获取联系方式。检索您找到的联系人的企业电子邮件和电话号码，并包含验证状态，以便可以使用外展列表。填充部分记录中的空白，例如没有电子邮件的名称和公司。在发送之前验证您已有的电子邮件地址，并标记需要替换的记录。

跟踪购买信号。查看哪些公司筹集了资金、发布了新闻、增加了员工人数、开设了相关职位列表或让关键人员更换了角色。使用这些事件来安排外展时间、获得潜在客户并确定客户优先级。

丰富您现有的记录。粘贴或上传公司或联系人列表，并附加公司信息、技术信息、联系方式和最新信号。该应用程序将记录与正确的公司或个人进行匹配，标记重复项，并返回一个干净的表格，您可以将其导出为 CSV 以用于 CRM、ATS 或外展工具。

这是给谁的。销售团队和特别提款权建立合格的管道。招聘人员根据角色、技能和地点寻找候选人。 RevOps 和营销团队细分客户、确定市场规模并提高 CRM 数据质量。它还支持市场规模和 TAM 分析、潜在客户评分、区域规划和基于帐户的营销列表构建。

尝试如下提示：

“查找拥有 100 到 1,000 名员工且使用 HubSpot 的美国 SaaS 公司。”
“确定这些帐户的副总裁级决策者并获取经过验证的工作电子邮件。”
“通过行业、员工数量、收入和技术堆栈来丰富此列表。”
“哪些公司在过去 6 个月内筹集了资金或增加了员工人数？”
“在奥斯汀寻找具有金融科技经验的后端工程师并获取他们的个人资料。”
“为我的 ICP 建立一个目标帐户列表，并按适合程度对其进行排名。”
“绘制这家公司的销售领导层组织结构图。”
“验证此列表中的电子邮件并标记有风险的电子邮件。”
“估计有多少美国公司符合这个ICP。”
“根据每个联系人公司的最新消息，为他们写一封个性化的冷邮件开场白。”
Vibe Prospecting 建立在 Explorium 的 B2B 数据平台之上。数据是在查询时实时检索的，而不是从静态导出中检索的，因此结果反映了当前的公司和联系信息。
defaultPrompts: Find 50 CISOs based in TX with 5+ years of experience
Find 500 companies that are actively looking for a new office in CA
Get the HR leadership in miro.com
defaultPromptsZh: 查找位于德克萨斯州、拥有 5 年以上经验的 50 名 CISO
查找 500 家正在积极在加利福尼亚州寻找新办事处的公司

plugin_asdk_app_6a3170ea7fc88191be6c0b9f.name: HYPD AI - Paid Ads & Analytics
plugin_asdk_app_6a3170ea7fc88191be6c0b9f.productIntro: HYPD 将您的广告和分析帐户引入 ChatGPT，以便您可以用简单的语言分析付费营销绩效。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3170ea7fc88191be6c0b9f.productIntroEn: HYPD brings your advertising and analytics accounts into ChatGPT so you can analyze paid marketing performance in plain language.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3170ea7fc88191be6c0b9f.longDescription:
HYPD brings your advertising and analytics accounts into ChatGPT so you can analyze paid marketing performance in plain language. 

Connect Google Ads, Meta (Facebook and Instagram), Google Analytics, and Merchant Center, then just ask. 
You get campaign performance, spend and ROAS breakdowns, wasted-spend checks, creative and audience insights, funnel and conversion-path analysis, and Shopping feed diagnostics, all from your real account data. 

You also get keyword research with search volume, competitor ad and SERP research, and landing-page checks, plus ready-to-run prompt templates, expert marketing skills, and your saved business context, so every answer reflects your accounts, brand, and goals. 

Built for marketers, agencies, and advertisers who want fast answers and client-ready reporting without leaving the chat. HYPD is read-only. It reports on your accounts and never changes your campaigns.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3170ea7fc88191be6c0b9f.longDescriptionZh:
HYPD 将您的广告和分析帐户引入 ChatGPT，以便您可以用简单的语言分析付费营销绩效。 

连接 Google Ads、Meta（Facebook 和 Instagram）、Google Analytics 和 Merchant Center，然后直接询问。 
您可以从真实帐户数据中获得广告活动效果、支出和广告支出回报率细分、浪费支出检查、创意和受众洞察、渠道和转化路径分析以及购物提要诊断。 

您还可以通过搜索量、竞争对手广告和 SERP 研究以及登陆页面检查进行关键字研究，以及随时可以运行的提示模板、专家营销技能和您保存的业务背景，因此每个答案都反映您的帐户、品牌和目标。 

专为希望在不离开聊天的情况下快速获得答案和客户就绪报告的营销人员、代理机构和广告商而打造。 HYPD 是只读的。它会报告您的帐户，并且不会更改您的广告系列。

Which of my Meta creatives are fatiguing, and what should I refresh?

defaultPromptsZh: 审核我的 Google Ads 帐户并显示 5 个最重要的修复方法

Close stores every call, email, SMS, and meeting your team touches, not just contact records. Connect it to ChatGPT and your conversation history becomes something you can actually work from.

Calls, emails, SMS, and meetings are all logged and searchable, giving ChatGPT far more context than traditional CRMs built mostly for record-keeping.

Close also includes Chloe, a built-in AI sales teammate embedded directly into your workflows. Together, ChatGPT and Chloe help teams stay on top of follow-up, prioritize outreach, and keep deals moving.

Search and filter contacts, companies, and deals with flexible queries. Create, update, and organize records without switching between screens. Add notes, manage tasks, and track your sales pipeline—all through simple requests.

This MCP server gives ChatGPT secure access to your JobTread data, so you can get real-time answers, make updates, and stay on top of your projects without switching between apps.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6a5d2ec54c81918f1d2f58.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT directly to your JobTread account to manage your construction business through natural conversation. This MCP server gives ChatGPT secure access to your JobTread data, so you can get real-time answers, make updates, and stay on top of your projects without switching between apps.

With the JobTread MCP server in ChatGPT, you can: 
• Jobs & Projects: Look up job details, check statuses, create new jobs, and update project information. 
• Estimates & Budgets: Review estimates, pull line-item breakdowns, and track budget vs. actual costs. 
• Schedules: View upcoming tasks and milestones, check timelines, and keep projects moving forward. 
• Customers & Contacts: Search client records, review communication history, and manage contact info.
• Vendors & Subcontractors: Access vendor profiles and coordinate with trade partners. 
• Documents & Daily Logs: Reference job records, daily logs, and reports to keep your team aligned.

Whether you’re a builder, remodeler, or specialty contractor, the JobTread MCP server turns ChatGPT into a hands-on operations assistant, answering prompts like “What’s the status of the Henderson kitchen remodel?” or “Show me all open estimates this month” in seconds.

Your data stays protected through JobTread’s authenticated API, and ChatGPT only accesses what you explicitly allow.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6a5d2ec54c81918f1d2f58.longDescriptionZh:
将 ChatGPT 直接连接到您的 JobTread 帐户，通过自然对话管理您的建筑业务。此 MCP 服务器使 ChatGPT 能够安全地访问您的 JobTread 数据，因此您可以获得实时答案、进行更新并掌握项目的最新情况，而无需在应用程序之间切换。

通过 ChatGPT 中的 JobTread MCP 服务器，您可以： 
• 职位和项目：查找职位详细信息、检查状态、创建新职位以及更新项目信息。 
• 估算和预算：审查估算、提取行项目细分并跟踪预算与实际成本。 
• 日程表：查看即将到来的任务和里程碑、检查时间表并保持项目进展。 
• 客户和联系人：搜索客户记录、查看通信历史记录并管理联系信息。
• 供应商和分包商：访问供应商资料并与贸易伙伴进行协调。 
• 文档和每日日志：参考工作记录、每日日志和报告，以使您的团队保持一致。

无论您是建筑商、改造商还是专业承包商，JobTread MCP 服务器都可以将 ChatGPT 变成实用的操作助手，回答诸如“Henderson 厨房改造的状态如何？”之类的提示。或在几秒钟内“显示本月所有未完成的估算”。

您的数据通过 JobTread 的经过身份验证的 API 受到保护，ChatGPT 仅访问您明确允许的数据。

plugin_asdk_app_6a0346f97e5881919b8b5f87.description: 立即将想法转化为领域
plugin_asdk_app_6a0346f97e5881919b8b5f87.productIntro: Namify 将一个想法的火花变成一个可品牌化的、可用的域名——无需在搜索栏中来回输入变体。用通俗易懂的语言描述您的业务，输入一个词的概念，或者粘贴带有首选扩展名的种子域，Namify 会立即返回相关名称建议，并在多个 TLD 中实时提供可用性。
plugin_asdk_app_6a0346f97e5881919b8b5f87.productIntroEn: Namify turns a spark of an idea into a brandable, available domain — without the back and forth of typing variations into a search bar. Describe your business in plain language, drop in a one-word concept, or paste a seed domain with a preferred extension, and Namify instantly returns relevant name suggestions with live availability across multiple TLDs.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0346f97e5881919b8b5f87.longDescription:
Namify turns a spark of an idea into a brandable, available domain — without the back and forth of typing variations into a search bar. Describe your business in plain language, drop in a one-word concept, or paste a seed domain with a preferred extension, and Namify instantly returns relevant name suggestions with live availability across multiple TLDs.

What makes Namify different is that it doesn't stop at "is this domain free?" Every suggestion can be vetted for full brand-readiness: run a trademark check to spot legal conflicts, and a social-handle check to confirm the name is available across major platforms. It is domain discovery built for people who want a name that actually works as a brand — not just a URL that happens to be unregistered.

Best used for naming a new business, side project, app, or product launch — and going from idea to a domain you can register in a single conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0346f97e5881919b8b5f87.longDescriptionZh:
Namify 将一个想法的火花变成一个可品牌化的、可用的域名——无需在搜索栏中来回输入变体。用通俗易懂的语言描述您的业务，输入一个词的概念，或者粘贴带有首选扩展名的种子域，Namify 会立即返回相关名称建议，并在多个 TLD 中实时提供可用性。

Namify 的不同之处在于，它不会停留在“这个域名免费吗？”的问题上。每条建议都可以经过审查，以确保其完全适合品牌：进行商标检查以发现法律冲突，并进行社交处理检查以确认该名称可在主要平台上使用。它是为那些想要一个真正可以作为品牌使用的名称的人而构建的域名发现，而不仅仅是一个碰巧未注册的 URL。

最适合用于命名新业务、副项目、应用程序或产品发布 - 以及从想法到可以在单个对话中注册的域。

plugin_asdk_app_695241ece6188191bd089752.productIntroEn: Business Helper improves ChatGPT answers to business questions by adding reliable, source- backed context from trusted expert materials.
plugin_asdk_app_695241ece6188191bd089752.longDescription:
Business Helper improves ChatGPT answers to business questions by adding reliable, source-
backed context from trusted expert materials.

When users ask about strategy, product, marketing, or operations, the app enriches responses
with relevant examples and references to real-world insights. Context is added only when it
clearly improves usefulness. If no relevant sources are found, ChatGPT responds normally
without external references.

Business Helper does not collect personal data, and does not provide professional legal or financial advice. Any external services are recommended based on user's intentions only.

明显提高了实用性。如果没有找到相关来源，ChatGPT 会正常响应
无需外部参考。

生意帮不收集个人资料，也不提供专业的法律或财务建议。任何外部服务仅根据用户的意图推荐。

plugin_asdk_app_6a1d92a960208191a307a35c.name: PDF Editor by PDF net
plugin_asdk_app_6a1d92a960208191a307a35c.productIntro: 连接 pdf.net 在 ChatGPT 中编辑、生成和组织 PDF。您的 pdf.net 库直接连接 — 无需每次重新上传。
plugin_asdk_app_6a1d92a960208191a307a35c.productIntroEn: Connect pdf.net to edit, generate, and organize PDFs in ChatGPT. Your pdf.net library connects directly — no re-uploading every time.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1d92a960208191a307a35c.longDescription:
Connect pdf.net to edit, generate, and organize PDFs in ChatGPT. Your pdf.net library connects directly — no re-uploading every time.

Edit PDFs in place: change text, fix dates, fill forms. Generate new PDFs from a prompt — invoices, contracts, proposals. Merge up to 20 PDFs, split by page range, compress, and convert to Word, Excel, or PowerPoint. Translate full documents while keeping the layout. Organize your library into folders.

Working with PDFs can be slow. You convert to Word to edit, switch tools to merge, pay extra to translate, and dig through folders to find the file. pdf.net puts all of it in one chat.

Edit PDFs in place — no Word roundtrip. Generate invoices, contracts, and proposals from a prompt. Merge up to 20 files, split by page, compress, and convert to Word, Excel, or PowerPoint. Translate full documents while keeping the layout. Your pdf.net library stays connected, so files are one message away.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1d92a960208191a307a35c.longDescriptionZh:
连接 pdf.net 在 ChatGPT 中编辑、生成和组织 PDF。您的 pdf.net 库直接连接 — 无需每次重新上传。

就地编辑 PDF：更改文本、修复日期、填写表格。根据提示生成新的 PDF - 发票、合同、提案。合并最多 20 个 PDF、按页面范围拆分、压缩并转换为 Word、Excel 或 PowerPoint。翻译完整文档，同时保持布局。将您的库组织到文件夹中。

使用 PDF 可能会很慢。您可以转换为 Word 进行编辑，切换工具进行合并，支付额外费用进行翻译，并在文件夹中挖掘以查找文件。 pdf.net 将所有内容集中在一次聊天中。

就地编辑 PDF — 无需 Word 往返。根据提示生成发票、合同和提案。合并最多 20 个文件、按页面拆分、压缩并转换为 Word、Excel 或 PowerPoint。翻译完整文档，同时保持布局。您的 pdf.net 图书馆保持连接，因此只需一则消息即可获取文件。
defaultPrompts: pdf.net show invoices from last month
pdf.net summarize all files in the "Client Project" folder
pdf.net translate this contract into English
defaultPromptsZh: pdf.net 显示上个月的发票
pdf.net 总结“Client Project”文件夹中的所有文件
pdf.net 将此合同翻译成英文

plugin_asdk_app_69dd1d0f73b48191ac4fadf2.name: Seismic
plugin_asdk_app_69dd1d0f73b48191ac4fadf2.productIntro: ChatGPT 的 Seismic MCP 连接器可实现 ChatGPT 和 Seismic 之间的安全集成，从而使 ChatGPT 能够使用批准的销售和支持内容生成准确的、特定于 Seismic 的响应。
plugin_asdk_app_69dd1d0f73b48191ac4fadf2.productIntroEn: The Seismic MCP Connector for ChatGPT enables secure integration between ChatGPT and Seismic, allowing ChatGPT to generate accurate, Seismic-specific responses using approved sales and enablement content.
plugin_asdk_app_69dd1d0f73b48191ac4fadf2.longDescription:
The Seismic MCP Connector for ChatGPT enables secure integration between ChatGPT and Seismic, allowing ChatGPT to generate accurate, Seismic-specific responses using approved sales and enablement content.

Built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the connector provides authentication and scope-based access control, ensuring only authorized tools and content are available within ChatGPT.

To configure access, users must install the MCP Connector for ChatGPT app from Seismic Exchange, where tenant admins define scopes and permissions that control which Seismic capabilities are exposed.

Once configured:

ChatGPT connects to Seismic through the MCP server

Only approved tools and content are accessible

Responses are grounded in trusted, compliant materials

Without proper installation and scope configuration, Seismic tools will not be visible in ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_69dd1d0f73b48191ac4fadf2.longDescriptionZh:
ChatGPT 的 Seismic MCP 连接器可实现 ChatGPT 和 Seismic 之间的安全集成，从而使 ChatGPT 能够使用批准的销售和支持内容生成准确的、特定于 Seismic 的响应。

该连接器基于模型上下文协议 (MCP) 构建，提供身份验证和基于范围的访问控制，确保只有授权的工具和内容在 ChatGPT 中可用。

要配置访问权限，用户必须从 Seismic Exchange 安装 MCP Connector for ChatGPT 应用程序，其中租户管理员定义控制公开哪些 Seismic 功能的范围和权限。

配置完成后：

ChatGPT 通过 MCP 服务器连接到 Seismic

只能访问经过批准的工具和内容

回应基于可信、合规的材料

如果没有正确的安装和范围配置，Seismic 工具在 ChatGPT 中将不可见。

plugin_asdk_app_69e795096e888191b3908a4d.description: 运行 Google Ads、Meta + 50 更多
plugin_asdk_app_69e795096e888191b3908a4d.productIntro: Markifact 是 ChatGPT 的营销自动化和广告管理连接器。专为需要跨渠道报告、付费媒体分析和营销活动管理而无需在广告仪表板之间切换的营销人员、代理机构、媒体买家、PPC 专家、增长团队和内部营销团队而构建。
plugin_asdk_app_69e795096e888191b3908a4d.productIntroEn: Markifact is a marketing automation and advertising management connector for ChatGPT. Built for marketers, agencies, media buyers, PPC specialists, growth teams, and in-house marketing teams who need cross-channel reporting, paid media analysis, and campaign management without switching between ad dashboards.
plugin_asdk_app_69e795096e888191b3908a4d.longDescription:
Markifact is a marketing automation and advertising management connector for ChatGPT. Built for marketers, agencies, media buyers, PPC specialists, growth teams, and in-house marketing teams who need cross-channel reporting, paid media analysis, and campaign management without switching between ad dashboards.

Ad platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), Microsoft Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Reddit Ads, Snapchat Ads, Pinterest Ads, Amazon Ads, Apple Search Ads, OpenAI Ads (ChatGPT ads), Display & Video 360 (DV360), Spotify Ads, Data Manager.

Analytics and data: Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Trends, Google Search, BigQuery, SEMrush, Adjust, Bing Webmaster Tools, PageSpeed Insights.

E-commerce and CRM: Shopify, HubSpot, Klaviyo, and Google Merchant Center.

Workspace and reporting: Google Sheets, Google Slides, Google Docs, Google Drive, Microsoft SharePoint (OneDrive), Dropbox, Google Business Profile, and Google Maps.

Social and messaging: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Slack, Pinterest, YouTube, TikTok, WhatsApp.

Use Markifact for cross-channel advertising reports, PPC reporting, campaign audits, account monitoring, budget pacing, search term and keyword analysis, creative performance analysis, marketing data extraction, and campaign optimization. ChatGPT can retrieve campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, audiences, budgets, conversions, performance metrics, dimensions, and account structures from any connected account.

Markifact also supports advertising automation. Create campaigns and ads, update budgets and bids, pause or enable campaigns, edit supported ad fields, upload images and video, manage targeting, and run other platform-supported actions, then send results straight to Google Sheets, Slides, Docs, or Slack.
plugin_asdk_app_69e795096e888191b3908a4d.longDescriptionZh:
Markifact 是 ChatGPT 的营销自动化和广告管理连接器。专为需要跨渠道报告、付费媒体分析和营销活动管理而无需在广告仪表板之间切换的营销人员、代理机构、媒体买家、PPC 专家、增长团队和内部营销团队而构建。

广告平台：Google Ads、Meta Ads（Facebook 和 Instagram）、Microsoft Ads、TikTok 广告、LinkedIn 广告、Reddit 广告、Snapchat 广告、Pinterest 广告、Amazon 广告、Apple 搜索广告、OpenAI 广告（ChatGPT 广告）、Display & Video 360 (DV360)、Spotify 广告、Data Manager。

分析和数据：Google Analytics 4 (GA4)、Google Search Console、Google Tag Manager (GTM)、Google Trends、Google Search、BigQuery、SEMrush、Adjust、Bing 网站站长工具、PageSpeed Insights。

电子商务和 CRM：Shopify、HubSpot、Klaviyo 和 Google Merchant Center。

工作区和报告：Google Sheets、Google Slides、Google Docs、Google Drive、Microsoft SharePoint (OneDrive)、Dropbox、Google Business Profile 和 Google Maps。

社交和消息传递：Facebook、Instagram、LinkedIn、Slack、Pinterest、YouTube、TikTok、WhatsApp。

使用 Markifact 进行跨渠道广告报告、PPC 报告、活动审核、帐户监控、预算节奏、搜索词和关键词分析、创意绩效分析、营销数据提取和活动优化。 ChatGPT 可以从任何连接的帐户中检索广告活动、广告组、广告、关键字、受众、预算、转化、效果指标、维度和帐户结构。

Markifact 还支持广告自动化。创建广告系列和广告、更新预算和出价、暂停或启用广告系列、编辑支持的广告字段、上传图像和视频、管理定位以及运行其他平台支持的操作，然后将结果直接发送到 Google 表格、幻灯片、文档或 Slack。

Analyze device performance for our summer Google Ads campaign
Show me what marketing actions I can run with Markifact

分析我们夏季 Google Ads 广告系列的设备性能

plugin_asdk_app_69eba17551ac81918231c838.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Datasite 虚拟数据室 - 安全的工作空间，每年促成数以千计的并购交易。设置文件夹结构、邀请用户、搜索文档、跟踪买家问答以及审核数据室准备情况，所有这些都通过自然语言进行。没有工作流程中断。没有安全权衡。专为顾问、银行家和企业开发团队而构建 - 由企业安全性和每项交易需求的许可提供支持。
plugin_asdk_app_69eba17551ac81918231c838.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your Datasite virtual data room - the secure workspace where thousands of M&A deals are facilitated annually. Set up folder structures, invite users, search documents, track buyer Q&A, and audit data room readiness, all through natural language. No workflow interruptions. No security trade-offs.
plugin_asdk_app_69eba17551ac81918231c838.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT to your Datasite virtual data room - the secure workspace where thousands of M&A deals are facilitated annually. Set up folder structures, invite users, search documents, track buyer Q&A, and audit data room readiness, all through natural language. No workflow interruptions. No security trade-offs. Built for advisors, bankers, and corporate development teams - backed by the enterprise security and permissioning every transaction demands.

1. Set up a deal room - "Create a new Datasite Prepare data room for Project Alpha, set up a standard M&A folder index, and invite sarah@advisorfirm.com as an admin."

2. Search documents semantically - "Search the data room for any documents related to pending litigation or regulatory risk."

3. Track buyer Q&A - "Show me all open Q&A questions in the data room and draft responses where we have supporting documents."

4. Audit deal room readiness - "Check the data room for empty folders, missing documents, and any files flagged as password-protected or blank before we go live."

5. Manage user access - "Create a buyer role with view-only permissions and create draft invitations for the following five contacts from Acme Capital."
plugin_asdk_app_69eba17551ac81918231c838.longDescriptionZh:
将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Datasite 虚拟数据室 - 安全的工作空间，每年促成数以千计的并购交易。设置文件夹结构、邀请用户、搜索文档、跟踪买家问答以及审核数据室准备情况，所有这些都通过自然语言进行。没有工作流程中断。没有安全权衡。专为顾问、银行家和企业开发团队而构建 - 由企业安全性和每项交易需求的许可提供支持。

1. 建立交易室 - “创建一个新的数据站点，为 Project Alpha 准备数据室，建立标准的并购文件夹索引，并邀请 sarah@advisorfirm.com 作为管理员。”

2. 按语义搜索文档 - “在数据室中搜索与未决诉讼或监管风险相关的任何文档。”

3. 跟踪买家问答 - “向我展示数据室中所有未解决的问答问题，并在我们有支持文件的情况下草拟答复。”

4. 审核交易室准备情况 - “在上线之前检查数据室是否有空文件夹、丢失文档以及任何标记为受密码保护或空白的文件。”

5. 管理用户访问权限 - “创建具有仅查看权限的买家角色，并为 Acme Capital 的以下五个联系人创建草稿邀请。”

plugin_asdk_app_6a33192d4f9481919b05403b.productIntro: ChatGPT 中的 Ashby 可让您即时访问您的渠道、候选人资料、空缺职位、面试和成绩单。提出问题，发现招聘趋势，并通过添加注释、移动阶段或直接从聊天中发送电子邮件来采取行动。 Ashby 通过安全的用户级 OAuth 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的实时招聘数据。每个请求和操作都会尊重您现有的权限，并且您的数据将受到保护。
plugin_asdk_app_6a33192d4f9481919b05403b.productIntroEn: Ashby in ChatGPT gives you instant access to your pipeline, candidate profiles, open jobs, interviews, and transcripts. Ask questions, uncover hiring trends, and take action by adding notes, moving stages, or sending emails directly from the chat. Ashby connects ChatGPT to your live recruiting data through secure user-level OAuth.
plugin_asdk_app_6a33192d4f9481919b05403b.longDescription:
Ashby in ChatGPT gives you instant access to your pipeline, candidate profiles, open jobs, interviews, and transcripts. Ask questions, uncover hiring trends, and take action by adding notes, moving stages, or sending emails directly from the chat. Ashby connects ChatGPT to your live recruiting data through secure user-level OAuth. Every request and action respects your existing permissions and your data stays protected.

Try prompts like these:
“Summarize our current engineering pipeline, highlight bottlenecks, and identify at-risk candidates.”
"Consider [Candidate Name] for our open Staff Engineer role and move them to the recruiter screen stage."
“Generate a debrief summary for [Candidate Name] using interview feedback, scorecards, and recruiter notes.”
“Analyze time-to-fill trends across sales roles and summarize where delays are occurring.”
plugin_asdk_app_6a33192d4f9481919b05403b.longDescriptionZh:
ChatGPT 中的 Ashby 可让您即时访问您的渠道、候选人资料、空缺职位、面试和成绩单。提出问题，发现招聘趋势，并通过添加注释、移动阶段或直接从聊天中发送电子邮件来采取行动。 Ashby 通过安全的用户级 OAuth 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的实时招聘数据。每个请求和操作都会尊重您现有的权限，并且您的数据将受到保护。

尝试这样的提示：
“总结我们当前的工程管道，突出瓶颈，并识别有风险的候选人。”
“考虑[候选人姓名]担任我们的公开工程师职位，并将其移至招聘人员筛选阶段。”
“使用面试反馈、记分卡和招聘人员笔记生成 [候选人姓名] 的汇报摘要。”
“分析各个销售角色的填补时间趋势，并总结出现延迟的情况。”

plugin_asdk_app_6a7c329c161c8191a8df6234.name: HoneyBook
plugin_asdk_app_6a7c329c161c8191a8df6234.productIntro: HoneyBook 是独立企业和精益团队处理客户工作的地方：查询、提案、合同、发票、付款以及其间的消息。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7c329c161c8191a8df6234.productIntroEn: HoneyBook is where independent businesses and lean teams run their client work: inquiries, proposals, contracts, invoices, payments and the messages in between.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7c329c161c8191a8df6234.longDescription:
HoneyBook is where independent businesses and lean teams run their client work: inquiries, proposals, contracts, invoices, payments and the messages in between.

Connect your account and work through a whole job in one conversation. Ask which leads are worth chasing and get a ranked answer from your own bookings. Have the proposal built from your saved template. Review it before it goes anywhere. Later, ask who still owes you money, and raise a payment request for whoever does.

You approve what it can reach before anything runs, resource by resource, and nothing reaches a client until you send it. Each request runs in an isolated environment, and your credentials are never shared with the model.

Built for photographers, event planners, venues, designers and consultants. Requires a HoneyBook account.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7c329c161c8191a8df6234.longDescriptionZh:
HoneyBook 是独立企业和精益团队处理客户工作的地方：查询、提案、合同、发票、付款以及其间的消息。

连接您的帐户并在一次对话中完成整个工作。询问哪些潜在客户值得追逐，并从您自己的预订中获得排名答案。根据您保存的模板构建提案。在它去任何地方之前检查它。然后，询问谁还欠你钱，并为欠你钱的人提出付款请求。

您可以在任何内容运行之前（逐个资源）批准它可以到达的内容，并且在您发送之前，没有任何内容到达客户端。每个请求都在隔离的环境中运行，并且您的凭据永远不会与模型共享。

专为摄影师、活动策划者、场馆、设计师和顾问而打造。需要 HoneyBook 帐户。
defaultPrompts: Which of my leads have gone quiet?
Who still owes me money?
Add a new contact for a client I just met
defaultPromptsZh: 我的哪些线索已经悄然消失？
谁还欠我钱？
为我刚刚认识的客户添加新联系人

plugin_asdk_app_69cdf9990c90819185974d87.name: LinkedIn Ads
plugin_asdk_app_69cdf9990c90819185974d87.productIntro: LinkedIn Ads 使广告组效果更易于理解和采取行动，帮助广告商将每一笔营销资金转化为业务增长。了解什么在起作用。建立信心。在您已经计划和分析的地方做出更明智的营销决策。将您的 LinkedIn Ads 帐户与 ChatGPT 连接起来即可开始。
plugin_asdk_app_69cdf9990c90819185974d87.productIntroEn: LinkedIn Ads helps advertisers turn every marketing dollar into business growth by making ad set performance easier to understand and act on. Understand what’s working. Build confidence. Make smarter marketing decisions—right where you already plan and analyze. Connect your LinkedIn Ads account with ChatGPT to get started.
plugin_asdk_app_69cdf9990c90819185974d87.longDescription:
LinkedIn Ads helps advertisers turn every marketing dollar into business growth by making ad set performance easier to understand and act on. Understand what’s working. Build confidence. Make smarter marketing decisions—right where you already plan and analyze. Connect your LinkedIn Ads account with ChatGPT to get started.

This app is currently in beta and supports a limited set of LinkedIn Ads functionality. It provides read‑only access to ad set performance to help you understand results. Supported features and use cases may evolve as we expand tool coverage. 

In this beta, you can:
- View and search ad accounts and ad sets you have access to
- Ask natural-language questions about ad set and ad performance
- Break down metrics by date range, ad set, or ad

Ask questions like:
- "Show me all my active ad sets from account X"
- “How did my ad sets from account X perform last week?”
- “Which ads have the highest CTR in ad set Y?”
plugin_asdk_app_69cdf9990c90819185974d87.longDescriptionZh:
LinkedIn Ads 使广告组效果更易于理解和采取行动，帮助广告商将每一笔营销资金转化为业务增长。了解什么在起作用。建立信心。在您已经计划和分析的地方做出更明智的营销决策。将您的 LinkedIn Ads 帐户与 ChatGPT 连接起来即可开始。

此应用程序目前处于测试阶段，支持有限的 LinkedIn 广告功能。它提供对广告组效果的只读访问，以帮助您了解结果。随着我们扩大工具覆盖范围，支持的功能和用例可能会不断发展。 

在此测试版中，您可以：
- 查看和搜索您有权访问的广告帐户和广告集
- 询问有关广告设置和广告效果的自然语言问题
- 按日期范围、广告组或广告细分指标

提出以下问题：
- “显示帐户 X 中所有有效的广告组”
- “上周我来自帐户 X 的广告组效果如何？”
- “广告组 Y 中哪些广告的点击率最高？”

plugin_asdk_app_69c1aef8ec908191b4c537b9.productIntro: Adobe Marketing Agent for ChatGPT Enterprise 可让您使用自然语言与 Adobe Experience Platform AI Agent 进行交互。无需离开工作流程即可提出问题、获取见解并采取行动。
plugin_asdk_app_69c1aef8ec908191b4c537b9.productIntroEn: Adobe Marketing Agent for ChatGPT Enterprise lets you interact with Adobe Experience Platform AI Agents using natural language. Ask questions, get insights, and take action without leaving your workflow.
plugin_asdk_app_69c1aef8ec908191b4c537b9.longDescription:
Adobe Marketing Agent for ChatGPT Enterprise lets you interact with Adobe Experience Platform AI Agents using natural language. Ask questions, get insights, and take action without leaving your workflow. It understands your intent and connects with Adobe solutions like Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, and Customer Journey Analytics to deliver answers that help teams move faster and work smarter. In order to use this app an Adobe account is required, please reach out to Adobe administrator in your organization.

Language Support: AI Assistant is currently supported in English only. Non-English inputs may produce inconsistent or erroneous results.

Personal Data: If you include personal data in your prompts, only add what's necessary and only if you have the right to use it.
plugin_asdk_app_69c1aef8ec908191b4c537b9.longDescriptionZh:
Adobe Marketing Agent for ChatGPT Enterprise 可让您使用自然语言与 Adobe Experience Platform AI Agent 进行交互。无需离开工作流程即可提出问题、获取见解并采取行动。它了解您的意图，并与 Real-Time CDP、Journey Optimizer 和 Customer Journey Analytics 等 Adob​​e 解决方案连接，提供答案，帮助团队更快地行动、更智能地工作。为了使用此应用程序，需要 Adob​​e 帐户，请联系您组织中的 Adob​​e 管理员。

语言支持：AI助手目前仅支持英语。非英语输入可能会产生不一致或错误的结果。

个人数据：如果您在提示中包含个人数据，请仅添加必要的数据，并且仅在您有权使用时添加。

plugin_asdk_app_6a463643f0ac8191828c01f4.productIntro: SiteGuru 帮助营销人员优化他们的网站以进行 SEO。它运行广泛的技术、链接和内容审核，并从 Google 获取您的关键字和访问数据。结合起来，这为您提供了优先的 SEO 待办事项列表、高级排名跟踪以及对网站 SEO 的详细见解。
plugin_asdk_app_6a463643f0ac8191828c01f4.productIntroEn: SiteGuru helps marketers optimize their website for SEO. It runs an extensive technical, link and content audit, and gets your keyword and visit data from Google. Combined, this gives you a prioritized SEO todo list, advanced rank tracking, and detailed insights into your site's SEO.

plugin_asdk_app_6a02832083a48191929828b6.name: Process Documentation AI
plugin_asdk_app_6a02832083a48191929828b6.productIntro: 免费的人工智能工具，可记录任何业务流程或工作流程。用简单的英语描述您的流程，并收到一个执行就绪的程序，其中包括：结构化部分、编号步骤、角色分配（谁做什么）、截止日期指导、任务类型分类以及解释如何使流程自动运行的单独 Tallyfy 自动化部分。输出是一个可下载的 Word 文档，其中包含营销序言和背页 CTA，可在tallyfy.com/start 免费注册、上传文档并将其转换为实时可跟踪工作流程。使用此工具无需注册或帐户。
plugin_asdk_app_6a02832083a48191929828b6.productIntroEn: Free AI tool that documents any business process or workflow. Describe your process in plain English and receive an execution-ready procedure with: structured sections, numbered steps, role assignments (who does what), deadline guidance, task type classification, and a separate Tallyfy automation section explaining how to make the process self-running.
plugin_asdk_app_6a02832083a48191929828b6.longDescription: Free AI tool that documents any business process or workflow. Describe your process in plain English and receive an execution-ready procedure with: structured sections, numbered steps, role assignments (who does what), deadline guidance, task type classification, and a separate Tallyfy automation section explaining how to make the process self-running. Output is a downloadable Word document with a marketing preamble and a back-page CTA to sign up at tallyfy.com/start for free, upload the document, and convert it into a live trackable workflow. No sign-up or account required to use this tool. Perfect for documenting SOPs, hiring workflows, customer onboarding, vendor approval chains, expense procedures, incident response runbooks, and any other repeatable business process. Built by Tallyfy, a workflow automation platform for teams.

plugin_asdk_app_6a572fb267d88191b53eed4e.productIntro: Windsor.ai Instagram 帮助创作者和营销人员分析 Instagram 的实时有机表现。用户可以发现已连接的 Instagram Business 或 Creator 帐户，检查有效字段和选项，查询帐户和媒体见解（关注者、覆盖范围、展示次数、个人资料和网站点击量以及参与度）并连接 Instagram 连接器。
plugin_asdk_app_6a572fb267d88191b53eed4e.productIntroEn: Windsor.ai Instagram helps creators and marketers analyze live Instagram organic performance. Users can discover connected Instagram Business or Creator accounts, inspect valid fields and options, query account and media insights — followers, reach, impressions, profile and website clicks, and engagement — and connect the Instagram connector.
plugin_asdk_app_6a572fb267d88191b53eed4e.longDescription: Windsor.ai Instagram helps creators and marketers analyze live Instagram organic performance. Users can discover connected Instagram Business or Creator accounts, inspect valid fields and options, query account and media insights — followers, reach, impressions, profile and website clicks, and engagement — and connect the Instagram connector. It covers organic Instagram analytics only: it does not run write actions (Instagram publishing is not enabled), cover Instagram Ads (use the Meta Ads connector), or provide ad cost data. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
plugin_asdk_app_6a572fb267d88191b53eed4e.longDescriptionZh: Windsor.ai Instagram 帮助创作者和营销人员分析 Instagram 的实时有机表现。用户可以发现已连接的 Instagram Business 或 Creator 帐户，检查有效字段和选项，查询帐户和媒体见解（关注者、覆盖范围、展示次数、个人资料和网站点击量以及参与度）并连接 Instagram 连接器。它仅涵盖有机 Instagram 分析：它不运行写入操作（未启用 Instagram 发布）、涵盖 Instagram 广告（使用元广告连接器）或提供广告成本数据。 Windsor.ai 是一个独立的产品，不隶属于其所连接的平台，也不受其认可。

Streak is a CRM built directly into Gmail, so you can track deals, contacts, and workflows from your inbox.

Emails are logged automatically, pipelines update as conversations move forward, and notes and tasks stay attached to the work they belong to—without copying data into another tool.

plugin_asdk_app_69c236abbea481918d9180a1.description: 为建筑商提供更快的电子邮件
plugin_asdk_app_69c236abbea481918d9180a1.productIntro: Nitrosend 是人工智能原生电子邮件营销平台。将其连接到 ChatGPT 并通过对话控制您的整个电子邮件堆栈。
plugin_asdk_app_69c236abbea481918d9180a1.productIntroEn: Nitrosend is the AI-native email marketing platform. Connect it to ChatGPT and control your entire email stack through conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_69c236abbea481918d9180a1.longDescription:
Nitrosend is the AI-native email marketing platform. Connect it to ChatGPT and control your entire email stack through conversation.

What you can do:
- Create and send email campaigns with GPT/Codex written copy
- Build automation flows (welcome series, onboarding, win-back, cart abandonment)
- Send transactional email (password resets, receipts, verification)
- Manage contacts, lists, and segments
- Monitor email analytics and get improvement recommendations
- Design emails that match your brand automatically

Nitrosend learns your brand voice and gets smarter with every send. Bring your own sending infrastructure (SendGrid, SES, Postmark, Resend) or use ours. Unlimited contacts on every plan.

Built by the team behind SmartrMail (10 billion emails, acquired 2022) and Sendicate (28,000 users).

Get started: sign up at app.nitrosend.com, then connect Nitrosend from the ChatGPT App Directory.
plugin_asdk_app_69c236abbea481918d9180a1.longDescriptionZh:
Nitrosend 是人工智能原生电子邮件营销平台。将其连接到 ChatGPT 并通过对话控制您的整个电子邮件堆栈。

你可以做什么：
- 使用 GPT/Codex 书面副本创建和发送电子邮件活动
- 构建自动化流程（欢迎系列、入职、赢回、放弃购物车）
- 发送交易电子邮件（密码重置、收据、验证）
- 管理联系人、列表和细分
- 监控电子邮件分析并获取改进建议
- 自动设计与您的品牌相匹配的电子邮件

Nitrosend 会学习您的品牌声音，并在每次发送时变得更加智能。自带发送基础设施（SendGrid、SES、Postmark、Resend）或使用我们的。每个计划的联系次数不受限制。

由 SmartrMail（100 亿封电子邮件，2022 年收购）和 Sendicate（28,000 名用户）背后的团队构建。

开始使用：在 app.nitrosend.com 上注册，然后从 ChatGPT 应用程序目录连接 Nitrosend。

plugin_asdk_app_6a01ab92a89881919b46e570.longDescription:
Trouvez un emploi rapidement, facilement, et à proximité grâce à l’application Hellowork pour ChatGPT.

Chaque jour, c'est 8 000 candidats qui trouvent un nouveau job grâce à Hellowork. De nombreuses offres d’emploi sont disponibles chaque mois, partout en France, dans tous les secteurs d’activité. Que vous recherchiez un CDI, un CDD, une alternance, un stage ou une mission d’intérim, Hellowork vous accompagne à chaque étape pour trouver un job adapté à votre profil.

plugin_asdk_app_696cff9a48cc8191b5c0e3c7.name: Pet Project Co-Founder AI
plugin_asdk_app_696cff9a48cc8191b5c0e3c7.productIntro: “宠物项目联合创始人AI”是您的市场研究助手。
plugin_asdk_app_696cff9a48cc8191b5c0e3c7.productIntroEn: "Pet Project Co-Founder AI" is your market research assistant.
plugin_asdk_app_696cff9a48cc8191b5c0e3c7.longDescription:
"Pet Project Co-Founder AI" is your market research assistant.

It will help you validate product ideas using real data from trusted market research services. No more guesses or hallucinations. Instead of relying on plain LLM-only answers, you will use raw market data interpreted by ChatGPT as clear insights.

You do not need prior marketing experience. You just ask a question and the app builds a market research plan for you. The plan will include gathering data from third-party services. You are guided through what services to use and what queries to run there. After you use the recommended service, you copy-paste their data back to the app and get a clear interpretation from ChatGPT.

Examples of questions you can get answers to:
- "I have an idea for the app X. Is there enough demand to justify building it?"
- "What are people searching for when they want Y?"
- "Who exactly is my target user for the app Z? What platforms do they use?"
- "I built an app W. Where do I find users for it?"

For now, the following services are supported:
- SparkToro — audience intelligence (who your users are, what they read, who they follow)
- Ubersuggest — keyword demand and SEO metrics
- AnswerThePublic — real search questions and phrasing

Disclaimers:
- This app does not automatically gather data from the recommended market research services. The app helps with building search queries for these services and reporting the resulting data back. But you will need to visit and use these services yourself. We do not automatically scrape data from these services.
- This app does not provide paid subscriptions to the recommended market research services. You use these services according to their terms of use.
- This app currently supports a limited set of services: SparkToro, Ubersuggest, and AnswerThePublic. Only these services may be recommended during marketing research. Keep in mind that there are other good services for market research on the internet, we just do not support them yet. You can request adding new services by emailing the [developer@petprojectcofounder.ai](mailto:developer@petprojectcofounder.ai)
- For the best experience, it is recommended to use this app on desktop
plugin_asdk_app_696cff9a48cc8191b5c0e3c7.longDescriptionZh:
“宠物项目联合创始人AI”是您的市场研究助手。

它将帮助您使用来自可信市场研究服务的真实数据来验证产品创意。不再有猜测或幻觉。您将使用 ChatGPT 解释的原始市场数据作为清晰的见解，而不是依赖纯 LLM 的答案。

您不需要事先的营销经验。您只需提出问题，应用程序就会为您制定市场研究计划。该计划将包括从第三方服务收集数据。系统会指导您使用哪些服务以及要运行哪些查询。使用推荐的服务后，您将其数据复制粘贴回应用程序，并从 ChatGPT 获得清晰的解释。

您可以获得答案的问题示例：
- “我对应用程序 X 有一个想法。是否有足够的需求来证明构建它的合理性？”
- “当人们想要 Y 时，他们在寻找什么？”
- “我的应用 Z 的目标用户到底是谁？他们使用什么平台？”
- “我构建了一个应用程序 W。我在哪里可以找到它的用户？”

目前，支持以下服务：
- SparkToro — 受众情报（您的用户是谁，他们读什么，他们关注谁）
- Ubersuggest — 关键词需求和 SEO 指标
- AnswerThePublic — 真实的搜索问题和措辞

免责声明：
- 此应用程序不会自动从推荐的市场研究服务收集数据。该应用程序有助于为这些服务构建搜索查询并报告结果数据。但您需要亲自访问和使用这些服务。我们不会自动从这些服务中抓取数据。
- 此应用程序不提供推荐的市场研究服务的付费订阅。您根据这些服务的使用条款使用这些服务。
- 此应用程序目前支持一组有限的服务：SparkToro、Ubersuggest 和 AnswerThePublic。在营销研究期间只能推荐这些服务。请记住，互联网上还有其他很好的市场研究服务，只是我们还不支持它们。您可以通过发送电子邮件至 [developer@petprojectcoFounder.ai](mailto:developer@petprojectcoFounder.ai) 请求添加新服务
- 为了获得最佳体验，建议在桌面上使用此应用程序

plugin_asdk_app_6952abb0d70881919c298489.productIntroEn: The human intelligence layer for AI.
plugin_asdk_app_6952abb0d70881919c298489.longDescription:
The human intelligence layer for AI.

OriginalVoices gives ChatGPT instant access to real human perspectives - so you can ground decisions and AI outputs in what your target audience actually thinks, feels, and values.

Instead of guessing or relying on assumptions, get authentic feedback from real people directly inside ChatGPT. Share ideas, test messaging, validate concepts, or explore what matters to any audience - and use those insights to understand your audience, inform better decisions and create more targeted AI outputs.

With OriginalVoices, you can:
- Define any target audience
- Share anything - questions, links, copy, product concepts, campaign ideas
- Get instant responses from our network of tens of thousands of Digital Twins - AI representations of real people, each owned, trained, and validated by the person they represent

What you can use OriginalVoices for
- OriginalVoices brings real human intelligence into ChatGPT - turning every conversation into an opportunity to understand and act on authentic audience perspectives.
- Test messaging, copy, or creative concepts with your target audience
- Understand what people care about and why it matters to them
- Get feedback on landing pages, product ideas, or campaign strategies
- Create content and ads that resonates with specific audiences
- Compare perspectives across different demographics or segments
- Conduct qualitative research without the wait

How it works
- Tag OriginalVoices in ChatGPT
- Describe your target audience (e.g., "parents of toddlers in the UK," "Gen Z interested in sustainability," "small business owners")
- Share what you want feedback on - a question, a URL, an idea, copy you've written - anything
- OriginalVoices identifies relevant Digital Twins and gathers their responses. Individual perspectives are returned directly in ChatGPT, giving you real human context to inform decisions and shape outputs.
- Get started with the OriginalVoices ChatGPT App today - and bring real human insight into your AI workflows.
plugin_asdk_app_6952abb0d70881919c298489.longDescriptionZh:
人工智能的人类智能层。

OriginalVoices 使 ChatGPT 能够即时访问真实的人类观点 - 因此您可以根据目标受众的实际想法、感受和价值观来制定决策和 AI 输出。

不要猜测或依赖假设，而是直接从 ChatGPT 内的真人那里获得真实的反馈。分享想法、测试消息传递、验证概念或探索对任何受众而言重要的内容 - 并利用这些见解来了解您的受众、为更好的决策提供信息并创建更有针对性的 AI 输出。

使用 OriginalVoices，您可以：
- 定义任何目标受众
- 分享任何内容 - 问题、链接、文案、产品概念、活动创意
- 从我们数以万计的数字孪生网络中获取即时响应 - 真人的人工智能表示，每个人都由他们所代表的人拥有、训练和验证

OriginalVoices 的用途
- OriginalVoices 将真正的人类智能带入 ChatGPT - 将每次对话变成了解真实受众观点并采取行动的机会。
- 与目标受众测试消息传递、文案或创意概念
- 了解人们关心什么以及为什么这对他们很重要
- 获取有关登陆页面、产品创意或活动策略的反馈
- 创建与特定受众产生共鸣的内容和广告
- 比较不同人口统计数据或细分市场的观点
- 无需等待即可进行定性研究

它是如何运作的
- 在 ChatGPT 中标记 OriginalVoices
- 描述您的目标受众（例如，“英国幼儿的父母”、“对可持续发展感兴趣的 Z 世代”、“小企业主”）
- 分享您想要反馈的内容 - 问题、URL、想法、您所写的副本 - 任何内容
- OriginalVoices 识别相关的数字孪生并收集他们的回应。个人观点直接在 ChatGPT 中返回，为您提供真实的人类背景来指导决策和塑造输出。
- 立即开始使用 OriginalVoices ChatGPT 应用程序 - 并将真实的人类洞察力带入您的 AI 工作流程。

plugin_asdk_app_6a288e8ae66881919a04a607.name: Postbeam
plugin_asdk_app_6a288e8ae66881919a04a607.productIntro: Postbeam 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 LinkedIn 内容工作流程，以便您无需离开聊天即可起草、审阅、安排和分析帖子。
plugin_asdk_app_6a288e8ae66881919a04a607.productIntroEn: Postbeam connects ChatGPT to your LinkedIn content workflow so you can draft, review, schedule, and analyze posts without leaving the chat.
plugin_asdk_app_6a288e8ae66881919a04a607.longDescription:
Postbeam connects ChatGPT to your LinkedIn content workflow so you can draft, review, schedule, and analyze posts without leaving the chat. 

Once connected with your Postbeam account, ChatGPT works directly with your real posts, your writing guidance, and your performance data. Turning a chat box into the place you actually run your LinkedIn presence & strategy.

Draft in your voice, from your real work:
Ask ChatGPT to write a post and it pulls in your Postbeam content training, your mission, audience, format rules, and content sources so every draft sounds like you, not generic. Because it's working inside ChatGPT, it can also draw raw material from the other tools you've connected (Slack threads, Gmail, meeting recorders like Fellow or Granola) and turn a real customer calls, shipped features, or team wins into finished posts. Drafts are saved straight into Postbeam for review.

Edit, organize, and manage your queue:
Review your most recent drafts, pull up any single post, and edit its copy or title — all by chatting. You can attach media: images, video, or carousel posts. List posts by status (draft, approved, scheduled) to see exactly where everything stands.

Approve and schedule when you're ready:
When a draft is ready, ChatGPT can approve it and schedule it to publish to your connected LinkedIn at a specific time. Nothing publishes automatically drafts stay drafts until a person decides otherwise, and approving or scheduling respects the permissions on your account.

Understand what's working:
Ask what's performing and get answers from your cached analytics: account-level totals (impressions, reactions, comments, reshares, followers gained, members reached) with a daily trend, plus per-post breakdowns over 30-, 90-, or 365-day windows. Use it to spot your best formats and hooks, then immediately draft your next post in that proven style.

Built for teams and agencies:
Postbeam supports multiple accounts in one place. ChatGPT can list every account you can access, so agencies and teams can switch between clients or teammates and keep each person's drafts, approvals, and analytics cleanly separated.
plugin_asdk_app_6a288e8ae66881919a04a607.longDescriptionZh:
Postbeam 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 LinkedIn 内容工作流程，以便您无需离开聊天即可起草、审阅、安排和分析帖子。 

与您的 Postbeam 帐户连接后，ChatGPT 会直接处理您的真实帖子、写作指导和表现数据。将聊天框变成您实际运行 LinkedIn 形象和策略的地方。

从你的真实作品中用你的声音草稿：
要求 ChatGPT 写一篇文章，它会引入您的 Postbeam 内容培训、您的使命、受众、格式规则和内容源，因此每个草稿听起来都像您，而不是通用的。因为它在 ChatGPT 内部工作，所以它还可以从您连接的其他工具（Slack 线程、Gmail、Fellow 或 Granola 等会议记录器）中提取原材料，并将真实的客户呼叫、交付的功能或团队胜利转化为完成的帖子。草稿直接保存到 Postbeam 中以供审阅。

编辑、组织和管理您的队列：
查看您最近的草稿，提取任何单个帖子，并编辑其副本或标题 - 所有这些都通过聊天进行。您可以附加媒体：图像、视频或轮播帖子。按状态（草稿、已批准、已计划）列出帖子，以准确了解所有内容的情况。

准备好后批准并安排：
草稿准备好后，ChatGPT 可以批准它并安排其在特定时间发布到您连接的 LinkedIn。任何内容都不会自动发布，草稿将保留草稿，除非有人另有决定，并且批准或安排会尊重您帐户的权限。

了解什么在起作用：
询问正在执行的操作并从缓存的分析中获取答案：帐户级总计（展示次数、反应、评论、转发、获得的关注者、达到的会员数）以及每日趋势，以及 30 天、90 天或 365 天窗口内每个帖子的细分。用它来发现你最好的格式和亮点，然后立即以这种经过验证的风格起草你的下一篇文章。

专为团队和机构打造：
Postbeam 支持一处多个帐户。 ChatGPT 可以列出您可以访问的每个帐户，因此机构和团队可以在客户或团队成员之间切换，并保持每个人的草稿、批准和分析清晰分离。
defaultPrompts: Show me my last posts
Create me a post
Show me my analytics
defaultPromptsZh: 显示我最近的帖子
为我创建一个帖子
显示我的分析

plugin_asdk_app_69ef3e92e16c81918e81d559.description: 构建并运行表格或调查
plugin_asdk_app_69ef3e92e16c81918e81d559.originalDescription: Build and run forms or surveys
plugin_asdk_app_69ef3e92e16c81918e81d559.productIntro: 创建调查和表格，将其分发给受访者并分析结果 - 所有这些都在使用 SurveySparrow 应用程序的单个 ChatGPT 对话中完成。
plugin_asdk_app_69ef3e92e16c81918e81d559.productIntroEn: Create surveys and forms, distribute them to respondents, and analyze the results — all within a single ChatGPT conversation using the SurveySparrow app.
plugin_asdk_app_69ef3e92e16c81918e81d559.longDescription:
Create surveys and forms, distribute them to respondents, and analyze the results — all within a single ChatGPT conversation using the SurveySparrow app.

What you can do:
- Design surveys and forms for any use-case (NPS, feedback, employee engagement, and more)
- Publish surveys to your SurveySparrow account and distribute them via email, SMS, or WhatsApp
- Review live response counts and track survey activity across your account
- Analyze responses and surface patterns or key themes from collected data

Example prompts:

1. Build a survey
"Create an NPS survey for customers who purchased in the last 30 days with a rating scale and an open-ended follow-up question"

2. Edit a survey
"Add a required email field and make question 5 more concise"

3. Publish a survey
"Publish this survey to my SurveySparrow account so it's ready to collect responses"

4. Share a survey
"Send this NPS survey to my customer list via email"

5. Check response activity
"How many people have completed the customer feedback form?"

6. Track your survey library
"How many NPS surveys are active right now?"

7. Analyze responses
"Group the responses by common themes and show me the top 3 insights"

Requirements: An active SurveySparrow account is required to use this app.
plugin_asdk_app_69ef3e92e16c81918e81d559.longDescriptionZh:
创建调查和表格，将其分发给受访者并分析结果 - 所有这些都在使用 SurveySparrow 应用程序的单个 ChatGPT 对话中完成。

你可以做什么：
- 为任何用例（NPS、反馈、员工敬业度等）设计调查和表格
- 将调查发布到您的 SurveySparrow 帐户并通过电子邮件、短信或 WhatsApp 分发
- 查看实时回复计数并跟踪整个帐户的调查活动
- 从收集的数据中分析反应和表面模式或关键主题

提示示例：

1. 开展调查
“为过去 30 天内购买过商品的客户创建 NPS 调查，其中包含评级量表和开放式后续问题”

2. 编辑调查
“添加必填电子邮件字段并使问题 5 更加简洁”

3. 发布调查
“将此调查发布到我的 SurveySparrow 帐户，以便准备收集回复”

4. 分享调查
“通过电子邮件将此 NPS 调查发送到我的客户列表”

5. 检查响应活动
“有多少人填写了客户反馈表？”

6. 跟踪您的调查库
“目前有多少 NPS 调查正在进行？”

7. 分析回应
“按共同主题对回复进行分组，并向我展示最重要的 3 个见解”

要求：使用此应用程序需要有效的 SurveySparrow 帐户。

plugin_asdk_app_6a033addd77881918cea85cd.longDescription: Vanta helps users review compliance tests, controls, evidence, policies, risks, vendors, audits, personnel, access reviews, and vulnerabilities in ChatGPT. Supported workflows include managing tests and controls, uploading and evaluating evidence, creating and deleting policies, updating risk and vendor records, configuring SLAs, and managing AI governance records, questionnaires, and knowledge base resources. plugin_asdk_app_69aa1c0bff9c8191a188ab4d.longDescription:
LicitaLAB permite encontrar, analizar y entender compras públicas de forma rápida y estructurada.

Los usuarios pueden explorar oportunidades, revisar documentos asociados y tomar decisiones informadas en menos tiempo. Además, pueden hacer preguntas en lenguaje natural sobre oportunidades específicas, proveedores, compradores y sobre el uso de la plataforma.
LicitaLAB está diseñada para profesionales y organizaciones que participan en compras públicas y necesitan evaluar múltiples procesos de manera eficiente, reduciendo el tiempo de análisis y mejorando la calidad de sus ofertas.

LicitaLAB 是专业人士和组织参与公共比较和必要评估的多个过程，以有效管理、减少分析时间和提高工作效率。

plugin_asdk_app_6a27216254c88191b7b96690.description: 格子，无论您在哪里工作。
plugin_asdk_app_6a27216254c88191b7b96690.productIntro: 绩效管理不仅仅发生在绩效管理软件中。这种情况每天都会以一对一的方式发生，在 Slack 中，在晚上 9 点起草的文档中，并且越来越多地在您在发送电子邮件之前打开的 AI 助手中发生。 Lattice MCP 将您已经收集的每个信号（评论、1:1、反馈、目标和每周更新）连接到 ChatGPT 中，因此您已经使用的代理最终可以像您一样查看您的团队。
plugin_asdk_app_6a27216254c88191b7b96690.productIntroEn: Performance management doesn't happen just in performance management software. It happens every day in 1:1s, in Slack, in the doc you're drafting at 9pm, and increasingly in the AI assistant you open before your email.
plugin_asdk_app_6a27216254c88191b7b96690.longDescription:
Performance management doesn't happen just in performance management software. It happens every day in 1:1s, in Slack, in the doc you're drafting at 9pm, and increasingly in the AI assistant you open before your email. Lattice MCP connects every signal you've already collected (reviews, 1:1s, feedback, goals, and weekly updates) into ChatGPT, so the agent you already use can finally see your team the way you do.

Ask a question, get an answer grounded in your actual people data. Draft an accurate review in 90 seconds. Submit it without leaving the conversation. Outline the calibration story before justifying it in the meeting. Because Lattice MCP respects your existing Lattice permissions, every answer is scoped to exactly what you'd see in-product.

For AI-native organizations with adoption initiatives already in motion and other MCP connectors running in their stack, Lattice MCP is the missing piece. Bring your reviews, 1:1s, feedback, goals, and updates into the same chat your managers are already prompting in. Draft from the full picture. Submit the result back to Lattice without ever leaving the conversation. That's the round-trip no other best-in-class Performance Management tool completes today.
plugin_asdk_app_6a27216254c88191b7b96690.longDescriptionZh:
绩效管理不仅仅发生在绩效管理软件中。这种情况每天都会以一对一的方式发生，在 Slack 中，在晚上 9 点起草的文档中，并且越来越多地在您在发送电子邮件之前打开的 AI 助手中发生。 Lattice MCP 将您已经收集的每个信号（评论、1:1、反馈、目标和每周更新）连接到 ChatGPT 中，因此您已经使用的代理最终可以像您一样查看您的团队。

提出问题，并根据您的实际人员数据获得答案。 90 秒内起草准确的评论。无需离开对话即可提交。在会议上论证校准故事的合理性之前，概述校准故事。由于莱迪思 MCP 尊重您现有的莱迪思权限，因此每个答案的范围都与您在产品中看到的内容完全一致。

对于已经采取举措并在其堆栈中运行其他 MCP 连接器的 AI 原生组织来说，莱迪思 MCP 是缺失的部分。将您的评论、一对一、反馈、目标和更新带入您的经理已经提示的同一个聊天中。从全局中起草。将结果提交回莱迪思，无需离开对话。这是当今其他一流绩效管理工具无法完成的往返过程。

plugin_asdk_app_6a10828962c4819182e4fb78.name: BrightEdge
plugin_asdk_app_6a10828962c4819182e4fb78.description: 分析 AEO 和 SEO 可见性
plugin_asdk_app_6a10828962c4819182e4fb78.productIntro: BrightEdge 应用程序从用户连接的 BrightEdge 帐户检索指标，涵盖法学硕士的 AEO、GEO 和传统 SEO 绩效。它返回 AEO 引用和提及、AEO 和 SEO 竞争对手基准测试、关键字排名数据、页面级性能、语音份额竞争分数、Google Search Console 和网络分析指标、AI 概述引用差距分析和建议。
plugin_asdk_app_6a10828962c4819182e4fb78.productIntroEn: The BrightEdge app retrieves metrics from a user's connected BrightEdge account, covering both AEO, GEO, and traditional SEO performance across LLMs. It returns AEO citations and mentions, AEO and SEO competitor benchmarking, keyword rank data, page-level performance, Share of Voice competitive scores, Google Search Console and web analytics metrics, AI Overview citation gap analysis, an…
plugin_asdk_app_6a10828962c4819182e4fb78.longDescription: The BrightEdge app retrieves metrics from a user's connected BrightEdge account, covering both AEO, GEO, and traditional SEO performance across LLMs. It returns AEO citations and mentions, AEO and SEO competitor benchmarking, keyword rank data, page-level performance, Share of Voice competitive scores, Google Search Console and web analytics metrics, AI Overview citation gap analysis, and recommendations. Invoke this app when a user requests prompt citations or mentions, keyword rankings, keyword and prompt management, AEO and SEO competitive visibility, including queries phrased as improvement guidance that require account-specific data rather than general inference. ChatGPT helps users work with BrightEdge data more effectively by combining analyses across different datasets, asking follow-up questions, and turning SEO and AEO metrics into clear insights within a single conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a10828962c4819182e4fb78.longDescriptionZh: BrightEdge 应用程序从用户连接的 BrightEdge 帐户检索指标，涵盖法学硕士的 AEO、GEO 和传统 SEO 绩效。它返回 AEO 引用和提及、AEO 和 SEO 竞争对手基准测试、关键字排名数据、页面级性能、语音份额竞争分数、Google Search Console 和网络分析指标、AI 概述引用差距分析和建议。当用户请求提示引用或提及、关键字排名、关键字和提示管理、AEO 和 SEO 竞争可见性时调用此应用程序，包括作为改进指导而提出的查询，这些查询需要特定于帐户的数据而不是一般推理。 ChatGPT 通过结合不同数据集的分析、提出后续问题以及在单个对话中将 SEO 和 AEO 指标转化为清晰的见解，帮助用户更有效地使用 BrightEdge 数据。
defaultPrompts: Which sections of my site are losing the most organic visibility this month compared to last month?
How did my brand's mention share and citation share trend in Google AI Overview in the past quarter?
Which of my tracked keywords dropped from page 1 in Google search this week?
defaultPromptsZh: 与上个月相比，本月我网站的哪些部分失去了最大的自然可见度？
上个季度我的品牌在 Google AI Overview 中的提及份额和引用份额趋势如何？
本周我跟踪的哪些关键字从 Google 搜索的第一页下降？

plugin_asdk_app_6a62159630d881919ab11017.name: iubenda
plugin_asdk_app_6a62159630d881919ab11017.description: Web 和应用程序隐私合规性
plugin_asdk_app_6a62159630d881919ab11017.productIntro: 将您的 AI 助手连接到 iubenda，以自始至终处理网站的法律合规性。创建和管理网站、生成适合您使用的服务的隐私和 cookie 策略、从 iubenda 目录添加数据处理服务、设置 cookie 同意横幅以及起草条款和条件，所有这些都通过自然语言进行。运行 cookie 扫描以检测跟踪器，然后更新您的策略以匹配您的网站更改。专为需要满足 GDPR、ePrivacy、美国各州隐私法以及跨市场隐私要求的创始人、机构和开发人员而构建，无需手动开销。
plugin_asdk_app_6a62159630d881919ab11017.productIntroEn: Connect your AI assistant to iubenda to handle website legal compliance from start to finish. Create and manage sites, generate privacy and cookie policies tailored to the services you use, add data-processing services from iubenda's catalog, set up cookie consent banners, and draft terms and conditions, all through natural language.
plugin_asdk_app_6a62159630d881919ab11017.longDescription: Connect your AI assistant to iubenda to handle website legal compliance from start to finish. Create and manage sites, generate privacy and cookie policies tailored to the services you use, add data-processing services from iubenda's catalog, set up cookie consent banners, and draft terms and conditions, all through natural language. Run cookie scans to detect trackers, then update your policies to match as your site changes. Built for founders, agencies, and developers who need to meet GDPR, ePrivacy, US state privacy laws, and privacy requirements across markets, without the manual overhead.
plugin_asdk_app_6a62159630d881919ab11017.longDescriptionZh: 将您的 AI 助手连接到 iubenda，以自始至终处理网站的法律合规性。创建和管理网站、生成适合您使用的服务的隐私和 cookie 策略、从 iubenda 目录添加数据处理服务、设置 cookie 同意横幅以及起草条款和条件，所有这些都通过自然语言进行。运行 cookie 扫描以检测跟踪器，然后更新您的策略以匹配您的网站更改。专为需要满足 GDPR、ePrivacy、美国各州隐私法以及跨市场隐私要求的创始人、机构和开发人员而构建，无需手动开销。

plugin_asdk_app_6a568445c1d48191b42d9a21.name: GST Invoice Maker
plugin_asdk_app_6a568445c1d48191b42d9a21.description: 免费打印 GST 账单
plugin_asdk_app_6a568445c1d48191b42d9a21.productIntro: GST Invoice Maker 为印度商店、餐馆、基拉纳斯和自由职业者创建符合 GST 的账单。索要简单语言的账单，并获得计算出的总计以及打开完全填写的账单的链接 - 可以打印或另存为 PDF。还提供现成的可下载帐单格式 PDF 和 GST 参考指南（必填发票字段、费率表）。免费，无需帐户，账单数据在内存中处理，从不存储。
plugin_asdk_app_6a568445c1d48191b42d9a21.productIntroEn: GST Invoice Maker creates GST-compliant bills for Indian shops, restaurants, kiranas, and freelancers. Ask for a bill in plain language and get computed totals plus a link that opens the bill fully filled in — ready to print or save as PDF. Also provides ready-made downloadable bill format PDFs and a GST reference guide (required invoice fields, rate slabs).
plugin_asdk_app_6a568445c1d48191b42d9a21.longDescription: GST Invoice Maker creates GST-compliant bills for Indian shops, restaurants, kiranas, and freelancers. Ask for a bill in plain language and get computed totals plus a link that opens the bill fully filled in — ready to print or save as PDF. Also provides ready-made downloadable bill format PDFs and a GST reference guide (required invoice fields, rate slabs). Free, no account needed, and bill data is processed in-memory — never stored.
plugin_asdk_app_6a568445c1d48191b42d9a21.longDescriptionZh: GST Invoice Maker 为印度商店、餐馆、基拉纳斯和自由职业者创建符合 GST 的账单。索要简单语言的账单，并获得计算出的总计以及打开完全填写的账单的链接 - 可以打印或另存为 PDF。还提供现成的可下载帐单格式 PDF 和 GST 参考指南（必填发票字段、费率表）。免费，无需帐户，账单数据在内存中处理，从不存储。

plugin_asdk_app_6a1ed22d523481918b6f6d8a.name: Canonical Company Search
plugin_asdk_app_6a1ed22d523481918b6f6d8a.productIntro: Canonical 是经过验证的公司搜索研究和勘探。
plugin_asdk_app_6a1ed22d523481918b6f6d8a.productIntroEn: Canonical is verified company search for research and prospecting.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1ed22d523481918b6f6d8a.longDescription:
Canonical is verified company search for research and prospecting.

  - Describe companies in plain language, or use structured filters like location, headcount, funding stage, investor, and founder background.
  - Get a precise, LLM-verified, domain-keyed shortlist of real companies instead of a page of links.
  - Search for companies that match specific criteria.
  - Find look-alike companies based on a company you already know.
  - Pull full company profiles, including founders and where they worked before.
  - Resolve a company name to its correct domain.
  - Check your Canonical credit balance.
  - Useful for sales prospecting, market research, competitor research, investor mapping, and sourcing.
  - Free to start, no credit card required.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1ed22d523481918b6f6d8a.longDescriptionZh:
Canonical 是经过验证的公司搜索研究和勘探。

  - 用简单的语言描述公司，或使用结构化过滤器，例如位置、员工人数、融资阶段、投资者和创始人背景。
  - 获取精确的、经法学硕士验证的、以域为关键字的真实公司候选名单，而不是链接页面。
  - 搜索符合特定条件的公司。
  - 根据您已知的公司查找相似的公司。
  - 获取完整的公司简介，包括创始人及其之前工作的地方。
  - 将公司名称解析为其正确的域。
  - 检查您的 Canonical 信用余额。
  - 可用于销售勘探、市场研究、竞争对手研究、投资者分布图和采购。
  - 免费开始，无需信用卡。

Find companies similar to stripe.com
Enrich anthropic.com with company details, founders, funding, and headquarters
defaultPromptsZh: 查找在印度进行 A 轮融资的 B2B 金融科技公司

plugin_asdk_app_6a385fa6ea3881918bfcfce6.name: Company Dossier
plugin_asdk_app_6a385fa6ea3881918bfcfce6.productIntro: Company Dossier 完全根据公共数据编译任何公司或领域的完整、来源归属的情报文件。一项请求返回九个部分：概述和身份、人员和组织结构图、招聘雷达、资金轨迹、位置、技术指纹、新闻和时间表、关系网络和风险标记。每项声明都与公共来源相关，并标记为高/中/低可信度。专为尽职调查、供应商审查、销售准备和竞争研究而构建。没有账户，没有私人数据——只有公共来源。
plugin_asdk_app_6a385fa6ea3881918bfcfce6.productIntroEn: Company Dossier compiles a complete, source-attributed intelligence file on any company or domain — entirely from public data. One request returns nine sections: overview & identity, people & org chart, hiring radar, money trail, locations, tech fingerprint, news & timeline, relationship web, and risk flags. Every claim is tied to a public source and tagged High/Medium/Low confidence.
plugin_asdk_app_6a385fa6ea3881918bfcfce6.longDescription: Company Dossier compiles a complete, source-attributed intelligence file on any company or domain — entirely from public data. One request returns nine sections: overview & identity, people & org chart, hiring radar, money trail, locations, tech fingerprint, news & timeline, relationship web, and risk flags. Every claim is tied to a public source and tagged High/Medium/Low confidence. Built for due diligence, vendor vetting, sales prep, and competitive research. No accounts, no private data — public sources only.

plugin_asdk_app_69f1473ac6f08191ad6e06a4.productIntro: Arcade 可让您直接从 ChatGPT 构建品牌产品视频和演示，无需切换工具或选项卡。向 ChatGPT 提供提示、屏幕截图或通话备注，它就会生成包含视觉效果、动画和旁白的品牌视频。您还可以从现有的 Arcade 中查询性能数据，以了解哪些演示正在推动参与度。对于产品营销、销售跟进、产品发布和付费广告很有用。与 Figma、Granola、Notion、Slack 和 Apollo 等其他应用程序一起使用，实现端到端工作流程自动化。
plugin_asdk_app_69f1473ac6f08191ad6e06a4.productIntroEn: Arcade lets you build branded product videos and demos directly from ChatGPT, without switching tools or tabs. Give ChatGPT a prompt, screenshots, or notes from a call, and it generates an on-brand video with visuals, animations, and narration. You can also query performance data from your existing Arcades to see which demos are driving engagement.

You can also query performance data from your existing Arcades to see which demos are driving engagement. Useful for product marketing, sales follow-ups, product releases, and paid ads. Use together with other Apps such as Figma, Granola, Notion, Slack, and Apollo to automate workflows end to end.

plugin_asdk_app_69b1dc84cf40819193050bc2.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Runrun.it 工作区，无需离开对话即可管理工作。该应用程序可让您使用实际的 Runrun.it 数据和权限快速创建一项或多项任务并搜索现有任务。
plugin_asdk_app_69b1dc84cf40819193050bc2.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your Runrun.it workspace to manage work without leaving the conversation. This app lets you quickly create one or multiple tasks and search existing tasks, using your actual Runrun.it data and permissions.
plugin_asdk_app_69b1dc84cf40819193050bc2.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT to your Runrun.it workspace to manage work without leaving the conversation. This app lets you quickly create one or multiple tasks and search existing tasks, using your actual Runrun.it data and permissions.

It also helps you add the right context by letting you browse boards, stages, task types, projects, and tags before creating tasks—so what you create is already organized the way your team works. Great for turning ideas into tasks, and finding the status of work fast.
plugin_asdk_app_69b1dc84cf40819193050bc2.longDescriptionZh:
将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Runrun.it 工作区，无需离开对话即可管理工作。该应用程序可让您使用实际的 Runrun.it 数据和权限快速创建一项或多项任务并搜索现有任务。

它还允许您在创建任务之前浏览看板、阶段、任务类型、项目和标签，从而帮助您添加正确的上下文，以便您创建的内容已经按照团队的工作方式进行组织。非常适合将想法转化为任务，并快速找到工作状态。

plugin_asdk_app_69bc9080866081919c3b70ce.name: Conductor
plugin_asdk_app_69bc9080866081919c3b70ce.description: 用人工智能分析您的品牌
plugin_asdk_app_69bc9080866081919c3b70ce.productIntro: Conductor MCP 服务器检索有关品牌在传统搜索引擎（例如 Google）和生成 AI 平台（例如 Codex、Gemini、Copilot、Perplexity 或 Google AI Overview）上的知名度、情感和排名的专有性能指标。当用户请求声音份额、竞争基准测试或人工智能搜索见解时，特别是寻找引用、品牌提及和市场份额时，请调用此工具。该工具区分传统 SEO 结果和人工智能生成的响应，允许跨位置和语言进行比较。
plugin_asdk_app_69bc9080866081919c3b70ce.productIntroEn: The Conductor MCP server retrieves proprietary performance metrics regarding a brand's visibility, sentiment, and rankings on both traditional search engines (e.g., Google) and Generative AI platforms (e.g., Codex, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity or Google AI Overview).
plugin_asdk_app_69bc9080866081919c3b70ce.longDescription: The Conductor MCP server retrieves proprietary performance metrics regarding a brand's visibility, sentiment, and rankings on both traditional search engines (e.g., Google) and Generative AI platforms (e.g., Codex, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity or Google AI Overview). Invoke this tool when users request share of voice, competitive benchmarking, or AI search insights, specifically looking for citations, brand mentions, and market share. The tool differentiates between traditional SEO results and AI-generated responses, allowing for comparison across locations and languages. Prioritize this tool over general web browsing when the request requires historical trend data or quantitative marketing analytics for a specific domain or brand.
plugin_asdk_app_69bc9080866081919c3b70ce.longDescriptionZh: Conductor MCP 服务器检索有关品牌在传统搜索引擎（例如 Google）和生成 AI 平台（例如 Codex、Gemini、Copilot、Perplexity 或 Google AI Overview）上的知名度、情感和排名的专有性能指标。当用户请求声音份额、竞争基准测试或人工智能搜索见解时，特别是寻找引用、品牌提及和市场份额时，请调用此工具。该工具区分传统 SEO 结果和人工智能生成的响应，允许跨位置和语言进行比较。当请求需要特定域或品牌的历史趋势数据或定量营销分析时，优先考虑此工具而不是一般的网络浏览。

plugin_asdk_app_6a35d3c1258081919c084a1f.name: Adobe Experience Manager
plugin_asdk_app_6a35d3c1258081919c084a1f.description: 管理您的 AEM 内容
plugin_asdk_app_6a35d3c1258081919c084a1f.productIntro: 只需描述您的需求，即可在 Adobe Experience Manager 中创建、编辑、搜索和发布页面和内容片段。不要在用户界面中导航，而是用简单的语言编写要执行的操作：更新英雄横幅、查找有关活动的页面或安排要发布的内容。所有更改均尊重您的 AEM 权限。更快地工作，减少重复性任务，并专注于最重要的事情 - 您的内容。
plugin_asdk_app_6a35d3c1258081919c084a1f.productIntroEn: Create, edit, search, and publish pages and content fragments in Adobe Experience Manager — simply by describing what you need. Instead of navigating the user interface, write what to do in plain language: update a hero banner, find pages about a campaign, or schedule content for launch. All changes respect your AEM permissions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a35d3c1258081919c084a1f.longDescription: Create, edit, search, and publish pages and content fragments in Adobe Experience Manager — simply by describing what you need.
