plugin_asdk_app_69987ba54fec819199a41838.name: Success.co
plugin_asdk_app_69987ba54fec819199a41838.description: 运行 EOS® 的下一代软件
plugin_asdk_app_69987ba54fec819199a41838.productIntro: Success.co MCP 服务器可让您直接从 ChatGPT 控制整个 Success.co 工作区。
plugin_asdk_app_69987ba54fec819199a41838.productIntroEn: Success.co MCP Server lets you control your entire Success.co workspace directly from ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_69987ba54fec819199a41838.longDescription:
Success.co MCP Server lets you control your entire Success.co workspace directly from ChatGPT.

Instead of clicking around inside the app, you can simply talk to ChatGPT and ask it to do things for you. You can draft a new process document, complete a to do, create or update an Issue, review your Rocks, check on scorecard numbers, or prepare for an upcoming session. It works like a natural conversation, but it is connected to your real data.

Because Success.co already holds a clear, structured picture of how your company runs EOS, ChatGPT can use that data to generate powerful insights and reports. You can ask it to summarize execution across teams, highlight risks, spot patterns in Issues, or generate a planning brief. The only limit is what you choose to ask. It is your data, your operating system, simply made available to ChatGPT so you can leverage it more fully.

It is also especially useful when you are on the move. Using the ChatGPT app, you can add to dos or Issues with your voice, capture ideas as they happen, and keep execution moving without waiting to get back to your desk.

The Success.co MCP Server makes ChatGPT a practical control layer for your company’s EOS data, helping you move faster, think more clearly, and stay aligned.
plugin_asdk_app_69987ba54fec819199a41838.longDescriptionZh:
Success.co MCP 服务器可让您直接从 ChatGPT 控制整个 Success.co 工作区。

您无需在应用程序内四处点击，只需与 ChatGPT 对话并要求它为您做一些事情即可。您可以起草新的流程文档、完成待办事项、创建或更新问题、查看您的 Rocks、检查记分卡数字或为即将到来的会议做准备。它的工作方式就像自然对话，但它与您的真实数据相关。

由于 Success.co 已经掌握了您公司如何运行 EOS 的清晰、结构化的图片，ChatGPT 可以使用该数据生成强大的见解和报告。您可以要求它总结跨团队的执行情况、突出风险、发现问题中的模式或生成计划摘要。唯一的限制是你选择问什么。这是您的数据、您的操作系统，只需提供给 ChatGPT，以便您可以更充分地利用它。

当您在旅途中时，它也特别有用。使用 ChatGPT 应用程序，您可以用语音添加待办事项或问题，捕捉发生的想法，并继续执行，而无需等待回到办公桌前。

Success.co MCP 服务器使 ChatGPT 成为您公司 EOS 数据的实用控制层，帮助您更快地行动、更清晰地思考并保持一致。

plugin_asdk_app_6a472e17233c8191a0674e5a.productIntro: Firmable，您的 AI 原生 B2B 销售智能平台 - 现在就在您的口袋里。 Firmable 拥有超过 1500 万个经过验证的公司资料和超过 1.35 亿个决策者联系人，为您的销售团队提供了在正确的时刻接触正确的买家的优势。

plugin_asdk_app_6a472e17233c8191a0674e5a.longDescription:
Firmable, your AI-native B2B sales intelligence platform – is now in your pocket. With 15 million+ verified company profiles and 135 million+ decision-maker contacts, Firmable gives your sales team the edge to reach the right buyer at exactly the right moment. 

Know who’s ready to buy 

Buying signals surface the accounts most likely to convert right now. Firmable monitors for role and leadership changes, funding rounds, hiring surges, and technology shifts - alerting you the moment a target account is ready to buy. No more guessing. No more chasing lukewarm leads 

Find the right contacts, fast 

Define your ICP (ideal customer profile) in plain English and build ICP-matched prospect lists in seconds. Filter by industry, company size, country, state, tech stack, and hiring activity. Then, access verified mobile numbers and email addresses for decision-makers. 

Trust the data you act on 

Firmable AI delivers accurate, continuously refreshed company and contact data, enriched with vital context that makes outreach smarter and more relevant. Firmable is ISO 27001 certified and built around secure, compliant data practices, giving teams confidence in every move they make.  

Keep your CRM fresh 

Agentic two-way CRM sync and enrichment update your records as accounts change. Firmable provides native integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, and Microsoft Dynamics 365. 

Trusted by 1,300+ businesses 

Rated 4.7/5 on G2. Privacy-compliant data you can prospect with confidently.

了解谁准备好购买 

购买信号会浮现出目前最有可能转化的账户。 Firmable 监控角色和领导层变化、融资轮次、招聘激增和技术转变 - 在目标账户准备购买时向您发出警报。不用再猜测了。不再追逐不冷不热的线索 

快速找到合适的联系人 

用简单的英语定义您的 ICP（理想客户档案），并在几秒钟内建立与 ICP 匹配的潜在客户列表。按行业、公司规模、国家/地区、州、技术堆栈和招聘活动进行筛选。然后，为决策者访问经过验证的手机号码和电子邮件地址。 

相信您所依据的数据 

Firmable AI 提供准确、持续更新的公司和联系人数据，并丰富了重要的背景信息，使外展活动更加智能、更具相关性。 Firmable 已通过 ISO 27001 认证，并围绕安全、合规的数据实践构建，让团队对他们所做的每一步都充满信心。  

让您的 CRM 保持新鲜感 

代理双向 CRM 同步和丰富会随着帐户的变化更新您的记录。 Firmable 提供与 Salesforce、HubSpot、Pipedrive 和 Microsoft Dynamics 365 的本机集成。

plugin_asdk_app_698ebfa1aadc81918b3bb13a.productIntro: Demandbase 与 ChatGPT 和 Codex 的集成使销售、营销和 GTM 团队可以直接在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中无缝访问丰富的 B2B 数据，从而更快地进行客户研究、勘探和参与。
plugin_asdk_app_698ebfa1aadc81918b3bb13a.productIntroEn: Demandbase integration with ChatGPT and Codex gives sales, marketing, and GTM teams seamless access to rich B2B data directly within ChatGPT and Codex for faster account research, prospecting, and engagement.
plugin_asdk_app_698ebfa1aadc81918b3bb13a.longDescription:
Demandbase integration with ChatGPT and Codex gives sales, marketing, and GTM teams seamless access to rich B2B data directly within ChatGPT and Codex for faster account research, prospecting, and engagement.

This app connects ChatGPT and Codex to Demandbase via a secure MCP connection, giving you access to both first-party and third-party data.

Third-Party Data (3P): Search and retrieve industry-leading company and contact data from Demandbase, including firmographics, technographics, family trees, company news, and leadership profiles.

First-Party Data (1P): Securely access your organization's Demandbase data, including known accounts, contacts, CRM entities, engagement, in-flight opportunities, intent signals, and buying-group data.

Account Brief: Generate a single, consolidated account overview combining engagement state, opportunities, buying-group coverage, intent signals, company profile, and recent news in a single request.

What you can do
Search companies by name, location, size, revenue, or industry
Discover decision-makers and influencers by role or job level
Fetch full company profiles, including recent news and competitors
Tap into 1P signals such as engagement, MQA status, and account activity
Identify buying intent on specific topics or keyword sets over time
Find net-new buying-group contacts that aren't already in your CRM
Pull a complete account brief in a single request for fast meeting preparation

Who it's for
Sales reps looking for fast answers about target accounts in real time
Marketing teams enriching leads and refining personas
RevOps and Enablement teams embedding GTM intelligence into workflows
AI product teams building agent-powered workflows

Availability

This integration is available to Demandbase customers with the appropriate Demandbase licenses and entitlements.

To request access, please contact your Demandbase Customer Success Manager (CSM).

For technical support, contact support@demandbase.com.
plugin_asdk_app_698ebfa1aadc81918b3bb13a.longDescriptionZh:
Demandbase 与 ChatGPT 和 Codex 的集成使销售、营销和 GTM 团队可以直接在 ChatGPT 和 Codex 中无缝访问丰富的 B2B 数据，从而更快地进行客户研究、勘探和参与。

该应用程序通过安全的 MCP 连接将 ChatGPT 和 Codex 连接到 Demandbase，使您可以访问第一方和第三方数据。

第三方数据 (3P)：从需求库中搜索和检索行业领先的公司和联系人数据，包括企业结构、技术结构、家谱、公司新闻和领导力简介。

第一方数据 (1P)：安全访问组织的需求库数据，包括已知客户、联系人、CRM 实体、参与度、飞行中的机会、意向信号和购买组数据。

客户简介：生成一个综合的客户概述，将参与状态、机会、购买群体覆盖范围、意向信号、公司概况和最新新闻合并到一个请求中。

你能做什么
按名称、地点、规模、收入或行业搜索公司
按角色或职位级别发现决策者和影响者
获取完整的公司简介，包括最新新闻和竞争对手
利用 1P 信号，例如参与度、MQA 状态和账户活动
确定一段时间内对特定主题或关键词集的购买意图
查找 CRM 中尚未包含的全新采购组联系人
在单个请求中提取完整的客户简介，以便快速准备会议

这是给谁的
销售代表实时寻求有关目标客户的快速答案
营销团队丰富销售线索并完善角色
RevOps 和支持团队将 GTM 智能嵌入到工作流程中
AI 产品团队构建代理驱动的工作流程

可用性

拥有适当的 Demandbase 许可证和权利的 Demandbase 客户可以使用此集成。

要请求访问权限，请联系您的需求库客户成功经理 (CSM)。

如需技术支持，请联系 support@demandbase.com。

plugin_asdk_app_698c7b3350e881919af205c1.longDescription:
AmbitionBox is a career-focused platform that helps professionals make informed decisions using anonymous, verified workplace insights from real employees. Users can explore company reviews, salary benchmarks, compensation trends, work culture feedback, benefits, and career growth insights to evaluate companies and understand their market value before making career decisions.

Key Features and Offerings

Company Reviews & Insights

Access verified reviews from current and former employees across companies and industries. Users can understand workplace culture, management quality, work-life balance, benefits, career progression, compensation sentiment, and overall employee experience.

Salary Insights

Explore company-specific salary insights. Users can compare compensation across companies, understand typical salary ranges, view salary buckets by years of experience.

Dream Company Explorer

plugin_asdk_app_698c7b3350e881919af205c1.longDescriptionZh:
AmbitionBox 是一个以职业为中心的平台，可帮助专业人士利用来自真实员工的匿名、经过验证的工作场所见解做出明智的决策。用户可以探索公司评论、薪资基准、薪酬趋势、工作文化反馈、福利和职业发展见解，以在做出职业决策之前评估公司并了解其市场价值。

主要特点和产品

公司评论与见解

访问各公司和行业的现任和前任员工的经过验证的评论。用户可以了解职场文化、管理质量、工作与生活平衡、福利、职业发展、薪酬情绪和整体员工体验。

薪资洞察

探索公司特定的薪资见解。用户可以比较不同公司的薪酬，了解典型的薪资范围，根据多年的经验查看薪资范围。

梦想公司探索者

探索您指定的梦想公司和合适的公司

plugin_asdk_app_6a57d911a27c819191fd055a.name: ABRAMS Trade Intelligence
plugin_asdk_app_6a57d911a27c819191fd055a.description: HS 代码、供应商和买家
plugin_asdk_app_6a57d911a27c819191fd055a.productIntro: ABRAMS Trade Intelligence 是一款适用于海关、采购、销售和市场分析团队的只读研究应用程序。它侧重于三个工作流程：查找最有可能经目录验证的 HS 代码和相关贸易背景、研究产品的国际供应商以及研究买家或潜在客户。产品分类可能会要求一轮分组澄清，然后返回最佳可用的官方 HS-6 结果，并在验证后提供 CN-8 或 TARIC-10 上下文。
plugin_asdk_app_6a57d911a27c819191fd055a.productIntroEn: ABRAMS Trade Intelligence is a read-only research app for customs, sourcing, sales, and market-analysis teams. It focuses on three workflows: finding the most likely catalog-verified HS code and related trade context, researching international suppliers for a product, and researching buyers or potential customers.
plugin_asdk_app_6a57d911a27c819191fd055a.developerName: Inigma LLC ABRAMS world trade wiki
plugin_asdk_app_6a57d911a27c819191fd055a.longDescription: ABRAMS Trade Intelligence is a read-only research app for customs, sourcing, sales, and market-analysis teams. It focuses on three workflows: finding the most likely catalog-verified HS code and related trade context, researching international suppliers for a product, and researching buyers or potential customers. Product classification may ask one grouped clarification round and then returns the best available official HS-6 result, with CN-8 or TARIC-10 context when verified. Results can include assumptions, confidence, import and export signals, markets, company names, countries, shipment scope, and verified ABRAMS World Trade Wiki links. The supporting company-profile tool is limited to companies represented in ABRAMS trade results and is not promoted as a standalone directory. The app does not contact companies, create leads, change records, create accounts, process payments, or complete transactions. Classifications and trade signals are informational research aids, not binding tariff rulings, legal advice, or compliance guarantees.
plugin_asdk_app_6a57d911a27c819191fd055a.longDescriptionZh: ABRAMS Trade Intelligence 是一款适用于海关、采购、销售和市场分析团队的只读研究应用程序。它侧重于三个工作流程：查找最有可能经目录验证的 HS 代码和相关贸易背景、研究产品的国际供应商以及研究买家或潜在客户。产品分类可能会要求一轮分组澄清，然后返回最佳可用的官方 HS-6 结果，并在验证后提供 CN-8 或 TARIC-10 上下文。结果可以包括假设、置信度、进出口信号、市场、公司名称、国家/地区、装运范围以及经过验证的 ABRAMS 世界贸易 Wiki 链接。支持公司简介工具仅限于 ABRAMS 贸易结果中代表的公司，并且不会作为独立目录进行推广。该应用程序不会联系公司、创建潜在客户、更改记录、创建帐户、处理付款或完成交易。分类和贸易信号是信息研究辅助工具，不具有约束力的关税裁决、法律建议或合规保证。

plugin_asdk_app_694964a4157c819182d54ad8.name: Wednesday.app
plugin_asdk_app_694964a4157c819182d54ad8.productIntro: 通过 ChatGPT 中的 Wednesday.app 寻找创作者和影响者
plugin_asdk_app_694964a4157c819182d54ad8.productIntroEn: Find Creators and Influencers with Wednesday.app inside ChatGPT
plugin_asdk_app_694964a4157c819182d54ad8.longDescription:
Find Creators and Influencers with Wednesday.app inside ChatGPT

Discover the right creators without navigating multiple platforms. Simply describe what you’re looking for in plain language, and ChatGPT will return results powered by Wednesday.app’s search engine.

For example:
“Give me english-speaking TikTok creators interested in sustainable fashion with 50K–200K followers.”

Based on your request, you’ll receive a curated list of creator profiles that match your criteria. Review key details, explore their profiles, and check recent posts to evaluate whether they’re a strong fit for your next campaign.

Wednesday.app inside ChatGPT makes creator discovery faster, more intuitive, and easier to act on.
plugin_asdk_app_694964a4157c819182d54ad8.longDescriptionZh:
通过 ChatGPT 中的 Wednesday.app 寻找创作者和影响者

无需浏览多个平台即可发现合适的创作者。只需用简单的语言描述您要寻找的内容，ChatGPT 就会返回由 Wednesday.app 的搜索引擎提供支持的结果。

例如：
“给我提供对可持续时尚感兴趣、拥有 5 万至 20 万粉丝的英语 TikTok 创作者。”

根据您的请求，您将收到符合您条件的创作者个人资料精选列表。查看关键详细信息，探索他们的个人资料，并检查最近的帖子，以评估他们是否非常适合您的下一个广告系列。

ChatGPT 内的 Wednesday.app 使创作者发现更快、更直观、更容易采取行动。
defaultPrompts: Find US beauty and lifestyle creators on Instagram using Wednesday.app
defaultPromptsZh: 使用 Wednesday.app 在 Instagram 上查找美国美容和生活方式创作者

Data Bloo helps you ask questions about your performance and get clear answers from your connected data sources. No exports, no spreadsheets, no manual reporting.

Use it to check campaign performance, compare channels, spot trends, and summarize key takeaways for your team or clients.

Data Bloo works with sources including Facebook Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Bing Ads, Google Search Console, Google Business Profile, Instagram Insights, Facebook Insights, WooCommerce, and more.

plugin_asdk_app_6a6d64e293e081918e221d70.name: eSignatures.com
plugin_asdk_app_6a6d64e293e081918e221d70.productIntro: 无需离开 ChatGPT，即可创建、发送和管理具有法律约束力的合同。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6d64e293e081918e221d70.productIntroEn: Create, send, and manage legally binding contracts without ever leaving ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6d64e293e081918e221d70.longDescription:
Create, send, and manage legally binding contracts without ever leaving ChatGPT.

Build from scratch or from reusable templates, generate a draft to review before it goes out, then add signers and track everything from draft to signed, all through plain conversation.

Need to fix a typo or adjust a clause after a contract's already been sent for signature? There's no need to void it and start over. Edit the content directly, mid-process, and keep things moving.

Perfect for NDAs, service agreements, and any contract you need to get out the door fast, with full visibility into where every signature stands.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6d64e293e081918e221d70.longDescriptionZh:
无需离开 ChatGPT，即可创建、发送和管理具有法律约束力的合同。

从头开始或从可重复使用的模板进行构建，生成草稿以在发布前进行审查，然后添加签名者并跟踪从草稿到签名的所有内容，所有这些都通过简单的对话进行。

合同送交签署后需要修复拼写错误或调整条款吗？无需将其作废并重新开始。直接在流程中编辑内容，让事情继续进行。

非常适合保密协议、服务协议以及您需要快速签订的任何合同，并且可以完全了解每个签名的位置。
defaultPrompts: Send an NDA based on my template to John Doe from ACME Corp at john@acme.com. Set the term to 2 years.
Create a draft NDA for a publisher, ready for me to review and send. Signer: John Doe, ACME Corp, john@acme.com.
Review my templates and suggest improvements. Do not apply any changes until I approve them one by one.
defaultPromptsZh: 将基于我的模板的 NDA 发送给 ACME Corp 的 John Doe，邮箱为 john@acme.com。将期限设置为 2 年。
为发布商创建一份保密协议草稿，供我审核和发送。签名者：John Doe，ACME Corp，john@acme.com。
检查我的模板并提出改进建议。在我一一批准之前不要应用任何更改。

plugin_asdk_app_6a0db03032d081918aa53b13.productIntroEn: Connect seamlessly to 60+ platforms—including Google Ads, GA4, Shopify, Meta, and more—and access all your cross-channel performance data in one place. Connect seamlessly to 60+ platforms—including Google Ads, GA4, Shopify, Meta, and more—and access all your cross-channel performance data in one place. Whatagraph helps you go from raw data to clear insights—faster and smarter.

plugin_asdk_app_6a57a4774c9881919600a0e7.productIntro: SeedLegals 是世界上最强大的法律和筹款平台。
plugin_asdk_app_6a57a4774c9881919600a0e7.productIntroEn: SeedLegals is the world’s most powerful legal and fundraising platform.
plugin_asdk_app_6a57a4774c9881919600a0e7.longDescription:
SeedLegals is the world’s most powerful legal and fundraising platform.

Connect ChatGPT to your SeedLegals account to work with your company's equity and legal documents. Ask about your cap table ownership, dilution, share classes, and SEIS/EIS scheme breakdowns, and see outstanding actions across your workflows. Find, read, and ask questions about your agreements, check who still needs to sign, send signature reminders, and share documents with your team. You can also create and update documents such as board minutes and employment agreements, directly from the conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a57a4774c9881919600a0e7.longDescriptionZh:
SeedLegals 是世界上最强大的法律和筹款平台。

将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 SeedLegals 帐户，以处理您公司的股权和法律文件。询问您的股权结构表所有权、稀释度、股票类别和 SEIS/EIS 计划细目，并查看整个工作流程中的突出行动。查找、阅读协议并提出问题，检查谁仍需要签名，发送签名提醒，以及与您的团队共享文档。您还可以直接通过对话创建和更新董事会会议记录和雇佣协议等文档。
defaultPrompts: Who are the shareholders in Acme Ltd and what percentage does each own?
What’s outstanding for Acme right now?
Who still needs to sign the board resolution, or has it been fully signed?
defaultPromptsZh: Acme Ltd 的股东有哪些？各持股比例是多少？
Acme 目前最突出的是什么？
谁还需要签署董事会决议，或者已经完全签署？

plugin_asdk_app_698d3d89f25c8191b5fc0737.productIntroEn: Givebutter is the fundraising and donor management platform trusted by tens of thousands of nonprofits. This app connects your Givebutter account to ChatGPT so your team can work with your fundraising data conversationally — no exports, no dashboards, no switching tabs.
plugin_asdk_app_698d3d89f25c8191b5fc0737.longDescription:
Givebutter is the fundraising and donor management platform trusted by tens of thousands of nonprofits. This app connects your Givebutter account to ChatGPT so your team can work with your fundraising data conversationally — no exports, no dashboards, no switching tabs.

Use it to:
- Look up donations, transactions, and payout activity across your campaigns
- Find and summarize donor and contact records, giving history, and engagement
- Check how a campaign, event, or fundraising page is performing
- Pull the numbers you need for board updates, grant reports, and end-of-month reconciliation

Ask things like:
- "How much did we raise in our spring appeal?"
- "Who are our top recurring donors this year?"
- "Summarize new donors from last week." 

ChatGPT retrieves the answer directly from your live Givebutter data and respects your existing account permissions — it can only access what your connected account can see.

Built and maintained by Givebutter. Authentication is handled securely through OAuth; you stay in control of access and can disconnect at any time.
plugin_asdk_app_698d3d89f25c8191b5fc0737.longDescriptionZh:
Givebutter 是受到数以万计的非营利组织信赖的筹款和捐助者管理平台。此应用程序将您的 Givebutter 帐户连接到 ChatGPT，以便您的团队可以通过对话方式处理您的筹款数据 — 无需导出、无需仪表板、无需切换选项卡。

用它来：
- 查找整个活动中的捐款、交易和支付活动
- 查找并总结捐赠者和联系人记录、捐赠历史和参与度
- 检查活动、活动或筹款页面的效果如何
- 提取董事会更新、拨款报告和月末对账所需的数字

问一些事情，比如：
- “我们在春季呼吁中筹集了多少资金？”
- “谁是我们今年最大的经常性捐助者？”
- “总结上周的新捐赠者。” 

ChatGPT 直接从您的实时 Givebutter 数据中检索答案，并尊重您现有的帐户权限 - 它只能访问您连接的帐户可以看到的内容。

由 Givebutter 建造和维护。通过 OAuth 安全地处理身份验证；您始终掌控访问权限并可以随时断开连接。

plugin_asdk_app_6a6b58be0398819182d203d3.description: 处理您的 STACK 项目
plugin_asdk_app_6a6b58be0398819182d203d3.productIntro: STACK 是估算人员和预施工团队使用的施工起飞和估算平台。该连接器将您的 AI 助手链接到您的 STACK 帐户，这样您只需描述您想要的内容即可处理您的项目、估算和估算 — 无需任何代码，也无需安装任何内容。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6b58be0398819182d203d3.productIntroEn: STACK is a construction takeoff and estimating platform used by estimators and preconstruction teams. This connector links your AI assistant to your STACK account so you can work with your projects, takeoffs, and estimates just by describing what you want — no code, and nothing to install.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6b58be0398819182d203d3.longDescription:
STACK is a construction takeoff and estimating platform used by estimators and preconstruction teams. This connector links your AI assistant to your STACK account so you can work with your projects, takeoffs, and estimates just by describing what you want — no code, and nothing to install.

Once connected, your assistant can:
• Find and review existing work — search projects and takeoffs, open and review estimates, and look things up in your takeoff libraries.
• Create, update, and import — start new projects (including straight from an invitation-to-bid email), update project details, make bulk edits to takeoffs, and import from your libraries and company lists.

You stay in control. You sign in on STACK's own secure page using standard OAuth 2.0 — your assistant never sees your password. A STACK-branded approval screen lets you choose exactly which capabilities to grant, and you can allow read-only work (finding and reviewing) without allowing changes. Before it creates, updates, or imports anything, your assistant shows you what it's about to do and waits for your approval.

Your existing STACK permissions always apply: the connector can only see and change what you already could, and STACK enforces the same company ownership and user permissions it always has.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6b58be0398819182d203d3.longDescriptionZh:
STACK 是估算人员和预施工团队使用的施工起飞和估算平台。该连接器将您的 AI 助手链接到您的 STACK 帐户，这样您只需描述您想要的内容即可处理您的项目、估算和估算 — 无需任何代码，也无需安装任何内容。

连接后，您的助手可以：
• 查找并审查现有工作 - 搜索项目和起飞，打开和审查估算，以及在起飞库中查找内容。
• 创建、更新和导入— 启动新项目（包括直接从招标邀请电子邮件中）、更新项目详细信息、对预算进行批量编辑以及从库和公司列表导入。

您保持掌控。您使用标准 OAuth 2.0 登录 STACK 自己的安全页面 - 您的助手永远不会看到您的密码。 STACK 品牌的批准屏幕可让您准确选择要授予的功能，并且您可以允许只读工作（查找和审阅）而不允许更改。在创建、更新或导入任何内容之前，您的助手会向您展示它将要执行的操作并等待您的批准。

您现有的 STACK 权限始终适用：连接器只能查看和更改您已经可以查看和更改的内容，并且 STACK 强制执行其始终拥有的相同公司所有权和用户权限。

plugin_asdk_app_69b0b3d19240819199df11e9.productIntroEn: Agree Zone brings real estate negotiation intelligence directly into ChatGPT. Ask ChatGPT to analyze any active deal and instantly receive a deal probability score, price gap breakdown, and market insight — without leaving the conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_69b0b3d19240819199df11e9.longDescription:
Agree Zone brings real estate negotiation intelligence directly
into ChatGPT. Ask ChatGPT to analyze any active deal and instantly
receive a deal probability score, price gap breakdown, and market
insight — without leaving the conversation.

With one prompt, real estate agents and brokers can:

- Get a deal probability score (0–100) showing how likely a
  transaction is to close based on the spread between listing
  price and offer price
- See the exact price gap percentage and what it means in the
  current market
- Receive an AI-generated market insight explaining expected
  counter offer dynamics for that property type and location
- Get a direct path to Agree Zone's Deal Room, where sellers
  privately lock in their preferences before negotiations begin

The free negotiation analysis runs in seconds from any ChatGPT
conversation — no account required to get a score.

For agents ready to go further, Agree Zone offers a Deal Room
subscription that privately matches seller preferences with buyer
limits before the first counter offer is made. Founding Agent
pricing provides lifetime discounted access, and enterprise
brokerage licensing is available for teams managing multiple
active listings.

Built for residential real estate agents, buyer's
agents, listing agents, and broker teams who negotiate deals daily
and need fast, structured insight at the offer stage.
plugin_asdk_app_69b0b3d19240819199df11e9.longDescriptionZh:
Agree Zone直接带来房产谈判情报
进入 ChatGPT。让 ChatGPT 立即分析任何活跃交易
接收交易概率得分、价格差距细分和市场
洞察力——无需离开对话。

只需一个提示，房地产经纪人和经纪人就可以：

- 获取交易概率得分 (0–100)，显示交易发生的可能性
  交易将根据上市之间的价差结束
  价格和报价
- 查看确切的价格差距百分比及其含义
  当前市场
- 接收人工智能生成的市场洞察，解释预期
  该房产类型和位置的还盘动态
- 获得前往 Agree Zone 交易室的直接路径，卖家可以在那里
  在谈判开始前私下锁定他们的偏好

免费协商分析可在几秒钟内从任何 ChatGPT 运行
对话——无需帐户即可获得分数。

对于准备进一步发展的代理商，Agree Zone 提供交易室
私下匹配卖家偏好和买家的订阅
第一次还盘之前的限制。创始代理人
定价提供终身折扣访问，并且企业
经纪许可适用于管理多个
活跃列表。

专为住宅房地产经纪人、买家而建
每天协商交易的代理人、上市代理人和经纪人团队
并且需要在报价阶段快速、结构化的洞察。

plugin_asdk_app_6a343f0d5c048191aa3ebd84.productIntro: Ventor 将 ChatGPT 连接到私有 Ventor 工作区，以查看客户对话、CRM 记录、产品、表格、助手、自动化和指标。用户可以安全地检查电子表格并将其导入到任何支持的表中、查询或分析存储的数据以及导出有限的结果。不可逆的出站操作和预览/应用工作流程需要明确批准；直接记录更新插入立即应用，并被标记为可能触发配置的自动化的持久写入。 Ventor 不处理付款、发起结帐或转移资金。
plugin_asdk_app_6a343f0d5c048191aa3ebd84.productIntroEn: Ventor connects ChatGPT to a private Ventor workspace to review customer conversations, CRM records, products, tables, assistants, automations, and metrics. Users can safely inspect and import spreadsheets into any supported table, query or analyze stored data, and export bounded results.
plugin_asdk_app_6a343f0d5c048191aa3ebd84.longDescription: Ventor connects ChatGPT to a private Ventor workspace to review customer conversations, CRM records, products, tables, assistants, automations, and metrics. Users can safely inspect and import spreadsheets into any supported table, query or analyze stored data, and export bounded results. Irreversible outbound actions and preview/apply workflows require explicit approval; direct record upserts apply immediately and are labeled as persistent writes that may trigger configured automations. Ventor does not process payments, initiate checkout, or transfer funds.

plugin_asdk_app_69ef8d8082c08191bfa97afe.productIntro: 从 ChatGPT 运行您的 Ideals 数据室。创建项目、构建项目结构、上传文件、管理用户、搜索和总结文档、跟踪项目活动等等——所有这些都通过自然对话进行，不会影响安全性，并且无需切换工具。
plugin_asdk_app_69ef8d8082c08191bfa97afe.productIntroEn: Run your Ideals data room from ChatGPT. Create projects, build project structures, upload files, manage users, search and summarise documents, track project activity, and more – all through natural conversation, no compromises on security, and without switching tools.
plugin_asdk_app_69ef8d8082c08191bfa97afe.longDescription:
Run your Ideals data room from ChatGPT. Create projects, build project structures, upload files, manage users, search and summarise documents, track project activity, and more – all through natural conversation, no compromises on security, and without switching tools.

The most popular use cases:

Project structure:
"Create a folder structure for our Series B round with sections for Financials, Legal, and HR – then upload the latest investor deck"


"Analyse my files and propose how to restructure my VDR"

Document search & summaries:
"Find all documents mentioning 'indemnification' across the project and summarize the key points from each"

User & group management:
"Invite jane.doe@idealsvdr.com as a viewer, add her to the Acme Due Diligence group, and remove access for the previous advisor"

Activity & engagement tracking:
"Show me the activity log for the past 7 days – who viewed documents, what they accessed, and when"

Deal room housekeeping:
"Find all empty folders in the project, list any recently deleted documents, and show me which files were uploaded this week"
plugin_asdk_app_69ef8d8082c08191bfa97afe.longDescriptionZh:
从 ChatGPT 运行您的 Ideals 数据室。创建项目、构建项目结构、上传文件、管理用户、搜索和总结文档、跟踪项目活动等等——所有这些都通过自然对话进行，不会影响安全性，并且无需切换工具。

最流行的用例：

项目结构：
“为我们的 B 轮融资创建一个文件夹结构，其中包含财务、法律和人力资源部分，然后上传最新的投资者资料”


“分析我的文件并提出如何重组我的 VDR”

文献检索及摘要：
“找到整个项目中所有提到‘赔偿’的文件，并总结每个文件的要点”

用户和组管理：
“邀请 jane.doe@idealsvdr.com 作为查看者，将她添加到 Acme Due Diligence 组，并删除前任顾问的访问权限”

活动和参与度跟踪：
“显示过去 7 天的活动日志 – 谁查看了文档、他们访问了什么以及何时”

交易室客房服务：
“查找项目中的所有空文件夹，列出所有最近删除的文档，并显示本周上传了哪些文件”

Find documents with indemnification clauses and make summary
Create a new Project Ideon

plugin_asdk_app_6a70a06970d481919fd0c767.productIntro: Reply.io 是一个销售参与平台。在 ChatGPT 中，它允许用户在对话中运行自己的回复工作区：查找序列并检查其执行情况、查找联系人及其活动历史记录、在共享收件箱中查看和答复回复、处理 AI SDR 审批队列（查看待处理的草稿、重新生成、批准或拒绝它们）、管理邮箱、发送计划和安全限制，以及诊断序列或邮箱未发送的原因。每个工具都作用于连接帐户已有权访问的工作区（在该帐户的现有回复权限和 API 范围下）。
plugin_asdk_app_6a70a06970d481919fd0c767.productIntroEn: Reply.io is a sales engagement platform. In ChatGPT it lets a user run their own Reply workspace in conversation: find sequences and check how they are performing, look up contacts and their activity history, review and answer replies in the shared inbox, work the AI SDR approval queue (see pending drafts, regenerate, approve, or reject them), manage mailboxes, sending schedules and safe…
plugin_asdk_app_6a70a06970d481919fd0c767.longDescription: Reply.io is a sales engagement platform. In ChatGPT it lets a user run their own Reply workspace in conversation: find sequences and check how they are performing, look up contacts and their activity history, review and answer replies in the shared inbox, work the AI SDR approval queue (see pending drafts, regenerate, approve, or reject them), manage mailboxes, sending schedules and safety limits, and diagnose why a sequence or mailbox is not sending. Every tool acts on the workspace the connected account already has access to, under that account's existing Reply permissions and API scopes.

plugin_asdk_app_69813e58fbf8819183685137.longDescription:
Canny’s app connects ChatGPT to your customer feedback data. Use it to uncover insights, take action, and stay organized.
Ask questions about your feedback:
- What are my top feature requests by ARR?
- What are enterprise customers asking for most?
- What did the product team ship last quarter?
Capture and triage feedback:
- Send a call transcript or support ticket and Autopilot will capture, deduplicate, and triage feedback automatically
- Attribute feedback to a specific user and/or company
- Link Salesforce opportunities or HubSpot deals to ideas
Manage your roadmap:
- Ensure feedback is organized so teams can access their feedback
- Create and update views to look at focused lists of feedback
- Update statuses and other custom fields to keep your team and customers in the loop
plugin_asdk_app_69813e58fbf8819183685137.longDescriptionZh:
Canny 的应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到您的客户反馈数据。用它来发现见解、采取行动并保持井井有条。
针对您的反馈提出问题：
- ARR 对我最重要的功能要求是什么？
- 企业客户最需要什么？
- 产品团队上个季度发布了什么？
捕获和分类反馈：
- 发送通话记录或支持票证，Autopilot 将自动捕获、删除重复数据并分类反馈
- 将反馈归因于特定用户和/或公司
- 将 Salesforce 机会或 HubSpot 交易与创意联系起来
管理您的路线图：
- 确保反馈得到组织，以便团队可以访问他们的反馈
- 创建和更新视图以查看重点反馈列表
- 更新状态和其他自定义字段，让您的团队和客户了解最新情况

plugin_asdk_app_6a3bc9df52f88191ab3a8918.productIntro: SeldonFrame 是一个面向服务企业的人工智能代理市场。找到一个适合这项工作的代理人——一个负责接听和预订的人工智能接待员、一个评论请求者、一个主要资格审查员、一个预订礼宾员——然后将其投入使用。描述您的业务，SeldonFrame 会在一分钟内启动一个真实的工作空间：一个实时网站、预订页面、CRM 和人工智能聊天机器人，无需注册。然后浏览市场并添加代理来处理繁忙的工作。建筑商也创建并列出他们自己的代理，因此目录不断增长。

plugin_asdk_app_6a57f0e928fc8191b6eee8f1.name: PredictLeads
plugin_asdk_app_6a57f0e928fc8191b6eee8f1.productIntro: 为您的人工智能助手提供有关全球数百万家公司的结构化情报。数据直接来源于公司网站、职业页面、新闻媒体、SEC 文件和评论网站。不断刷新，已有5年以上历史。
plugin_asdk_app_6a57f0e928fc8191b6eee8f1.productIntroEn: Give your AI assistant structured intelligence on millions of companies worldwide. Data sourced directly from company websites, career pages, news outlets, SEC filings, and review sites. Continuously refreshed, with 5+ years of history.
plugin_asdk_app_6a57f0e928fc8191b6eee8f1.longDescription:
Give your AI assistant structured intelligence on millions of companies worldwide. Data sourced directly from company websites, career pages, news outlets, SEC filings, and review sites. Continuously refreshed, with 5+ years of history.

Every API endpoint is a native tool: ask natural-language questions, get structured answers.

- Enrich known companies by domain name: news, job postings, technographics, key customers, lookalikes.
- Discover net new companies by criteria: technologies used, hiring activity, funding received and more. Filtered by location, size, and industry.

Signal types: News Events (launches, partnerships, leadership changes...), Job Openings (with salaries, seniority, locations), Technology Detections, Financing Events, Similar Companies, SEC Filings (as Markdown), Product offerings, Key Customers, and GitHub Activity.

Built for GTM teams, researchers, and investors running agentic workflows that need live, structured company data.
plugin_asdk_app_6a57f0e928fc8191b6eee8f1.longDescriptionZh:
为您的人工智能助手提供有关全球数百万家公司的结构化情报。数据直接来源于公司网站、职业页面、新闻媒体、SEC 文件和评论网站。不断刷新，已有5年以上历史。

每个 API 端点都是一个本机工具：提出自然语言问题，获得结构化答案。

- 通过域名丰富知名公司：新闻、职位发布、技术图表、关键客户、相似者。
- 按标准发现净新公司：使用的技术、招聘活动、收到的资金等等。按位置、规模和行业过滤。

信号类型：新闻事件（发布、合作伙伴关系、领导层变动...）、职位空缺（薪资、资历、地点）、技术检测、融资事件、类似公司、SEC 文件（如 Markdown）、产品供应、主要客户和 GitHub 活动。

专为运行需要实时结构化公司数据的代理工作流程的 GTM 团队、研究人员和投资者而构建。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3038eec05081919256a864.description: 优化您的电子商务商店
plugin_asdk_app_6a3038eec05081919256a864.productIntro: DataGlass 帮助市场卖家了解盈利能力并发现提高业务绩效的机会。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3038eec05081919256a864.productIntroEn: DataGlass helps marketplace sellers understand profitability and identify opportunities to improve business performance.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3038eec05081919256a864.longDescription:
DataGlass helps marketplace sellers understand profitability and identify opportunities to improve business performance.

Connect your Shopee, Lazada, or TikTok Shop account to analyze sales, advertising performance, fees, costs, margins, and operational metrics. Ask questions about your business in natural language and receive data-backed insights based on your shop’s actual data.

Use DataGlass to:
• Analyze product and campaign profitability
• Understand true ROAS after fees and costs
• Identify underperforming products and ads
• Find opportunities to improve margins
• Compare performance across products and campaigns
• Explore recommendations for pricing, advertising, and inventory decisions

DataGlass combines analytics and optimization techniques to help sellers make more informed decisions using their marketplace data.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3038eec05081919256a864.longDescriptionZh:
DataGlass 帮助市场卖家了解盈利能力并发现提高业务绩效的机会。

连接您的 Shopee、Lazada 或 TikTok Shop 帐户以分析销售、广告效果、费用、成本、利润和运营指标。用自然语言询问有关您的业务的问题，并根据您商店的实际数据获得有数据支持的见解。

使用 DataGlass 可以：
• 分析产品和营销活动的盈利能力
• 了解扣除费用和成本后的真实 ROAS
• 识别表现不佳的产品和广告
• 寻找提高利润的机会
• 比较不同产品和活动的效果
• 探索有关定价、广告和库存决策的建议

DataGlass 结合了分析和优化技术，帮助卖家利用市场数据做出更明智的决策。

plugin_asdk_app_69c270fef8088191b28fe11b.productIntroEn: Find your next business from a conversation. Venturu connects you to one of the largest online marketplaces for businesses for sale in the US, with thousands of verified listings and over a thousand brokers.
plugin_asdk_app_69c270fef8088191b28fe11b.longDescription:
Find your next business from a conversation. Venturu connects you to one of the largest online marketplaces for businesses for sale in the US, with thousands of verified listings and over a thousand brokers.

Search listings by location, price, revenue, industry, and 20+ other filters. Find brokers by city, specialty, or language. Pull up full details on any listing or broker profile, and send inquiries to sellers or brokers — all without leaving ChatGPT.

What you can do:

- Search businesses for sale by location, price range, revenue, industry, SBA eligibility, and more
- Find and compare verified business brokers
- Get detailed listing info including financials, employee count, and deal structure
- Contact sellers and brokers directly from the chat

Free to search and browse. Messaging sellers and brokers requires a free Venturu account.
plugin_asdk_app_69c270fef8088191b28fe11b.longDescriptionZh:
从对话中找到您的下一个业务。 Venturu 将您连接到美国最大的待售企业在线市场之一，其中有数千个经过验证的列表和一千多名经纪人。

按位置、价格、收入、行业和 20 多个其他过滤器搜索列表。按城市、专业或语言查找经纪人。获取任何列表或经纪人资料的完整详细信息，并向卖家或经纪人发送查询 - 所有这些都无需离开 ChatGPT。

你可以做什么：

- 按地点、价格范围、收入、行业、SBA 资格等搜索待售企业
- 查找并比较经过验证的商业经纪人
- 获取详细的列表信息，包括财务信息、员工人数和交易结构
- 直接通过聊天联系卖家和经纪人

免费搜索和浏览。向卖家和经纪人发送消息需要一个免费的 Venturu 帐户。

plugin_asdk_app_6a55de20f190819190ec84f7.productIntro: Bloom 帮助 Shopify 商家了解商店盈利能力，而无需深入研究仪表板。向 ChatGPT 询问收入、利润、营销支出、净利润、订单水平 成本、或产品和变体性能，Bloom 从您的互联商店数据中返回清晰的分析结果。
plugin_asdk_app_6a55de20f190819190ec84f7.productIntroEn: Bloom helps Shopify merchants understand store profitability without digging through dashboards. Ask ChatGPT for revenue, margins, marketing spend, net profit, order-level costs, or product and variant performance, and Bloom returns clear analytics from your connected store data.
plugin_asdk_app_6a55de20f190819190ec84f7.longDescription:
Bloom helps Shopify merchants understand store profitability without digging through dashboards. Ask ChatGPT for revenue, margins, marketing spend, net profit, order-level
  costs, or product and variant performance, and Bloom returns clear analytics from your connected store data.

  It is built for operators who want faster answers to practical questions: which products are most profitable, how fulfillment costs affect margin, how net profit is trending,
  or which connected store needs attention. Bloom keeps the workflow focused on read-only business insights, so teams can explore performance, spot margin issues, and make
  better day-to-day decisions from the data they already trust in Bloom.
plugin_asdk_app_6a55de20f190819190ec84f7.longDescriptionZh:
Bloom 帮助 Shopify 商家了解商店盈利能力，而无需深入研究仪表板。向 ChatGPT 询问收入、利润、营销支出、净利润、订单水平
  成本、或产品和变体性能，Bloom 从您的互联商店数据中返回清晰的分析结果。

  它是为那些想要更快地回答实际问题的运营商而设计的：哪些产品最有利可图、履行成本如何影响利润、净利润趋势如何，
  或者需要关注哪个关联商店。 Bloom 让工作流程专注于只读业务洞察，因此团队可以探索绩效、发现利润问题并制定
  根据他们已经信任 Bloom 的数据做出更好的日常决策。
defaultPrompts: Show my Bloom P&L for the last 30 days, including revenue, CM2, marketing spend, and net profit.
Which products had the highest net profit last quarter, and what were their ad spend and ROAS?

defaultPromptsZh: 显示我过去 30 天的 Bloom 损益表，包括收入、CM2、营销支出和净利润。

查看 2026 年 5 月以来的订单盈利能力，包括总销售额、产品成本、运输成本和 CM2。

plugin_asdk_app_69f9511a65a08191aed1b782.name: Rhythms
plugin_asdk_app_69f9511a65a08191aed1b782.productIntro: 人工智能代理很强大，但与上下文无关。他们不知道你的优先事项、已决定的内容、团队是如何组织的，或者你的公司学到了什么。 Rhythms 为 ChatGPT 提供了与组织战略环境（目标、决策、知识、团队和进度）的实时双向连接。询问重要的事情。创建目标和文件。从实时数据生成业务评论。您贡献的一切都会使整个组织的环境变得更加丰富。
plugin_asdk_app_69f9511a65a08191aed1b782.productIntroEn: AI agents are powerful but context-blind. They don't know your priorities, what's been decided, how teams are organized, or what your company has learned. Rhythms gives ChatGPT a live, two-way connection to your organization's strategic context — goals, decisions, knowledge, teams, and progress. Query what matters. Create goals and documents. Generate business reviews from live data.
plugin_asdk_app_69f9511a65a08191aed1b782.longDescription: AI agents are powerful but context-blind. They don't know your priorities, what's been decided, how teams are organized, or what your company has learned. plugin_asdk_app_69fa8eea4c9081919175171b.productIntro: RAMMP 帮助创始人和营销人员找出他们的营销没有转化的原因。它根据企业自己的 Google Analytics 数据和收入目标计算免费的 0-100 品牌信任评分，使用 ADORE 框架查明漏斗中最薄弱的阶段，并返回影响最大的修复方案。完整的报告工具将其扩展到每个里程碑分数并提供规定性指导，并且一组辅助工具为战略、品牌、网站、承诺、入职和保留提供特定阶段的建议。所有工具都是只读的：它们根据用户提供的输入计算并返回指导，并且从不修改用户的数据或任何外部系统。
plugin_asdk_app_69fa8eea4c9081919175171b.productIntroEn: RAMMP helps founders and marketers find out why their marketing isn't converting. It computes a free 0-100 Brand Trust Score from a business's own Google Analytics figures and revenue goals, pinpoints the weakest stages of the funnel using the ADORE framework, and returns the highest-impact fixes.
plugin_asdk_app_69fa8eea4c9081919175171b.longDescription: RAMMP helps founders and marketers find out why their marketing isn't converting. It computes a free 0-100 Brand Trust Score from a business's own Google Analytics figures and revenue goals, pinpoints the weakest stages of the funnel using the ADORE framework, and returns the highest-impact fixes. A full report tool expands this into per-milestone scores with prescriptive guidance, and a set of helper tools give stage-specific advice for strategy, branding, website, commitment, onboarding, and retention. All tools are read-only: they compute and return guidance from the inputs the user provides and never modify the user's data or any external system.

plugin_asdk_app_69a7ae128414819195bbbadb.productIntroEn: Collect, understand, and act on user feedback.
plugin_asdk_app_69a7ae128414819195bbbadb.longDescription:
Collect, understand, and act on user feedback.
 
Connecting your Userback data with ChatGPT makes it easier to review, understand, and manage customer feedback without switching between tools. Teams can quickly access feedback items, review screenshots and technical details, summarize reports, and decide what needs attention next.
 
With ChatGPT connected to Userback, product, engineering, and support teams can triage incoming feedback faster, identify patterns in customer reports, and keep work moving by creating, updating, and commenting on feedback items directly from their AI workflow.

Userback helps teams turn customer feedback into clear, actionable insights so bugs, usability issues, and feature requests are understood and addressed more efficiently across the business.
plugin_asdk_app_69a7ae128414819195bbbadb.longDescriptionZh:
收集、理解用户反馈并根据用户反馈采取行动。
 
将您的用户反馈数据与 ChatGPT 连接起来，可以更轻松地查看、理解和管理客户反馈，而无需在工具之间切换。团队可以快速访问反馈项目、查看屏幕截图和技术细节、总结报告并决定接下来需要注意的事项。
 
通过连接到 Userback 的 ChatGPT，产品、工程和支持团队可以更快地分类收到的反馈，识别客户报告中的模式，并通过直接从 AI 工作流程创建、更新和评论反馈项目来保持工作顺利进行。

Userback 帮助团队将客户反馈转化为清晰、可操作的见解，以便整个企业更有效地理解和解决错误、可用性问题和功能请求。

plugin_asdk_app_6a771fa2bae48191af8e607f.name: Dropshipping Product Scout
plugin_asdk_app_6a771fa2bae48191af8e607f.productIntro: Dropshipping Product Scout 是一个独立的只读研究工具，它使用 CJ Dropshipping API 数据来帮助用户查看小型、手动策划的普通受众目录。按关键字或经批准的 CJ 产品代码搜索；检查销售状态、批准的变体、公开价格和标准化仓库库存；然后估算一种批准的变体的运输方式、运输窗口和美元邮资。它不会访问 CJ 帐户、客户订单、地址、跟踪或付款数据，也无法保留库存、下订单、预订发货、发布列表或进行购买。
plugin_asdk_app_6a771fa2bae48191af8e607f.productIntroEn: Dropshipping Product Scout is an independent, read-only research tool that uses CJ Dropshipping API data to help users review a small, manually curated, general-audience catalog. Search by keyword or an approved CJ product code; inspect sale status, approved variants, public prices, and normalized warehouse inventory; then estimate shipping methods, transit windows, and USD postage for o…
plugin_asdk_app_6a771fa2bae48191af8e607f.longDescription: Dropshipping Product Scout is an independent, read-only research tool that uses CJ Dropshipping API data to help users review a small, manually curated, general-audience catalog. Search by keyword or an approved CJ product code; inspect sale status, approved variants, public prices, and normalized warehouse inventory; then estimate shipping methods, transit windows, and USD postage for one approved variant. It does not access CJ accounts, customer orders, addresses, tracking, or payment data, and it cannot reserve stock, place orders, book shipments, publish listings, or make purchases. Availability and shipping are current estimates from the data source and can change. CJ Dropshipping and OpenAI do not sponsor or endorse this independent app.
plugin_asdk_app_6a771fa2bae48191af8e607f.longDescriptionZh: Dropshipping Product Scout 是一个独立的只读研究工具，它使用 CJ Dropshipping API 数据来帮助用户查看小型、手动策划的普通受众目录。按关键字或经批准的 CJ 产品代码搜索；检查销售状态、批准的变体、公开价格和标准化仓库库存；然后估算一种批准的变体的运输方式、运输窗口和美元邮资。它不会访问 CJ 帐户、客户订单、地址、跟踪或付款数据，也无法保留库存、下订单、预订发货、发布列表或进行购买。可用性和运输是数据源的当前估计值，可能会发生变化。 CJ Dropshipping 和 OpenAI 不赞助或认可此独立应用程序。

plugin_asdk_app_6a634c50a9a08191b8322f94.productIntroEn: cowork24 helps users discover coworking desks, private offices and meeting rooms in Swiss cities, plus airport lounges at international airports. Users search by city and see results on a map with price markers next to a synced list of photo cards carrying live CHF prices from cowork24.
plugin_asdk_app_6a634c50a9a08191b8322f94.longDescription: cowork24 helps users discover coworking desks, private offices and meeting rooms in Swiss cities, plus airport lounges at international airports. Users search by city and see results on a map with price markers next to a synced list of photo cards carrying live CHF prices from cowork24.ch; they can open a detail view with photos, the exact price, the amenities the host listed and how booking and cancellation work; check which time slots a space still has free in Swiss local time; get an exact price breakdown computed by the marketplace's own pricing engine rather than estimated; and prepare a booking summary that ends in a secure link to complete the reservation on cowork24.ch. No payment, card entry or reservation ever happens inside the chat. Where cowork24 has no spaces in a location, the app says so instead of returning listings from a different city.
plugin_asdk_app_6a634c50a9a08191b8322f94.longDescriptionZh: cowork24 帮助用户发现瑞士城市的联合办公桌、私人办公室和会议室，以及国际机场的机场休息室。用户按城市搜索，并在地图上查看结果，地图上有价格标记，旁边是同步的照片卡列表，其中包含来自 cowork24.ch 的实时瑞士法郎价格；他们可以打开详细视图，其中包含照片、确切价格、房东列出的设施以及预订和取消的方式；查看瑞士当地时间的哪些时段还有空闲空间；获得由市场自己的定价引擎计算而不是估计的准确价格细目；并准备一份以安全链接结尾的预订摘要，以在 cowork24.ch 上完成预订。聊天中不会发生任何付款、刷卡或预订。如果 cowork24 某个位置没有空格，该应用程序会如此说明，而不是返回来自不同城市的列表。

plugin_asdk_app_69e0285a0acc8191a0164999.description: 人工智能搜索可见性和洞察力
plugin_asdk_app_69e0285a0acc8191a0164999.productIntro: seoClarity ArcAI MCP 服务器通过人工智能驱动的搜索引擎为您的品牌和竞争对手的品牌提供实时和历史可见性数据。
plugin_asdk_app_69e0285a0acc8191a0164999.productIntroEn: The seoClarity ArcAI MCP server provides real-time and historical visibility data for your brand and your competitors' brands across AI-powered search engines.
plugin_asdk_app_69e0285a0acc8191a0164999.longDescription:
The seoClarity ArcAI MCP server provides real-time and historical visibility data for your brand and your competitors' brands across AI-powered search engines.

ArcAI tracks how your brand appears across 9 AI search engines - including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Google AI Mode, Microsoft CoPilot,  DeepSeek and Grok - ssurfacing where you're mentioned and cited, how often, and whether sentiment is positive or negative. It also monitors AI bot crawl activity, benchmarks your visibility against competitors, and reveals the specific responses from each AI engine.

Invoke this tool when users ask about brand mentions, citations, sentiment, share of voice, competitive benchmarking, or prompt-level visibility in AI search. Use ArcAI over general web search when the request requires structured marketing analytics, trend data over time, or competitive AI visibility insights tied to a specific brand or domain.
plugin_asdk_app_69e0285a0acc8191a0164999.longDescriptionZh:
seoClarity ArcAI MCP 服务器通过人工智能驱动的搜索引擎为您的品牌和竞争对手的品牌提供实时和历史可见性数据。

ArcAI 跟踪您的品牌在 9 个人工智能搜索引擎（包括 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Claude、Gemini、Google AI Overviews、Google AI Mode、Microsoft CoPilot、DeepSeek 和 Grok）中的显示方式，显示您被提及和引用的位置、频率以及情绪是正面还是负面。它还监控人工智能机器人爬行活动，将您的可见性与竞争对手进行比较，并揭示每个人工智能引擎的具体响应。

当用户询问人工智能搜索中的品牌提及、引用、情绪、声音份额、竞争基准或提示级别可见性时，调用此工具。当请求需要结构化营销分析、一段时间内的趋势数据或与特定品牌或领域相关的竞争性 AI 可见性见解时，请使用 ArcAI 而不是一般的网络搜索。

Lloyd by The L Suite brings peer intelligence from a private community of 2,500+ in-house general counsel and their teams into ChatGPT. plugin_asdk_app_69fce78ea9a48191af1a9f23.productIntro: A4B 是一种基于云的维护管理系统 (CMMS)，用于跟踪设备和安排预防性维护。将其连接到 ChatGPT，以简单的语言管理您的资产库存和维护工作。
plugin_asdk_app_69fce78ea9a48191af1a9f23.productIntroEn: A4B is a cloud-based maintenance management system (CMMS) for tracking equipment and scheduling preventive maintenance. Connect it to ChatGPT to manage your asset inventory and maintenance work in plain language.
plugin_asdk_app_69fce78ea9a48191af1a9f23.longDescription:
A4B is a cloud-based maintenance management system (CMMS) for tracking equipment and scheduling preventive maintenance. Connect it to ChatGPT to manage your asset inventory and maintenance work in plain language.

What you can do:
- Search, create, and update assets — equipment, vehicles, tools, IT hardware. Inventory numbers and QR codes are generated automatically.
- Create and assign preventive or reactive maintenance tasks with due dates and notes.
- Change asset states (stored, available, in use, in maintenance).
- Look up an asset's full change history and audit trail.
- View organization stats: asset counts by state, plan usage, and a maintenance summary (overdue, due this week, completed).
- Manage workspaces, users, and invites.
plugin_asdk_app_69fce78ea9a48191af1a9f23.longDescriptionZh:
A4B 是一种基于云的维护管理系统 (CMMS)，用于跟踪设备和安排预防性维护。将其连接到 ChatGPT，以简单的语言管理您的资产库存和维护工作。

你可以做什么：
- 搜索、创建和更新资产——设备、车辆、工具、IT 硬件。库存编号和二维码自动生成。
- 创建并分配带有截止日期和注释的预防性或反应性维护任务。
- 更改资产状态（已存储、可用、使用中、维护中）。
- 查找资产的完整变更历史记录和审计跟踪。
- 查看组织统计数据：按州划分的资产计数、计划使用情况和维护摘要（已过期、本周到期、已完成）。
- 管理工作区、用户和邀请。
defaultPrompts: Show me a snapshot of my organization — how many assets, plan usage.
Generate a QR code label for UPS System Alpha and show it to me.
defaultPromptsZh: 显示我的组织的快照 - 有多少资产、计划使用情况。
为 UPS System Alpha 生成二维码标签并将其显示给我。

plugin_asdk_app_69e1fe1aff308191a3c3838f.productIntro: 金融科技解释器帮助用户了解塑造欧洲金融业和更广泛的金融科技生态系统的金融科技和人工智能新闻。该应用程序以清晰的语言解释了行业发展、市场变化和新兴技术，并提供了它们对银行、初创企业、监管机构和金融专业人士意味着什么的背景信息。
plugin_asdk_app_69e1fe1aff308191a3c3838f.productIntroEn: Fintech Explainer helps users understand fintech and AI news shaping the financial industry in Europe and the broader fintech ecosystem. The app explains industry developments, market shifts, and emerging technologies in clear language, with context on what they mean for banks, startups, regulators, and financial professionals.
plugin_asdk_app_69e1fe1aff308191a3c3838f.longDescription:
Fintech Explainer helps users understand fintech and AI news shaping the financial industry in Europe and the broader fintech ecosystem. The app explains industry developments, market shifts, and emerging technologies in clear language, with context on what they mean for banks, startups, regulators, and financial professionals.

Built on the editorial archive of Fintech.hu, a Hungarian fintech publication, the app interprets and explains articles originally published in Hungarian, turning them into structured, easy-to-understand insights.
plugin_asdk_app_69e1fe1aff308191a3c3838f.longDescriptionZh:
金融科技解释器帮助用户了解塑造欧洲金融业和更广泛的金融科技生态系统的金融科技和人工智能新闻。该应用程序以清晰的语言解释了行业发展、市场变化和新兴技术，并提供了它们对银行、初创企业、监管机构和金融专业人士意味着什么的背景信息。

该应用程序以匈牙利金融科技出版物 Fintech.hu 的编辑档案为基础，解释和解释了最初以匈牙利语发表的文章，将其转化为结构化、易于理解的见解。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4270cd76a88191a7d27b2d.name: Komplyt Zero
plugin_asdk_app_6a4270cd76a88191a7d27b2d.description: 保留人工智能所知道的内容。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4270cd76a88191a7d27b2d.productIntro: ChatGPT 会在会话之间忘记内容，并将其学到的任何内容锁定在一个工具内。 Komplyt Zero 捕获您对话中的重要内容，并将其转化为您专属的结构化、可搜索的知识库。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4270cd76a88191a7d27b2d.productIntroEn: ChatGPT forgets between sessions and locks whatever it learns inside one tool. Komplyt Zero captures what matters from your conversations and turns it into a structured, searchable knowledge base that stays yours.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4270cd76a88191a7d27b2d.longDescription:
ChatGPT forgets between sessions and locks whatever it learns inside one tool. Komplyt Zero captures what matters from your conversations and turns it into a structured, searchable knowledge base that stays yours.

Ask a question, get an answer grounded in your own past work, decisions, and notes. No re-explaining context every time. No copy-pasting from a doc pile.

Free for one person. EU-hosted, private to you, never used to train any model. Your knowledge, portable across the tools you already use.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4270cd76a88191a7d27b2d.longDescriptionZh:
ChatGPT 会在会话之间忘记内容，并将其学到的任何内容锁定在一个工具内。 Komplyt Zero 捕获您对话中的重要内容，并将其转化为您专属的结构化、可搜索的知识库。

提出问题，根据您自己过去的工作、决定和笔记获得答案。无需每次都重新解释上下文。无需从文档堆中进行复制粘贴。

一人免费。欧盟托管，仅供您私人使用，从未用于训练任何模型。您的知识可以跨您已使用的工具移植。

plugin_asdk_app_6a05b91596008191a90c4df0.longDescription:
AIMS360 is a fashion ERP, apparel ERP, and consumer brand ERP platform that brings authorized AIMS360 business insights into ChatGPT and Codex.
Analyze sales, customer orders, invoiced revenue, open orders, backlog, customers, styles, products, colors, sizes, Shopify stores, wholesale and DTC channels, sales representatives, seasons, margins, overdue invoices, accounts receivable, and business performance.
AIMS360 is built for fashion and apparel brands and also serves footwear, jewelry, accessories, beauty, wellness, outdoor, home, baby, pet, and other consumer product companies.
Ask questions such as “Who are my top customers?”, “Which fashion styles are selling best?”, “What are my top apparel products?”, “How much open order value do we have?”, “Which customers owe us money?”, “Compare Shopify and wholesale sales,” or “How are sales trending compared with last month?”

AIMS360 专为时尚和服装品牌打造，还为鞋类、珠宝、配饰、美容、保健、户外、家居、婴儿、宠物和其他消费品公司提供服务。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5e601e83bc81918acb4d7e.name: AI Leads Scout
plugin_asdk_app_6a5e601e83bc81918acb4d7e.description: 寻找优质 B2B 前景
plugin_asdk_app_6a5e601e83bc81918acb4d7e.productIntro: AI Lead Scout 通过引导 AI 研究帮助企业找到合格的 B2B 潜在客户。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5e601e83bc81918acb4d7e.productIntroEn: AI Lead Scout helps businesses find qualified B2B prospects through guided AI research.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5e601e83bc81918acb4d7e.longDescription:
AI Lead Scout helps businesses find qualified B2B prospects through guided AI research.

Before it begins researching, AI Lead Scout interviews you to understand your business, services, target market, preferred locations, qualification requirements, and ideal customer profile. It then uses that information to identify relevant business prospects, explain why each company may be a good fit, check for duplicates, and save approved leads to your AI Lead Scout dashboard for review and follow-up.

AI Lead Scout is designed for business owners, marketers, agencies, and sales teams that want a more focused and organized way to find B2B prospects that match their specific goals.

A paid ChatGPT subscription and an active AI Lead Scout account are required. Visit AILeadScout.net to learn more and create your account before using the plugin.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5e601e83bc81918acb4d7e.longDescriptionZh:
AI Lead Scout 通过引导 AI 研究帮助企业找到合格的 B2B 潜在客户。

在开始研究之前，AI Lead Scout 会采访您，以了解您的业务、服务、目标市场、首选地点、资格要求和理想的客户概况。然后，它使用该信息来识别相关的业务前景，解释为什么每家公司可能是合适的，检查重复项，并将批准的潜在客户保存到您的 AI Lead Scout 仪表板以供审查和跟进。

AI Lead Scout 专为企业主、营销人员、代理机构和销售团队而设计，他们希望以更有针对性和更有条理的方式来寻找符合其特定目标的 B2B 潜在客户。

需要付费 ChatGPT 订阅和活跃的 AI Lead Scout 帐户。在使用该插件之前，请访问 AILeadScout.net 了解更多信息并创建您的帐户。

plugin_asdk_app_69987038dee08191a69f9b89.longDescription:
Discover and compare event venues for meetings, offsites, seminars, and corporate gatherings with Kactus. Whether you need a central meeting space with natural light, a residential venue with bedrooms, or a unique location for a team experience, Kactus helps you find the right option based on location, capacity, and event needs.

Simply describe what you’re looking for in ChatGPT. Kactus will surface relevant venues and display them in an interactive map and results widget so you can compare key criteria at a glance (capacity, amenities, photos, and location). When you find the right fit, open the venue page to review details and request a quote.

Example prompts:
- “Find meeting venues for 30 people in Paris with natural light.”
- “Residential offsite for 40 people with 20 bedrooms near Bordeaux.”
- “Show me a castle venue for 60 people near Nantes.”

plugin_asdk_app_6995f5172f088191b89b2b9e.name: Neartail
plugin_asdk_app_6995f5172f088191b89b2b9e.productIntro: 您的菜单每周都会变化。您需要一个可以在几分钟内更新的订单，而不是一个必须重建的电子商务网站。
plugin_asdk_app_6995f5172f088191b89b2b9e.productIntroEn: Your menu changes every week. You need an order form you can update in minutes, not an ecommerce site you have to rebuild.
plugin_asdk_app_6995f5172f088191b89b2b9e.longDescription:
Your menu changes every week. You need an order form you can update in minutes, not an ecommerce site you have to rebuild.

What if creating an order form was as easy as editing Google Forms? Neartail does that. Describe your menu, set prices, and get an order form that calculates totals automatically. Your customers don't have to browse an ecommerce site, add to cart, and get lost along the way. They go through the form, review their order, and submit. Simple.

Orders sync to Google Sheets. Share with your kitchen to prep. Share with delivery to route. Next week, update your menu and go again.

Describe what you need: "meal prep order form with 5 meals," "weekly lunch menu for office canteen," or "bakery pre-order with pickup times." Neartail creates it with pricing and payment built in.
Meal prep companies, office canteens, bakeries, and caterers use Neartail because menus change weekly and Google Sheets is how their team already works.

Describe. Share. Take orders.
plugin_asdk_app_6995f5172f088191b89b2b9e.longDescriptionZh:
您的菜单每周都会变化。您需要一个可以在几分钟内更新的订单，而不是一个必须重建的电子商务网站。

如果创建订单表单像编辑 Google 表单一样简单会怎样？近尾就是这么做的。描述您的菜单、设置价格并获取自动计算总计的订单。您的客户不必浏览电子商务网站、添加到购物车，然后迷失方向。他们浏览表格、查看订单并提交。简单的。

订单同步到 Google 表格。与您的厨房分享以进行准备。与送货路线共享。下周，更新你的菜单，然后再去。

描述您需要什么：“含 5 餐的膳食准备订单”、“办公室食堂每周午餐菜单”或“带取货时间的面包店预订单”。 Neartail 创建它时内置了定价和付款方式。
膳食准备公司、办公室食堂、面包店和餐饮服务商都使用 Neartail，因为菜单每周更换一次，而 Google Sheets 是他们团队已经采用的工作方式。

描述。分享。秉承。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5ea285e2cc819195ac4d64.productIntro: 专业知识人工智能将任何网站变成一个工作人工智能代理，就在 ChatGPT 内部。共享一个 URL，它会读取网站的关键页面，然后训练一个实时代理，使用该网站的实际内容回答问题。整个过程大约需要一分钟。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5ea285e2cc819195ac4d64.productIntroEn: Expertise AI turns any website into a working AI agent, right inside ChatGPT. Share a URL and it reads the site's key pages, then trains a live agent that answers questions using that site's actual content. The whole thing takes about a minute.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5ea285e2cc819195ac4d64.longDescription:
Expertise AI turns any website into a working AI agent, right inside ChatGPT. Share a URL and it reads the site's key pages, then trains a live agent that answers questions using that site's actual content. The whole thing takes about a minute.

You get a link to a live preview where you can start chatting with the agent right away. No account, no setup, nothing to install.

Things you can do:
• Try it on your own site and see what an AI agent trained on your content would tell your customers.
• Test how an agent handles your docs, pricing, and product questions before putting one on your website.

Ask ChatGPT to "build an AI agent for mycompany.com" and see for yourself.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5ea285e2cc819195ac4d64.longDescriptionZh:
专业知识人工智能将任何网站变成一个工作人工智能代理，就在 ChatGPT 内部。共享一个 URL，它会读取网站的关键页面，然后训练一个实时代理，使用该网站的实际内容回答问题。整个过程大约需要一分钟。

您将获得实时预览的链接，您可以立即开始与代理聊天。没有帐户，无需设置，无需安装任何内容。

你可以做的事情：
• 在您自己的网站上尝试一下，看看根据您的内容进行训练的人工智能代理会告诉您的客户什么。
• 在将文档、定价和产品问题放到您的网站上之前测试代理如何处理您的文档、定价和产品问题。

请 ChatGPT“为 mycompany.com 构建 AI 代理”并亲自查看。

plugin_asdk_app_6a75d75faf1081919cf020e9.longDescription: Searchable measures how brands appear in AI answers across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. plugin_asdk_app_6a7da2b1c32881919265c2a6.name: Smartling
plugin_asdk_app_6a7da2b1c32881919265c2a6.productIntro: Smartling 是一个基于云的翻译管理平台，全球品牌使用它来大规模翻译和管理本地化内容。该 MCP 服务器将 Smartling 的翻译和本地化工具直接带入您的 AI 助手中。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7da2b1c32881919265c2a6.productIntroEn: Smartling is a cloud-based translation management platform used by global brands to translate and manage localized content at scale. This MCP server brings Smartling's translation and localization tools directly into your AI assistant.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7da2b1c32881919265c2a6.longDescription:
Smartling is a cloud-based translation management platform used by global brands to translate and manage localized content at scale. This MCP server brings Smartling's translation and localization tools directly into your AI assistant.

What you can do:
- Translate text instantly using Smartling's MT API, applying your glossary, style guide, and preferred terminology
- Search, tag, and review strings across your projects
- Create, monitor, and manage translation jobs — add or remove content, authorize work, and review job history
- Raise, track, and resolve string issues and quality questions between reviewers and linguists
- Look up glossaries, style guides, translation memory, and linguistic packages to check terminology and brand voice
- Review vendor and translator assignments, word count reports, and workflow details
- List projects, users, and accounts across your Smartling organization

Who it's for:
Localization managers, project managers, and engineers already working in Smartling who want fast answers or bulk actions without leaving their AI assistant — checking a job's status, triaging quality issues, pulling a report, or getting an instant translation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7da2b1c32881919265c2a6.longDescriptionZh:
Smartling 是一个基于云的翻译管理平台，全球品牌使用它来大规模翻译和管理本地化内容。该 MCP 服务器将 Smartling 的翻译和本地化工具直接带入您的 AI 助手中。

你可以做什么：
- 使用 Smartling 的 MT API 立即翻译文本，应用您的术语表、风格指南和首选术语
- 在您的项目中搜索、标记和审查字符串
- 创建、监控和管理翻译作业 — 添加或删除内容、授权工作以及查看作业历史记录
- 提出、跟踪和解决审稿人和语言学家之间的字符串问题和质量问题
- 查找词汇表、风格指南、翻译记忆库和语言包以检查术语和品牌声音
- 审查供应商和翻译人员的分配、字数统计报告和工作流程详细信息
- 列出 Smartling 组织中的项目、用户和帐户

适合谁：

plugin_asdk_app_6a19594d066c819188c6c988.longDescription:
Recruiter Roles is the job board built only for recruiters and talent acquisition professionals. Ask in plain language and get live openings straight from the board: "remote recruiter jobs paying over $90k", "healthcare talent acquisition roles in Canada", or "entry level recruiter jobs added this week".

Search and filter 1,000+ live recruiter, recruiting, and talent acquisition jobs across the US, UK, and Canada by sector, location, seniority, salary, and remote or hybrid. Open any role for the full description, requirements, and a direct apply link.

plugin_asdk_app_69fe16bb7a048191af54574d.productIntro: BrightSite 是一个网站托管和内容管理平台。连接您的 BrightSite 帐户以构建和编辑页面、布局和可重用组件；撰写、发布和组织博客文章；管理表格并审查提交的内容；上传和组织媒体；配置 SEO、结构化数据、重定向和分析设置；审查网站流量；并管理团队成员和角色。内容编辑首先保存到暂存草稿中，以便您可以查看更改，然后在准备就绪后将其发布到实时网站。暂存站点和完整版本历史记录可让您预览较大的更改并在需要时回滚。
plugin_asdk_app_69fe16bb7a048191af54574d.productIntroEn: BrightSite is a website hosting and content management platform. Connect your BrightSite account to build and edit pages, layouts, and reusable components; write, publish, and organize blog posts; manage forms and review submissions; upload and organize media; configure SEO, structured data, redirects, and analytics settings; review site traffic; and manage team members and roles.
plugin_asdk_app_69fe16bb7a048191af54574d.longDescription: BrightSite is a website hosting and content management platform. Connect your BrightSite account to build and edit pages, layouts, and reusable components; write, publish, and organize blog posts; manage forms and review submissions; upload and organize media; configure SEO, structured data, redirects, and analytics settings; review site traffic; and manage team members and roles. Content edits are saved to a staged draft first, so you can review changes and then publish them to the live site when they are ready. A staging site and full version history let you preview larger changes and roll back if needed.

plugin_asdk_app_69f8c657dc2c81918f352ea2.productIntro: Abacor 将您的客户会议和对话转化为专为会计师事务所构建的可搜索、结构化情报。
plugin_asdk_app_69f8c657dc2c81918f352ea2.productIntroEn: Abacor turns your client meetings and conversations into searchable, structured intelligence, built for accounting firms.
plugin_asdk_app_69f8c657dc2c81918f352ea2.longDescription:
Abacor turns your client meetings and conversations into searchable, structured intelligence, built for accounting firms.

Connect Abacor to ChatGPT to:
- Search across meeting notes, transcripts, and summaries from past client conversations
- Recall what a specific client said, asked for, or committed to
- Pull open action items across your book of business or for a single engagement
- Get a prep brief before any upcoming meeting on your calendar
- Look up contacts and organizations synced from your practice management system

Abacor records and summarizes your meetings, extracts action items, and ties every conversation back to the right contact and organization. All data stays scoped to your Abacor workspace.
plugin_asdk_app_69f8c657dc2c81918f352ea2.longDescriptionZh:
Abacor 将您的客户会议和对话转化为专为会计师事务所构建的可搜索、结构化情报。

将 Abacor 连接到 ChatGPT 以：
- 搜索过去客户对话的会议记录、笔录和摘要
- 回忆特定客户所说、要求或承诺的内容
- 在您的业务手册中或单次参与中拉出未完成的行动项目
- 在日历上即将举行的任何会议之前获取准备简报
- 查找从您的实践管理系统同步的联系人和组织

Abacor 记录并总结您的会议，提取行动项目，并将每次对话与正确的联系人和组织联系起来。所有数据的范围仅限于您的 Abacor 工作区。

plugin_asdk_app_6a286d326c3c8191acfa27fd.name: BROSH AI CRM
plugin_asdk_app_6a286d326c3c8191acfa27fd.description: 面向 AI 专业人士的智能 CRM
plugin_asdk_app_6a286d326c3c8191acfa27fd.productIntro: BROSH MCP 通过模型上下文协议 (MCP) 将您的 CRM、销售、营销、项目、文档和业务运营直接带入 AI 助手中。 AI 代理无需在应用程序之间切换，而是可以使用 BROSH 工作区中的实时数据安全地访问、分析、更新、管理设置并自动化工作流程。
plugin_asdk_app_6a286d326c3c8191acfa27fd.productIntroEn: BROSH MCP brings your CRM, sales, marketing, projects, documents, and business operations directly into AI assistants through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Instead of switching between applications, AI agents can securely access, analyze, update, manage settings, and automate workflows using live data from your BROSH workspace.
plugin_asdk_app_6a286d326c3c8191acfa27fd.longDescription:
BROSH MCP brings your CRM, sales, marketing, projects, documents, and business operations directly into AI assistants through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Instead of switching between applications, AI agents can securely access, analyze, update, manage settings, and automate workflows using live data from your BROSH workspace.

Designed for sales teams, consultants, service providers, agencies, and growing businesses, BROSH MCP enables AI to work with real business context—including leads, contacts, opportunities, projects, tasks, invoices, contracts, support tickets, and marketing activities. Users can ask questions in natural language, generate insights, automate repetitive processes, and execute CRM actions directly from their AI environment.

Key capabilities include:

Secure MCP-based access to CRM and business data
AI-powered querying, reporting, and data analysis
Lead, contact, account, and opportunity management
Project, task, and workflow automation
Marketing automation and customer engagement workflows
Document generation, e-signatures, quotes, and invoicing
Custom business objects, fields, dashboards, and reporting
Real-time interaction between AI agents and operational systems

BROSH MCP transforms AI assistants from simple chat interfaces into business operators capable of understanding your organization, retrieving information, updating records, and helping teams move faster with less manual work. Built on the open MCP standard, it provides a secure bridge between AI and the systems your business relies on every day.
plugin_asdk_app_6a286d326c3c8191acfa27fd.longDescriptionZh:
BROSH MCP 通过模型上下文协议 (MCP) 将您的 CRM、销售、营销、项目、文档和业务运营直接带入 AI 助手中。 AI 代理无需在应用程序之间切换，而是可以使用 BROSH 工作区中的实时数据安全地访问、分析、更新、管理设置并自动化工作流程。

BROSH MCP 专为销售团队、顾问、服务提供商、代理机构和成长型企业而设计，使 AI 能够与真实的业务环境配合使用，包括潜在客户、联系人、机会、项目、任务、发票、合同、支持票证和营销活动。用户可以用自然语言提出问题、生成见解、自动执行重复流程，并直接从 AI 环境中执行 CRM 操作。

主要能力包括：

基于 MCP 的安全访问 CRM 和业务数据
AI 支持的查询、报告和数据分析
潜在客户、联系人、客户和机会管理
项目、任务和工作流程自动化
营销自动化和客户参与工作流程
文档生成、电子签名、报价和发票
自定义业务对象、字段、仪表板和报告
AI代理与操作系统之间的实时交互

BROSH MCP 将人工智能助手从简单的聊天界面转变为业务操作员，能够了解您的组织、检索信息、更新记录，并帮助团队以更少的体力工作更快地开展工作。它基于开放的 MCP 标准构建，在 AI 和您的企业日常依赖的系统之间提供了一座安全的桥梁。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7b5a0c6f5c8191978777f4.productIntro: Placer.ai Pi 回答了基于可测量的现实世界行为的业务问题。用简单的语言提出一个完整的分析问题，Pi 会运行完整的 Placer.ai 分析 - 客流量趋势、游客人口统计和旅程、贸易区域、交叉购物以及销售和支出 - 然后返回一个书面答案，其中包含数据诚实警告、它使用的任何网络资源，以及在 Pi 中打开相同分析及其交互式地图的深层链接。完整的分析通常需要几分钟：ask_pi 启动它并返回句柄，get_pi_result 收集答案，在工作运行时报告进度。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b5a0c6f5c8191978777f4.productIntroEn: Placer.ai Pi answers business questions that turn on measured real-world behavior. Ask a full analytical question in plain language and Pi runs a complete Placer.ai analysis - foot traffic trends, visitor demographics and journeys, trade areas, cross-shopping, and sales and spend - then returns a written answer with data-honesty caveats, any web sources it used, and a deep link that open…
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b5a0c6f5c8191978777f4.longDescription: Placer.ai Pi answers business questions that turn on measured real-world behavior. Ask a full analytical question in plain language and Pi runs a complete Placer.ai analysis - foot traffic trends, visitor demographics and journeys, trade areas, cross-shopping, and sales and spend - then returns a written answer with data-honesty caveats, any web sources it used, and a deep link that opens the same analysis, with its interactive map, in Pi. A full analysis normally takes several minutes: ask_pi starts it and returns a handle, and get_pi_result collects the answer, reporting progress while the work runs. Typical workflows include store and portfolio performance, trade-area and site analysis, competitive benchmarking, tenant mix and co-tenancy review, market feasibility, and category or market-share tracking. Follow-up questions can reuse a previous analysis so the numbers stay consistent across a conversation. Access requires a Placer.ai account with Pi and the MCP access entitlement; Pi returns only the data the signed-in Placer user is entitled to see.

plugin_asdk_app_6a605cbc508481918272ea7e.name: Review Buddy- draft AI replies
plugin_asdk_app_6a605cbc508481918272ea7e.productIntro: 对您的在线评论进行完美回复。
plugin_asdk_app_6a605cbc508481918272ea7e.productIntroEn: Write the perfect replies to your online reviews.
plugin_asdk_app_6a605cbc508481918272ea7e.longDescription:
Write the perfect replies to your online reviews.

This app helps business owners write clear, personal, and polite replies to customer reviews. Copy a review, paste it into the app, and get a response that sounds friendly and professional. Save time, keep your customers happy, and build a better online reputation without staring at a blank page.

Good review? Bad review? Short review? Long review? This app can help. It creates thoughtful replies that fit the customer’s message instead of giving the same answer every time. You stay in control and can edit every reply before you post it.

Customers notice when businesses reply. A simple thank you can make a good review even better. A calm and caring answer to a bad review can show that you listen and want to help. Taking time to reply builds trust, but writing every response can take hours. This app does the hard part for you.

The app is made for busy business owners, managers, and teams. It works well for restaurants, cafés, shops, hotels, plumbers, electricians, salons, gyms, dentists, doctors, real estate agents, law firms, cleaners, contractors, and many other businesses. If people leave reviews about your business, this app can help you answer them.

Every reply is written to sound natural. The app looks at what the customer said and writes a response that matches the situation. Happy customers get warm thanks. Customers with questions get helpful answers. Customers who had a bad experience get a calm and respectful reply that shows you care.

You can change the reply before you use it. Add your own details, adjust the tone, or make it shorter or longer. The app gives you a strong starting point so you spend less time writing and more time running your business.

Replying to reviews can help your business grow. People often read reviews before they choose where to spend their money. When they see helpful replies from the owner, they know someone is paying attention. That can build confidence and encourage more people to visit, call, or buy.

The app is easy to use. Paste a review, choose the style you want, and generate a reply in seconds. There is no need to search for templates or wonder what to say. The app helps you find the right words quickly.

Use it for positive reviews, negative reviews, five-star reviews, one-star reviews, first-time customers, regular customers, complaints, compliments, questions, and everything in between. Every review is different, and every reply should feel personal.

Keep your brand voice consistent. Whether your business is fun, formal, warm, or simple, you can create replies that match your style. This helps customers recognize your business and builds a stronger connection over time.

The app also helps reduce stress. Many business owners worry about saying the wrong thing, especially when responding to unhappy customers. Instead of starting from scratch, you get a thoughtful draft that you can review and adjust before posting.

Fast replies can make a big difference. Customers like knowing they have been heard. A quick response shows that your business cares about feedback and wants to improve. Even a short reply can leave a lasting impression.

Whether you receive a few reviews each month or many every day, this app helps you stay on top of them. Save time, reply with confidence, and give every customer the attention they deserve. Better conversations lead to better relationships, stronger trust, and a better reputation. Start writing smarter review replies today and spend less time typing while making every customer feel heard.
plugin_asdk_app_6a605cbc508481918272ea7e.longDescriptionZh:
对您的在线评论进行完美回复。

该应用程序可帮助企业主对客户评论做出清晰、个性化且礼貌的回复。复制评论，将其粘贴到应用程序中，然后获得听起来友好且专业的回复。无需盯着空白页即可节省时间、让客户满意并建立更好的在线声誉。

好评吗？差评？简短的评论？长评？这个应用程序可以提供帮助。它会创建符合客户信息的深思熟虑的回复，而不是每次都给出相同的答案。您可以掌控一切，并可以在发布之前编辑每个回复。

当企业回复时，客户会注意到。一句简单的感谢可以使好的评论变得更好。对差评的冷静和关心的回答可以表明您在倾听并愿意提供帮助。花时间回复可以建立信任，但写每个回复可能需要几个小时。这个应用程序为您完成了困难的部分。

该应用程序是为忙碌的企业主、经理和团队设计的。它非常适合餐馆、咖啡馆、商店、酒店、水管工、电工、沙龙、健身房、牙医、医生、房地产经纪人、律师事务所、清洁工、承包商和许多其他企业。如果人们留下有关您的业务的评论，此应用程序可以帮助您回答这些评论。

每条回复都写得听起来很自然。该应用程序会查看客户所说的内容并写出符合情况的回复。满意的顾客会得到热烈的感谢。有疑问的客户可以获得有用的答案。经历过不良体验的客户会得到冷静和尊重的答复，这表明您很关心。

您可以在使用之前更改回复。添加您自己的详细信息，调整音调，或使其更短或更长。该应用程序为您提供了一个强有力的起点，因此您可以花更少的时间写作，而将更多的时间花在经营业务上。

回复评论可以帮助您的业务发展。人们在选择花钱的地方之前经常会阅读评论。当他们看到业主的有用回复时，他们知道有人在关注。这可以建立信心并鼓励更多人参观、致电或购买。

该应用程序易于使用。粘贴评论，选择您想要的样式，然后在几秒钟内生成回复。无需搜索模板或想知道该说什么。该应用程序可帮助您快速找到正确的单词。
使用它来评价正面评价、负面评价、五星级评价、一星级评价、首次顾客、老顾客、投诉、赞美、问题以及介于两者之间的一切。每条评论都是不同的，每一条回复都应该是个性化的。

保持您的品牌声音一致。无论您的业务是有趣、正式、温馨还是简单，您都可以创建符合您风格的回复。这有助于客户认可您的业务并随着时间的推移建立更牢固的联系。

该应用程序还有助于减轻压力。许多企业主担心说错话，尤其是在回应不满意的客户时。您无需从头开始，而是会得到一份经过深思熟虑的草稿，您可以在发布之前进行审查和调整。

快速回复可以带来很大的不同。客户喜欢知道他们的意见被倾听。快速回复表明您的企业关心反馈并希望改进。即使是简短的回复也能给人留下深刻的印象。

无论您每个月收到几条评论还是每天收到很多评论，此应用程序都可以帮助您掌握这些评论。节省时间，自信回复，并给予每位客户应有的关注。更好的对话可以带来更好的关系、更强的信任和更好的声誉。从今天开始撰写更明智的评论回复，减少打字时间，同时让每位客户都感到被倾听。

plugin_asdk_app_6a42d608995481919c044c15.productIntroEn: Vettara lets authorized workspace users prepare executive-search briefs, create editable MCP search sessions, launch private candidate searches, monitor run status, review compact candidate results, and export completed project CSVs from ChatGPT. Access is enforced through Vettara OAuth and each user only sees records available to their Vettara workspace permissions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a42d608995481919c044c15.longDescription: Vettara lets authorized workspace users prepare executive-search briefs, create editable MCP search sessions, launch private candidate searches, monitor run status, review compact candidate results, and export completed project CSVs from ChatGPT. Access is enforced through Vettara OAuth and each user only sees records available to their Vettara workspace permissions. Vettara supports sourcing and research workflows only and does not make hiring decisions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a42d608995481919c044c15.longDescriptionZh: Vettara 允许授权工作区用户准备高管搜索简报、创建可编辑的 MCP 搜索会话、启动私人候选人搜索、监控运行状态、审查紧凑的候选人结果以及从 ChatGPT 导出已完成的项目 CSV。访问是通过 Vettara OAuth 强制执行的，每个用户只能看到其 Vettara 工作区权限可用的记录。 Vettara 仅支持采购和研究工作流程，不做出招聘决定。

plugin_asdk_app_69cd2c4e26ac8191add6d0cc.name: Trendata Market Intelligence
plugin_asdk_app_69cd2c4e26ac8191add6d0cc.productIntro: Trendata 将您连接到实时市场情报和消费者搜索数据。它允许您直接在工作流程中轻松分析全球位置、产品类别以及特定品牌或零售商。通过提供历史搜索量和具体的增长指标，您可以准确地发现消费者偏好和不断变化的市场趋势。它将复杂的数据转化为清晰、可操作的见解，以做出更明智的业务决策。

By providing historical search volumes and concrete growth metrics, you can accurately spot consumer preferences and changing market trends.

plugin_asdk_app_6a5a6880b6dc8191897d607c.description: 值得您信赖的人工智能带来的收入
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a6880b6dc8191897d607c.originalDescription: AI you can trust with revenue
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a6880b6dc8191897d607c.productIntro: Clearskies 是收入 AI 的上下文层。一个连接即可将您的 CRM、电话、电子邮件、日历、Slack 和支持票证转化为每个帐户的单一、始终最新的图片，因此 ChatGPT 可以处理完整的记录，而不是重建上下文并猜测重要的内容。获取赢/输和代表绩效等深入分析，并运行通话前准备、CRM 卫生和交易风险等工作流程。一次组装的上下文是每个团队、工具和代理都可以重用的上下文，并且它会随着数据的增长而改进。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a6880b6dc8191897d607c.productIntroEn: Clearskies is the context layer for revenue AI. One connection turns your CRM, calls, email, calendar, Slack, and support tickets into a single, always-current picture of every account, so ChatGPT works across complete records instead of rebuilding context and guessing what matters.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a6880b6dc8191897d607c.longDescription: Clearskies is the context layer for revenue AI. One connection turns your CRM, calls, email, calendar, Slack, and support tickets into a single, always-current picture of every account, so ChatGPT works across complete records instead of rebuilding context and guessing what matters. Get deep analysis like win/loss and rep performance, and run workflows like pre-call prep, CRM hygiene, and deal risk. Context assembled once is context every team, tool, and agent can reuse, and it improves as your data grows.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a6880b6dc8191897d607c.longDescriptionZh: Clearskies 是收入 AI 的上下文层。一个连接即可将您的 CRM、电话、电子邮件、日历、Slack 和支持票证转化为每个帐户的单一、始终最新的图片，因此 ChatGPT 可以处理完整的记录，而不是重建上下文并猜测重要的内容。获取赢/输和代表绩效等深入分析，并运行通话前准备、CRM 卫生和交易风险等工作流程。一次组装的上下文是每个团队、工具和代理都可以重用的上下文，并且它会随着数据的增长而改进。

plugin_asdk_app_6a1d9e570188819180e6b571.name: Nexoya
plugin_asdk_app_6a1d9e570188819180e6b571.productIntro: Nexoya 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Nexoya 工作区，以便营销人员可以提出有关营销组合、营销活动或广告集内容、漏斗步骤、标签、事件、绩效指标、每日趋势、基于回归的归因和预算优化建议的自然语言问题。该应用程序可以帮助用户在不离开 ChatGPT 的情况下总结营销绩效、比较周期和渠道、检查 ROI 和 ROAS、推理趋势并解释最新的优化建议。访问权限仅限于登录用户的 Nexoya 帐户和团队权限。
plugin_asdk_app_6a1d9e570188819180e6b571.productIntroEn: Nexoya connects ChatGPT to a Nexoya workspace so marketers can ask natural-language questions about marketing portfolios, campaign or adset contents, funnel steps, labels, events, performance metrics, daily trends, regression-based attribution, and budget optimization recommendations.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1d9e570188819180e6b571.longDescription: Nexoya connects ChatGPT to a Nexoya workspace so marketers can ask natural-language questions about marketing portfolios, campaign or adset contents, funnel steps, labels, events, performance metrics, daily trends, regression-based attribution, and budget optimization recommendations. The app helps users summarize marketing performance, compare periods and channels, inspect ROI and ROAS, reason about trends, and explain the latest optimization proposal without leaving ChatGPT.
