plugin_asdk_app_6a89243b262481918a189c2e.name: adplane
plugin_asdk_app_6a89243b262481918a189c2e.description: 管理 Google 广告和元广告
plugin_asdk_app_6a89243b262481918a189c2e.originalDescription: Manage Google Ads and Meta Ads
plugin_asdk_app_6a89243b262481918a189c2e.productIntro: Adplane 将您的 Google Ads 和元广告帐户连接到 ChatGPT，以便您可以分析效果并在同一对话中进行更改。
plugin_asdk_app_6a89243b262481918a189c2e.productIntroEn: Adplane connects your Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts to ChatGPT so you can analyze performance and make changes in the same conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a89243b262481918a189c2e.longDescription:
Adplane connects your Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts to ChatGPT so you can analyze performance and make changes in the same conversation.

Ask questions in plain language and get answers from your live account data, on either platform or both at once. Compare campaigns across any date range, find where spend is going, pull search terms, put Google and Meta results side by side, or write raw GAQL when you need something the report builder does not cover. Money is returned in your account currency, already converted, so numbers can be read as-is.

Adplane also builds and changes campaigns. On Google it can create Search campaigns, ad groups, keywords, and responsive search ads, and add negative keywords. On Meta it can create campaigns, ad sets, ads, and creatives built from images and video you provide, with live previews. On both platforms it can update names, budgets, bids, and status on things that already exist.

Everything Adplane creates starts paused. A new campaign cannot serve or spend until you explicitly ask to turn it on, and turning something on is a separate, deliberate step through a single tool per platform. Negative keywords only restrict where ads show and can never spend. Deleting is limited to removing a campaign that has never spent, for cleaning up a draft you abandoned; there is no bulk delete. Every change is read back from the platform after it is applied, so what you see reported is what the platform actually stored.

Connecting takes one click. Sign in with the Google account you already use for Google Ads and every account you have access to is connected at once. Meta ad accounts connect from your accounts page with a Facebook sign-in.

Requires a Google Ads or Meta ad account and an Adplane account at adplane.ai.
plugin_asdk_app_6a89243b262481918a189c2e.longDescriptionZh:
Adplane 将您的 Google Ads 和元广告帐户连接到 ChatGPT，以便您可以分析效果并在同一对话中进行更改。

在任一平台或同时在两个平台上以通俗易懂的语言提出问题，并从您的真实账户数据中获取答案。比较任何日期范围内的营销活动、查找支出去向、提取搜索词、并排放置 Google 和 Meta 结果，或者在您需要报告生成器未涵盖的内容时编写原始 GAQL。资金以您的帐户货币退回，并且已经转换，因此可以按原样读取数字。

Adplane 还构建和更改营销活动。在 Google 上，它可以创建搜索广告系列、广告组、关键字和响应式搜索广告，并添加否定关键字。在 Meta 上，它可以根据您提供的图像和视频创建营销活动、广告集、广告和创意，并提供实时预览。在这两个平台上，它都可以更新已存在事物的名称、预算、出价和状态。

Adplane 创建的所有内容都开始暂停。除非您明确要求将其打开，否则新的广告系列无法投放或支出，而打开某些内容是通过每个平台的单一工具进行的单独的、经过深思熟虑的步骤。否定关键字仅限制广告展示的位置，并且永远无法支出。删除仅限于删除从未花费过的活动，以清理您放弃的草稿；没有批量删除。每个更改在应用后都会从平台读回，因此您看到的报告就是平台实际存储的内容。

只需单击一下即可连接。使用您已用于 Google Ads 的 Google 帐户登录，您有权访问的每个帐户都会立即连接。元广告帐户通过 Facebook 登录从您的帐户页面进行连接。

需要 Google Ads 或元广告帐户以及 adplane.ai 上的 Adplane 帐户。
defaultPrompts: Which ad accounts do I have connected?
How much did I spend on Google Ads in the last 30 days, by campaign?
Show me my Meta campaigns with their status and budgets.
defaultPromptsZh: 我连接了哪些广告帐户？
过去 30 天内我在 Google Ads 上花费了多少钱（按广告系列划分）？
显示我的元广告系列及其状态和预算。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3a3f4a5f708191a14ef415.name: Velaris Basic
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a3f4a5f708191a14ef415.productIntro: Velaris Basic 可让您使用简单的语言直接从 ChatGPT 访问客户数据 — 无需仪表板，无需切换选项卡。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a3f4a5f708191a14ef415.productIntroEn: Velaris Basic lets you access your customer data directly from ChatGPT, using plain language — no dashboards, no switching tabs.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a3f4a5f708191a14ef415.longDescription:
Velaris Basic lets you access your customer data directly from ChatGPT, using plain language — no dashboards, no switching tabs.

What you can do:

Look up accounts and organizations — check health scores, churn status, ARR, lifecycle stage, and assigned CSM for any customer.
Search contacts — find individuals by name, account, or role and review their details.
Track risks and opportunities — surface at-risk accounts or open expansion opportunities across your book of business.
Manage notes and tasks — read existing notes, create new ones, and update tasks tied to customer records.
Who it's for:
Customer Success Managers and CS leaders who want a faster way to access and update their Velaris data without leaving their workflow.

Requires a Velaris account. Read and write access is governed by your Velaris role permissions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a3f4a5f708191a14ef415.longDescriptionZh:
Velaris Basic 可让您使用简单的语言直接从 ChatGPT 访问客户数据 — 无需仪表板，无需切换选项卡。

你可以做什么：

查找帐户和组织 - 检查健康评分、流失状态、ARR、生命周期阶段以及为任何客户分配的 CSM。
搜索联系人 - 按姓名、帐户或角色查找个人并查看其详细信息。
跟踪风险和机遇——在您的业务范围内显示有风险的账户或开放的扩张机会。
管理笔记和任务 - 阅读现有笔记、创建新笔记以及更新与客户记录相关的任务。
适合谁：
希望在不离开工作流程的情况下以更快的方式访问和更新 Velaris 数据的客户成功经理和 CS 领导者。

需要 Velaris 帐户。读取和写入访问权限由您的 Velaris 角色权限控制。

plugin_asdk_app_6a05acaf22a481918028b9e5.name: Coevera
plugin_asdk_app_6a05acaf22a481918028b9e5.description: 管理您的 Coevera CRM 数据
plugin_asdk_app_6a05acaf22a481918028b9e5.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Coevera（以前称为 Pipeliner CRM），并以对话方式处理您的销售数据。使用自然语言查询搜索客户、联系人、潜在客户、机会、任务和约会，然后直接从聊天中创建后续任务或更新交易阶段。服务器支持标准字段、自定义字段和自定义实体，并带有过滤器以进行精确查询。对于准备通话的销售代表、检查管道运行状况的经理以及运行临时报告（无需导出为 CSV）的运营团队来说非常有用。
plugin_asdk_app_6a05acaf22a481918028b9e5.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your Coevera (formerly Pipeliner CRM) and work with your sales data conversationally. Search accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, tasks, and appointments using natural-language queries, then create follow-up tasks or update deal stages directly from chat. The server supports standard fields, custom fields, and custom entities, with filters for precise queries.
plugin_asdk_app_6a05acaf22a481918028b9e5.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your Coevera (formerly Pipeliner CRM) and work with your sales data conversationally. Search accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, tasks, and appointments using natural-language queries, then create follow-up tasks or update deal stages directly from chat. The server supports standard fields, custom fields, and custom entities, with filters for precise queries. Useful for sales reps preparing for calls, managers reviewing pipeline health, and ops teams running ad-hoc reports without exporting to CSV.

plugin_asdk_app_69f1d288a5ac8191b3d01822.name: 4Degrees
plugin_asdk_app_69f1d288a5ac8191b3d01822.description: 在 ChatGPT 中点击您的网络
plugin_asdk_app_69f1d288a5ac8191b3d01822.productIntro: 4Degrees 将您的关系情报和交易流带入 ChatGPT。用简单的英语询问您的联系人、公司和交易——“谁是我成为 Stripe 首席技术官的最温暖途径？”、“按阶段向我展示 B 轮交易”、“今天需要我注意什么？”。您还可以更新您的 CRM（添加标签、记录注释和移动交易阶段），并通过每次更改的预览和确认步骤以及一键撤消。通过 OAuth 将每个队友的范围限定到您的席位已拥有的数据和权限。专为私募市场投资者、并购团队和搜索基金而设计。
plugin_asdk_app_69f1d288a5ac8191b3d01822.productIntroEn: 4Degrees brings your relationship intelligence and deal flow into ChatGPT. Ask about your contacts, companies, and deals in plain English — "who's my warmest path to a CTO at Stripe?", "show me Series B deals by stage", "what needs my attention today?".
plugin_asdk_app_69f1d288a5ac8191b3d01822.longDescription: 4Degrees brings your relationship intelligence and deal flow into ChatGPT. Ask about your contacts, companies, and deals in plain English — "who's my warmest path to a CTO at Stripe?", "show me Series B deals by stage", "what needs my attention today?". You can also update your CRM — add tags, log notes, and move deal stages — with a preview-and-confirm step on every change and one-tap undo. Scoped per-teammate via OAuth to the data and permissions your seat already has. Designed for private-markets investors, M&A teams, and search funds.

plugin_asdk_app_69680cd25f3c81918d933557.longDescription:
Software + AI pricing isn't public, so searching the internet won't tell you if you're overpaying. Tropic will.

Connect Tropic to ChatGPT to benchmark your pricing against $18B+ in verified technology spend, access negotiation playbooks from 100,000+ real deals, and get supplier intelligence on competitors and contract terms. Upload a proposal, ask if you're getting a good price, and go into your next negotiation with real leverage.

Your existing Tropic permissions apply. You only see data you're authorized to access in the Tropic app.

plugin_asdk_app_6a706dc692d08191a3a1aa5e.name: LZ Virtual Mail
plugin_asdk_app_6a706dc692d08191a3a1aa5e.productIntro: LegalZoom 虚拟邮件可将您的企业和个人邮政邮件数字化，现在您可以直接在 ChatGPT 中查找、理解和管理它。
plugin_asdk_app_6a706dc692d08191a3a1aa5e.productIntroEn: LegalZoom Virtual Mail digitizes your business and personal postal mail and now you can find, understand, and manage it directly in ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a706dc692d08191a3a1aa5e.longDescription:
LegalZoom Virtual Mail digitizes your business and personal postal mail and now you can find, understand, and manage it directly in ChatGPT.

Ask about new or unread mail, search for specific items, and read or summarize scanned documents. You can also organize mail with folders and tags, review mailbox status and alerts, and check the progress of mail-handling requests.

What you can do:
• Find mail by sender, recipient, date, status, tag, or content
• Read and summarize scanned mail
• Request eligible items to be opened and scanned
• Archive, organize, or securely shred eligible mail
• Track shipments and available check-forwarding activity

A LegalZoom Virtual Mail account is required. Some features depend on your account, plan, verification status, and the actions available for each mail item. Physical mail requests may require processing time.
plugin_asdk_app_6a706dc692d08191a3a1aa5e.longDescriptionZh:
LegalZoom 虚拟邮件可将您的企业和个人邮政邮件数字化，现在您可以直接在 ChatGPT 中查找、理解和管理它。

询问新的或未读的邮件、搜索特定项目以及阅读或总结扫描的文档。您还可以使用文件夹和标签组织邮件、查看邮箱状态和警报以及检查邮件处理请求的进度。

你可以做什么：
• 按发件人、收件人、日期、状态、标签或内容查找邮件
• 阅读并总结扫描的邮件
• 要求打开并扫描符合条件的物品
• 存档、组织或安全粉碎符合条件的邮件
• 跟踪货运和可用的支票转发活动

需要 LegalZoom 虚拟邮件帐户。某些功能取决于您的帐户、计划、验证状态以及每个邮件项目可用的操作。物理邮件请求可能需要处理时间。

Read my latest scanned letter and summarize it.
Show me the shipment and tracking status for my forwarded mail.
defaultPromptsZh: 显示我的虚拟邮箱中的最新活动。
阅读我最新的扫描信并进行总结。
显示我转发的邮件的发货和跟踪状态。

plugin_asdk_app_698cc2d00acc8191aff29c79.name: Spacebring
plugin_asdk_app_698cc2d00acc8191aff29c79.description: 管理您的联合办公空间
plugin_asdk_app_698cc2d00acc8191aff29c79.productIntro: Spacebring 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的联合办公空间管理平台，让您可以即时访问企业的运营数据以进行报告、会员支持和日常决策。
plugin_asdk_app_698cc2d00acc8191aff29c79.productIntroEn: Spacebring connects ChatGPT to your coworking space management platform, giving you instant access to your business' operational data for reporting, member support, and day-to-day decision-making.
plugin_asdk_app_698cc2d00acc8191aff29c79.longDescription:
Spacebring connects ChatGPT to your coworking space management platform, giving you instant access to your business' operational data for reporting, member support, and day-to-day decision-making.

Spacebring helps coworking space operators deliver superior member service through automated operations, built-in AI, and an admin mobile app. The platform helps operators serve customers faster, reduce admin chores, and streamline operations, while delivering a seamless branded customer experience to sign up, book, pay, and get support with ease.

This plugin lets ChatGPT query your live Spacebring data directly in conversation, so you can ask questions, get answers without switching tools or building reports manually.

Key features:
• Pull details on your network and every location you operate, including configuration and status.
•  Look up members and companies in your network, including their details and account status.
•  Access contracts and the templates behind them, useful for audits, renewals, and legal review.
•  Review active subscriptions and the membership plans tied to them.
•  Retrieve invoice records for billing checks, reconciliation, and reporting.
•  Query benefit categories, individual benefits, and member benefit applications.
•  Look up shop categories, products, and orders for on-site retail or add-on services.
•  Access member-facing guides and resources published in your network.

This plugin is read-only today: it's built for retrieving and analyzing data, not making changes to your Spacebring account. Future updates will expand coverage further and eventually support write actions (like updating records or triggering workflows) directly from ChatGPT.

Built by the Spacebring team for the Spacebring family.
plugin_asdk_app_698cc2d00acc8191aff29c79.longDescriptionZh:
Spacebring 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的联合办公空间管理平台，让您可以即时访问企业的运营数据以进行报告、会员支持和日常决策。

Spacebring 通过自动化操作、内置人工智能和管理移动应用程序，帮助联合办公空间运营商提供卓越的会员服务。该平台可帮助运营商更快地为客户提供服务，减少管理工作并简化运营，同时提供无缝的品牌客户体验，以便轻松注册、预订、付款和获得支持。

该插件可让 ChatGPT 在对话中直接查询您的实时 Spacebring 数据，这样您就可以提出问题、获得答案，而无需切换工具或手动构建报告。

主要特点：
• 获取有关您的网络和您运营的每个位置的详细信息，包括配置和状态。
•  查找网络中的成员和公司，包括他们的详细信息和帐户状态。
•  访问合同及其背后的模板，对于审核、续订和法律审查非常有用。
• 查看有效订阅以及与其相关的会员计划。
•  检索发票记录以进行账单检查、对账和报告。
•  查询福利类别、个人福利和会员福利申请。
•  查找商店类别、产品和现场零售或附加服务的订单。
•  访问您网络中发布的面向会员的指南和资源。

该插件目前是只读的：它是为检索和分析数据而构建的，而不是对您的 Spacebring 帐户进行更改。未来的更新将进一步扩大覆盖范围，并最终支持直接从 ChatGPT 进行写入操作（例如更新记录或触发工作流程）。

由 Spacebring 团队为 Spacebring 家族打造。

plugin_asdk_app_69fc68c5091c81919fccb6b6.productIntro: 连接到 Adthena 竞争情报平台，分析付费搜索市场、监控竞争对手并直接在 ChatGPT 内发现搜索机会。
plugin_asdk_app_69fc68c5091c81919fccb6b6.productIntroEn: Connect to the Adthena competitive intelligence platform to analyze paid search markets, monitor competitors, and uncover search opportunities directly inside ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_69fc68c5091c81919fccb6b6.longDescription:
Connect to the Adthena competitive intelligence platform to analyze paid search markets, monitor competitors, and uncover search opportunities directly inside ChatGPT.

Explore market share trends, compare advertiser visibility, discover high-value search terms, analyze ad copy strategies, track AI Overview presence, and detect potential trademark infringements using natural language queries.

Ask questions like “Who is gaining market share in running shoes?”, “What ad copy themes are competitors using?”, or “Which search terms are driving growth in this category?” and receive structured, data-driven insights instantly.

plugin_asdk_app_6a7afe588ab08191833eda9f.name: Dreambooth Studio
plugin_asdk_app_6a7afe588ab08191833eda9f.productIntro: Dreambooth Studio 经营自助照相亭，就是您在 婚礼、活动和购物中心。这个应用程序在聊天中回答有关他们的问题。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7afe588ab08191833eda9f.productIntroEn: Dreambooth Studio runs self-service photobooths, the kind you find at weddings, events and malls. This app answers questions about them in chat.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7afe588ab08191833eda9f.longDescription:
Dreambooth Studio runs self-service photobooths, the kind you find at
weddings, events and malls. This app answers questions about them in chat.

Thinking of starting one? Ask what hardware you need, which cameras and
printers work, how the plans are priced, what each print costs in paper
and ribbon, or how payments and payouts work. Answers come from the
Dreambooth documentation, and none of it needs an account.

Already running booths? Connect your account and ask how a booth did last
weekend, what you earned this month and how much of it was cash, whether a
booth is online right now, how many AI credits are left, or how much media
a booth has produced. A sentence back, instead of opening the dashboard.

Connecting your account is the only thing it changes. After that it only
reads: it cannot edit a booth, issue a refund, move money or delete
anything, and it sees only the account you sign in with. Your booths,
never another operator's.

When a figure leaves something out it says so. Cash and voucher income
never reaches the wallet ledger, so income is reported from the sessions
themselves rather than handed to you as a partial total.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7afe588ab08191833eda9f.longDescriptionZh:
Dreambooth Studio 经营自助照相亭，就是您在
婚礼、活动和购物中心。这个应用程序在聊天中回答有关他们的问题。

考虑开始一个吗？询问您需要什么硬件、哪些相机和
打印机的工作原理、计划如何定价、每次打印的纸张成本是多少
和功能区，或者付款和付款的工作方式。答案来自于
Dreambooth 文档，并且都不需要帐户。

已经在运营摊位了吗？连接您的帐户并询问摊位的持续情况
周末，你这个月挣了多少钱，其中有多少是现金，是否
摊位现在上线，还剩多少AI积分，或者还有多少媒体
一个摊位已经制作完成。回复一句话，而不是打开仪表板。

连接您的帐户是唯一改变的事情。之后就只有
内容为：它无法编辑摊位、发放退款、转移资金或删除
任何东西，它只会看到您登录所用的帐户。您的摊位，
绝不是其他运营商的。

当一个人物漏掉一些东西时，它就是这样说的。现金及代金券收入
永远不会到达钱包分类账，因此收入是从会话中报告的
它们本身，而不是作为部分整体交给您。

上周我的摊位表现如何？

plugin_asdk_app_6a7e00f905a88191a46f1d21.productIntro: DashThis 是一个营销报告平台，可将来自 30 多个营销集成的数据引入代理机构和内部营销团队的仪表板中。此连接器为 ChatGPT 提供对用户 DashThis 帐户上的仪表板的只读访问权限。用户可以列出和搜索仪表板，查看仪表板的设置方式以及为其提供数据的来源，检查支持的报告周期的当前小部件值，将结果与另一个周期进行比较，识别具有源错误的仪表板，并将仪表板结果转换为客户端可用的摘要。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7e00f905a88191a46f1d21.productIntroEn: DashThis is a marketing reporting platform that brings data from 30+ marketing integrations into dashboards for agencies and in-house marketing teams. This connector gives ChatGPT read-only access to the dashboards on the user's DashThis account.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7e00f905a88191a46f1d21.longDescription: DashThis is a marketing reporting platform that brings data from 30+ marketing integrations into dashboards for agencies and in-house marketing teams. This connector gives ChatGPT read-only access to the dashboards on the user's DashThis account. Users can list and search dashboards, see how a dashboard is set up and which sources feed it, inspect current widget values for supported reporting periods, compare results with another period, identify dashboards with source errors, and turn dashboard results into client-ready summaries. The connector cannot create, edit, delete, send, or schedule anything in the user's DashThis account. It only reads data already available through the user's DashThis dashboards and requires the user to connect their DashThis account with OAuth.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7e00f905a88191a46f1d21.longDescriptionZh: DashThis 是一个营销报告平台，可将来自 30 多个营销集成的数据引入代理机构和内部营销团队的仪表板中。此连接器为 ChatGPT 提供对用户 DashThis 帐户上的仪表板的只读访问权限。用户可以列出和搜索仪表板，查看仪表板的设置方式以及为其提供数据的来源，检查支持的报告周期的当前小部件值，将结果与另一个周期进行比较，识别具有源错误的仪表板，并将仪表板结果转换为客户端可用的摘要。连接器无法在用户的 DashThis 帐户中创建、编辑、删除、发送或安排任何内容。它仅读取通过用户的 DashThis 仪表板可用的数据，并要求用户将其 DashThis 帐户与 OAuth 连接。

plugin_asdk_app_69c97dfccdac819182320df3.productIntro: SAIRYŌ 帮助活动组织者和客户使用 ChatGPT 搜索他们的活动和报告、获取活动或收入详细信息，并查看请求日期范围内的门票销售 KPI 快照。它还允许主办方创建自己的活动，并提供在 SAIRYŌ 网站上完成的链接。
plugin_asdk_app_69c97dfccdac819182320df3.productIntroEn: SAIRYŌ helps event organizers and customers use ChatGPT to search their events and reports, fetch event or revenue details, and review ticket-sales KPI snapshots for a requested date range. It will also allow hosts to create their own events with a link to complete on SAIRYŌ's website.
plugin_asdk_app_69c97dfccdac819182320df3.longDescription:
SAIRYŌ helps event organizers and customers use ChatGPT to search their events and reports, fetch event or revenue details, and review ticket-sales KPI snapshots for a requested date range. It will also allow hosts to create their own events with a link to complete on SAIRYŌ's website. 

The app does not facilitate in-chat commerce, payment, order creation, ticket fulfillment, transfers, or digital goods. It is limited to event discovery, event information, ticket tier display, and providing a link to the official SAIRYŌ.live page where any transaction is completed directly by the user.

Note: The SAIRYŌ ChatGPT app receives only the minimum information required to respond to a user’s event-related request, such as event ID, city, date range, category, ticket tier ID, or quantity. The app does not receive full conversation history, payment card details, or unrelated personal information. Purchases, payments, refunds, and ticket fulfillment occur only on SAIRYŌ.live and are governed by SAIRYŌ’s website terms and privacy policy.
plugin_asdk_app_69c97dfccdac819182320df3.longDescriptionZh:
SAIRYŌ 帮助活动组织者和客户使用 ChatGPT 搜索他们的活动和报告、获取活动或收入详细信息，并查看请求日期范围内的门票销售 KPI 快照。它还允许主办方创建自己的活动，并提供在 SAIRYŌ 网站上完成的链接。 

该应用程序不促进聊天内商务、支付、订单创建、票据履行、转账或数字商品。它仅限于活动发现、活动信息、门票等级显示以及提供官方 SAIRYŌ.live 页面的链接，在该页面上任何交易均由用户直接完成。

注意：SAIRYŌ ChatGPT 应用程序仅接收响应用户的活动相关请求所需的最少信息，例如活动 ID、城市、日期范围、类别、门票等级 ID 或数量。该应用程序不会接收完整的对话历史记录、支付卡详细信息或不相关的个​​人信息。购买、付款、退款和门票履行仅在 SAIRYŌ.live 上进行，并受 SAIRYŌ 网站条款和隐私政策的约束。

plugin_asdk_app_6a70ac2559fc8191b4020611.name: Badger Maps (Advanced)
plugin_asdk_app_6a70ac2559fc8191b4020611.productIntro: Badger Maps 是排名第一的现场销售平台。
plugin_asdk_app_6a70ac2559fc8191b4020611.productIntroEn: Badger Maps is the #1 field sales platform.
plugin_asdk_app_6a70ac2559fc8191b4020611.longDescription:
Badger Maps is the #1 field sales platform.

Badger AI brings a new layer of intelligence to the platform your team already uses. Opt into the features that make sense for your workflow — from AI-built routes to automated CRM updates — and let Badger handle the busy work so your reps can spend more time selling.

AI Route Planner: Your optimal week, built automatically
Stop deciding who to see and when. Badger AI analyzes your accounts and builds your entire week automatically — prioritizing your stops by last visit date, follow-up status, and opportunity size, all built around the existing meetings in your calendar.

Automated Follow-Up Emails: No deal goes cold. No follow-up gets missed.
Deals die in the silence between meetings. Badger AI reads your meeting notes and automatically drafts and sends personalized follow-up emails to every customer — so the right message goes to the right person at the right time, without you lifting a finger.

Automated Scheduling Emails: Scheduling, without the back and forth
Before you even leave for the field, Badger AI analyzes your routes and sends targeted email blasts to prospects in the areas you're visiting — so by the time you're on the road, meetings are already being set up around your existing schedule.

The old way of field sales is over.

plugin_asdk_app_6a79a62ffec081918338dda6.name: Beamtrace
plugin_asdk_app_6a79a62ffec081918338dda6.description: 了解 AI 如何对您的业务进行排名
plugin_asdk_app_6a79a62ffec081918338dda6.originalDescription: See how AI ranks your business
plugin_asdk_app_6a79a62ffec081918338dda6.productIntro: Beamtrace 是一个 AI 可见性平台，涵盖 AI 搜索中的可见性指标、提示跟踪、网站优化和声誉管理。它旨在展示当人们向人工智能寻求建议时您的业务如何发展。
plugin_asdk_app_6a79a62ffec081918338dda6.productIntroEn: Beamtrace is an AI visibility platform covering your visibility metrics, prompt tracking, website optimization, and reputation management in AI search. It's built to show how your business holds up when people turn to AI for recommendations.
plugin_asdk_app_6a79a62ffec081918338dda6.longDescription:
Beamtrace is an AI visibility platform covering your visibility metrics, prompt tracking, website optimization, and reputation management in AI search. It's built to show how your business holds up when people turn to AI for recommendations.

The app puts your data into a conversation ChatGPT can work with: cross-reference numbers, explain what's behind a drop, and turn scores into something you can act on or hand off.

What you can do with it
#1 Spot the pattern behind your visibility
- "Why don't AI assistants recommend my business?" 
Reads across every prompt you're missing from and names what they have in common.

#2 Find your competitor's edge
- "Why did my competitor jump ahead this month?"
Pulls the competitor leaderboard, then narrows it to what they did or what changed to cause it.

#3 Prioritize your next content fix
- "I can fix only one thing this month, what should I do?”
Ranks your content improvements by impact rather than listing every gap flat, so you know exactly where to start and what to do.

#4 Understand what moved your score
- "What changed in my AI visibility this month?" 
Checks the score trend against the topic and prompt movement to tell you whether it's a real shift.

#5 Build a client-ready report
- "Build this month's AI visibility summary for my client" 
Draws the score, competitor standing, and top fixes, and writes it up as a report that you can paste anywhere.

#6 Know what a metric actually means
- "What does [metric] mean for my visibility, and should I care about it?"
Explains what a metric measures or gives a read on your visibility state in simple words.

How to get started
- Sign in with a Beamtrace account.
- The app reads live data from your connected website.
- No setup beyond that; start the conversation.

Ask a question in plain language and get an analysis scoped to your business.

Requirements
Your business needs an active subscription or trial. A website must be connected to the service. If it isn't, ChatGPT points you to Beamtrace's setup page instead of guessing at your data. 

It doesn't change your Beamtrace settings, tracked prompts, or account data. It reads your dashboard and hands the numbers to ChatGPT for analysis, reporting, and Q&A.
plugin_asdk_app_6a79a62ffec081918338dda6.longDescriptionZh:
Beamtrace 是一个 AI 可见性平台，涵盖 AI 搜索中的可见性指标、提示跟踪、网站优化和声誉管理。它旨在展示当人们向人工智能寻求建议时您的业务如何发展。

该应用程序将您的数据放入 ChatGPT 可以使用的对话中：交叉引用数字，解释掉落背后的原因，并将分数转化为您可以采取行动或移交的东西。

你可以用它做什么
#1 发现你的知名度背后的模式
- “为什么人工智能助手不推荐我的生意？” 
阅读您错过的每个提示并指出它们的共同点。

#2 找到竞争对手的优势
- “为什么我的竞争对手这个月领先了？”
拉出竞争对手排行榜，然后将其范围缩小到他们所做的事情或导致其发生的变化。

#3 确定下一个内容修复的优先顺序
- “这个月我只能解决一件事，我该怎么办？”
按影响对您的内容改进进行排名，而不是列出每个差距，以便您确切地知道从哪里开始以及做什么。

#4 了解是什么改变了你的分数
- “这个月我的人工智能可见度发生了什么变化？” 
根据主题检查分数趋势并提示移动，以告诉您这是否是真正的转变。

#5 构建可供客户使用的报告
-“为我的客户构建本月的人工智能可见度摘要” 
绘制得分、竞争对手排名和最佳修复，并将其写成可以粘贴到任何地方的报告。

#6 了解指标的实际含义
- “[指标] 对我的可见性意味着什么？我应该关心它吗？”
用简单的语言解释指标衡量的内容或了解您的可见性状态。

如何开始
- 使用 Beamtrace 帐户登录。
- 该应用程序从您连接的网站读取实时数据。
- 除此之外没有任何设置；开始对话。

用简单的语言提出问题并获得适合您业务的分析。

要求
您的企业需要有效的订阅或试用。网站必须连接到该服务。如果不是，ChatGPT 会将您引导至 Beamtrace 的设置页面，而不是猜测您的数据。 

它不会更改您的 Beamtrace 设置、跟踪提示或帐户数据。它读取您的仪表板并将数据传递给 ChatGPT 进行分析、报告和问答。
defaultPrompts: Why don't AI assistants recommend my business?
Which AI search questions is my top competitor winning?
What should I fix first to raise my score?
defaultPromptsZh: 为什么人工智能助手不推荐我的商家？
我的顶级竞争对手在哪些人工智能搜索问题上获胜？
我应该首先解决什么问题才能提高分数？

plugin_asdk_app_6a4ac2b699748191a0a9dca2.description: 检测图像和 PDF 中的欺诈行为
plugin_asdk_app_6a4ac2b699748191a0a9dca2.originalDescription: Detect Fraud in Images and PDF
plugin_asdk_app_6a4ac2b699748191a0a9dca2.productIntro: 检测图像和 PDF 文档中的欺诈、操纵和 AI 生成的迹象。上传文件，应用程序会分析该文件的真实性信号，例如可能的编辑、合成内容、文档篡改和人工智能生成的视觉效果。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4ac2b699748191a0a9dca2.productIntroEn: Detect signs of fraud, manipulation, and AI generation in images and PDF documents. Upload a file and the app analyzes it for authenticity signals such as possible edits, synthetic content, document tampering, and AI-generated visuals.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4ac2b699748191a0a9dca2.longDescription:
Detect signs of fraud, manipulation, and AI generation in images and PDF documents. Upload a file and the app analyzes it for authenticity signals such as possible edits, synthetic content, document tampering, and AI-generated visuals.

It helps teams quickly review suspicious images, identity documents, invoices, statements, screenshots, and PDFs before making decisions. Results are presented in a clear, easy-to-understand format so users can spot risks faster, reduce manual review time, and make more confident fraud checks.

Ideal for compliance teams, fraud analysts, marketplaces, fintech platforms, KYC providers, insurers, and anyone who needs a practical way to assess whether visual content or documents may have been altered, forged, or AI-generated.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4ac2b699748191a0a9dca2.longDescriptionZh:
检测图像和 PDF 文档中的欺诈、操纵和 AI 生成的迹象。上传文件，应用程序会分析该文件的真实性信号，例如可能的编辑、合成内容、文档篡改和人工智能生成的视觉效果。

它可以帮助团队在做出决策之前快速审查可疑图像、身份证件、发票、报表、屏幕截图和 PDF。结果以清晰、易于理解的格式呈现，因此用户可以更快地发现风险，减少人工审核时间，并更自信地进行欺诈检查。

非常适合合规团队、欺诈分析师、市场、金融科技平台、KYC 提供商、保险公司以及任何需要实用方法来评估视觉内容或文档是否已被更改、伪造或人工智能生成的人。
defaultPrompts: Is this image is AI-generated?
defaultPromptsZh: 这张图片是人工智能生成的吗？

plugin_asdk_app_6a70ca16fd8c81919b5cf5fd.name: Quotient
plugin_asdk_app_6a70ca16fd8c81919b5cf5fd.productIntro: Quotient 是一个集人工智能原生平台和智能代理于一体的平台；旨在跨电子邮件、社交媒体、博客和活动规划和执行营销活动，无需使用您已经无法满足的分散工具。
plugin_asdk_app_6a70ca16fd8c81919b5cf5fd.productIntroEn: Quotient is an AI-native platform and intelligent agent in one; built to plan and execute campaigns across email, social, blog, and events, without the fragmented tools you've outgrown.
plugin_asdk_app_6a70ca16fd8c81919b5cf5fd.longDescription:
Quotient is an AI-native platform and intelligent agent in one; built to plan and execute campaigns across email, social, blog, and events, without the fragmented tools you've outgrown.

At its core, Quotient is an AI demand marketing platform. It brings everything that attracts customers: blogs, social posts, email, webinars and events, and brand-building, into one integrated workspace. You work with Quotient like a coworker. Describe what you want in plain English, and it takes it from there.

Campaigns organize your marketing around a central goal, like a feature launch or event. Each is a coordinated set of tasks and deliverables moving through a clear workflow. Deliverables are the real assets Quotient creates and ships: blog posts, email broadcasts, marketing events, automated flows, and social posts for X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. Ask Quotient to build a campaign end to end: it writes the brief, breaks the work into tasks, sets the timeline, and produces each deliverable.

Quotient gets smarter over time, drawing on a Knowledge Store of brand information, recording memories of your preferences, and using tools to search the web and pull from your audience of people and companies.

The result is a single platform where strategy, content, and execution live together, replacing the patchwork of disconnected marketing tools with one AI that plans, writes, and ships.
plugin_asdk_app_6a70ca16fd8c81919b5cf5fd.longDescriptionZh:
Quotient 是一个集人工智能原生平台和智能代理于一体的平台；旨在跨电子邮件、社交媒体、博客和活动规划和执行营销活动，无需使用您已经无法满足的分散工具。

Quotient 的核心是一个人工智能需求营销平台。它将吸引客户的一切内容：博客、社交帖子、电子邮件、网络研讨会和活动以及品牌建设整合到一个集成的工作空间中。您像同事一样与 Quotient 一起工作。用简单的英语描述你想要什么，然后它就会从那里开始。

营销活动围绕一个中心目标组织您的营销活动，例如功能发布或活动。每一项都是通过清晰的工作流程进行协调的一组任务和可交付成果。可交付成果是 Quotient 创建和交付的真实资产：博客文章、电子邮件广播、营销活动、自动化流程以及 X、LinkedIn、Instagram、Facebook 和 TikTok 的社交帖子。要求 Quotient 端到端地构建一个营销活动：它编写概要、将工作分解为任务、设定时间表并生成每个可交付成果。

随着时间的推移，商数变得越来越聪明，它利用品牌信息的知识库，记录您的偏好记忆，并使用工具搜索网络并从您的受众和公司中获取信息。

结果是一个单一平台，其中战略、内容和执行共存，用一个可以规划、编写和发布的人工智能取代了杂乱无章的营销工具。
defaultPrompts: Create a launch campaign for our new product, including a brief, tasks, and draft social posts.
Stand up a weekly newsletter program with template, recurring Agent Job, and evergreen campaign to link all email broadcasts to.
List our current campaigns and help me decide what marketing work should happen next.

plugin_asdk_app_6a39af10a3a08191a83911e4.name: Data247
plugin_asdk_app_6a39af10a3a08191a83911e4.productIntro: Data247 将实时联系人和身份数据引入 ChatGPT，用于识别和验证联系人信息、欺诈活动、TCPA 合规性等。
plugin_asdk_app_6a39af10a3a08191a83911e4.productIntroEn: Data247 brings real-time contact and identity data into ChatGPT, for identifying and verifying contact information, fraudulent activity, TCPA compliance, and more.
plugin_asdk_app_6a39af10a3a08191a83911e4.longDescription:
Data247 brings real-time contact and identity data into ChatGPT, for identifying and verifying contact information,  fraudulent activity, TCPA compliance, and more. 
 
Ask in plain language and ChatGPT runs the lookup for you: confirm whether a phone line is active and what carrier and line type it is, check whether an email is deliverable, validate a postal address, or find the person behind a phone or email. Before you call or text a US number, check it against the Do-Not-Call registry, and add numbers to your internal DNC list when someone opts out. Looking into a suspicious signup or order? Geolocate the IP for proxy/VPN signals and screen the details for fraud.

Upload spreadsheets or lists of data to be cleaned, appended to, or  validated, and ChatGPT will consult Data247 and give it back to you completely processed.

It's handy for keeping a CRM clean, validating and enriching leads before outreach, staying compliant with calling rules, and reviewing flagged accounts.

You must have an active Data247 account, and lookups are billed per use against your prepaid balance — checking your balance and rate card is free, and you can ask for either anytime.
plugin_asdk_app_6a39af10a3a08191a83911e4.longDescriptionZh:
Data247 将实时联系人和身份数据引入 ChatGPT，用于识别和验证联系人信息、欺诈活动、TCPA 合规性等。 
 
用简单的语言询问，ChatGPT 会为您运行查找：确认电话线路是否处于活动状态以及其运营商和线路类型，检查电子邮件是否可以送达，验证邮政地址，或者找到电话或电子邮件背后的人员。在您拨打美国号码或发短信之前，请对照拒收来电注册表进行检查，并在有人选择退出时将号码添加到您的内部 DNC 列表中。正在调查可疑的注册或订单？地理定位代理/VPN 信号的 IP，并筛查欺诈的详细信息。

上传要清理、附加或验证的电子表格或数据列表，ChatGPT 将咨询 Data247 并将其完全处理后返回给您。

它可以方便地保持 CRM 干净、在外展之前验证和丰富潜在客户、遵守呼叫规则以及审查标记的帐户。

您必须有一个有效的 Data247 帐户，并且查询是根据您的预付余额按使用次数计费的 - 检查您的余额和价目表是免费的，您可以随时索取。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7e0dd98e0481919510faaf.description: 验证并查找电子邮件地址
plugin_asdk_app_6a7e0dd98e0481919510faaf.productIntro: ClearBounce 在 ChatGPT 内实时验证电子邮件地址。询问某个地址是否可以安全地发送电子邮件，它会运行全面检查 - 语法、MX 记录、实时邮箱检查、一次性和角色帐户检测、拼写错误救援和风险评分 - 返回明确的状态和 0-100 的质量分数。它还可以从姓名和公司域中查找某人的商务电子邮件，并报告您的剩余信用余额。登录使用 OAuth：您的密码永远不会通过聊天传递。新帐户包含 100 个免费积分。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7e0dd98e0481919510faaf.productIntroEn: ClearBounce verifies email addresses in real time inside ChatGPT. Ask whether an address is safe to email and it runs a full check - syntax, MX records, a live mailbox check, disposable and role-account detection, typo rescue and risk scoring - returning a clear status and a 0-100 quality score.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7e0dd98e0481919510faaf.longDescription: ClearBounce verifies email addresses in real time inside ChatGPT. Ask whether an address is safe to email and it runs a full check - syntax, MX records, a live mailbox check, disposable and role-account detection, typo rescue and risk scoring - returning a clear status and a 0-100 quality score. It can also find a person's business email from a name and company domain, and report your remaining credit balance. Sign-in uses OAuth: your password never passes through the chat. New accounts include 100 free credits.

plugin_asdk_app_6a7e6d2b2834819187023eba.name: Scribble
plugin_asdk_app_6a7e6d2b2834819187023eba.productIntro: Scribble 发送真实的手写卡片。一台机器拿着一支真正的笔，用墨水在每张卡片和信封上书写，然后我们在上面盖章并将其邮寄到美国任何地方。没有什么是印刷字体。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7e6d2b2834819187023eba.productIntroEn: Scribble sends real handwritten cards. A machine holds an actual pen and writes each card and envelope in ink, then we stamp it and put it in the post anywhere in the United States. Nothing is a printed font.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7e6d2b2834819187023eba.longDescription:
Scribble sends real handwritten cards. A machine holds an actual pen and writes each card and envelope in ink, then we stamp it and put it in the post anywhere in the United States. Nothing is a printed font.

Connect this and you can ask ChatGPT to look someone up in your address book, draft the card, and send it — and it shows you a picture of the card first, written in the handwriting that will actually be used, alongside the printed front. Ask to see the handwriting styles and it writes you a real specimen of each. You can also load a spreadsheet of contacts, send a personalised batch where every card says a different name, and set up a rule that sends birthday cards every year on its own.

Cards are paid for with credits bought in advance on scribblecards.com, so nothing here takes a payment or links to a checkout. Sending is marked as an action that cannot be undone, so ChatGPT asks before it posts anything. A batch is prepared first and shows real examples of the merged cards before you confirm it. A recurring rule is always created switched off, and reports how many people it can reach, so a person decides before it ever fires.

Requires a Scribble business account with credits.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7e6d2b2834819187023eba.longDescriptionZh:
Scribble 发送真实的手写卡片。一台机器拿着一支真正的笔，用墨水在每张卡片和信封上书写，然后我们在上面盖章并将其邮寄到美国任何地方。没有什么是印刷字体。

连接这个，你可以要求 ChatGPT 在你的地址簿中查找某人，起草卡片并发送它 - 它首先向你显示一张卡片的图片，用实际使用的手写体写在打印的正面旁边。要求查看笔迹风格，它会为您写出每种笔迹的真实样本。您还可以加载联系人电子表格，发送个性化批次，其中每张卡片都有不同的名称，并设置每年单独发送生日贺卡的规则。

刷卡费用是通过在 scribblecards.com 上提前购买的积分来支付的，因此这里不需要任何付款或结帐链接。发送被标记为无法撤消的操作，因此 ChatGPT 在发布任何内容之前都会进行询问。首先准备一批，并在您确认之前显示合并卡的真实示例。重复规则始终在创建时处于关闭状态，并报告它可以覆盖多少人，以便人们在触发之前做出决定。

需要一个带有积分的 Scribble 企业帐户。

Set up automatic birthday cards for my team
Send handwritten follow-ups to everyone I met at the conference

plugin_asdk_app_6a43e4284a708191b2b6b454.productIntro: Lightbringer 将人工智能原生平台与我们团队中合格的专利律师相结合，帮助科技公司端到端管理专利流程。我们的服务涵盖创新捕获、知识产权战略、新颖性和自由操作评估、专利申请起草和提交以及通过授权进行起诉。
plugin_asdk_app_6a43e4284a708191b2b6b454.productIntroEn: Lightbringer helps technology companies manage the patent process end to end, combining an AI-native platform with qualified patent attorneys on our team. Our service covers innovation capture, IP strategy, novelty and freedom-to-operate assessments, patent application drafting and filing, and prosecution through grant.
plugin_asdk_app_6a43e4284a708191b2b6b454.longDescription:
Lightbringer helps technology companies manage the patent process end to end, combining an AI-native platform with qualified patent attorneys on our team. Our service covers innovation capture, IP strategy, novelty and freedom-to-operate assessments, patent application drafting and filing, and prosecution through grant.

The Lightbringer plugin connects ChatGPT to your private organisation workspace. Capture innovations while working on technical solutions, find and enrich existing disclosures as your ideas develop, get automated feedback on clarity and completeness, and search and summarise inventions and patent documents. Review, comment on, and respond to work with your Lightbringer patent team directly from the conversation.

Register an innovation to preserve and develop it, even before deciding how to protect it. When you decide to pursue a patent, separately request preparation for filing with Lightbringer. Attorney-led services are available through the Lightbringer team; the plugin supports the connected workflows described above.

Try questions like:
“Help me identify potential innovations in the solution we’ve been developing”
“Register this innovation without requesting patent preparation”
“Find our adaptive-fins disclosure and add what we learned today”
“Check this disclosure for gaps and help me prepare questions for our Lightbringer patent team”
“Show the reviews awaiting my response and help me act on them”
plugin_asdk_app_6a43e4284a708191b2b6b454.longDescriptionZh:
Lightbringer 将人工智能原生平台与我们团队中合格的专利律师相结合，帮助科技公司端到端管理专利流程。我们的服务涵盖创新捕获、知识产权战略、新颖性和自由操作评估、专利申请起草和提交以及通过授权进行起诉。

Lightbringer 插件将 ChatGPT 连接到您的私人组织工作区。在开发技术解决方案的同时捕获创新，随着您的想法的发展查找并丰富现有的披露内容，获得有关清晰度和完整性的自动反馈，以及搜索和总结发明和专利文档。直接通过对话查看、评论并回复与您的 Lightbringer 专利团队的合作。

注册一项创新以保护和发展它，甚至在决定如何保护它之前。当您决定申请专利时，请单独请求准备向 Lightbringer 提交申请。 Lightbringer 团队可提供律师主导的服务；该插件支持上述连接的工作流程。

尝试提出以下问题：
“帮助我确定我们正在开发的解决方案中的潜在创新”
“无需申请专利准备即可注册该创新”

plugin_asdk_app_6a9725e18a5c8191a4281dc6.longDescription:
SEO articles & backlinks for your website, run from ChatGPT. Connect your Distribb account and you can research keywords with real search volume and difficulty data, plan a content calendar, write SEO articles, and publish them straight to WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, Wix, Framer, Ghost or Notion without leaving the chat.

SEO reporting is built in. Check how pages are performing in Google Search Console, see which backlinks your site has earned through Distribb's exchange, and track how often AI assistants cite your brand. You can also edit posts that are already live and push the changes back to your site, and reply to Google Business Profile reviews.

It is built for founders, marketers, agencies and content teams who would rather describe what they want than click through a dashboard. You need a Distribb account at distribb.io, and every tool works only against your own projects.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9725e18a5c8191a4281dc6.longDescriptionZh:
您网站的 SEO 文章和反向链接，从 ChatGPT 运行。连接您的 Distribb 帐户，您可以使用真实搜索量和难度数据研究关键字、规划内容日历、撰写 SEO 文章，并将其直接发布到 WordPress、Webflow、Shopify、Wix、Framer、Ghost 或 Notion，而无需离开聊天。

内置 SEO 报告。检查页面在 Google Search Console 中的表现，查看您的网站通过 Distribb 的交换获得了哪些反向链接，并跟踪人工智能助手引用您品牌的频率。您还可以编辑已发布的帖子并将更改推送回您的网站，以及回复 Google 商家资料评论。

它是为创始人、营销人员、代理机构和内容团队构建的，他们宁愿描述自己想要什么，也不愿点击仪表板。您需要在 distribb.io 上有一个 Distribb 帐户，并且每个工具仅适用于您自己的项目。

plugin_asdk_app_6a55df0728f081919ea4075f.productIntro: Intellistrata 将 ChatGPT 与 Intellistrata 地层管理平台连接起来，允许授权用户安全地访问和使用与其管理的房产和业主立案法团相关的信息。
plugin_asdk_app_6a55df0728f081919ea4075f.productIntroEn: Intellistrata connects ChatGPT with the Intellistrata strata management platform, allowing authorised users to securely access and work with information relating to the properties and owners corporations they manage.
plugin_asdk_app_6a55df0728f081919ea4075f.longDescription:
Intellistrata connects ChatGPT with the Intellistrata strata management platform, allowing authorised users to securely access and work with information relating to the properties and owners corporations they manage.

Depending on the user’s Intellistrata permissions and the tools enabled for their organisation, the plugin can help users locate property, lot, owner, financial, task, maintenance, document and other strata management information. It may also support approved operational workflows through conversational requests.

Access is restricted to authenticated Intellistrata users and is governed by the permissions configured for their organisation and account. Users can only access information and perform actions they are authorised to access within Intellistrata. Important financial, legal, property and administrative information should be reviewed and confirmed by an authorised user before it is relied upon.
plugin_asdk_app_6a55df0728f081919ea4075f.longDescriptionZh:
Intellistrata 将 ChatGPT 与 Intellistrata 地层管理平台连接起来，允许授权用户安全地访问和使用与其管理的房产和业主立案法团相关的信息。

根据用户的 Intellistrata 权限和为其组织启用的工具，该插件可以帮助用户找到财产、地段、所有者、财务、任务、维护、文档和其他分层管理信息。它还可以通过对话请求支持批准的操作工作流程。

访问权限仅限于经过身份验证的 Intellistrata 用户，并受为其组织和帐户配置的权限控制。用户只能在 Intellistrata 中访问信息并执行他们被授权访问的操作。重要的财务、法律、财产和管理信息在依赖之前应由授权用户审查和确认。

plugin_asdk_app_6a59233e54a88191bdd16a43.name: beglaubigt.de
plugin_asdk_app_6a59233e54a88191bdd16a43.productIntro: Beglaubigt 直接在对话中成立了一家德国公司 - GmbH 或 UG (haftungsbeschränkt)。告诉助理您想要成立的公司，它会一步一步收集详细信息：公司名称和目的、股本、股东和董事总经理，以及您希望如何进行公证。当一切准备就绪后，它会返回一个您在浏览器中打开的安全结帐链接 - 助手本身不会处理付款。
plugin_asdk_app_6a59233e54a88191bdd16a43.productIntroEn: Beglaubigt sets up a German company — a GmbH or UG (haftungsbeschränkt) — directly in the conversation. Tell the assistant you want to incorporate and it collects the details one step at a time: company name and purpose, share capital, the shareholder(s) and managing director, and how you'd like to notarize.
plugin_asdk_app_6a59233e54a88191bdd16a43.longDescription:
Beglaubigt sets up a German company — a GmbH or UG (haftungsbeschränkt) — directly in the conversation. Tell the assistant you want to incorporate and it collects the details one step at a time: company name and purpose, share capital, the shareholder(s) and managing director, and how you'd like to notarize. When everything's ready it returns a secure checkout link you open in your browser — the assistant never processes payment itself.

On the back end, Beglaubigt coordinates the notarization, the commercial-register (Handelsregister) filing, and your formation documents, so you can start a German company without assembling the paperwork yourself. It's built for founders in Germany and for international entrepreneurs incorporating there.

Currently supports GmbH and UG formation. After the checkout link, you complete payment and your notary appointment through Beglaubigt.
plugin_asdk_app_6a59233e54a88191bdd16a43.longDescriptionZh:
Beglaubigt 直接在对话中成立了一家德国公司 - GmbH 或 UG (haftungsbeschränkt)。告诉助理您想要成立的公司，它会一步一步收集详细信息：公司名称和目的、股本、股东和董事总经理，以及您希望如何进行公证。当一切准备就绪后，它会返回一个您在浏览器中打开的安全结帐链接 - 助手本身不会处理付款。

在后端，Beglaubigt 负责协调公证、商业登记 (Handelsregister) 备案和您的成立文件，这样您就可以创办一家德国公司，而无需自己组装文件。它是为德国的创始人和在那里注册的国际企业家而建立的。

目前支持 GmbH 和 UG 组建。结帐链接后，您可以通过 Beglaubigt 完成付款和公证预约。

plugin_asdk_app_6a511673beb08191964b117e.description: 管理公司电子邮件签名
plugin_asdk_app_6a511673beb08191964b117e.productIntro: Scribe 是企业的电子邮件签名管理：IT 设置一次，营销人员运行它，并且无需员工安装任何东西。
plugin_asdk_app_6a511673beb08191964b117e.productIntroEn: Scribe is email signature management for enterprise: IT sets it up once, marketing runs it, and no employee ever installs anything.
plugin_asdk_app_6a511673beb08191964b117e.longDescription:
Scribe is email signature management for enterprise: IT sets it up once, marketing runs it, and no employee ever installs anything.

Connect Scribe to ChatGPT and manage your workspace in plain language:

• Create, edit, preview and publish signature templates
• Assign signatures to teammates, groups and folders
• Manage smart fields, assets and integrations
• Launch, schedule and pause banner campaigns
• Pull view, click and conversion analytics

Signatures deploy centrally across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 and 30+ tools. Sign in with your Scribe account via OAuth — the app forwards your own access token and never stores an API key.
plugin_asdk_app_6a511673beb08191964b117e.longDescriptionZh:
Scribe 是企业的电子邮件签名管理：IT 设置一次，营销人员运行它，并且无需员工安装任何东西。

将 Scribe 连接到 ChatGPT 并用简单的语言管理您的工作区：

• 创建、编辑、预览和发布签名模板
• 为队友、群组和文件夹分配签名
• 管理智能领域、资产和集成
• 启动、安排和暂停横幅广告活动
• 拉取视图、点击和转化分析

签名在 Google Workspace、Microsoft 365 和 30 多种工具中集中部署。通过 OAuth 使用您的 Scribe 帐户登录 — 该应用程序会转发您自己的访问令牌，并且从不存储 API 密钥。
defaultPrompts: Create a signature called Sales with our logo, each person's title and phone, LinkedIn icon and a button "book a demo".
Which signatures are published, who are they assigned to, and are any integrations failing?
Give me the conversion rate of our email signatures for the last 90 days.
defaultPromptsZh: 使用我们的徽标、每个人的头衔和电话、LinkedIn 图标以及“预订演示”按钮创建一个名为 Sales 的签名。
发布了哪些签名、分配给了谁以及是否有任何集成失败？
请提供过去 90 天我们电子邮件签名的转化率。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7006800afc8191a35f4df4.name: APiM Galaxy
plugin_asdk_app_6a7006800afc8191a35f4df4.productIntro: APiM Galaxy 是一款 MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器，由 A Piece of Map Inc. 构建，它将业务开发和市场进入研究添加到您已经使用的 AI（ChatGPT、Claude 或 Claude Code）中。您指定您想要接触的公司或您想要进入的市场，连接器会映射出他们实际合作的人员，找到最热情的介绍路径，并返回优先计划 - 每个关系都根据其来源进行检查，并标记未经验证的关系。完整的研究是免费的，没有使用限制。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7006800afc8191a35f4df4.productIntroEn: APiM Galaxy is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, built by A Piece of Map Inc., that adds business-development and market-entry research to the AI you already use — ChatGPT, Claude, or Claude Code.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7006800afc8191a35f4df4.longDescription: APiM Galaxy is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, built by A Piece of Map Inc., that adds business-development and market-entry research to the AI you already use — ChatGPT, Claude, or Claude Code. You name a company you want to reach or a market you want to enter, and the connector maps who they actually work with, finds the warmest introduction path, and returns a prioritized plan — with every relationship checked against its source, and unverified ties flagged. The full research is free, with no usage limit. With an existing APiM Galaxy Pro account signed in, the same run also delivers a branded report page with a one-click PDF and a saved company profile. Learn more at galaxy.apieceofmap.com/connector.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7006800afc8191a35f4df4.longDescriptionZh: APiM Galaxy 是一款 MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器，由 A Piece of Map Inc. 构建，它将业务开发和市场进入研究添加到您已经使用的 AI（ChatGPT、Claude 或 Claude Code）中。您指定您想要接触的公司或您想要进入的市场，连接器会映射出他们实际合作的人员，找到最热情的介绍路径，并返回优先计划 - 每个关系都根据其来源进行检查，并标记未经验证的关系。完整的研究是免费的，没有使用限制。登录现有的 APiM ​​Galaxy Pro 帐户后，同一运行还会提供带有一键式 PDF 和已保存的公司简介的品牌报告页面。如需了解更多信息，请访问 Galaxy.apieceofmap.com/connector。
defaultPrompts: Build a market-entry strategy for logistics companies in Japan — who should I approach first, and who can introduce us?
Map who [target company] works with and check each relationship against its source.
Here are five prospects for our sensor business — rank them by fit and explain the order.
defaultPromptsZh: 为日本物流公司制定市场进入战略——我应该首先联系谁，谁可以介绍我们？

以下是我们传感器业务的五个前景——按适合度对它们进行排名并解释顺序。

plugin_asdk_app_6a6832de8c088191b69cafaf.description: 在 Reddit 上寻找客户
plugin_asdk_app_6a6832de8c088191b69cafaf.productIntro: OneUp Today 在 Reddit 上找到已经在描述您的产品解决的问题的人，并将其转变为可审查的外展渠道。使用此插件，您可以查看 OneUp 帐户中运行的营销活动，浏览每个发现的潜在客户及其相关性分数和渠道状态，阅读与任何潜在客户的对话历史记录，并使用 OneUp 的消息编写器起草个性化的开场白。批准的草稿可以排队等待发送，并且您可以在发送之前检查发送准备情况。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6832de8c088191b69cafaf.productIntroEn: OneUp Today finds people on Reddit who are already describing the problem your product solves, and turns them into a reviewable outreach pipeline. With this plugin you can review the campaigns running in your OneUp account, browse the leads each one discovered with their relevance scores and funnel status, read the conversation history with any lead, and draft a personalized opener using…
plugin_asdk_app_6a6832de8c088191b69cafaf.longDescription: OneUp Today finds people on Reddit who are already describing the problem your product solves, and turns them into a reviewable outreach pipeline. With this plugin you can review the campaigns running in your OneUp account, browse the leads each one discovered with their relevance scores and funnel status, read the conversation history with any lead, and draft a personalized opener using OneUp's message writer. Approved drafts can be queued for delivery, and you can check send readiness before you do. Every message is delivered through your own connected browser session, so outreach always goes out as you, on your own account, after you have approved it. Drafting and sending are always separate steps: nothing is sent without an explicit confirmation. New here? Sign in with Google on first use; the account is created for you and the first Reddit lead search starts from this chat: say what your product's website is. Requires a OneUp Today account.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6832de8c088191b69cafaf.longDescriptionZh: OneUp Today 在 Reddit 上找到已经在描述您的产品解决的问题的人，并将其转变为可审查的外展渠道。使用此插件，您可以查看 OneUp 帐户中运行的营销活动，浏览每个发现的潜在客户及其相关性分数和渠道状态，阅读与任何潜在客户的对话历史记录，并使用 OneUp 的消息编写器起草个性化的开场白。批准的草稿可以排队等待发送，并且您可以在发送之前检查发送准备情况。每条消息都是通过您自己连接的浏览器会话传递的，因此在您批准消息后，外展始终会在您自己的帐户上进行。起草和发送始终是分开的步骤：未经明确确认，不会发送任何内容。新来的？首次使用时使用 Google 登录；该帐户已为您创建，第一个 Reddit 潜在客户搜索从此聊天开始：说出您产品的网站是什么。需要 OneUp Today 帐户。

plugin_asdk_app_69aa70e213a8819197fe9fb5.productIntroEn: Ray Arceneaux AI helps business owners find out if their company is invisible to ChatGPT and AI search engines — and shows them exactly what to do about it.
plugin_asdk_app_69aa70e213a8819197fe9fb5.longDescription:
Ray Arceneaux AI helps business owners find out if their company is invisible to ChatGPT and AI search engines — and shows them exactly what to do about it.

Start with a free 3-minute ChatGPT Visibility Audit. Get a real Discoverability Score, see where your business stands against competitors in AI search, and walk away with a prioritized action plan — no technical knowledge required.

Ray Arceneaux is a Nashville-based AI Implementation Strategist with 27 years of experience across Amazon, UBS Financial Services, and the State of Tennessee. His Build-Implement-Train methodology helps businesses move from manual workflows to automated, agentic operations that actually run without a developer on call.

Use this app to:
Run a free AI visibility audit for your business
Explore AI Readiness Sessions, workflow automation, and team training services
Learn how the Build-Implement-Train process works
Book a session directly through the chat

Whether you are a real estate broker, law firm, medical practice, or local service business — if your customers are using ChatGPT to find providers and you are not showing up, this app shows you why and how we can it fix.
plugin_asdk_app_69aa70e213a8819197fe9fb5.longDescriptionZh:
Ray Arceneaux AI 帮助企业主查明他们的公司是否对 ChatGPT 和 AI 搜索引擎不可见，并准确地向他们展示该怎么做。

从免费的 3 分钟 ChatGPT 可见性审核开始。获得真正的可发现性得分，了解您的企业在人工智能搜索方面与竞争对手相比处于什么位置，并制定优先行动计划——无需任何技术知识。

Ray Arceneaux 是一位位于纳什维尔的人工智能实施策略师，在亚马逊、瑞银金融服务公司和田纳西州拥有 27 年的经验。他的“构建-实施-培训”方法帮助企业从手动工作流程转向自动化、代理操作，这些操作实际上无需开发人员值班即可运行。

使用此应用程序可以：
为您的企业进行免费的人工智能可见性审核
探索人工智能准备会议、工作流程自动化和团队培训服务

plugin_asdk_app_6a1d38c4f36081919f1b1e1a.description: 新加坡 CSP 运营助理
plugin_asdk_app_6a1d38c4f36081919f1b1e1a.productIntro: IncorpFlow Copilot 适用于经过身份验证的 CSP 租户管理员。它回答产品使用问题，仅读取链接的租户工作区，并可以创建已确认的租户记录，例如后端服务请求、付款后合并票证和 Quotech 支持票证。它还可以发送确认电子邮件，例如选定的公司文件交付、SOA 提醒和导出 OTP。 Copilot 不会在 ChatGPT 内收集受限个人文档、完整个人标识符、支付卡详细信息、健康数据、生物识别数据、SSN 或 PCI 数据。
plugin_asdk_app_6a1d38c4f36081919f1b1e1a.productIntroEn: IncorpFlow Copilot is for authenticated CSP tenant admins. It answers product-use questions, reads only the linked tenant workspace, and can create confirmed tenant records such as backend service requests, after-payment incorporation tickets, and Quotech support tickets. It may also send confirmed emails such as selected company-file delivery, SOA reminders, and export OTPs.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1d38c4f36081919f1b1e1a.longDescription: IncorpFlow Copilot is for authenticated CSP tenant admins. It answers product-use questions, reads only the linked tenant workspace, and can create confirmed tenant records such as backend service requests, after-payment incorporation tickets, and Quotech support tickets. It may also send confirmed emails such as selected company-file delivery, SOA reminders, and export OTPs. Copilot does not collect restricted personal documents, full personal identifiers, payment card details, health data, biometric data, SSNs, or PCI data inside ChatGPT. Required onboarding details and supporting documents are submitted through secure IncorpFlow pages under tenant-admin authority and the Quotech privacy policy.

plugin_asdk_app_6a6a6625092c81919a597a7c.name: Duckhub QR Menu
plugin_asdk_app_6a6a6625092c81919a597a7c.description: 创建二维码菜单和网站
plugin_asdk_app_6a6a6625092c81919a597a7c.productIntro: Duckhub QR Menu 是一款餐厅软件，可通过 QR 码菜单和集成点餐将餐饮数字化。食客扫描代码即可在手机上查看数字菜单，无需应用程序或纸张。 AI 助手会生成菜肴描述、将菜单翻译成 14 种语言并创建商品图像。预订通过菜单或 WhatsApp 等应用程序进行管理，并通过仪表板处理确认。在线订购使餐馆可以创建带有菜单和订购功能的网站。餐桌点餐允许食客扫描二维码、选择菜品，然后通过餐桌标识将订单发送到厨房。包括交付管理和员工访问控制。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6a6625092c81919a597a7c.productIntroEn: Duckhub QR Menu is restaurant software that digitizes dining with QR code menus and integrated ordering. Diners scan codes to view digital menus on their phones without apps or paper. An AI assistant generates dish descriptions, translates menus into 14 languages, and creates item images.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6a6625092c81919a597a7c.longDescription:
Duckhub QR Menu is restaurant software that digitizes dining with QR code menus and integrated ordering. Diners scan codes to view digital menus on their phones without apps or paper. An AI assistant generates dish descriptions, translates menus into 14 languages, and creates item images. Reservations are managed via the menu or apps like WhatsApp, with confirmations handled through a dashboard. Online ordering lets restaurants create websites with menus and ordering features. Table ordering allows diners to scan QR codes, select items, and send orders to the kitchen with table identification. Delivery management and staff access controls are included. Analytics track trends and peak hours, while customization options include templates, fonts, and logos. Smart promotions automate discounts based on times or days.

With this plugin, a restaurant owner connects their Duckhub venue to ChatGPT and manages it by conversation: read the current draft menu, create or edit categories, dishes, prices, ingredients and option groups, upload dish photos, translate the menu into any enabled language, adjust venue info, working hours, design and ordering settings, manage tables and their QR links, run promotions and banners, then publish the menu live (or roll a bad publish back). Paid plans can also read guest orders and move them through their lifecycle. Every change is scoped to the single venue the owner authorized, is written to a draft first, and only becomes visible to guests after an explicit publish.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6a6625092c81919a597a7c.longDescriptionZh:
Duckhub QR Menu 是一款餐厅软件，可通过 QR 码菜单和集成点餐将餐饮数字化。食客扫描代码即可在手机上查看数字菜单，无需应用程序或纸张。 AI 助手会生成菜肴描述、将菜单翻译成 14 种语言并创建商品图像。预订通过菜单或 WhatsApp 等应用程序进行管理，并通过仪表板处理确认。在线订购使餐馆可以创建带有菜单和订购功能的网站。餐桌点餐允许食客扫描二维码、选择菜品，然后通过餐桌标识将订单发送到厨房。包括交付管理和员工访问控制。分析跟踪趋势和高峰时段，而自定义选项包括模板、字体和徽标。智能促销会根据时间或天数自动进行折扣。

使用此插件，餐厅老板将他们的 Duckhub 场所连接到 ChatGPT 并通过对话进行管理：读取当前草稿菜单，创建或编辑类别、菜肴、价格、成分和选项组，上传菜肴照片，将菜单翻译成任何启用的语言，调整场地信息、工作时间、设计和订购设置，管理桌子及其 QR 链接，运行促销和横幅，然后实时发布菜单（或回滚不良发布）。付费计划还可以读取客人订单并在其生命周期中移动它们。每次更改的范围仅限于所有者授权的单个场所，首先写入草稿，并且只有在明确发布后才对客人可见。
defaultPrompts: What's currently on my Duckhub menu?
Add a new dish to my menu with a price and a short description.
Translate my menu into English and tell me what's still missing.
defaultPromptsZh: 我的 Duckhub 菜单上目前有什么？
在我的菜单中添加一道新菜，并附上价格和简短说明。
将我的菜单翻译成英文并告诉我还缺少什么。

Profit.co is an AI-powered strategy execution platform that bridges the gap between high-level strategy and daily execution. Founded in Silicon Valley and headquartered in Texas, the company serves customers across 70 countries, ranging from agile startups to more than 50 Fortune 500 giants. 

The platform is architected around three critical organizational pillars to drive measurable results:

      • Plan: Defines strategy through advanced OKR Software, Balanced Scorecards, Hoshin Kanri and Strategy Roadmaps to ensure total organizational alignment.
      • Process: Drives execution via Project Portfolio Management (PPM), Task Management, Timesheets, and structured Meeting tools.
      • People: Aligning the human side of performance through Employee Engagement, Recognition, Pulse Surveys, 360-degree Feedback, and continuous Performance Management.

Profit.co is designed for enterprise-scale adoption, featuring 80+ seamless integrations with essential tools like Slack, Microsoft Teams, Jira, and Salesforce. Consistently recognized for enterprise-grade excellence, Profit.co is featured in Gartner® Hype Cycle™ reports, the Capterra Shortlist, and maintains its position as a G2 Leader. Supported by a global team and a robust network of local partners, Profit.co complements its technology with expert coaching, strategic consulting, and 24/7 live support to ensure every organization achieves its most ambitious strategic goals.
plugin_asdk_app_69ba714e376481918b8bc66c.longDescriptionZh:
Profit.co 是一个人工智能驱动的策略执行平台，弥合了高级策略与日常执行之间的差距。该公司成立于硅谷，总部位于德克萨斯州，为 70 个国家/地区的客户提供服务，从敏捷的初创公司到 50 多家财富 500 强巨头。 

该平台围绕三个关键的组织支柱构建，以推动可衡量的结果：

      • 计划：通过先进的 OKR 软件、平衡计分卡、方针管理和战略路线图来定义战略，以确保组织的整体一致性。
      • 流程：通过项目组合管理(PPM)、任务管理、时间表和结构化会议工具推动执行。
      • 人员：通过员工敬业度、认可、脉搏调查、360 度反馈和持续绩效管理来调整绩效的人性化一面。

Profit.co 专为企业规模采用而设计，具有与 Slack、Microsoft Teams、Jira 和 Salesforce 等基本工具的 80 多个无缝集成。 Profit.co 因其企业级卓越表现而一直受到认可，在 Gartner® Hype Cycle™ 报告和 Capterra 入围名单中占有一席之地，并保持了 G2 领导者的地位。在全球团队和强大的本地合作伙伴网络的支持下，Profit.co 通过专家指导、战略咨询和 24/7 实时支持来补充其技术，以确保每个组织实现其最雄心勃勃的战略目标。

plugin_asdk_app_699634bbd95881918fb3c381.productIntroEn: Just formed an LLC in New York? Find out the publication requirement, how much it costs to publish by county, and which newspapers you need — before the 120-day deadline. Live pricing for all 62 NY counties. Works for domestic LLCs, foreign LLCs, and PLLCs.
plugin_asdk_app_699634bbd95881918fb3c381.developerName: Sandeep Arneja LLC d/b/a LLC Publishers
plugin_asdk_app_699634bbd95881918fb3c381.longDescription:
Just formed an LLC in New York? Find out the publication requirement, how much it costs to publish by county, and which newspapers you need — before the 120-day deadline. Live pricing for all 62 NY counties. Works for domestic LLCs, foreign LLCs, and PLLCs.

What you can do:
- Check if your LLC needs to publish and what happens if you don't
- Get county-specific pricing and designated newspaper lists
- Generate a legally compliant publication notice
- Verify an existing notice for compliance issues
- Review your filing package before mailing to the state
- Get step-by-step guidance for the full process

 Data sourced from NY LLC Law §206, county clerk offices, and llcpublishers.com — updated regularly.
plugin_asdk_app_699634bbd95881918fb3c381.longDescriptionZh:
刚刚在纽约成立了一家有限责任公司？在 120 天的截止日期之前查明出版要求、按县出版的费用以及您需要哪些报纸。纽约州所有 62 个县的实时定价。为国内有限责任公司、国外有限责任公司和 PLLC 工作。

你可以做什么：
- 检查您的有限责任公司是否需要发布，如果不发布会发生什么
- 获取特定县的定价和指定报纸列表
- 生成合法合规的发布通知
- 验证现有通知的合规性问题
- 在邮寄到州之前检查您的归档包
- 获得整个过程的分步指导

 数据来源于 NY LLC Law §206、县书记员办公室和 llcpublishers.com — 定期更新。

plugin_asdk_app_6a688e43e01c819196eb2cac.productIntro: Influencer Hero 是一个针对消费品牌的影响者营销平台。通过此连接器，您可以在对话中运行影响者计划，而无需单击仪表板。
plugin_asdk_app_6a688e43e01c819196eb2cac.productIntroEn: Influencer Hero is an influencer marketing platform for consumer brands. This connector lets you run your influencer program in conversation instead of clicking through the dashboard.
plugin_asdk_app_6a688e43e01c819196eb2cac.longDescription:
Influencer Hero is an influencer marketing platform for consumer brands. This connector lets you run your influencer program in conversation instead of clicking through the dashboard.

Discovery. Search a database of creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube by audience demographics, engagement, and location. Pull full audience reports and verified contact details.

Outreach. List and inspect campaigns, add creators to them, and review the email flows and scheduled sends attached to each one.

CRM. Query your deal pipeline by campaign, board, funnel stage, country, or follower count. Open a deal for its history, notes, tasks, and scheduled communications. Create deals, move them between funnel stages, and log notes and tasks.

Collaborations and performance. Break down a collaboration's orders, revenue, top products, and performance over time. Pull campaign reports across date ranges, and review payouts and payout analytics.

Content. Search captured UGC across creators, campaigns, brands, and products, and manage creator submissions through review and approval.

Access follows the signed-in user. The connector inherits that user's role and brand permissions exactly as the web app does, so it can never read or change anything the user could not reach directly. Discovery, audience reports, and contact lookups consume account credits and say so before running.
plugin_asdk_app_6a688e43e01c819196eb2cac.longDescriptionZh:
Influencer Hero 是一个针对消费品牌的影响者营销平台。通过此连接器，您可以在对话中运行影响者计划，而无需单击仪表板。

发现。按受众人口统计、参与度和位置搜索 Instagram、TikTok 和 YouTube 上的创作者数据库。提取完整的受众报告和经过验证的联系方式。

外展。列出并检查营销活动，向其中添加创建者，并查看每个营销活动附带的电子邮件流和计划发送。

客户关系管理。按活动、董事会、漏斗阶段、国家/地区或关注者数量查询您的交易渠道。为其历史记录、注释、任务和预定通信建立交易。创建交易，在漏斗阶段之间移动它们，并记录注释和任务。

合作与表现。随时间分解协作的订单、收入、热门产品和绩效。跨日期范围提取营销活动报告，并审查支出和支出分析。

内容。搜索捕获跨创作者、活动、品牌和产品的 UGC，并通过审核和批准来管理创作者提交的内容。

访问按照登录用户进行。连接器继承用户的角色和品牌权限，就像 Web 应用程序一样，因此它永远无法读取或更改用户无法直接访问的任何内容。发现、受众报告和联系人查找会消耗帐户积分，并在运行前说明。

Which influencers in my main campaign board have no scheduled follow-up, and log a note on the top three?
Show me last quarter's performance for my biggest collaboration — orders, revenue, and top products.
defaultPromptsZh: 在 Instagram 上寻找拥有 1 万至 10 万粉丝的美妆创作者，并将其中最好的添加到我的推广活动中。
我的主要竞选委员会中的哪些影响者没有预定的后续行动，并在前三名上记录了注释？
显示上季度我最大的合作的绩效 - 订单、收入和顶级产品。

It extracts available times, timezone, contact details, notes, missing fields, source text, and errors, helping recruiting workflows organize candidate replies faster.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1e83d5e44481919b586724.longDescription:
Candidate Time Extractor turns candidate availability messages into structured interview time details. It extracts available times, timezone, contact details, notes, missing fields, source text, and errors, helping recruiting workflows organize candidate replies faster.

The app is read-only and stateless. It does not schedule interviews, send invitations, contact candidates, update ATS systems, rank candidates, or make hiring decisions.

plugin_asdk_app_6a32c44c7bc4819182e04e40.productIntro: Energy Aspects 使人工智能代理可以直接访问专家能源市场情报——研究报告、实时分析师评论以及石油、天然气、电力和相关市场的时间序列数据。
plugin_asdk_app_6a32c44c7bc4819182e04e40.productIntroEn: Energy Aspects gives AI agents direct access to expert energy market intelligence — research reports, real-time analyst commentary, and timeseries data across oil, gas, power, and related markets.
plugin_asdk_app_6a32c44c7bc4819182e04e40.longDescription:
Energy Aspects gives AI agents direct access to expert energy market intelligence — research reports, real-time analyst commentary, and timeseries data across oil, gas, power, and related markets.

Energy Aspects is an independent research firm trusted by traders, investors, and energy professionals worldwide. The connector draws on three content types: in-depth research publications with analysis and forecasts; EA Live posts with intraday market commentary from analysts; and a library of quantitative timeseries covering supply, demand, inventories, flows, and prices — including point-in-time queries against historical releases.
plugin_asdk_app_6a32c44c7bc4819182e04e40.longDescriptionZh:
Energy Aspects 使人工智能代理可以直接访问专家能源市场情报——研究报告、实时分析师评论以及石油、天然气、电力和相关市场的时间序列数据。

Energy Aspects 是一家受到全球贸易商、投资者和能源专业人士信赖的独立研究公司。该连接器利用三种内容类型：带有分析和预测的深入研究出版物； EA Live 发布了分析师的盘中市场评论；以及涵盖供应、需求、库存、流量和价格的定量时间序列库，包括针对历史发布的时间点查询。

plugin_asdk_app_6a188532dd6081919de7700c.longDescription:
Running a hospitality business means your answers are spread across reports, dashboards, and closing sheets. With the 20Tabs connector, you can just ask ChatGPT instead.

Ask "What were my top sellers last week?", "How did April compare to March?", or "Show me all voided receipts from yesterday." You get a direct answer from your live 20Tabs data. No clicking through menus, no exporting spreadsheets.

The connector covers the full breadth of your 20Tabs account: sales and revenue reports, taxbreakdowns, daily and monthly closings, customer purchase history, receipt and payment details, and product performance. You can also manage your catalog, floor plan, and POS configuration through the same conversation.

Access is authorized through your 20Tabs account using OAuth. You control exactly which permissions ChatGPT receives.
plugin_asdk_app_6a188532dd6081919de7700c.longDescriptionZh:
经营酒店业务意味着您的答案分布在报告、仪表板和结单中。使用 20Tabs 连接器，您可以直接询问 ChatGPT。

问“上周我最畅销的商品是什么？”、“四月与三月相比如何？”或“显示昨天所有作废的收据。”您可以从实时 20Tabs 数据中得到直接答案。无需点击菜单，无需导出电子表格。

该连接器涵盖了 20Tabs 帐户的全部内容：销售和收入报告、税收明细、每日和每月结账、客户购买历史记录、收据和付款详细信息以及产品性能。您还可以通过同一对话管理目录、平面图和 POS 配置。

访问权限是通过您的 20Tabs 帐户使用 OAuth 进行授权的。您可以准确控制 ChatGPT 接收哪些权限。

plugin_asdk_app_69a99d242ec08191925371d3.description: 探索团队健康状况和产出
plugin_asdk_app_69a99d242ec08191925371d3.productIntro: 询问有关您的团队和组织的简单语言问题，并使用您的 Workleap 帐户中的数据进行回答。
plugin_asdk_app_69a99d242ec08191925371d3.productIntroEn: Ask plain-language questions about your team and organization—answered with data from your Workleap account.
plugin_asdk_app_69a99d242ec08191925371d3.longDescription:
Ask plain-language questions about your team and organization—answered with data from your Workleap account.

Instead of navigating dashboards, ask things like "What's our engagement score this month?", "Who is the new hire on my team?", or "Show me my recent recognition" and get a concise, visual answer.

What it covers:
- Engagement scores, eNPS, and participation trends—for your team or the whole org
- Employee profiles, hire dates, and reporting relationships
- Recognition cards you've sent and received
- Team structures and org context, so references like "my direct reports" resolve automatically

Built for managers and HR teams who want faster access to the signals already in Workleap, without switching tools.
plugin_asdk_app_69a99d242ec08191925371d3.longDescriptionZh:
询问有关您的团队和组织的简单语言问题，并使用您的 Workleap 帐户中的数据进行回答。

不要浏览仪表板，而是询问诸如“本月我们的敬业度分数是多少？”、“我的团队中的新员工是谁？”或“向我展示我最近的认可”之类的问题，并获得简洁、直观的答案。

它涵盖的内容：
- 敬业度分数、eNPS 和参与趋势 - 针对您的团队或整个组织
- 员工档案、雇用日期和汇报关系
- 您发送和收到的识别卡
- 团队结构和组织环境，因此像“我的直接报告”这样的引用会自动解析

专为希望更快地访问 Workleap 中已有信号而无需切换工具的经理和人力资源团队而设计。
defaultPrompts: Fetch my recent Good Vibes
What's the engagement score of the Customer Support team?
Tell me more about Daniel, the new hire
defaultPromptsZh: 获取我最近的好心情

plugin_asdk_app_6a3a676e22a88191b790ad05.longDescription:
Policy Doctor brings EU legislative, case law and lobbying intelligence directly into ChatGPT and your daily work.
• Monitor and analyse EU lobbying activity — search meetings, track who lobbies whom and on what topics – and what public affairs firms are used by companies
• Profile lobbying organisations and targets like EU officials across the EU Transparency Register
• Also includes Finnish legislative projects and lobbying information
• Structured data designed for AI tools — retrieve, analyse, and act on policy intelligence without leaving your AI tool
• Draft documents and infuse your own Sharepoint, Google Drive, or other files with data brought to you by Policy Doctor

Built for public affairs and legal professionals operating at the EU and national level

专为在欧盟和国家层面运作的公共事务和法律专业人士而打造

plugin_asdk_app_6a798064b7108191af56a1cb.name: Windsor.ai TikTok Ads
plugin_asdk_app_6a798064b7108191af56a1cb.productIntro: Windsor.ai TikTok Ads 将您的 TikTok 广告数据连接到您的 AI 助手，以便您可以用简单的英语分析效果并管理广告活动。发现连接的广告帐户，检查有效字段和选项，并查询任何日期范围内的广告系列、广告组和广告指标（支出、展示次数、点击次数、点击率、每次点击费用和转化次数）。确认后，它还可以暂停或启用广告系列、广告组和广告，并设置广告系列和广告组预算。
plugin_asdk_app_6a798064b7108191af56a1cb.productIntroEn: Windsor.ai TikTok Ads connects your TikTok Ads data to your AI assistant, so you can analyze performance and manage campaigns in plain English. Discover connected ad accounts, inspect valid fields and options, and query campaign, ad group, and ad metrics (spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, and conversions) over any date range.
plugin_asdk_app_6a798064b7108191af56a1cb.longDescription:
Windsor.ai TikTok Ads connects your TikTok Ads data to your AI assistant, so you can analyze performance and manage campaigns in plain English. Discover connected ad accounts, inspect valid fields and options, and query campaign, ad group, and ad metrics (spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, and conversions) over any date range. On confirmation, it can also pause or enable campaigns, ad groups, and ads and set campaign and ad group budgets.

Common workflows:
- Compare spend, clicks, and conversions by campaign for the last 30 days
- Find an underperforming ad group and pause it, after you confirm
- Adjust a campaign budget without leaving the conversation

Changes to your account are made only after you confirm the specific action; everything else is read-only. Free plan available, no credit card required.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
plugin_asdk_app_6a798064b7108191af56a1cb.longDescriptionZh:
Windsor.ai TikTok Ads 将您的 TikTok 广告数据连接到您的 AI 助手，以便您可以用简单的英语分析效果并管理广告活动。发现连接的广告帐户，检查有效字段和选项，并查询任何日期范围内的广告系列、广告组和广告指标（支出、展示次数、点击次数、点击率、每次点击费用和转化次数）。确认后，它还可以暂停或启用广告系列、广告组和广告，并设置广告系列和广告组预算。

常见工作流程：
- 按广告系列比较过去 30 天的支出、点击次数和转化次数
- 找到效果不佳的广告组并在确认后将其暂停
- 无需离开对话即可调整营销活动预算

仅在您确认具体操作后才会对您的帐户进行更改；其他一切都是只读的。提供免费计划，无需信用卡。

Windsor.ai 是一个独立的产品，不隶属于其所连接的平台，也不受其认可。
defaultPrompts: Show me spend, impressions, clicks, and CPA by ad group for my Microsoft Ads account over the last 14 days.
My highest-CPA campaign is overspending — help me lower its daily budget.
Compare this week's Microsoft Ads spend and CPA to last week, then pause the worst-performing ad group.
defaultPromptsZh: 按广告组显示过去 14 天内我的 Microsoft Ads 帐户的支出、展示次数、点击次数和每次转化费用。

将本周的 Microsoft Ads 支出和每次转化费用与上周进行比较，然后暂停表现最差的广告组。

plugin_asdk_app_6a611aed0b4c81919f681696.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到一位 Conterminal 承运商或货运代理工作区，并询问有关集装箱运输的只读问题。按集装箱、主提单、参考号、船舶、码头、状态、持有、热装标志或支持的日期进行搜索。检索结果的策划操作快照，包括里程碑和当前操作标志。 Conterminal 会在每次调用时重新检查登录用户、OAuth 客户端、工作区成员资格和发货授权。连接器无法编辑货件、调度司机、刷新提供商、发送消息、上传文档或访问其他组织。

plugin_asdk_app_6a611aed0b4c81919f681696.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to one Conterminal carrier or freight-forwarder workspace and ask read-only questions about container shipments. plugin_asdk_app_6a4bb46596648191a84d189c.name: magicplan
plugin_asdk_app_6a4bb46596648191a84d189c.productIntro: magicplan 是一款用于现场测量、记录和估算的现场应用程序，广泛应用于财产修复、保险和建筑领域。此连接器为 ChatGPT 提供了对 magicplan 工作区的只读访问权限，因此您可以直接在对话中查看和推理项目数据。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4bb46596648191a84d189c.productIntroEn: magicplan is a field app for measuring, documenting, and estimating on site, widely used in property restoration, insurance, and construction. This connector gives ChatGPT read-only access to a magicplan workspace, so you can review and reason over project data directly in the conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4bb46596648191a84d189c.longDescription:
magicplan is a field app for measuring, documenting, and estimating on site, widely used in property restoration, insurance, and construction. This connector gives ChatGPT read-only access to a magicplan workspace, so you can review and reason over project data directly in the conversation.

Once connected, ChatGPT can:
- List and open projects, and read the field data captured on each floor plan
- Retrieve measured areas and volumes, broken down by floor and room
- Read the custom forms filled out on site, and the drying history recorded by moisture instruments
- Browse project photos and files, matched to the part of the building they document
- Open estimates down to individual line items and cost totals

A connection is authenticated at the workspace level with your magicplan Customer ID and API key, and acts on behalf of that whole workspace. The connector is read-only: it never creates, changes, or deletes anything in magicplan, and your API key is never shared with ChatGPT.

Typical uses: preparing a scope of work from a restoration project, checking which rooms still need documentation, summarizing an estimate, or answering questions about a plan's measurements.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4bb46596648191a84d189c.longDescriptionZh:
magicplan 是一款用于现场测量、记录和估算的现场应用程序，广泛应用于财产修复、保险和建筑领域。此连接器为 ChatGPT 提供了对 magicplan 工作区的只读访问权限，因此您可以直接在对话中查看和推理项目数据。

连接后，ChatGPT 可以：
- 列出并打开项目，并读取每个平面图上捕获的现场数据
- 检索按楼层和房间细分的测量面积和体积
- 阅读现场填写的定制表格，以及湿度仪器记录的干燥历史
- 浏览与他们记录的建筑物部分相匹配的项目照片和文件
- 打开估算直至单个行项目和成本总计

连接使用您的 magicplan 客户 ID 和 API 密钥在工作区级别进行身份验证，并代表整个工作区进行操作。连接器是只读的：它永远不会创建、更改或删除 magicplan 中的任何内容，并且您的 API 密钥永远不会与 ChatGPT 共享。

典型用途：准备修复项目的工作范围、检查哪些房间仍需要文档、总结估算或回答有关计划测量的问题。

plugin_asdk_app_6a563c8d0e6081919ccce130.productIntro: 获取有关 Shallon CSP（Shallon Legal FZ LLC 的商业名称）的准确、可引用的答案，Shallon CSP 是一家位于阿联酋富查伊拉的法律、企业和信托服务提供商，为欧洲和国际市场的客户提供服务。 Courtyard AI 在公司的明确授权下为 Shallon CSP 运行此连接器，并自动保持其内容最新，因此答案来自公司自己发布的信息，而不是过时的第三方来源。
plugin_asdk_app_6a563c8d0e6081919ccce130.productIntroEn: Get accurate, citable answers about Shallon CSP (the trading name of Shallon Legal FZ LLC), a UAE-based legal, corporate, and fiduciary services provider based in Fujairah that serves clients across Europe and international markets.
plugin_asdk_app_6a563c8d0e6081919ccce130.longDescription:
Get accurate, citable answers about Shallon CSP (the trading name of Shallon Legal FZ LLC), a UAE-based legal, corporate, and fiduciary services provider based in Fujairah that serves clients across Europe and international markets. Courtyard AI operates this connector for Shallon CSP with the firm's explicit authorization and keeps its content current automatically, so answers come from the firm's own published information rather than stale third-party sources.

Use it for full details on the firm's practice areas: company formation and corporate administration; corporate services (ongoing governance, compliance, and corporate housekeeping); DIFC and ADGM wills, trusts, and foundations for expatriates in the UAE; cross-border structuring; dispute resolution; legal drafting and documentation; and regulatory compliance and licensing. It also covers who the firm serves, its office hours and logistics in Fujairah, and accessibility information.

The connector exposes two read-only tools. search returns ranked results, each with a title, a canonical source URL, and a text snippet. fetch returns a document's full text, its canonical URL, and metadata. Every result resolves to the exact page it came from, so answers stay grounded and citable to source.

All content is public business information describing the firm's services. It is general information, not legal advice. No account, login, or personal data is required, and no client data is exposed. The connector is strictly read-only: it retrieves and cites the firm's published information and never performs writes, bookings, or transactions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a563c8d0e6081919ccce130.longDescriptionZh:
获取有关 Shallon CSP（Shallon Legal FZ LLC 的商业名称）的准确、可引用的答案，Shallon CSP 是一家位于阿联酋富查伊拉的法律、企业和信托服务提供商，为欧洲和国际市场的客户提供服务。 Courtyard AI 在公司的明确授权下为 Shallon CSP 运行此连接器，并自动保持其内容最新，因此答案来自公司自己发布的信息，而不是过时的第三方来源。

使用它来了解公司业务领域的完整详细信息：公司组建和公司管理；公司服务（持续治理、合规性和公司内务管理）； DIFC 和 ADGM 为阿联酋外籍人士设立的遗嘱、信托和基金会；跨境架构；争议解决；法律起草和文件；以及监管合规性和许可。它还涵盖了该公司的服务对象、其在富查伊拉的办公时间和物流以及可达性信息。

连接器公开了两个只读工具。搜索返回排名结果，每个结果都有标题、规范源 URL 和文本片段。 fetch 返回文档的全文、规范 URL 和元数据。每个结果都会解析到它来自的确切页面，因此答案保持接地且可引用来源。

所有内容都是描述公司服务的公共商业信息。这是一般信息，而不是法律建议。不需要帐户、登录或个人数据，也不会暴露任何客户数据。连接器是严格只读的：它检索并引用公司发布的信息，并且从不执​​行写入、预订或交易。

plugin_asdk_app_6a71ebe0200c8191bda1264a.productIntroEn: nowo Immobilien is a modern real estate company specialising in the Braunschweig region. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in Braunschweig and the surrounding area.
plugin_asdk_app_6a71ebe0200c8191bda1264a.longDescription:
nowo Immobilien is a modern real estate company specialising in the Braunschweig region. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties in Braunschweig and the surrounding area.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to understand a property's location, nearby infrastructure, and surroundings at a glance, creating a faster and more efficient property search experience.

With in-depth local market knowledge and personalised service, nowo Immobilien combines modern digital solutions with regional expertise to help buyers, sellers, and investors navigate the Braunschweig real estate market.

Key Benefits

* Interactive map-based property search
* Faster orientation in Braunschweig and the surrounding region
* Better understanding of neighborhoods, infrastructure, and local amenities
* Focus on carefully selected residential and investment properties
* Easy comparison of different cities and communities
* More efficient property search through visual navigation
* Direct contact with experienced real estate professionals
* Modern and user-friendly mobile experience

Whether you're looking for an apartment in Braunschweig, a family home in the surrounding area, or an attractive investment opportunity, nowo Immobilien offers a modern and transparent way to explore the regional real estate market.
plugin_asdk_app_6a71ebe0200c8191bda1264a.longDescriptionZh:
nowo Immobilien 是一家专门从事布伦瑞克地区业务的现代化房地产公司。该应用程序提供了一种直观的、基于位置的方式来发现、购买或出售布伦瑞克及周边地区的房产。

用户无需浏览冗长的房产列表，而是可以直接在交互式地图上探索可用的房屋、公寓、土地和投资房产。这使得您可以一目了然地了解房产的位置、附近的基础设施和周围环境，从而创造更快、更高效的房产搜索体验。

凭借深入的当地市场知识和个性化服务，nowo Immobilien 将现代数字解决方案与区域专业知识相结合，帮助买家、卖家和投资者驾驭不伦瑞克房地产市场。

主要优点

* 基于交互式地图的房产搜索
* 在布伦瑞克及周边地区更快的定位
* 更好地了解社区、基础设施和当地便利设施
* 专注于精心挑选的住宅和投资物业
* 轻松比较不同城市和社区
* 通过视觉导航更高效的房产搜索
* 与经验丰富的房地产专业人士直接联系
* 现代且用户友好的移动体验

无论您是在布伦瑞克寻找公寓、周边地区的家庭住宅，还是有吸引力的投资机会，nowo Immobilien 都能提供现代、透明的方式来探索该地区的房地产市场。
