plugin_asdk_app_6a7b8619ab348191a773e0fb.productIntro: Masha 是一个针对 CTV、视频和展示广告的活动管理平台。连接您的 Masha 帐户，以简单的语言询问您自己的广告系列：列出它们，检查按天、设备、地理位置、时间、年龄或电子商务细分的投放和效果指标，并查看您帐户中的广告商和发布商。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b8619ab348191a773e0fb.productIntroEn: Masha is a campaign management platform for CTV, video and display advertising. Connect your Masha account to ask about your own campaigns in plain language: list them, check delivery and performance metrics broken down by day, device, geography, hours, age or e-commerce, and review the advertisers and publishers in your account.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b8619ab348191a773e0fb.longDescription:
Masha is a campaign management platform for CTV, video and display advertising. Connect your Masha account to ask about your own campaigns in plain language: list them, check delivery and performance metrics broken down by day, device, geography, hours, age or e-commerce, and review the advertisers and publishers in your account.

Without connecting an account you can still browse Masha's public CTV inventory and rate card, and get the brand kit and pitch-deck structure used to build a media proposal. Connected users can also render a finished deck to a downloadable PDF.

The connector is read-only over your Masha data. It never exposes supplier costs, agency margins or any other tenant's data — every call is scoped to your own account by the same permissions the web app uses.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b8619ab348191a773e0fb.longDescriptionZh:
Masha 是一个针对 CTV、视频和展示广告的活动管理平台。连接您的 Masha 帐户，以简单的语言询问您自己的广告系列：列出它们，检查按天、设备、地理位置、时间、年龄或电子商务细分的投放和效果指标，并查看您帐户中的广告商和发布商。

无需连接帐户，您仍然可以浏览 Masha 的公共 CTV 库存和价目表，并获取用于构建媒体提案的品牌工具包和推介材料结构。连接的用户还可以将完成的甲板呈现为可下载的 PDF。

连接器对您的 Masha 数据是只读的。它永远不会暴露供应商成本、代理利润或任何其他租户的数据——每次调用都通过网络应用程序使用的相同权限限定在您自己的帐户范围内。
defaultPrompts: List my campaigns and tell me which one delivered the most impressions
What CTV inventory is available in Mexico, and at what CPM?
Draft a 4-slide CTV pitch deck for a coffee brand and render it to PDF
defaultPromptsZh: 列出我的广告系列并告诉我哪一个广告系列带来的展示次数最多
墨西哥有哪些 CTV 广告资源，每千次展示费用是多少？
为咖啡品牌起草 4 幻灯片 CTV 推介材料并将其呈现为 PDF

plugin_asdk_app_697198292e2881918e3535fb.name: Stabile: Loyalty Rewards Agent
plugin_asdk_app_697198292e2881918e3535fb.productIntro: Stabile 帮助 ChatGPT 用户检查 Shopify 商家忠诚度条款、估算购物车赚取的积分、在购物者同意的情况下查找奖励选项，并在结帐前兑换符合条件的奖励代码。
plugin_asdk_app_697198292e2881918e3535fb.productIntroEn: Stabile helps ChatGPT users check Shopify merchant loyalty terms, estimate points earned for a cart, look up reward options with shopper consent, and redeem eligible reward codes before checkout.
plugin_asdk_app_697198292e2881918e3535fb.longDescription:
Stabile helps ChatGPT users check Shopify merchant loyalty terms, estimate points earned for a cart, look up reward options with shopper consent, and redeem eligible reward codes before checkout.

For configured merchant workflows, Stabile can also support reviewed win-back points rewards for selected customers.

Stabile does not search products, create carts, process payments, or place orders. Checkout remains with Shopify or the merchant.
plugin_asdk_app_697198292e2881918e3535fb.longDescriptionZh:
Stabile 帮助 ChatGPT 用户检查 Shopify 商家忠诚度条款、估算购物车赚取的积分、在购物者同意的情况下查找奖励选项，并在结帐前兑换符合条件的奖励代码。

对于配置的商家工作流程，Stabile 还可以支持对选定客户进行审核的赢回积分奖励。

Stabile 不会搜索产品、创建购物车、处理付款或下订单。结账仍由 Shopify 或商家进行。

plugin_asdk_app_6a754e3ed8b48191aa0e6761.name: Gateway Tariff Calculator
plugin_asdk_app_6a754e3ed8b48191aa0e6761.description: 美国进口关税和 HTS 代码
plugin_asdk_app_6a754e3ed8b48191aa0e6761.originalDescription: US import duty and HTS codes
plugin_asdk_app_6a754e3ed8b48191aa0e6761.productIntro: 在做出承诺之前计算一下您的进口实际成本。输入 HTS 代码和原产国并获取所欠关税，包括在基本税率之上叠加的每项贸易行为：第 301 条、第 232 条、第 338 条、保障措施、AD/CVD 等，加上政府费用和到岸总额。您还可以查找产品的 HTS 分类，了解美国贸易政策的变化以及接下来生效的内容，每项都有其来源。数据来自实时的美国统一关税表和已发布的贸易行动，引用以便您可以查看。他们正在计划估算，而不是海关裁决。
plugin_asdk_app_6a754e3ed8b48191aa0e6761.productIntroEn: Calculate what your imports actually cost before you commit. Enter an HTS code and country of origin and get the duty owed, including every trade action that stacks on top of the base rate: Section 301, Section 232, Section 338, safeguards, AD/CVD and the rest, plus government fees and the landed total.
plugin_asdk_app_6a754e3ed8b48191aa0e6761.longDescription: Calculate what your imports actually cost before you commit. Enter an HTS code and country of origin and get the duty owed, including every trade action that stacks on top of the base rate: Section 301, Section 232, Section 338, safeguards, AD/CVD and the rest, plus government fees and the landed total. You can also look up HTS classifications for a product, and see what changed in US trade policy and what takes effect next, each with its source. Figures come from the live US Harmonized Tariff Schedule and published trade actions, cited so you can check them. They are planning estimates, not customs rulings. Built and maintained by Gateway Lines, an FMC-licensed NVOCC and ocean freight forwarder, using the same tariff engine that prices our own shipments.
plugin_asdk_app_6a754e3ed8b48191aa0e6761.longDescriptionZh: 在做出承诺之前计算一下您的进口实际成本。输入 HTS 代码和原产国并获取所欠关税，包括在基本税率之上叠加的每项贸易行为：第 301 条、第 232 条、第 338 条、保障措施、AD/CVD 等，加上政府费用和到岸总额。您还可以查找产品的 HTS 分类，了解美国贸易政策的变化以及接下来生效的内容，每项都有其来源。数据来自实时的美国统一关税表和已发布的贸易行动，引用以便您可以查看。他们正在计划估算，而不是海关裁决。由获得 FMC 许可的 NVOCC 和海运代理公司 Gateway Lines 建造和维护，使用与我们自己的货运定价相同的关税引擎。
defaultPrompts: What's the real landed duty on $200,000 of Chinese solar cells, HTS 8541.42.00.10?
I'm importing $150,000 of lithium-ion batteries from China. What do I actually owe?
What changed in US trade policy in the last 30 days, and what takes effect next?
defaultPromptsZh: 价值 20 万美元的中国太阳能电池 HTS 8541.42.00.10 的实际到岸关税是多少？
我从中国进口价值 15 万美元的锂离子电池。我实际上欠了什么？
过去 30 天内美国贸易政策发生了哪些变化？接下来会发生什么变化？

plugin_asdk_app_6a997b8a0f3c8191a388dcac.name: base.com
plugin_asdk_app_6a997b8a0f3c8191a388dcac.productIntro: Base MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Base 帐户，以只读访问您的商店数据。通过 OAuth 2.1 连接后（您通过 Base 屏幕登录并同意），ChatGPT 可以检查帐户详细信息、查找订单、查看产品列表和检查库存水平 - 所有这些都无需离开对话。连接器仅读取数据；它无法创建、修改或删除您的基本帐户中的任何内容。
plugin_asdk_app_6a997b8a0f3c8191a388dcac.productIntroEn: Base MCP connects ChatGPT to your Base account for read-only access to your store data. Once connected via OAuth 2.1 (with your login and consent through Base's screen), ChatGPT can check account details, look up orders, review product listings, and check inventory levels — all without leaving the conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a997b8a0f3c8191a388dcac.longDescription: Base MCP connects ChatGPT to your Base account for read-only access to your store data. Once connected via OAuth 2.1 (with your login and consent through Base's screen), ChatGPT can check account details, look up orders, review product listings, and check inventory levels — all without leaving the conversation. The connector only reads data; it cannot create, modify, or delete anything in your Base account.

plugin_asdk_app_6a7eb386661081918aaf06a7.name: Qualisend
plugin_asdk_app_6a7eb386661081918aaf06a7.description: 验证并清理电子邮件列表
plugin_asdk_app_6a7eb386661081918aaf06a7.productIntro: Qualisend 会验证电子邮件地址并清理列表，以便您的邮件到达真实的收件箱并保持较低的退回率。要求它检查单个地址、批次或整个列表 - 您会得到每个地址的明确可交付/有风险/无法交付/未知的判决，以及拼写错误建议和一次性地址和角色地址检测。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7eb386661081918aaf06a7.productIntroEn: Qualisend verifies email addresses and cleans lists so your messages reach real inboxes and bounces stay low. Ask it to check a single address, a batch, or a whole list — you get a clear deliverable / risky / undeliverable / unknown verdict for each, with typo suggestions and disposable- and role-address detection.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7eb386661081918aaf06a7.longDescription:
Qualisend verifies email addresses and cleans lists so your messages reach real inboxes and bounces stay low. Ask it to check a single address, a batch, or a whole list — you get a clear deliverable / risky / undeliverable / unknown verdict for each, with typo suggestions and disposable- and role-address detection.

It runs the full check: syntax, domain and mail server (MX), disposable and role detection, catch-all, and a real mailbox (SMTP) check. Large lists run in the background and return a result summary you can review.

On the Pro plan it also checks whether a sending domain is set up correctly (SPF/DMARC), generates the DNS records you need (SPF, DMARC, BIMI, MTA-STS), and analyzes raw email headers to diagnose deliverability. With the Blacklist Monitoring add-on it can check whether a domain or IP is on major blacklists.

Each verification uses one Qualisend credit, and you connect your own Qualisend account.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7eb386661081918aaf06a7.longDescriptionZh:
Qualisend 会验证电子邮件地址并清理列表，以便您的邮件到达真实的收件箱并保持较低的退回率。要求它检查单个地址、批次或整个列表 - 您会得到每个地址的明确可交付/有风险/无法交付/未知的判决，以及拼写错误建议和一次性地址和角色地址检测。

它运行完整的检查：语法、域和邮件服务器 (MX)、一次性和角色检测、包罗万象以及真实邮箱 (SMTP) 检查。大型列表在后台运行并返回您可以查看的结果摘要。

在 Pro 计划中，它还会检查发送域是否设置正确 (SPF/DMARC)，生成您需要的 DNS 记录（SPF、DMARC、BIMI、MTA-STS），并分析原始电子邮件标头以诊断送达能力。通过黑名单监控插件，它可以检查域或 IP 是否在主要黑名单上。

每次验证都使用一个 Qualisend 积分，并且您可以连接自己的 Qualisend 帐户。

plugin_asdk_app_6a46611fe1d88191af0dfb49.originalDescription: Top AI Powered Open House CRM
plugin_asdk_app_6a46611fe1d88191af0dfb49.productIntro: HAVN 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的房地产工作区。 借助 HAVN，代理商和团队可以向 ChatGPT 请求有关房产、开放日、联系人、销售线索、任务、媒体、分析和卖家报告的范围内的、许可感知的帮助。 ChatGPT 可以查找相关的 HAVN 记录、总结活动、准备卖家更新、显示房产照片和文件，并在您明确要求时帮助创建或更新支持的记录。 访问权限遵循您的 HAVN 角色和机构权限，因此用户只能查看允许他们使用的数据并对其进行操作。
plugin_asdk_app_6a46611fe1d88191af0dfb49.productIntroEn: HAVN connects ChatGPT to your real estate workspace. With HAVN, agents and teams can ask ChatGPT for scoped, permission-aware help with properties, open houses, contacts, leads, tasks, media, analytics, and seller reports.
plugin_asdk_app_6a46611fe1d88191af0dfb49.longDescription:
HAVN connects ChatGPT to your real estate workspace.
With HAVN, agents and teams can ask ChatGPT for scoped, permission-aware help with properties, open houses, contacts, leads, tasks, media, analytics, and seller reports. ChatGPT can find relevant HAVN records, summarize activity, prepare seller updates, surface property photos and files, and help create or update supported records when you explicitly ask.
Access follows your HAVN role and agency permissions, so users only see and act on the data they are allowed to use. You can rotate or revoke MCP access from HAVN Settings at any time.

HAVN is built for agents who want fewer scattered notes, cleaner lead capture, better follow-through, and a more organized workflow after every property visit.
plugin_asdk_app_6a46611fe1d88191af0dfb49.longDescriptionZh:
HAVN 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的房地产工作区。
借助 HAVN，代理商和团队可以向 ChatGPT 请求有关房产、开放日、联系人、销售线索、任务、媒体、分析和卖家报告的范围内的、许可感知的帮助。 ChatGPT 可以查找相关的 HAVN 记录、总结活动、准备卖家更新、显示房产照片和文件，并在您明确要求时帮助创建或更新支持的记录。
访问权限遵循您的 HAVN 角色和机构权限，因此用户只能查看允许他们使用的数据并对其进行操作。您可以随时从 HAVN 设置轮换或撤销 MCP 访问权限。

HAVN 专为希望减少分散的笔记、更清晰地捕获潜在客户、更好的跟进以及在每次房产访问后更有条理的工作流程的代理商而设计。

plugin_asdk_app_6a98163f30548191864ee5e6.longDescription:
Syntheia brings two things lawyers do every day into ChatGPT.

Compare: upload a counterparty's draft and your last version, and Syntheia returns a clause-by-clause list of insertions, deletions, and moved text, with a redlined document to download.

Query: ask a question about one agreement, a group of agreements, or your whole workspace. Syntheia navigates each document's structure, follows cross-references, and returns the exact provision text with a link to the source clause, so every answer is grounded in the document rather than in a summary.

Documents stay in your private Syntheia workspace, and results are scoped to your account.

plugin_asdk_app_6a48cc28fd6881918b950cd5.productIntroEn: Der ecoExperten-Connector bringt den deutschen Energieausweis in den KI-Chat. Wer eine Wohnimmobilie vermieten oder verkaufen will, braucht gesetzlich einen Energieausweis — mit dieser App lässt er sich vollständig im Gespräch bestellen:
plugin_asdk_app_6a48cc28fd6881918b950cd5.longDescription:
Der ecoExperten-Connector bringt den deutschen Energieausweis in den KI-Chat. Wer eine Wohnimmobilie vermieten oder verkaufen will, braucht gesetzlich einen Energieausweis — mit dieser App lässt er sich vollständig im Gespräch bestellen:

1. Beraten: Die App erklärt, welcher Ausweistyp passt und welche Angaben nötig sind (Gebäudedaten plus drei aufeinanderfolgende Jahres-Heizabrechnungen).
2. Prüfen: Alle Angaben werden vorab kostenlos gegen die gesetzlichen Regeln des Gebäudeenergiegesetzes (GEG) validiert — z. B. 18-Monats-Frist der Verbrauchsdaten, Bedarfsausweis-Pflicht nach § 80 Abs. 3, Leerstandsgrenzen — ohne dass eine Bestellung ausgelöst wird.
3. Bestellen: Nach ausdrücklicher Zustimmung zu AGB und zahlungspflichtiger Bestellung legt die App eine schwebende Bestellung an und sendet einen Bestätigungslink an die angegebene E-Mail-Adresse. Erst der Klick auf diesen Link macht die Bestellung verbindlich; unbestätigte Bestellungen verfallen nach 48 Stunden automatisch. Kauf auf Rechnung, kein Zahlungsvorgang im Chat. Ein Doppelbestellungs-Schutz verhindert versehentliche Mehrfachkäufe.
4. Verfolgen: Der Bearbeitungsstand ist über Bestellnummer plus die bei der Bestellung angegebene E-Mail-Adresse abrufbar; die Antwort enthält nur den Bearbeitungsstand, keine Personen- oder Gebäudedaten.

Die Ausstellung erfolgt durch eingetragene Energieberater des CO5 Ingenieurbüros für nachhaltiges Bauen (PartG mbB, Berlin); jeder Ausweis erhält eine amtliche DIBt-Registriernummer und wird in der Regel innerhalb von 1–2 Werktagen als PDF per E-Mail zugestellt. Preis: 59 € brutto (Verbrauchsausweis); der Bedarfsausweis (119 €) ist über das Web-Formular erhältlich.
plugin_asdk_app_6a48cc28fd6881918b950cd5.longDescriptionZh:
ecoExperten-Connector 将德国能源证书带入人工智能聊天中。任何想要合法租赁或出售住宅物业的人都需要能源证书 - 使用此应用程序，您可以在对话中完全订购它：

1.建议：应用程序说明哪种类型的身份证适合以及需要哪些信息（建筑数据加上连续三年的年度取暖费）。
2. 检查：所有信息均根据《建筑能源法》(GEG) 的法律规则提前免费验证 - 例如例如。消费数据的 18 个月期限、根据第 80 (3) 条要求提供需求证明、空缺限制 - 不触发订单。
3. 订单：明确同意条款和条件并下达要求付款的订单后，应用程序将创建待处理订单并向所提供的电子邮件地址发送确认链接。只有点击此链接，订单才具有约束力；未经确认的订单将在 48 小时后自动失效。通过帐户购买，无需在聊天中进行付款。双重订单保护可防止意外多次购买。
4. 追踪：可通过订单号加上订购时提供的电子邮件地址查看处理状态；答案仅包含处理状态，没有个人或建筑数据。

该展览由可持续建筑 CO5 工程办公室（柏林 PartG mbB）的注册能源顾问举办；每张身份证都会收到一个官方 DIBt 注册号，通常会在 1-2 个工作日内通过电子邮件以 PDF 形式发送。价格：毛额 59 欧元（消费凭证）；要求证书（119 欧元）可通过网络表格获取。

plugin_asdk_app_6a159fe3f6e48191acf2de28.description: 用于寻找交易的 B2B 数据
plugin_asdk_app_6a159fe3f6e48191acf2de28.productIntro: Spectre 是一个 B2B 情报平台，可帮助投资专业人士研究公司、投资者和人员，以进行尽职调查、交易搜寻、投资组合监控、竞争分析和关系映射。通过 ChatGPT，您可以从名称、域名、电子邮件或 LinkedIn URL 解析公司或个人，在公司、投资者、融资轮次、收购和 IPO 之间运行自然语言发现搜索，并提取包含融资历史、估值、收入估算、竞争格局以及人才或投资者兴趣信号的深入资料。
plugin_asdk_app_6a159fe3f6e48191acf2de28.productIntroEn: Specter is a B2B intelligence platform that helps investment professionals research companies, investors, and people for due diligence, deal sourcing, portfolio monitoring, competitive analysis, and relationship mapping.
plugin_asdk_app_6a159fe3f6e48191acf2de28.longDescription: Specter is a B2B intelligence platform that helps investment professionals research companies, investors, and people for due diligence, deal sourcing, portfolio monitoring, competitive analysis, and relationship mapping. Through ChatGPT you can resolve a company or person from a name, domain, email, or LinkedIn URL, run natural-language discovery searches across companies, investors, funding rounds, acquisitions, and IPOs, and pull deep profiles with funding history, valuations, revenue estimates, competitive landscapes, and talent or investor-interest signals. You can save searches, curate private lists, and fetch professional or personal contact emails for the people you are researching. All results come from Specter's curated dataset, your saved searches, and your own lists.

plugin_asdk_app_6a5f249573388191bc636a69.longDescription:

What you can do:
  • "Create a square product image of our new ceramic mug on a clean studio background" — generate with the Studio creative agent, then refine it
  • "Show me my 20 most recent library assets" — browse, search, rename, and favorite your videos and images
  • "What stores are connected, and show me a few products from my catalog"
  • "List my onsite widgets and show me one's configuration"
  • "Show me my best-performing Meta ads from the last 30 days"

plugin_asdk_app_6a9361d2ee7481919a8c706c.name: Trooth Network
plugin_asdk_app_6a9361d2ee7481919a8c706c.productIntro: Trooth 是软件经济的信任网络。该连接器允许 ChatGPT 对话中的任何人在 Trooth 上查找公司当前的、见证的记录，涵盖九个类别，从身份和安全到隐私、人工智能实践和历史，每个类别都有其来源和上次阅读的日期。在依赖一家公司之前先阅读它，在购买之前比较同一类别的两个供应商，对域的公共安全表面进行实时中立的阅读，验证签名的 Trust Ledger 令牌，或者询问 Trooth 的工作原理。公司还可以查询自己的记录，看看买家看到了什么。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9361d2ee7481919a8c706c.productIntroEn: Trooth is the trust network for the software economy. This connector lets anyone in a ChatGPT conversation look up a company's current, witnessed record on Trooth across nine categories, from identity and security to privacy, AI practices, and history, each with its source and the date it was last read.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9361d2ee7481919a8c706c.longDescription: Trooth is the trust network for the software economy. This connector lets anyone in a ChatGPT conversation look up a company's current, witnessed record on Trooth across nine categories, from identity and security to privacy, AI practices, and history, each with its source and the date it was last read. Read a company before you rely on it, compare two vendors on the same categories before you buy, take a live neutral read of a domain's public security surface, verify a signed Trust Ledger Token, or ask how Trooth works. A company can also look up its own record to see what buyers see. Every answer names its source and date, witnessed evidence is labeled apart from what a company declares, and anything not settled comes back marked unknown rather than guessed. It is read-only and returns only public data, with no account and no login.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9361d2ee7481919a8c706c.longDescriptionZh: Trooth 是软件经济的信任网络。该连接器允许 ChatGPT 对话中的任何人在 Trooth 上查找公司当前的、见证的记录，涵盖九个类别，从身份和安全到隐私、人工智能实践和历史，每个类别都有其来源和上次阅读的日期。在依赖一家公司之前先阅读它，在购买之前比较同一类别的两个供应商，对域的公共安全表面进行实时中立的阅读，验证签名的 Trust Ledger 令牌，或者询问 Trooth 的工作原理。公司还可以查询自己的记录，看看买家看到了什么。每个答案都会注明其来源和日期，目击证据与公司声明的内容分开标记，任何未解决的问题都会被标记为未知而不是猜测。它是只读的，仅返回公共数据，没有帐户，也无需登录。

plugin_asdk_app_6a73449598d0819188d577a5.productIntroEn: Sellergoo is a profit-and-operations analytics service for online sellers. You connect the shops, marketplaces, payment and accounting accounts you already sell through, and Sellergoo brings the orders, fees, refunds, cost of goods, advertising and overhead together to work out what you actually earned — per channel, per product, per order.
plugin_asdk_app_6a73449598d0819188d577a5.longDescription:
Sellergoo is a profit-and-operations analytics service for online sellers. You connect the shops, marketplaces, payment and accounting accounts you already sell through, and Sellergoo brings the orders, fees, refunds, cost of goods, advertising and overhead together to work out what you actually earned — per channel, per product, per order.

This plugin lets you ask about those numbers in plain language instead of exporting spreadsheets. Ask what last month really made after fees, which SKUs are thin on margin, what a marketplace actually deposited in your bank account, or which products run out of stock first.

READ-ONLY
This plugin can only look. It cannot place, cancel, refund, reprice or change anything — not in Sellergoo, and not in any shop or marketplace you have connected. Every tool it exposes is read-only, and the access you grant it carries no permission to write. It reads figures that already belong to you, in answer to questions you ask.

WHAT IT CAN ANSWER
• Profit — sales, units, refunds, fees, cost of goods, ad spend, overhead, gross and net profit, margin and ROI for a period, combined and per channel.
• Profit and loss — a month-by-month P&L for up to the last 12 months, all channels or one.
• Orders — any date range, paginated, with each order's sales and marketplace fees.
• Products — per-SKU sales, units, margin and profit for a period, ranked by sales.
• Payouts — the settlements marketplaces and payment providers actually paid out, with the amounts grouped by line type.
• Inventory — stock on hand, 30-day sell-through and days of cover per SKU, one sales channel at a time.
• Alerts — stock-outs, low stock, thin margins, lost Buy Box, price changes and negative reviews.
• Channels — which shops are connected and when each last synced.

WHAT YOU NEED
A Sellergoo account (sellergoo.com). You sign in once and approve the connection; nothing is copied or pasted by hand. The answers are only as complete as the accounts you have connected — a brand-new account returns empty figures rather than errors, and you can always ask which account is being read.

Sellergoo works with Amazon, eBay, OTTO, Kaufland, Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy and Stripe, plus QuickBooks for accounting and UPS and FedEx for shipping. Walmart is planned and not available yet. Money is reported in euro.

INDEPENDENT PRODUCT
Sellergoo is made by Wolfsohn Handel (Hüseyin Kurtoglu Wolfsohn, Einzelunternehmen, Germany). It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by or certified by Amazon, eBay, OTTO, Kaufland, Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy, Stripe, Intuit, UPS or FedEx. Those names appear only to say which of your own accounts Sellergoo can read for you.

YOUR DATA
The figures returned are commercial: totals, fees, SKUs, stock and payouts. Order records carry no buyer names, addresses, e-mail addresses or payment details. Nothing returned here is used to train any model. You can cut the connection off at any moment in Sellergoo under Settings → API keys; it stops working immediately, with no grace period.

Documentation: https://sellergoo.com/docs/mcp
Privacy: https://sellergoo.com/privacy · Terms: https://sellergoo.com/terms
Support: info@wolfsohn.de
plugin_asdk_app_6a73449598d0819188d577a5.longDescriptionZh:
Sellergoo 是为在线卖家提供的利润和运营分析服务。您连接已通过销售的商店、市场、支付和会计帐户，Sellergoo 会将订单、费用、退款、商品成本、广告和管理费用汇总在一起，计算出您实际赚取的收入 - 每个渠道、每个产品、每个订单。

该插件可让您以简单的语言询问这些数字，而无需导出电子表格。询问上个月扣除费用后的实际收入、哪些 SKU 利润微薄、市场实际存入您的银行账户的金额是多少，或者哪些产品首先缺货。

只读
这个插件只能看看。它不能放置、取消、退款、重新定价或更改任何东西 - 不能在 Sellergoo 中，也不能在您连接的任何商店或市场中。它公开的每个工具都是只读的，您授予它的访问权限不包含写入权限。它读取已经属于您的数据，以回答您提出的问题。

它能回答什么
• 利润— 一段时间内的销售额、单位数、退款、费用、商品成本、广告支出、管理费用、毛利和净利润、利润率和投资回报率（组合和每个渠道）。
• 损益——过去12 个月内所有渠道或单个渠道的逐月损益。
• 订单— 任何日期范围，分页，包含每个订单的销售和市场费用。
• 产品— 一段时间内每个SKU 的销售额、单位数、利润率和利润，按销售额排名。
• 支付— 结算市场和支付提供商实际支付，金额按行类型分组。
• 库存 — 现有库存、30 天的销售量和每个 SKU 的覆盖天数，一次一个销售渠道。
• 警报——缺货、库存不足、利润微薄、Buy Box 丢失、价格变化和负面评论。
• 渠道— 哪些商店已连接以及每个商店上次同步的时间。

您需要什么
Sellergoo 帐户 (sellergoo.com)。您登录一次并批准连接；没有任何内容是手工复制或粘贴的。答案的完整程度取决于您所连接的帐户 - 全新的帐户会返回空数字而不是错误，并且您可以随时询问正在读取哪个帐户。

Sellergoo 与 Amazon、eBay、OTTO、Kaufland、Shopify、WooCommerce、Etsy 和 Stripe 合作，还与 QuickBooks 进行会计合作，与 UPS 和 FedEx 进行运输合作。沃尔玛已计划，但尚未开放。资金以欧元报告。

独立产品
Sellergoo 由 Wolfsohn Handel（Hüseyin Kurtoglu Wolfsohn，Einzelunternehmen，德国）制造。它不隶属于 Amazon、eBay、OTTO、Kaufland、Shopify、WooCommerce、Etsy、Stripe、Intuit、UPS 或 FedEx，也不受其认可、赞助或认证。这些名称仅表明 Sellergoo 可以为您读取您自己的哪些帐户。

您的数据
返回的数据是商业数据：总计、费用、SKU、库存和支出。订单记录不包含买家姓名、地址、电子邮件地址或付款详细信息。这里返回的任何内容都不会用于训练任何模型。您可以随时在 Sellergoo 中的“设置”→“API 密钥”下切断连接；它会立即停止工作，没有宽限期。

文档：https://sellergoo.com/docs/mcp
隐私：https://sellergoo.com/privacy · 条款：https://sellergoo.com/terms
支持：info@wolfsohn.de

plugin_asdk_app_6a8c361886e88191a4704eed.productIntroEn: PKB Immobilien is a locally focused real estate company specializing in Baunatal, Kassel, the Kassel district, and the Schwalm-Eder district. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties throughout the region.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8c361886e88191a4704eed.longDescription:
PKB Immobilien is a locally focused real estate company specializing in Baunatal, Kassel, the Kassel district, and the Schwalm-Eder district. The app provides an intuitive, location-based way to discover, buy, or sell properties throughout the region.

Instead of browsing through long property listings, users can explore available houses, apartments, plots of land, and investment properties directly on an interactive map. This makes it easy to understand location, infrastructure, and the surrounding neighborhood at a glance, making the property search simpler and more efficient.

Combining in-depth local market knowledge with personal advice, PKB Immobilien connects modern digital solutions with regional real estate expertise. Buyers, sellers, and investors gain transparent and convenient access to the property market in Baunatal, Kassel, and the surrounding region.

Key Benefits

* Interactive property search with a modern map view
* Quick orientation across Baunatal, Kassel, and Northern Hesse
* Better understanding of location, infrastructure, and surroundings
* Focus on selected residential and investment properties
* Easy comparison of different locations and municipalities
* More efficient property searches through visual navigation
* Local market expertise and personalized real estate advice
* Modern and user-friendly access to the regional property market

Whether you are looking for an apartment in Kassel, a family home in Baunatal, a property in the Kassel district, or an attractive investment property in the Schwalm-Eder district, PKB Immobilien offers a modern, transparent, and regionally focused way to access the local real estate market.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8c361886e88191a4704eed.longDescriptionZh:
PKB Immobilien 是一家专注于当地的房地产公司，专注于鲍纳塔尔、卡塞尔、卡塞尔区和施瓦尔姆-埃德尔区。该应用程序提供了一种直观的、基于位置的方式来发现、购买或出售整个地区的房产。

用户无需浏览冗长的房产列表，而是可以直接在交互式地图上探索可用的房屋、公寓、土地和投资房产。这使得位置、基础设施和周边社区一目了然，使房产搜索更简单、更高效。

PKB Immobilien 将深入的当地市场知识与个人建议相结合，将现代数字解决方案与区域房地产专业知识结合起来。买家、卖家和投资者可以透明、便捷地进入鲍纳塔尔、卡塞尔及周边地区的房地产市场。

主要优点

* 具有现代地图视图的交互式房产搜索
* 快速了解鲍纳塔尔、卡塞尔和北黑森州
* 更好地了解位置、基础设施和周围环境
* 专注于选定的住宅和投资物业
* 轻松比较不同地点和城市
* 通过视觉导航更高效的财产搜索
* 当地市场专业知识和个性化的房地产建议
* 现代且用户友好的方式进入区域房地产市场

无论您是在卡塞尔寻找公寓、在鲍纳塔尔寻找家庭住宅、在卡塞尔地区寻找房产，还是在 Schwalm-Eder 地区寻找有吸引力的投资房产，PKB Immobilien 都能提供一种现代、透明且以区域为重点的方式进入当地房地产市场。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3c3057bc8481918c64e253.name: Trussi AI
plugin_asdk_app_6a3c3057bc8481918c64e253.productIntro: Trussi AI 将您的 Trussi Roofing CRM 连接到 ChatGPT，以便您的团队可以用简单的语言运行业务。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3c3057bc8481918c64e253.productIntroEn: Trussi AI connects your Trussi roofing CRM to ChatGPT so your team can run the business in plain language.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3c3057bc8481918c64e253.longDescription:
Trussi AI connects your Trussi roofing CRM to ChatGPT so your team can run the business in plain language.

Look things up:
- Find and open projects and customers, with full job detail (status, quotes, files, measurements)
- Check your sales pipeline, dashboard, and rep leaderboard
- Pull month-by-month revenue, AR/collections, and marketing-channel performance
- See calendar, labor, and delivery schedules for any day or date range
- Review profit analysis, worksheets (signed value, collected, balance due), and insurance supplements
- Read project and per-user activity timelines, and run your saved reports

Take action (with your permissions):
- Add comments, create calendar events and quotes, and move projects through the pipeline
- Send an email or text to a customer on your behalf

Security:
- OAuth 2.0 sign-in with PKCE; the app only sees data your account already allows
- Every request is account-scoped and capability-checked, exactly like the Trussi app
- Read and write are separate scopes you approve when connecting

Built for roofing teams - reps, production, and owners - scoped automatically by role and branch.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3c3057bc8481918c64e253.longDescriptionZh:
Trussi AI 将您的 Trussi Roofing CRM 连接到 ChatGPT，以便您的团队可以用简单的语言运行业务。

查一下事情：
- 查找并打开项目和客户，以及完整的工作详细信息（状态、报价、文件、测量）
- 检查您的销售渠道、仪表板和代表排行榜
- 拉动逐月收入、AR/收藏品和营销渠道绩效
- 查看任何日期或日期范围的日历、人工和交货时间表
- 审查利润分析、工作表（签名价值、已收款项、应付余额）和保险补充
- 读取项目和每个用户的活动时间表，并运行保存的报告

采取行动（在您的许可下）：
- 添加评论、创建日历事件和报价，以及通过管道移动项目
- 代表您向客户发送电子邮件或短信

安全性：
- OAuth 2.0 使用 PKCE 登录；该应用程序只能看到您的帐户已允许的数据
- 每个请求都是帐户范围和功能检查，就像 Trussi 应用程序一样
- 读取和写入是连接时您批准的独立范围

专为屋顶团队（代表、生产和业主）而构建，按角色和分支机构自动确定范围。

plugin_asdk_app_6a99ed098c7481919d72739e.name: GadgetOS
plugin_asdk_app_6a99ed098c7481919d72739e.productIntro: GadgetOS 是一家孟加拉国手机、笔记本电脑和电子产品商店运行的零售管理系统 — 销售点、按 IMEI 和序列号列出的库存、保修和维修台、供应商以及符合增值税的收据。该连接器为商店的老板和员工提供了一种简单的语言方式来了解他们自己的实时记录。
plugin_asdk_app_6a99ed098c7481919d72739e.productIntroEn: GadgetOS is the retail-management system a Bangladeshi phone, laptop and electronics shop runs on — point of sale, stock by IMEI and serial number, a warranty and repair desk, suppliers, and VAT-compliant receipts. This connector gives the owner and staff of one shop a plain-language way into their own live records.
plugin_asdk_app_6a99ed098c7481919d72739e.longDescription:
GadgetOS is the retail-management system a Bangladeshi phone, laptop and electronics shop runs on — point of sale, stock by IMEI and serial number, a warranty and repair desk, suppliers, and VAT-compliant receipts. This connector gives the owner and staff of one shop a plain-language way into their own live records.

Ask what sold this month and get the real figure. Ask what is running out and get the items below their reorder level with a suggested quantity. Ask about one IMEI and get that exact handset: in stock or sold, its cost and its price, when it arrived and when it left, and the warranty left on it. Ask what is on the repair desk and get every claim with its status, customer, device, days open and estimate. Ask whether a customer's phone is still under warranty and get the determination from the sale date — or, where no warranty period was ever recorded, that fact stated plainly instead of a guess.

With the owner's opt-in it also writes: create a device, change a price, a rack location or a reorder level, receive stock or one serialized unit, log an expense, add a supplier, raise a draft purchase order, record a customer's payment against what they already owe, book a device in for repair, and move a claim along to inspecting, estimate pending, approved, repairing, ready or delivered.

It searches a shared reference catalog of phones, laptops and accessories, so adding a product inherits the right brand, category, specifications and official image rather than starting from a blank row.

Everything is scoped to the single shop the signed-in user belongs to. There is no parameter on any tool that could reach another business's data.

Rejecting or refunding a warranty claim needs a manager PIN, and there is no tool for it — that stays in the app on purpose.

Amounts are in Bangladeshi Taka, held as integer paisa. Dates are Asia/Dhaka. Bangla and English both work.
plugin_asdk_app_6a99ed098c7481919d72739e.longDescriptionZh:
GadgetOS 是一家孟加拉国手机、笔记本电脑和电子产品商店运行的零售管理系统 — 销售点、按 IMEI 和序列号列出的库存、保修和维修台、供应商以及符合增值税的收据。该连接器为商店的老板和员工提供了一种简单的语言方式来了解他们自己的实时记录。

询问本月销售了什么并获得真实的数字。询问哪些商品已用完，并按照建议数量购买低于再订购水平的商品。询问一个 IMEI 并获得准确的手机：库存或已售出、其成本和价格、到达和离开的时间以及保修期。询问维修台上有什么，并获取每项索赔的状态、客户、设备、开放天数和估计。询问客户的手机是否仍在保修期内，并从销售日期开始确定——或者，如果没有记录保修期，则明确说明这一事实而不是猜测。

如果所有者选择加入，它还可以写入：创建设备、更改价格、机架位置或重新订购级别、接收库存或一个序列化设备、记录费用、添加供应商、提出草稿采购订单、记录客户已欠的付款、预订设备进行维修以及将索赔移至检查、估计待定、批准、维修、准备或交付。

它搜索手机、笔记本电脑和配件的共享参考目录，因此添加产品会继承正确的品牌、类别、规格和官方图像，而不是从空白行开始。

一切都仅限于登录用户所属的单个商店。任何工具上都没有可以访问其他企业数据的参数。

拒绝或退款保修索赔需要经理 PIN，但没有专门用于此目的的工具 - 该工具会故意保留在应用程序中。

金额以孟加拉国塔卡为单位，以整数派萨表示。日期为亚洲/达卡。孟加拉语和英语都可以使用。
defaultPrompts: What's on the repair desk?
Is IMEI 356938035643809 still under warranty?
Which brand made me the most profit this month?
defaultPromptsZh: 维修台上有什么？
IMEI 356938035643809 还在保修期内吗？
这个月哪个品牌给我带来的利润最多？

plugin_asdk_app_6a84539026a88191aa8c1db7.productIntro: Gleap 将您的客户支持工作区带入 ChatGPT。搜索和分类票证、查找联系人和公司、回复客户或添加内部注释、使您的帮助中心保持最新状态，以及在不离开对话的情况下检查支持指标。
plugin_asdk_app_6a84539026a88191aa8c1db7.productIntroEn: Gleap brings your customer support workspace into ChatGPT. Search and triage tickets, look up contacts and companies, reply to customers or add an internal note, keep your help center up to date, and check support metrics without leaving the conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a84539026a88191aa8c1db7.longDescription:
Gleap brings your customer support workspace into ChatGPT. Search and triage tickets, look up contacts and companies, reply to customers or add an internal note, keep your help center up to date, and check support metrics without leaving the conversation.

Ask for the open high-priority tickets that are still unassigned, pull a customer's full history before you answer them, draft a help center article in every language you support, or compare this month's first response time to last month's. Sales teams can move deals through CRM pipelines, and product teams can search feature requests and survey responses.

Connecting takes a single sign-in: authorize with your Gleap account, choose the project ChatGPT may access, and you are set. Every action runs with your own Gleap permissions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a84539026a88191aa8c1db7.longDescriptionZh:
Gleap 将您的客户支持工作区带入 ChatGPT。搜索和分类票证、查找联系人和公司、回复客户或添加内部注释、使您的帮助中心保持最新状态，以及在不离开对话的情况下检查支持指标。

请求尚未分配的开放高优先级票证，在回答客户之前提取客户的完整历史记录，用您支持的每种语言起草帮助中心文章，或者将本月的首次响应时间与上个月的第一次响应时间进行比较。销售团队可以通过 CRM 管道转移交易，产品团队可以搜索功能请求和调查响应。

连接需要单点登录：使用您的 Gleap 帐户授权，选择 ChatGPT 可以访问的项目，然后就完成了。每个操作都以您自己的 Gleap 权限运行。
defaultPrompts: Show me the open high-priority tickets nobody is assigned to
Summarise the tickets that came in this week
What was our average first response time last month?

上个月我们的平均首次回复时间是多少？

plugin_asdk_app_6a03a3be33648191aef497e7.productIntroEn: With this app, you can consult your campaigns, create new communications, schedule deliveries, read statistics, and work with your account data more quickly and easily. ChatGPT can help you transform simple requests into operational actions, such as preparing a campaign, checking the status of a delivery, or analyzing performance.
plugin_asdk_app_6a03a3be33648191aef497e7.longDescription:
With this app, you can consult your campaigns, create new communications, schedule deliveries, read statistics, and work with your account data more quickly and easily. ChatGPT can help you transform simple requests into operational actions, such as preparing a campaign, checking the status of a delivery, or analyzing performance.

MailSenpai Cold is designed for marketing teams, agencies, and companies looking to reduce manual work and gain more immediate access to the key features of their email platform. Sensitive actions, such as sending or unsubscribing, respect the permissions configured in the account and may require explicit confirmation before being executed.

With MailSenpai Cold, you can use ChatGPT as an operational assistant to better manage your email marketing, maintaining control over your account settings, permissions, and data.
plugin_asdk_app_6a03a3be33648191aef497e7.longDescriptionZh:
借助此应用程序，您可以更快速、更轻松地咨询您的营销活动、创建新的通信、安排交付、读取统计数据以及处理您的帐户数据。 ChatGPT 可以帮助您将简单的请求转化为操作操作，例如准备活动、检查交付状态或分析绩效。

MailSenpai Cold 专为希望减少手动工作并更直接地访问其电子邮件平台的关键功能的营销团队、代理机构和公司而设计。敏感操作（例如发送或取消订阅）尊重帐户中配置的权限，并且在执行之前可能需要明确确认。

借助 MailSenpai Cold，您可以使用 ChatGPT 作为操作助手，更好地管理您的电子邮件营销，保持对帐户设置、权限和数据的控制。

plugin_asdk_app_69cdd011ebf481919fa1698d.productIntro: Spinify 将您的销售竞争数据直接导入 ChatGPT。询问您当前的排名，查看任何活跃比赛的实时排行榜，并准确了解您的表现趋势 - 所有这些都无需离开聊天室。
plugin_asdk_app_69cdd011ebf481919fa1698d.productIntroEn: Spinify brings your sales competition data directly into ChatGPT. Ask for your current standings, see a live leaderboard for any active competition, and understand exactly how your performance is trending — all without leaving the chat.
plugin_asdk_app_69cdd011ebf481919fa1698d.longDescription:
Spinify brings your sales competition data directly into ChatGPT. Ask for your current standings, see a live leaderboard for any active competition, and understand exactly how your performance is trending — all without leaving the chat.

For sales managers and admins, Spinify gives you an instant view across your whole team. Run a coaching report for any competition to see who's on track, who's at risk, and where to focus your attention. Every result includes direct links back to Spinify so you can act immediately.

What you can ask:
- "Show me the leaderboard for [competition name]"
- "How is my score trending this month?"
- "Show me a coaching report for the Revenue Rumble competition"
- "What competitions am I currently in?"
*Your Spinify account is required. Player and Admin license tiers are both supported.
plugin_asdk_app_69cdd011ebf481919fa1698d.longDescriptionZh:
Spinify 将您的销售竞争数据直接导入 ChatGPT。询问您当前的排名，查看任何活跃比赛的实时排行榜，并准确了解您的表现趋势 - 所有这些都无需离开聊天室。

对于销售经理和管理员来说，Spinify 可以让您即时查看整个团队。为任何比赛制作一份教练报告，看看谁在正轨、谁有风险以及您的注意力应该集中在哪里。每个结果都包含返回 Spinify 的直接链接，以便您可以立即采取行动。

你可以问什么：
- “显示[比赛名称]的排行榜”
- “这个月我的分数趋势如何？”
- “给我看一份 Revenue Rumble 比赛的教练报告”

*需要您的 Spinify 帐户。玩家和管理员许可证层均受支持。

plugin_asdk_app_6a79804c02b881918c6e6cb3.description: 加载 Google 商家资料
plugin_asdk_app_6a79804c02b881918c6e6cb3.productIntro: Windsor.ai Google Business Profile 将您的 Google Business Profile 数据连接到您的 AI 助手，以便您可以分析本地表现并用简单的英语管理您的列表。发现连接的位置，检查有效字段和选项，以及查询视图、搜索、呼叫、指示请求以及查看任何日期范围内的指标。确认后，它还可以发布或更新帖子、回复评论、上传照片、更新业务信息以及设置常规、特殊或开放和关闭时间。
plugin_asdk_app_6a79804c02b881918c6e6cb3.productIntroEn: Windsor.ai Google Business Profile connects your Google Business Profile data to your AI assistant, so you can analyze local performance and manage your listing in plain English. Discover connected locations, inspect valid fields and options, and query views, searches, calls, direction requests, and review metrics over any date range.
plugin_asdk_app_6a79804c02b881918c6e6cb3.longDescription:
Windsor.ai Google Business Profile connects your Google Business Profile data to your AI assistant, so you can analyze local performance and manage your listing in plain English. Discover connected locations, inspect valid fields and options, and query views, searches, calls, direction requests, and review metrics over any date range. On confirmation, it can also publish or update posts, reply to reviews, upload photos, update business info, and set regular, special, or open and closed hours.

Common workflows:
- See how customers found your business in the last 30 days
- Reply to a recent review, after you confirm the wording
- Publish a post or update your opening hours

Changes to your listing are made only after you confirm the specific action; everything else is read-only. Free plan available, no credit card required.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
plugin_asdk_app_6a79804c02b881918c6e6cb3.longDescriptionZh:
Windsor.ai Google Business Profile 将您的 Google Business Profile 数据连接到您的 AI 助手，以便您可以分析本地表现并用简单的英语管理您的列表。发现连接的位置，检查有效字段和选项，以及查询视图、搜索、呼叫、指示请求以及查看任何日期范围内的指标。确认后，它还可以发布或更新帖子、回复评论、上传照片、更新业务信息以及设置常规、特殊或开放和关闭时间。

常见工作流程：
- 查看过去 30 天内客户如何找到您的企业
- 确认措辞后回复最近的评论
- 发布帖子或更新您的营业时间

仅在您确认具体操作后才会对您的列表进行更改；其他一切都是只读的。提供免费计划，无需信用卡。

Windsor.ai 是一个独立的产品，不隶属于其所连接的平台，也不受其认可。

plugin_asdk_app_69690af05a74819189e671dc.productIntro: Teamspective 是一个领导力支持平台，可帮助领导者通过参与度调查、反馈和协作见解了解其团队。此应用程序使 ChatGPT 能够访问您的 Teamspective 工作区数据，提供以下方面的个性化见解：
plugin_asdk_app_69690af05a74819189e671dc.productIntroEn: Teamspective is a Leadership Enablement Platform that helps leaders understand their teams through engagement surveys, feedback, and collaboration insights. This app enables ChatGPT to access your Teamspective workspace data, providing personalized insights about:
plugin_asdk_app_69690af05a74819189e671dc.longDescription:
Teamspective is a Leadership Enablement Platform that helps leaders understand their teams through engagement surveys, feedback, and collaboration insights. This app enables ChatGPT to access your Teamspective workspace data, providing personalized insights about:

- Your identity & context: Role, teams, direct reports, and data access permissions
- Engagement results: Survey scores, KPIs (engagement, wellbeing, leadership, DEIB), themes, trends, and AI-interpreted insights with benchmarks
- Feedback summaries: Growth feedback, praise, and performance evaluations you've received or given to direct reports
- Survey comments: Qualitative insights from open-text responses with sentiment analysis

Perfect for preparing 1:1s, understanding team sentiment, identifying areas needing attention, and getting actionable leadership guidance.
plugin_asdk_app_69690af05a74819189e671dc.longDescriptionZh:
Teamspective 是一个领导力支持平台，可帮助领导者通过参与度调查、反馈和协作见解了解其团队。此应用程序使 ChatGPT 能够访问您的 Teamspective 工作区数据，提供以下方面的个性化见解：

- 您的身份和背景：角色、团队、直接下属和数据访问权限
- 敬业度结果：调查分数、KPI（敬业度、幸福感、领导力、DEIB）、主题、趋势以及人工智能解释的基准洞察
- 反馈摘要：您收到或给予直接下属的成长反馈、表扬和绩效评估
- 调查评论：通过情绪分析从开放文本回复中获得定性见解

非常适合准备一对一会议、了解团队情绪、确定需要关注的领域以及获得可行的领导指导。

plugin_asdk_app_6a14183a803c8191be1e856c.productIntro: JobPhoning MCP 以只读关键数据 (KPI)、任务、远程操作员、呼叫状态和 JobPhoning 平台的活动时间表（为订单提供者和远程操作员进行外包电话勘探）的形式显示。
plugin_asdk_app_6a14183a803c8191be1e856c.productIntroEn: Le MCP JobPhoning expose en lecture seule les chiffres clés (KPIs), missions, téléopérateurs, états d'appel et timeline d'activité de la plateforme JobPhoning — prospection téléphonique externalisée pour Donneurs d'Ordres et Téléopérateurs.
plugin_asdk_app_6a14183a803c8191be1e856c.longDescription:
Le MCP JobPhoning expose en lecture seule les chiffres clés (KPIs), missions, téléopérateurs, états d'appel et timeline d'activité de la plateforme JobPhoning — prospection téléphonique externalisée pour Donneurs d'Ordres et Téléopérateurs.

通过 OAuth 与您的 JobPhoneing 凭据连接：每个用户只能看到与其相关的数据。

plugin_asdk_app_6a95a6871f108191b6846e59.name: GETWAB Federal Procurement AI
plugin_asdk_app_6a95a6871f108191b6846e59.productIntro: GETWAB 是一个由人工智能驱动的联邦采购和捕获情报平台，专为联邦承包商、捕获团队和 GovCon 顾问而构建。用简单的英语提出问题，寻找并确定最合适的机会，评估投标/不投标决策、研究机构和市场，识别现任者和竞争对手，并分析历史奖项、分包合同、实体和排除。继续在 GETWAB 平台中进行研究，探索潜在记录、比较市场并制定更深入的捕获策略。
plugin_asdk_app_6a95a6871f108191b6846e59.productIntroEn: GETWAB is an AI-powered federal procurement and capture intelligence platform built for federal contractors, capture teams, and GovCon advisors. Ask questions in plain English to find and qualify best-fit opportunities, assess bid/no-bid decisions, research agencies and markets, identify incumbents and competitors, and analyze historical awards, subcontracts, entities, and exclusions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a95a6871f108191b6846e59.longDescription: GETWAB is an AI-powered federal procurement and capture intelligence platform built for federal contractors, capture teams, and GovCon advisors. Ask questions in plain English to find and qualify best-fit opportunities, assess bid/no-bid decisions, research agencies and markets, identify incumbents and competitors, and analyze historical awards, subcontracts, entities, and exclusions. Continue your research in the GETWAB platform to explore underlying records, compare the market, and build a deeper capture strategy.
plugin_asdk_app_6a95a6871f108191b6846e59.longDescriptionZh: GETWAB 是一个由人工智能驱动的联邦采购和捕获情报平台，专为联邦承包商、捕获团队和 GovCon 顾问而构建。用简单的英语提出问题，寻找并确定最合适的机会，评估投标/不投标决策、研究机构和市场，识别现任者和竞争对手，并分析历史奖项、分包合同、实体和排除。继续在 GETWAB 平台中进行研究，探索潜在记录、比较市场并制定更深入的捕获策略。

plugin_asdk_app_6a34c510354c8191b8a065fa.productIntro: 获取任何位置的供暖和制冷度日 (HDD/CDD) 以及室外温度、基础温度和日期范围 - 直接在聊天中获取，无需电子表格或手动查找。 专为需要快速标准化能源数据的能源经理、顾问和审计员而设计。按城市或坐标询问度日或温度数据，设置您自己的基础温度，并获得可以直接放入节省计算或 M&V 报告中的干净数字。 由 Energy-Data.io 的天气数据引擎提供支持——与专业能源标准化所使用的来源相同。

Get heating and cooling degree days (HDD/CDD) and outside temperatures for any location, base temperature, and date range — straight in chat, no spreadsheets or manual lookups.
Built for energy managers, consultants, and auditors who need to weather-normalize energy data fast. Ask for degree days or temperature data by city or coordinates, set your own base temperature, and get clean numbers you can drop straight into a savings calculation or M&V report.
Backed by Energy-Data.io's weather data engine — the same source used for professional energy normalization.

plugin_asdk_app_6a6cf7506ec88191b19e91e1.name: Magnus
plugin_asdk_app_6a6cf7506ec88191b19e91e1.productIntro: Magnus 是一个面向移动和网络应用程序发行商的分析平台。它将来自广告网络、订阅和应用内收入、广告网络货币化、支付提供商结果和第一方产品分析事件的营销支出聚合到一个地方，因此发布商可以询问广告系列、应用程序或实验的实际执行情况。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6cf7506ec88191b19e91e1.productIntroEn: Magnus is an analytics platform for mobile and web app publishers. It aggregates marketing spend from ad networks, subscription and in-app revenue, ad-network monetization, payment-provider outcomes and first-party product-analytics events into one place, so a publisher can ask how a campaign, an app or an experiment is actually performing.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6cf7506ec88191b19e91e1.longDescription:
Magnus is an analytics platform for mobile and web app publishers. It aggregates marketing spend from ad networks, subscription and in-app revenue, ad-network monetization, payment-provider outcomes and first-party product-analytics events into one place, so a publisher can ask how a campaign, an app or an experiment is actually performing.

Over MCP the app exposes that data read-only. Three tools answer questions: marketing_timeline_report for acquisition and monetization performance (installs, spend, revenue, ROMI, forecasts), finances_risk_report and finances_risk_approval_rates for payment risk (approval rate, refunds, fraud alerts, disputes, chargebacks). A second group answers product-analytics questions from the publisher's own SDK events: event counts, funnels, retention, user-property segments and A/B experiment configuration. Everything else is a lookup helper that exists to feed those tools with real ids, filter values and metric definitions, because app ids, event names and metric semantics are account-specific and cannot be guessed.

Access is scoped to the companies the signed-in user is an active member of, and that membership is re-checked on every single call, so the model can never reach another tenant's data. The OAuth scope the app requests, mcp:analytics.read, grants read access only: no tool in the server can create, update or delete anything.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6cf7506ec88191b19e91e1.longDescriptionZh:
Magnus 是一个面向移动和网络应用程序发行商的分析平台。它将来自广告网络、订阅和应用内收入、广告网络货币化、支付提供商结果和第一方产品分析事件的营销支出聚合到一个地方，因此发布商可以询问广告系列、应用程序或实验的实际执行情况。

通过 MCP，应用程序以只读方式公开该数据。三个工具可以回答问题：marketing_timeline_report 用于获取和货币化绩效（安装、支出、收入、ROMI、预测），finances_risk_report 和 Finances_risk_approval_rates 用于支付风险（批准率、退款、欺诈警报、争议、退款）。第二组回答发布商自己的 SDK 事件中的产品分析问题：事件计数、渠道、留存率、用户属性细分和 A/B 实验配置。其他一切都是一个查找助手，它的存在是为了向这些工具提供真实的 ID、过滤器值和指标定义，因为应用程序 ID、事件名称和指标语义是特定于帐户的并且无法猜测。

访问范围仅限于登录用户所属的公司，并且每次调用都会重新检查该成员资格，因此该模型永远无法访问其他租户的数据。应用程序请求的 OAuth 范围 mcp:analytics.read 仅授予读取访问权限：服务器中的任何工具都无法创建、更新或删除任何内容。

plugin_asdk_app_6a77161fdca48191a4a48bcf.name: Meistron
plugin_asdk_app_6a77161fdca48191a4a48bcf.productIntro: Meistron 是工艺品企业的操作软件。使用人工智能访问，公司将 ChatGPT 与其数据连接起来，并可以查询和维护订单、发票、报价、材料、工作时间和选定的设置。每个区域可设置关闭、读、写权限；外部效果单独释放。 Access 不会触发发送任何信件，不会发出银行详细信息或付款指令，也不会删除任何数据记录。通过电子邮件发送发票还需要两步确认。注册和同意是通过 OAuth 2.1 和 PKCE 完成的。
plugin_asdk_app_6a77161fdca48191a4a48bcf.productIntroEn: Meistron ist die Betriebssoftware für Handwerksbetriebe. Über den KI-Zugang verbindet ein Betrieb ChatGPT mit seinen Daten und kann Aufträge, Rechnungen, Angebote, Material, Arbeitszeiten und ausgewählte Einstellungen abfragen und pflegen. Die Rechte sind je Bereich auf aus, lesen oder schreiben einstellbar; Außenwirkungen werden separat freigegeben.
plugin_asdk_app_6a77161fdca48191a4a48bcf.longDescription: Meistron ist die Betriebssoftware für Handwerksbetriebe. Über den KI-Zugang verbindet ein Betrieb ChatGPT mit seinen Daten und kann Aufträge, Rechnungen, Angebote, Material, Arbeitszeiten und ausgewählte Einstellungen abfragen und pflegen. Die Rechte sind je Bereich auf aus, lesen oder schreiben einstellbar; Außenwirkungen werden separat freigegeben. Der Zugang löst keinen Briefversand aus, gibt keine Bankverbindung oder Zahlungsanweisung aus und löscht keine Datensätze. Der Rechnungsversand per E-Mail verlangt zusätzlich eine Zwei-Schritt-Bestätigung. Anmeldung und Zustimmung erfolgen über OAuth 2.1 mit PKCE.

plugin_asdk_app_6a25e53c4a1c8191bc59f203.description: SEO + AI 在聊天中的可见性
plugin_asdk_app_6a25e53c4a1c8191bc59f203.productIntro: 将您的整个 SEO 堆栈引入 ChatGPT。 SEOcrawl AI 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的实时 SEO 数据：Google Search Console 性能（点击次数、展示次数、点击率、排名）、GA4 分析（包括您从 AI 助手收到的流量）以及 SEOcrawl 的 AI 跟踪器，该跟踪器可监控您的品牌在 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 和 Perplexity 上的出现和引用情况。
plugin_asdk_app_6a25e53c4a1c8191bc59f203.productIntroEn: Bring your whole SEO stack into ChatGPT. SEOcrawl AI connects ChatGPT to your live SEO data: Google Search Console performance (clicks, impressions, CTR, positions), GA4 analytics including the traffic you receive from AI assistants, and SEOcrawl's AI Tracker, which monitors how your brand appears and gets cited across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity.
plugin_asdk_app_6a25e53c4a1c8191bc59f203.longDescription: Bring your whole SEO stack into ChatGPT. SEOcrawl AI connects ChatGPT to your live SEO data: Google Search Console performance (clicks, impressions, CTR, positions), GA4 analytics including the traffic you receive from AI assistants, and SEOcrawl's AI Tracker, which monitors how your brand appears and gets cited across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity. Compare date ranges, surface winning and losing keywords and pages, drill into any URL or query, and explore your site with advanced filters. Then act on insights without leaving the chat: create and update SEO tasks, add comments, manage tags and tag rules, save Smart Views and log annotations. 43 tools on a hosted, secure OAuth connector — part of the SEOcrawl SEO + GEO platform (https://seocrawl.ai/mcp).

plugin_asdk_app_6a3261b7cdfc81919a864e7a.name: Sponja
plugin_asdk_app_6a3261b7cdfc81919a864e7a.description: 将网络研讨会变成管道
plugin_asdk_app_6a3261b7cdfc81919a864e7a.productIntro: Sponja 将您的代表为您的特定交易准备的提案、定价、演示记录和安全文档直接连接到 ChatGPT。询问任何有关您的评估的问题，并仅从这些材料中获得答案，并且每次都会引用来源。当某些内容未涵盖时，Sponja 会告诉您而不是猜测，并提出为您的代表标记它。您还可以询问有关 Sponja 如何工作的一般问题。每个连接器都通过安全登录仅限于一位买家和一笔交易，因此您只能看到自己的材料。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3261b7cdfc81919a864e7a.productIntroEn: Sponja connects the proposal, pricing, demo recording, and security documents your rep prepared for your specific deal directly to ChatGPT. Ask anything about your evaluation and get answers drawn only from those materials, with the source cited every time. When something is not covered, Sponja tells you instead of guessing and offers to flag it for your rep.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3261b7cdfc81919a864e7a.longDescription: Sponja connects the proposal, pricing, demo recording, and security documents your rep prepared for your specific deal directly to ChatGPT. Ask anything about your evaluation and get answers drawn only from those materials, with the source cited every time. When something is not covered, Sponja tells you instead of guessing and offers to flag it for your rep. You can also ask general questions about how Sponja works. Each connector is scoped to one buyer and one deal through a secure sign-in, so you only ever see your own materials. The first time you connect, a welcome card shows your deal snapshot and a few suggested questions, so you know right away what you can ask.

plugin_asdk_app_6a84b1b40d3481919f11600f.productIntro: Patlytics 将概念级、人工智能原生专利搜索带入您的助手中：语义搜索，而不是基于关键字的搜索。用简单的散文描述一项发明，获取最相关的专利，查找任何专利的权利要求，搜索科学文献，并提取您自己组织保存的专利，所有这些都通过结构化、可预测的工具（而不是黑匣子）实现。
plugin_asdk_app_6a84b1b40d3481919f11600f.productIntroEn: Patlytics brings concept-level, AI-native patent search into your assistant: semantic, not keyword-based. Describe an invention in plain prose and get the most relevant patents, look up any patent's claims, search the scientific literature, and pull your own organization's saved patents, all through structured, predictable tools (not a black box).
plugin_asdk_app_6a84b1b40d3481919f11600f.longDescription:
Patlytics brings concept-level, AI-native patent search into your assistant: semantic, not keyword-based. Describe an invention in plain prose and get the most relevant patents, look up any patent's claims, search the scientific literature, and pull your own organization's saved patents, all through structured, predictable tools (not a black box).


The five tools are read-only: semantic patent search (optionally anchored to a reference patent), patent lookup (bibliographic data and full claims), non-patent literature search (via OpenAlex), and listings of your organization's private portfolios and vault. Search is semantic, so a richer description (how an invention works, the problem it solves, its components) returns better results.


Access is for existing Patlytics users: each member signs in with their own account (OAuth), and results are scoped to their organization. Deeper work like freedom-to-operate opinions, infringement and invalidity claim charts, and patent drafting runs in the Patlytics web app, linked from every result.
plugin_asdk_app_6a84b1b40d3481919f11600f.longDescriptionZh:
Patlytics 将概念级、人工智能原生专利搜索带入您的助手中：语义搜索，而不是基于关键字的搜索。用简单的散文描述一项发明，获取最相关的专利，查找任何专利的权利要求，搜索科学文献，并提取您自己组织保存的专利，所有这些都通过结构化、可预测的工具（而不是黑匣子）实现。


这五个工具是只读的：语义专利检索（可选择锚定到参考专利）、专利查找（书目数据和完整权利要求）、非专利文献检索（通过 OpenAlex）以及组织的私人专利组合和库列表。搜索是语义的，因此更丰富的描述（发明如何工作、它解决的问题、其组成部分）会返回更好的结果。


访问权限适用于现有 Patlytics 用户：每个成员使用自己的帐户 (OAuth) 登录，结果仅限于其组织。诸如自由操作意见、侵权和无效索赔图表以及专利起草等更深层次的工作在 Patlytics 网络应用程序中运行，并与每个结果相关联。

plugin_asdk_app_6a81bc5a01608191ae2ff2e7.productIntro: Inntally是酒吧、餐馆和酒店背后的运营平台。该插件可让您询问有关您自己场地的问题，并从现场记录而不是估计中获得答案。
plugin_asdk_app_6a81bc5a01608191ae2ff2e7.productIntroEn: Inntally is the operations platform behind bars, restaurants and hotels. This plugin lets you ask questions about your own venue and get answers from live records rather than estimates.
plugin_asdk_app_6a81bc5a01608191ae2ff2e7.longDescription:
Inntally is the operations platform behind bars, restaurants and hotels. This plugin lets you ask questions about your own venue and get answers from live records rather than estimates.

Ask what stock is running low, which suppliers changed their prices, how many covers are booked for Saturday, what a recipe costs to make, or how last month's profit and loss looks — and get figures straight from your Inntally account.

Access is read-only. The plugin can investigate, compare and help you draft, but it cannot change stock, place orders, alter bookings or post to your accounts. Those stay in Inntally, where they are approved and audited. It only ever reads the venues your own Inntally permissions cover, and if those change, so does what it can see. Guest phone numbers and booking notes are never shared.

You will need an Inntally account to connect.
plugin_asdk_app_6a81bc5a01608191ae2ff2e7.longDescriptionZh:
Inntally是酒吧、餐馆和酒店背后的运营平台。该插件可让您询问有关您自己场地的问题，并从现场记录而不是估计中获得答案。

询问哪些库存不足、哪些供应商改变了价格、周六预订了多少封面、制作食谱的成本是多少，或者上个月的损益情况如何——并直接从您的 Inntally 帐户中获取数据。

访问权限为只读。该插件可以调查、比较并帮助您起草，但它不能更改库存、下订单、更改预订或发布到您的帐户。这些留在 Inntally，在那里接受批准和审核。它只会读取您自己的内部权限所覆盖的场所，如果这些场所发生变化，它能看到的内容也会发生变化。客人的电话号码和预订说明绝不会被泄露。

您需要一个 Inntally 帐户才能连接。
defaultPrompts: What's running low in stock?
How many covers are booked this Saturday?
How did last month's profit and loss look?
defaultPromptsZh: 什么东西库存不足？
本周六预订了多少封面？
上个月的损益情况如何？

plugin_asdk_app_6a8868f97220819184b8720e.name: Semji
plugin_asdk_app_6a8868f97220819184b8720e.description: 规划和评分 SEO 内容
plugin_asdk_app_6a8868f97220819184b8720e.productIntro: Semji 是一个面向营销团队的内容平台。该应用程序可以访问用户已经所属的 Semji 工作区，因此可以在对话中驱动编辑管道：使用与应用程序相同的过滤器浏览内容管道，从标题和焦点关键字批量添加草稿到规划中，运行 SEO 和 GEO 关键字分析，并读取每个表面的键入建议（Google 搜索、Google AI 概述、ChatGPT）生成的内容得分。可选的人工智能起草功能是可用的，并且总是首先进入审查状态，因此在没有明确确认的情况下不会将任何内容写入草稿。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8868f97220819184b8720e.productIntroEn: Semji is a content platform for marketing teams. This app gives access to the Semji workspaces a user already belongs to, so an editorial pipeline can be driven in conversation: browse the content pipeline with the same filters as the app, add drafts to the planning in bulk from titles and focus keywords, run SEO and GEO keyword analyses, and read the resulting Content Score with typed r…
plugin_asdk_app_6a8868f97220819184b8720e.longDescription: Semji is a content platform for marketing teams. This app gives access to the Semji workspaces a user already belongs to, so an editorial pipeline can be driven in conversation: browse the content pipeline with the same filters as the app, add drafts to the planning in bulk from titles and focus keywords, run SEO and GEO keyword analyses, and read the resulting Content Score with typed recommendations per surface (Google Search, Google AI Overview, ChatGPT). Optional AI drafting is available and always lands in a review state first, so nothing is written to a draft without an explicit confirmation. Access follows the user's own Semji permissions: they reach only the workspaces their account already has, with the role they already hold there, and every call is authorised server-side against the organization their token belongs to.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8868f97220819184b8720e.longDescriptionZh: Semji 是一个面向营销团队的内容平台。该应用程序可以访问用户已经所属的 Semji 工作区，因此可以在对话中驱动编辑管道：使用与应用程序相同的过滤器浏览内容管道，从标题和焦点关键字批量添加草稿到规划中，运行 SEO 和 GEO 关键字分析，并读取每个表面的键入建议（Google 搜索、Google AI 概述、ChatGPT）生成的内容得分。可选的人工智能起草功能是可用的，并且总是首先进入审查状态，因此在没有明确确认的情况下不会将任何内容写入草稿。访问遵循用户自己的 Semji 权限：他们只能访问其帐户已拥有的工作区以及他们已在其中担任的角色，并且每个调用都在服务器端针对其令牌所属的组织进行授权。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9d4f410b908191a43c5d18.name: Nowlun Tracking
plugin_asdk_app_6a9d4f410b908191a43c5d18.productIntro: Nowlun 将提单转变为实时装运视图。上传文档，或仅粘贴提单号、预订号或集装箱号，然后在聊天中获取当前状态。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9d4f410b908191a43c5d18.productIntroEn: Nowlun turns a Bill of Lading into a live shipment view. Upload the document, or just paste a BL, booking, or container number, and get the current status back in the chat.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9d4f410b908191a43c5d18.longDescription:
Nowlun turns a Bill of Lading into a live shipment view. Upload the document, or just paste a BL, booking, or container number, and get the current status back in the chat.

Beyond tracking identifiers, it reads the full contents of the BL — shipper and consignee, notify party, cargo description, container numbers and sizes, ports of loading and discharge, vessel and voyage, and commercial terms. So instead of retyping details from a PDF into a portal, you can ask questions about the document directly.

Once the shipment is identified, you get:

Current status and last known milestone
Vessel, voyage, and carrier details
ETD and ETA, with schedule changes when the carrier updates them
Container-level breakdown for multi-container shipments
An interactive map showing the route and where the vessel is now

Useful for freight forwarders, importers and exporters, and anyone who handles shipping documents and wants an answer without logging into three carrier websites.

Nowlun is a digital freight forwarding platform covering sea freight, air cargo, customs clearance, and inland trucking. No account is required to track a shipment.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9d4f410b908191a43c5d18.longDescriptionZh:
Nowlun 将提单转变为实时装运视图。上传文档，或仅粘贴提单号、预订号或集装箱号，然后在聊天中获取当前状态。

除了跟踪标识符之外，它还读取提单的全部内容——托运人和收货人、通知方、货物描述、集装箱数量和尺寸、装货港和卸货港、船舶和航程以及商业条款。因此，您可以直接询问有关文档的问题，而无需将 PDF 中的详细信息重新输入到门户中。

一旦货物被识别，您将获得：

当前状态和最后已知的里程碑
船舶、航次和承运人详细信息
ETD 和 ETA，当承运商更新时时间表会发生变化
多集装箱运输的集装箱级别细分
显示航线和船只当前位置的交互式地图

对于货运代理、进口商和出口商以及任何处理货运单据并希望在不登录三个承运商网站的情况下获得答案的人很有用。

Nowlun是一个涵盖海运、空运、清关、内陆卡车运输的数字化货运代理平台。无需帐户即可跟踪货件。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa06c4c57508191afa23e90.name: BetterMenu
plugin_asdk_app_6aa06c4c57508191afa23e90.description: 根据食谱构建 FDA 标签
plugin_asdk_app_6aa06c4c57508191afa23e90.productIntro: BetterMenu 将配方配方、营养分析和 FDA 标签保留在一个版本系统中，因此在开发结束时合规性不再是一个单独的项目。
plugin_asdk_app_6aa06c4c57508191afa23e90.productIntroEn: BetterMenu keeps recipe formulation, nutrition analysis and FDA labeling in one versioned system, so compliance stops being a separate project at the end of development.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa06c4c57508191afa23e90.longDescription:
BetterMenu keeps recipe formulation, nutrition analysis and FDA labeling in one versioned system, so compliance stops being a separate project at the end of development.

Search standard and branded ingredients, resolve kitchen measures to gram weights, and calculate per-serving and per-container nutrition against the FDA reference values in 21 CFR 101. Add custom ingredients with your own nutrition data, set serving sizes, and export the Nutrition Facts label.

Every recipe is versioned: reformulate freely, then see which ingredient change moved which nutrient, and which version any given label came from. Values carry their source, so you can answer where a number came from without reconstructing it.

For food manufacturers, co-packers, and R&D and regulatory teams working on packaged food sold in the United States.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa06c4c57508191afa23e90.longDescriptionZh:
BetterMenu 将配方配方、营养分析和 FDA 标签保留在一个版本系统中，因此在开发结束时合规性不再是一个单独的项目。

搜索标准和品牌成分，将厨房测量结果解析为克重，并根据 21 CFR 101 中的 FDA 参考值计算每份和每个容器的营养成分。使用您自己的营养数据添加自定义成分，设置份量，并导出营养成分标签。

每个食谱都有版本：自由地重新配制，然后查看哪种成分的变化改变了哪种营养素，以及任何给定标签来自哪个版本。值带有其来源，因此您可以回答数字的来源，而无需重建它。

适用于在美国销售的包装食品的食品制造商、联合包装商以及研发和监管团队。

plugin_asdk_app_6a96c88693588191aaaaccd1.name: Dcipher Analytics
plugin_asdk_app_6a96c88693588191aaaaccd1.productIntro: Dcipher 是一个研究和分析平台，可收集大量外部内容（网络、新闻、社交媒体、您自己的文件）并将其转换为结构化、可分析的数据。此连接器使 ChatGPT 能够访问您的 Dcipher 工作区，因此您可以在对话中使用整个平台。
plugin_asdk_app_6a96c88693588191aaaaccd1.productIntroEn: Dcipher is a research and analytics platform that collects large volumes of external content — web, news, social media, your own files — and turns it into structured, analyzable data. This connector gives ChatGPT access to your Dcipher workspace, so you can work through the whole platform in conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a96c88693588191aaaaccd1.longDescription:
Dcipher is a research and analytics platform that collects large volumes of external content — web, news, social media, your own files — and turns it into structured, analyzable data. This connector gives ChatGPT access to your Dcipher workspace, so you can work through the whole platform in conversation.

ChatGPT can run research agents, build and manage knowledge bases, search them and answer questions with references back to source documents, and set up Insight Boosters, Dcipher's insight and foresight analytics engine. It can produce content landscapes, trend radar charts, comparison matrices, scenario analysis views and write reports from your sources, and schedule workflows so everything stays current.

You describe what you want to know. ChatGPT figures out which parts of Dcipher get you there — whether that means collecting new material, querying what you already have, or building a dashboard on top of it.
plugin_asdk_app_6a96c88693588191aaaaccd1.longDescriptionZh:
Dcipher 是一个研究和分析平台，可收集大量外部内容（网络、新闻、社交媒体、您自己的文件）并将其转换为结构化、可分析的数据。此连接器使 ChatGPT 能够访问您的 Dcipher 工作区，因此您可以在对话中使用整个平台。

ChatGPT 可以运行研究代理、构建和管理知识库、搜索知识库并通过引用源文档回答问题，并设置 Insight Booster、Dcipher 的洞察力和预见性分析引擎。它可以生成内容景观、趋势雷达图、比较矩阵、场景分析视图并根据来源编写报告，并安排工作流程，使一切保持最新状态。

您描述您想知道的内容。 ChatGPT 找出 Dcipher 的哪些部分可以帮助您实现这一目标 - 无论这意味着收集新材料、查询您已有的材料，还是在其之上构建仪表板。
defaultPrompts: Set up a research agent tracking solid-state battery developments across news and social media over the past 12 months.
Create a content landscape of my battery knowledge base, then show me which themes grew fastest over the last two quarters.
Schedule this workflow weekly and update the report each time new material comes in.

每周安排此工作流程，并在每次新材料出现时更新报告。

plugin_asdk_app_6a631f1b9dc88191a576ad6f.name: CE Cosmos Deep Dive
plugin_asdk_app_6a631f1b9dc88191a576ad6f.description: 精细访问 CE 数据
plugin_asdk_app_6a631f1b9dc88191a576ad6f.productIntro: Cosmos 将 Consumer Edge 的交易数据直接引入 ChatGPT。用简单的英语提出问题，并根据来自数百万张美国信用卡和借记卡的近实时支出数据（涵盖数千个品牌和商家）获得分析师级答案 - 比公司报告提前几周。直接使用交易级数据来构建自定义群组、运行价格点分析并回答聚合无法回答的问题。
plugin_asdk_app_6a631f1b9dc88191a576ad6f.productIntroEn: Cosmos brings Consumer Edge's transaction data directly into ChatGPT. Ask questions in plain English and get analyst-grade answers built on near-real-time spend data from millions of US credit and debit cards, covering thousands of brands and merchants — weeks ahead of company reporting.
plugin_asdk_app_6a631f1b9dc88191a576ad6f.longDescription:
Cosmos brings Consumer Edge's transaction data directly into ChatGPT. Ask questions in plain English and get analyst-grade answers built on near-real-time spend data from millions of US credit and debit cards, covering thousands of brands and merchants — weeks ahead of company reporting. Work directly with transaction-level data to build custom cohorts, run price-point analyses, and answer questions aggregates can't.

Each question runs through Cosmos, Consumer Edge's AI analytics engine, which selects the right metrics, handles panel weighting and merchant hierarchies, and returns a structured summary with the underlying data. Results come back as queryable tables, so ChatGPT can run follow-up analysis, calculate custom metrics, or build charts without re-querying.


Key features:

Natural language querying — no SQL or schema knowledge required; ask about brands, tickers, or merchant groups directly

Full KPI coverage — spend, transactions, average ticket, unique shoppers, visit frequency, and new customer acquisition

Demographic and cohort breakdowns — segment any brand's performance by customer income cohort

Flexible time grains — daily, monthly, or quarterly trends, including quarter-to-date reads on partial periods

Analyst-ready output — answers flag accelerations, decelerations, calendar shifts, and partial-month caveats automatically

Use it to:

Track brand performance ahead of earnings — monthly and quarter-to-date spend growth versus prior periods

Run competitive benchmarking — compare KPIs and market share shifts across any set of brands

Analyze customer behavior — see where new customer growth comes from and whether cohorts are trading down

Spot inflection points — decompose month-over-month changes into customer count, frequency, and ticket drivers

Requires a Consumer Edge subscription with MCP access enabled.
plugin_asdk_app_6a631f1b9dc88191a576ad6f.longDescriptionZh:
Cosmos 将 Consumer Edge 的交易数据直接引入 ChatGPT。用简单的英语提出问题，并根据来自数百万张美国信用卡和借记卡的近实时支出数据（涵盖数千个品牌和商家）获得分析师级答案 - 比公司报告提前几周。直接使用交易级数据来构建自定义群组、运行价格点分析并回答聚合无法回答的问题。

每个问题都通过 Consumer Edge 的人工智能分析引擎 Cosmos 运行，该引擎会选择正确的指标、处理面板权重和商家层次结构，并返回包含基础数据的结构化摘要。结果以可查询表的形式返回，因此 ChatGPT 可以运行后续分析、计算自定义指标或构建图表，而无需重新查询。


主要特点：

自然语言查询——无需 SQL 或模式知识；直接询问品牌、股票代码或商家群体

全面的 KPI 覆盖——支出、交易、平均门票、独特购物者、访问频率和新客户获取

人口统计和群体细分——按客户收入群体对任何品牌的表现进行细分

灵活的时间粒度——每日、每月或每季度趋势，包括部分周期的季度至今读数

分析师就绪的输出 - 自动回答标记加速、减速、日历变化和部分月份的警告

用它来：

在盈利之前跟踪品牌表现——与前期相比的月度和季度至今的支出增长

运行竞争性基准测试 - 比较任何品牌组的 KPI 和市场份额变化

分析客户行为——了解新客户增长来自何处以及客户群体是否正在下降

拐点点——将逐月变化分解为客户数量、频率和票务驱动因素

需要启用 MCP 访问的消费者边缘订阅。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7ccad6e7dc81918d0a4c9f.productIntro: Easy BeeZy 让美容专业人士的一天井井有条。查看今天的日程安排，查找空闲时段，查找客户和您提供的服务，然后预约或将其移至其他时间 - 无需离开聊天室。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ccad6e7dc81918d0a4c9f.productIntroEn: Easy BeeZy keeps a beauty professional's day in order. Check today's schedule, find free slots, look up a client and the services you offer, then book an appointment or move it to another time — without leaving the chat.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ccad6e7dc81918d0a4c9f.longDescription:
Easy BeeZy keeps a beauty professional's day in order. Check today's schedule, find free slots, look up a client and the services you offer, then book an appointment or move it to another time — without leaving the chat.

It works on the same calendar as the Easy BeeZy mobile app, so anything you do here appears on your phone straight away.

Cancelling an appointment is deliberately left out: a cancelled visit is a real person who will not be called back, so that stays in the app.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ccad6e7dc81918d0a4c9f.longDescriptionZh:
Easy BeeZy 让美容专业人士的一天井井有条。查看今天的日程安排，查找空闲时段，查找客户和您提供的服务，然后预约或将其移至其他时间 - 无需离开聊天室。

它与 Easy BeeZy 移动应用程序使用相同的日历，因此您在此处执行的任何操作都会立即显示在您的手机上。

故意省略取消预约：取消的访问是真实的人，不会被回电，因此会保留在应用程序中。

Find a free 90-minute slot this week
Book Anna for a manicure tomorrow at 2pm

plugin_asdk_app_69c508cb54088191b45c164c.longDescription:
EquipDash connects your rental business to ChatGPT. Manage bookings, check product availability, process payments, track inventory, and generate revenue reports — all through conversation.                                                                                         
                                                                                                                                               
Use it to:                                                                                                                                   
  - Create and manage bookings for rental products and experiences                                                                             
  - Check availability and calculate pricing for any date range   
  - View revenue summaries, booking trends, and top customers                                                                                  
  - Track inventory levels and get low-stock alerts                                                                                            
  - Manage staff schedules and shifts                                                                                                          
  - Send payment links, process refunds, and apply promo codes                                                                                 
  - Look up customers and their booking history

123 tools across bookings, products, experiences, customers, payments, staff, inventory, promotions, reporting, and more. Connects securely via OAuth — just authorize your EquipDash account to get started.
plugin_asdk_app_69c508cb54088191b45c164c.longDescriptionZh:
EquipDash 将您的租赁业务连接到 ChatGPT。管理预订、检查产品可用性、处理付款、跟踪库存并生成收入报告——所有这些都通过对话进行。

123 个工具，涉及预订、产品、体验、客户、付款、员工、库存、促销、报告等。通过 OAuth 安全连接 — 只需授权您的 EquipDash 帐户即可开始。

AgencyAnalytics is the only reporting and insights platform built for marketing agencies — and now it works directly inside ChatGPT. No login, no export, no digging through dashboards. Data comes straight from your connected integrations, so it's always accurate and up to date.

Your existing AgencyAnalytics permissions carry over automatically, so every team member only sees the clients they're supposed to. Setup takes under 60 seconds with no installation required.

plugin_asdk_app_6a4dbbf0f6348191b97cbb88.name: Sellerise
plugin_asdk_app_6a4dbbf0f6348191b97cbb88.productIntro: Sellerise 将您的亚马逊业务数据引入 ChatGPT - 清晰、结构化且易于分析。
plugin_asdk_app_6a4dbbf0f6348191b97cbb88.productIntroEn: Sellerise brings your Amazon business data into ChatGPT - clear, structured, and ready to analyze.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4dbbf0f6348191b97cbb88.longDescription:
Sellerise brings your Amazon business data into ChatGPT - clear, structured, and ready to analyze.

Connect your Sellerise account to ask questions about sales, profit, advertising, inventory, keyword rankings, Amazon Search Query Performance, reviews, reimbursements, payouts, Subscribe & Save, and overall account performance.

Get fast answers without digging through dashboards: compare periods, spot profit leaks, find inefficient ad spend, identify stock risks, and see which products, campaigns, keywords, or search terms need attention.

Use it to understand what changed, what is driving performance, and where your Amazon business may be losing money or missing opportunities.

Sellerise uses read-only access to your Amazon business data, so you can analyze performance and make better-informed decisions without modifying your account. Sellerise is Amazon ToS-compliant, helping you analyze and understand your business while staying aligned with Amazon’s rules.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4dbbf0f6348191b97cbb88.longDescriptionZh:
Sellerise 将您的亚马逊业务数据引入 ChatGPT - 清晰、结构化且易于分析。

连接您的 Sellerise 帐户，询问有关销售、利润、广告、库存、关键字排名、亚马逊搜索查询性能、评论、报销、付款、订阅和保存以及整体帐户性能的问题。

无需深入分析仪表板即可快速获得答案：比较期间、发现利润泄漏、发现低效的广告支出、识别股票风险，以及查看哪些产品、营销活动、关键字或搜索词需要关注。

使用它来了解发生了什么变化、什么推动了绩效，以及您的亚马逊业务可能在哪些方面亏损或错失机会。

Sellerise 对您的亚马逊业务数据进行只读访问，因此您可以分析绩效并做出更明智的决策，而无需修改您的帐户。 Sellerise 符合 Amazon ToS 要求，可帮助您分析和了解您的业务，同时遵守 Amazon 的规则。
defaultPrompts: Compare my Amazon performance for the last 30 days vs. the prior 30 days and recommend my top three actions
Find the products hurting profit most, explain why using sales, PPC, inventory, reviews, and keyword data, and suggest fixes.
Audit my PPC for wasted spend, high ACoS, search-term opportunities, and negative-keyword candidates. Prioritize the fixes.
defaultPromptsZh: 比较我在过去 30 天与之前 30 天的亚马逊表现，并推荐我的前三项行动
找到对利润影响最大的产品，解释为什么使用销售、PPC、库存、评论和关键字数据，并提出修复建议。
审核我的 PPC 是否存在浪费的支出、高 ACoS、搜索词机会和否定关键字候选者。确定修复的优先顺序。

plugin_asdk_app_6a914a0cdf9481919be3610f.productIntro: Brainerce 将由 Brainerce 提供支持的在线商店连接到 ChatGPT，这样您就可以在对话中运行它，而无需点击仪表板。检查库存、查找和更新产品、查看和履行订单、发放和管理折扣代码、查找客户以及编辑店面内容。
plugin_asdk_app_6a914a0cdf9481919be3610f.productIntroEn: Brainerce connects your Brainerce-powered online store to ChatGPT so you can run it in conversation instead of clicking through a dashboard. Check what is in stock, look up and update products, review and fulfil orders, issue and manage discount codes, find customers, and edit storefront content.
plugin_asdk_app_6a914a0cdf9481919be3610f.longDescription:
Brainerce connects your Brainerce-powered online store to ChatGPT so you can run it in conversation instead of clicking through a dashboard. Check what is in stock, look up and update products, review and fulfil orders, issue and manage discount codes, find customers, and edit storefront content.

The connection is bound to a single store and to the permissions you grant when you sign in. An assistant given read-only access cannot change anything, and it can never reach another merchant's store. Actions that modify or delete data are marked as such, so ChatGPT asks before running them.

This app manages catalogues of physical goods. It does not sell digital products or subscriptions, and it does not process payments or transfer funds through ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a914a0cdf9481919be3610f.longDescriptionZh:
Brainerce 将由 Brainerce 提供支持的在线商店连接到 ChatGPT，这样您就可以在对话中运行它，而无需点击仪表板。检查库存、查找和更新产品、查看和履行订单、发放和管理折扣代码、查找客户以及编辑店面内容。

该连接绑定到单个商店以及您登录时授予的权限。授予只读访问权限的助手无法更改任何内容，也永远无法到达其他商家的商店。修改或删除数据的操作会被标记为此类，因此 ChatGPT 在运行它们之前会询问。

该应用程序管理实物商品的目录。它不销售数字产品或订阅，也不通过 ChatGPT 处理付款或转移资金。
defaultPrompts: Show me the products in my store
Show me my recent orders
How is my store performing this month?
defaultPromptsZh: 显示我商店中的产品
显示我最近的订单
我的商店本月表现如何？

plugin_asdk_app_6a2acc5bb3a48191a2e3eb35.productIntroEn: Sweescape is an all-in-one event management suite for organizers — ticketing, badges, check-in, analytics, and audience campaigns. This connector lets you run your own Sweescape workspace directly from ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2acc5bb3a48191a2e3eb35.longDescription:
Sweescape is an all-in-one event management suite for organizers — ticketing, badges, check-in, analytics, and audience campaigns. This connector lets you run your own Sweescape workspace directly from ChatGPT.

Ask ChatGPT to look up your events, ticket types and sales, attendance and analytics, and to list your audiences and automations. You can also draft newticketing pages, automations, and email or SMS campaigns — all inside your own workspace.

Everything stays a draft: the connector can prepare and edit content, but publishing a page, activating an automation, or sending a campaign always remains a manual action you take inside Sweescape. It is a first-party connector that accesses only your own Sweescape data.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2acc5bb3a48191a2e3eb35.longDescriptionZh:
Sweescape 是一款面向组织者的一体化活动管理套件 - 票务、徽章、签到、分析和受众活动。此连接器可让您直接从 ChatGPT 运行自己的 Sweescape 工作区。

要求 ChatGPT 查找您的活动、门票类型和销售、出席率和分析，并列出您的受众和自动化。您还可以起草新的票务页面、自动化以及电子邮件或短信活动——所有这些都在您自己的工作空间内进行。

一切都只是草稿：连接器可以准备和编辑内容，但发布页面、激活自动化或发送营销活动始终仍然是您在 Sweescape 中执行的手动操作。它是仅访问您自己的 Sweescape 数据的第一方连接器。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7b33f0560c8191ac449363.description: 审核站点和 AI 可见性
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b33f0560c8191ac449363.productIntro: 看看人工智能助手是否真的推荐您的业务。网站审核员向 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 和 Perplexity 提出真实客户会问的问题，报告答案中列出了哪些企业，并添加了 SEO、安全标头、断开链接和性能检查 - 整体 AI 可见性得分 (0-100)、每个引擎的细分、竞争对手比较以及持续的每周监控。内置示例报告不需要 API 密钥，也无需设置，因此您可以在连接帐户之前准确查看完整报告的外观。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b33f0560c8191ac449363.productIntroEn: See whether AI assistants actually recommend your business. Website Auditor puts the questions a real customer would ask to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, reports which businesses get named in the answers, and adds SEO, security-header, broken-link and performance checks — an overall AI-visibility score (0–100), a per-engine breakdown, competitor comparisons, and ongoing weekly…
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b33f0560c8191ac449363.longDescription: See whether AI assistants actually recommend your business. Website Auditor puts the questions a real customer would ask to ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity, reports which businesses get named in the answers, and adds SEO, security-header, broken-link and performance checks — an overall AI-visibility score (0–100), a per-engine breakdown, competitor comparisons, and ongoing weekly monitoring. The built-in sample report needs no API key and no setup, so you can see exactly what a full report looks like before connecting an account.

plugin_asdk_app_6a81f7d8bb3c8191a1d8b91c.name: Kometrics
plugin_asdk_app_6a81f7d8bb3c8191a1d8b91c.productIntro: Kometrics 将您已经在 Stripe、Paddle、Creem 或 Asaas 上运行的计费转化为您可以信赖的订阅指标：MRR、ARR、流失率、ARPA、LTV、群组及其下方的移动分类账。询问 MRR 是如何移动的，它会逐月读取真实的序列；询问它为何移动，它会打开该号码背后的单个客户动向，指出谁注册、扩展或流失。询问谁有风险，它会列出他们以及每个人持有的 MRR；询问现金，它会报告未来 30、60 或 90 天内到期的续订。
plugin_asdk_app_6a81f7d8bb3c8191a1d8b91c.productIntroEn: Kometrics turns the billing you already run on Stripe, Paddle, Creem or Asaas into subscription metrics you can trust: MRR, ARR, churn, ARPA, LTV, cohorts and the movement ledger underneath them. Ask how MRR moved and it reads the real series month by month; ask why it moved and it opens the individual customer movements behind the number, naming who signed up, expanded or churned.
plugin_asdk_app_6a81f7d8bb3c8191a1d8b91c.longDescription: Kometrics turns the billing you already run on Stripe, Paddle, Creem or Asaas into subscription metrics you can trust: MRR, ARR, churn, ARPA, LTV, cohorts and the movement ledger underneath them. Ask how MRR moved and it reads the real series month by month; ask why it moved and it opens the individual customer movements behind the number, naming who signed up, expanded or churned. Ask who is at risk and it lists them with the MRR each one carries, and ask about cash and it reports what renewals are due in the next 30, 60 or 90 days. Every figure is computed by the same code that draws the reports in the Kometrics app, and every result carries a link back to the report it came from. The connector is read-only and scoped to a single workspace that the user chooses when they approve the connection.
plugin_asdk_app_6a81f7d8bb3c8191a1d8b91c.longDescriptionZh: Kometrics 将您已经在 Stripe、Paddle、Creem 或 Asaas 上运行的计费转化为您可以信赖的订阅指标：MRR、ARR、流失率、ARPA、LTV、群组及其下方的移动分类账。询问 MRR 是如何移动的，它会逐月读取真实的序列；询问它为何移动，它会打开该号码背后的单个客户动向，指出谁注册、扩展或流失。询问谁有风险，它会列出他们以及每个人持有的 MRR；询问现金，它会报告未来 30、60 或 90 天内到期的续订。每个数字都是由在 Kometrics 应用程序中绘制报告的相同代码计算的，每个结果都带有一个返回其来源报告的链接。连接器是只读的，范围仅限于用户在批准连接时选择的单个工作区。

plugin_asdk_app_6a63356dad8c8191b47c8e64.productIntro: Cosmos 将 Consumer Edge 的交易数据直接引入 ChatGPT。用简单的英语提出问题，并根据来自数百万张美国信用卡和借记卡的近实时支出数据（涵盖数千个品牌和商家）获得分析师级答案 - 比公司报告提前几周。查询汇总支出指标，以跟踪整个消费者领域的公司趋势、市场份额和细分绩效。
