plugin_asdk_app_6a63356dad8c8191b47c8e64.longDescription:
Cosmos brings Consumer Edge's transaction data directly into ChatGPT. Ask questions in plain English and get analyst-grade answers built on near-real-time spend data from millions of US credit and debit cards, covering thousands of brands and merchants — weeks ahead of company reporting. Query aggregated spend metrics to track company trends, market share, and segment performance across the consumer landscape.

Each question runs through Cosmos, Consumer Edge's AI analytics engine, which selects the right metrics, handles panel weighting and merchant hierarchies, and returns a structured summary with the underlying data. Results come back as queryable tables, so ChatGPT can run follow-up analysis, calculate custom metrics, or build charts without re-querying.

Key features:

Natural language querying — no SQL or schema knowledge required; ask about brands, tickers, or merchant groups directly

Full KPI coverage — spend, transactions, average ticket, unique shoppers, visit frequency, and new customer acquisition

Demographic and cohort breakdowns — segment any brand's performance by customer income cohort

Flexible time grains — daily, monthly, or quarterly trends, including quarter-to-date reads on partial periods

Analyst-ready output — answers flag accelerations, decelerations, calendar shifts, and partial-month caveats automatically

Use it to:

Track brand performance ahead of earnings — monthly and quarter-to-date spend growth versus prior periods

Run competitive benchmarking — compare KPIs and market share shifts across any set of brands

Analyze customer behavior — see where new customer growth comes from and whether cohorts are trading down

Spot inflection points — decompose month-over-month changes into customer count, frequency, and ticket drivers

Requires a Consumer Edge subscription with MCP access enabled.
plugin_asdk_app_6a63356dad8c8191b47c8e64.longDescriptionZh:
Cosmos 将 Consumer Edge 的交易数据直接引入 ChatGPT。用简单的英语提出问题，并根据来自数百万张美国信用卡和借记卡的近实时支出数据（涵盖数千个品牌和商家）获得分析师级答案 - 比公司报告提前几周。查询汇总支出指标，以跟踪整个消费者领域的公司趋势、市场份额和细分绩效。

每个问题都通过 Consumer Edge 的人工智能分析引擎 Cosmos 运行，该引擎会选择正确的指标、处理面板权重和商家层次结构，并返回包含基础数据的结构化摘要。结果以可查询表的形式返回，因此 ChatGPT 可以运行后续分析、计算自定义指标或构建图表，而无需重新查询。

主要特点：

自然语言查询——无需 SQL 或模式知识；直接询问品牌、股票代码或商家群体

全面的 KPI 覆盖——支出、交易、平均门票、独特购物者、访问频率和新客户获取

人口统计和群体细分——按客户收入群体对任何品牌的表现进行细分

灵活的时间粒度——每日、每月或每季度趋势，包括部分周期的季度至今读数

分析师就绪的输出 - 自动回答标记加速、减速、日历变化和部分月份的警告

用它来：

在盈利之前跟踪品牌表现——与前期相比的月度和季度至今的支出增长

运行竞争性基准测试 - 比较任何品牌组的 KPI 和市场份额变化

分析客户行为——了解新客户增长来自何处以及客户群体是否正在下降

拐点点——将逐月变化分解为客户数量、频率和票务驱动因素

需要启用 MCP 访问的消费者边缘订阅。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8d1d39203c8191ba7959aa.productIntro: 比泽尔气体冷却器工具对已发布的 R744 气体冷却器模型进行评级，选择所需容量的模型，检索经过验证的 R744 饱和极限，并以 SI 单位创建本地化 PDF、STEP、3D、尺寸图、夹点图和容量图工件。兼容的 ChatGPT 客户端会收到一个内联多语言结果库，其中包含计算输入和输出、PNG 预览、交互式 3D 模型、警告、强制性暂定数据通知、到期状态和安全临时下载。当计算数据、轨迹、发布的几何图形或渲染依赖项不可用时，应用程序永远不会替换估计的工程值。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8d1d39203c8191ba7959aa.productIntroEn: BITZER Gascooler Tool rates released R744 gas-cooler models, selects models for a required capacity, retrieves validated R744 saturation limits, and creates localized PDF, STEP, 3D, dimensional-drawing, pinch-diagram, and capacity-map artifacts in SI units.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8d1d39203c8191ba7959aa.longDescription: BITZER Gascooler Tool rates released R744 gas-cooler models, selects models for a required capacity, retrieves validated R744 saturation limits, and creates localized PDF, STEP, 3D, dimensional-drawing, pinch-diagram, and capacity-map artifacts in SI units. Compatible ChatGPT clients receive one inline multilingual result gallery with calculation inputs and outputs, PNG previews, an interactive 3D model, warnings, the mandatory tentative-data notice, expiry status, and secure temporary downloads. The app never substitutes estimated engineering values when calculation data, traces, released geometry, or rendering dependencies are unavailable.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8d1d39203c8191ba7959aa.longDescriptionZh: 比泽尔气体冷却器工具对已发布的 R744 气体冷却器模型进行评级，选择所需容量的模型，检索经过验证的 R744 饱和极限，并以 SI 单位创建本地化 PDF、STEP、3D、尺寸图、夹点图和容量图工件。兼容的 ChatGPT 客户端会收到一个内联多语言结果库，其中包含计算输入和输出、PNG 预览、交互式 3D 模型、警告、强制性暂定数据通知、到期状态和安全临时下载。当计算数据、轨迹、发布的几何图形或渲染依赖项不可用时，应用程序永远不会替换估计的工程值。
defaultPrompts: Select a CO2 gas cooler for 180 kW CO2 inlet 95 °C and 9000 kPa(a) leaving at 35°C, water entering at 20 °C and leaving at 35°C.
Rate GK2742K-10T-1H with R744 at 90 °C, 8800 kPa(a) and 0.45 kg/s, water in 25 °C out 40°C, show the pinch diagram.
Show capacity map for GK2742K-10T-1H with R744 at 90 °C, 8800 kPa(a) and 0.45 kg/s, water in 25 °C out 40°C.
defaultPromptsZh: 选择 180 kW CO2 入口 95 °C 和 9000 kPa(a) 的 CO2 气体冷却器，离开温度为 35°C，水进入温度为 20 °C，离开温度为 35°C。
使用 R744 对 GK2742K-10T-1H 在 90 °C、8800 kPa(a) 和 0.45 kg/s、水进 25 °C 出 40°C 下进行额定值，显示夹点图。
显示采用 R744 的 GK2742K-10T-1H 在 90 °C、8800 kPa(a) 和 0.45 kg/s、水在 25 °C 和 40°C 下的容量图。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8c88f806c08191ab0ae925.productIntro: 将 Unify 连接到 ChatGPT 和 Codex 以端到端运行您的出站：构建目标列表、通过经过验证的电子邮件和电话号码丰富联系人、起草个性化序列并将其全部同步回您的 CRM。然后询问什么是有效的：按顺序排列的回复率、代表活动和转化率。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8c88f806c08191ab0ae925.productIntroEn: Connect Unify to ChatGPT and Codex to run your outbound end to end: build target lists, enrich contacts with verified emails and phone numbers, draft personalized sequences, and sync it all back to your CRM. Then ask what's working: reply rates by sequence, rep activity, and conversion.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8c88f806c08191ab0ae925.longDescription:
Connect Unify to ChatGPT and Codex to run your outbound end to end: build target lists, enrich contacts with verified emails and phone numbers, draft personalized sequences, and sync it all back to your CRM. Then ask what's working: reply rates by sequence, rep activity, and conversion.

Try asking "Find champions from my customer accounts who recently started new roles, get their verified emails and mobile numbers, and draft a sequence," or "Show me the breakdown of tasks completed by reps over the last 30 days."

Unify searches 1.1B+ people and 65M+ companies across 40+ data providers. Find, enrich, and sequence prospects in one chat.

将 Unify 连接到 ChatGPT 和 Codex 以端到端运行您的出站：构建目标列表、通过经过验证的电子邮件和电话号码丰富联系人、起草个性化序列并将其全部同步回您的 CRM。然后询问什么是有效的：按顺序排列的回复率、代表活动和转化率。

尝试询问“从我的客户帐户中查找最近开始新角色的支持者，获取他们经过验证的电子邮件和手机号码，并起草一个序列”，或“显示代表在过去 30 天内完成的任务的详细信息”。

plugin_asdk_app_6a45ef86fd088191bdd64fda.name: AI Dispatcher by FieldCamp
plugin_asdk_app_6a45ef86fd088191bdd64fda.productIntro: FieldCamp AI Dispatcher 将您的现场服务操作带入 ChatGPT。连接您的 FieldCamp Workspace 和 ChatGPT 可以查看您的实时工作、技术人员、每日日程安排和调度绩效， 然后采取行动：创造就业机会，在整个团队中运行人工智能调度优化，并接受或拒绝 人工智能建议的任务——全部来自聊天。专为想要制定计划的调度员和运营团队而打造 并通过对话调整他们的一天。
plugin_asdk_app_6a45ef86fd088191bdd64fda.productIntroEn: FieldCamp AI Dispatcher brings your field-service operations into ChatGPT. Connect your FieldCamp workspace and ChatGPT can see your live jobs, technicians, daily schedule, and dispatch performance, then act on them: create jobs, run AI dispatch optimization across your team, and accept or reject the AI's suggested assignments — all from chat.
plugin_asdk_app_6a45ef86fd088191bdd64fda.longDescription:
FieldCamp AI Dispatcher brings your field-service operations into ChatGPT. Connect your FieldCamp
workspace and ChatGPT can see your live jobs, technicians, daily schedule, and dispatch performance,
then act on them: create jobs, run AI dispatch optimization across your team, and accept or reject the
AI's suggested assignments — all from chat. Built for dispatchers and operations teams who want to plan
and adjust their day conversationally. Read tools only retrieve data; write tools (create job, run
dispatch, accept/reject) make explicit, reviewable changes, each annotated with read/write hints.
plugin_asdk_app_6a45ef86fd088191bdd64fda.longDescriptionZh:
FieldCamp AI Dispatcher 将您的现场服务操作带入 ChatGPT。连接您的 FieldCamp
Workspace 和 ChatGPT 可以查看您的实时工作、技术人员、每日日程安排和调度绩效，
然后采取行动：创造就业机会，在整个团队中运行人工智能调度优化，并接受或拒绝
人工智能建议的任务——全部来自聊天。专为想要制定计划的调度员和运营团队而打造
并通过对话调整他们的一天。读取工具仅检索数据；编写工具（创建作业、运行
调度、接受/拒绝）进行明确的、可审查的更改，每个更改都带有读/写提示注释。

Create a job for a water-heater repair at 123 Main St tomorrow morning and run AI dispatch

plugin_asdk_app_6a9586f0e6d081918e32b973.productIntro: SmartFlow Portal 将客户项目引入 ChatGPT。查看项目计划和里程碑、执行等待您的操作、审核发票并保持交付顺利进行。授权的 SmartFlow 管理员还可以管理组织、计划、客户提交、时间条目和计费工作流程，并从登录用户的角色和组织范围强制执行访问权限。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9586f0e6d081918e32b973.productIntroEn: SmartFlow Portal brings client projects into ChatGPT. plugin_asdk_app_697b04cd95b48191ad45b6a2.productIntro: 我们的平台允许用户根据角色、地点、经验、薪资和技能等多种标准探索工作机会。用户可以查看详细的职位描述，包括职责、要求和公司信息，以做出明智的决策。该平台使您可以轻松地在一处发现和比较相关机会。一旦找到合适的工作，用户就可以无缝转移到我们的平台继续他们的旅程。他们可以毫无摩擦地申请该职位或继续招聘流程的后续步骤。该体验旨在为用户提供简单、快速且直观的体验。我们确保职位列表具有相关性并定期更新。该平台支持用户从最初的工作发现到申请完成。
plugin_asdk_app_697b04cd95b48191ad45b6a2.productIntroEn: Our platform allows users to explore job opportunities based on multiple criteria such as role, location, experience, salary, and skills. Users can view detailed job descriptions, including responsibilities, requirements, and company information, to make informed decisions. The platform makes it easy to discover and compare relevant opportunities in one place.
plugin_asdk_app_697b04cd95b48191ad45b6a2.longDescription: Our platform allows users to explore job opportunities based on multiple criteria such as role, location, experience, salary, and skills. Users can view detailed job descriptions, including responsibilities, requirements, and company information, to make informed decisions. The platform makes it easy to discover and compare relevant opportunities in one place. Once a suitable job is found, users can seamlessly move to our platform to continue their journey. They can apply for the job or proceed with the next steps in the hiring process without friction. The experience is designed to be simple, fast, and intuitive for users. We ensure that job listings are relevant and regularly updated. The platform supports users from initial job discovery to application completion. It helps reduce effort and improves clarity during the job search process. Our goal is to make job exploration and application more efficient and transparent for every user.

plugin_asdk_app_6a6dc91907c08191b8634b76.productIntro: IntelCue 监控竞争对手和市场信号，然后将其转化为 ChatGPT 的实时背景。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6dc91907c08191b8634b76.productIntroEn: IntelCue monitors competitor and market signals, then turns them into live context for ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6dc91907c08191b8634b76.longDescription:
IntelCue monitors competitor and market signals, then turns them into live context for ChatGPT.

Access monitored market data, competitor updates, trends, and insights directly from your IntelCue workspace.

Use IntelCue in ChatGPT to:
• Get a weekly briefing on what happened in your market
• Find what competitors are launching or promoting
• Analyze how competitor messaging has evolved
• Create competitive briefs and market summaries
• Draft a LinkedIn post from the week’s top trending topic
• Check for competitor moves from the last three days

IntelCue helps teams track competitors and market movements, understand emerging trends and signals, generate briefs, reports, and content ideas, and make decisions using continuously updated intelligence within ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6dc91907c08191b8634b76.longDescriptionZh:
IntelCue 监控竞争对手和市场信号，然后将其转化为 ChatGPT 的实时背景。

直接从您的 IntelCue 工作区访问受监控的市场数据、竞争对手更新、趋势和见解。

在 ChatGPT 中使用 IntelCue 可以：
• 每周获取有关您所在市场发生情况的简报
• 查找竞争对手正在推出或推广的产品
• 分析竞争对手的信息传递方式如何演变
• 创建竞争简介和市场摘要
• 根据本周热门话题起草 LinkedIn 帖子
• 检查竞争对手过去三天的动向

IntelCue 帮助团队跟踪竞争对手和市场动向，了解新兴趋势和信号，生成简报、报告和内容创意，并使用 ChatGPT 中不断更新的情报做出决策。
defaultPrompts: Give me a weekly briefing on the most important trends, competitor moves, and keywords in my market.
What significant competitor moves were detected in the last three days, and why do they matter?

找到本周最热门的主题，并根据支持情报起草 LinkedIn 帖子。

plugin_asdk_app_6a99b662c5a881919b0c8b65.productIntro: Magister Marketing 将您品牌的营销工作区连接到 ChatGPT。查看您的品牌概况和营销计划，然后逐项实施该计划：阅读下一个优先任务及其完整简介，记录进度注释，并在工作交付时更新项目状态。
plugin_asdk_app_6a99b662c5a881919b0c8b65.productIntroEn: Magister Marketing connects your brand's marketing workspace to ChatGPT. Review your brand profile and marketing plan, then work the plan item by item: read the next prioritized task with its full brief, record progress notes, and update item status as work ships.
plugin_asdk_app_6a99b662c5a881919b0c8b65.longDescription:
Magister Marketing connects your brand's marketing workspace to ChatGPT. Review your brand profile and marketing plan, then work the plan item by item: read the next prioritized task with its full brief, record progress notes, and update item status as work ships.

Track AI visibility and GEO. See how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews answer the prompts your buyers actually ask about your category, start new scoring rounds, and open an interactive report showing score trends across rounds, results by AI model, and per-prompt detail.

Run SEO and answer-engine audits with per-channel health scores, research keywords with search volume and difficulty, and review Google Ads, Meta Ads, and TikTok Ads performance. Draft and schedule social posts from your brand voice, pull per-post and follower analytics, discover influencers by channel and topic, work with project assets and files, monitor public sources for brand mentions, and open pull requests against a connected GitHub repository.

Writes are scoped and audited. Publishing a post, sending an email, merging a pull request, and deleting a file each stop at an explicit confirmation or a server-side approval that a person must grant in the Magister app before anything happens. New ad campaigns are created paused on Meta or TikTok, and this connector has no way to activate a campaign or begin ad spend. Requires a Magister account.
plugin_asdk_app_6a99b662c5a881919b0c8b65.longDescriptionZh:
Magister Marketing 将您品牌的营销工作区连接到 ChatGPT。查看您的品牌概况和营销计划，然后逐项实施该计划：阅读下一个优先任务及其完整简介，记录进度注释，并在工作交付时更新项目状态。

跟踪 AI 可见性和 GEO。了解 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Perplexity 和 Google AI Overviews 如何回答买家实际询问的有关您的类别的提示，开始新的评分轮次，并打开一个交互式报告，显示各轮次的分数趋势、AI 模型的结果以及每个提示的详细信息。

根据每个渠道的健康评分运行 SEO 和答案引擎审核，研究关键词的搜索量和难度，并审查 Google Ads、元广告和 TikTok 广告的效果。根据您的品牌声音起草和安排社交帖子，提取每个帖子和关注者分析，按渠道和主题发现影响者，使用项目资产和文件，监控品牌提及的公共来源，以及针对连接的 GitHub 存储库打开拉取请求。

写入会受到范围限制和审核。发布帖子、发送电子邮件、合并拉取请求和删除文件都会在明确确认或服务器端批准后停止，在发生任何事情之前，人们必须在 Magister 应用程序中授予这些批准。新的广告活动在 Meta 或 TikTok 上创建时已暂停，并且此连接器无法激活活动或开始广告支出。需要一个魔导师帐户。
defaultPrompts: Run an audit of my business and create a report.
Run an AI visibility audit on my website, show me the results and what we need to work on.
How did our ads perform last month across Google, Meta, and TikTok?
defaultPromptsZh: 对我的业务进行审计并创建报告。
在我的网站上运行人工智能可见性审核，向我展示结果以及我们需要做什么。
上个月我们的广告在 Google、Meta 和 TikTok 上的表现如何？

plugin_asdk_app_698a0208e7d881919cc8d521.name: Ad Superpowers
plugin_asdk_app_698a0208e7d881919cc8d521.description: 跨 8 个平台管理广告
plugin_asdk_app_698a0208e7d881919cc8d521.productIntro: Ad Superpowers 将 ChatGPT 连接到营销人员已经运行的广告和分析帐户：Meta Ads、Google Ads、Google Analytics 4、Google Search Console、Google Tag Manager、Google Merchant Center、LinkedIn Ads 和 TikTok Ads。
plugin_asdk_app_698a0208e7d881919cc8d521.productIntroEn: Ad Superpowers connects ChatGPT to the advertising and analytics accounts a marketer already runs: Meta Ads, Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Google Merchant Center, LinkedIn Ads and TikTok Ads.
plugin_asdk_app_698a0208e7d881919cc8d521.longDescription:
Ad Superpowers connects ChatGPT to the advertising and analytics accounts a marketer already runs: Meta Ads, Google Ads, Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, Google Merchant Center, LinkedIn Ads and TikTok Ads.

Read workflows: pull campaign results across platforms and compare them, find which creatives are fatiguing, check why a campaign stopped spending, reconcile conversion numbers that differ between a platform and GA4, compare paid keywords against organic Search Console queries, and audit a Tag Manager container before a release.

Write workflows: pause or adjust a campaign that is overspending, fix a wrong landing-page URL on a live ad without losing its social proof, duplicate a winning ad into a new variant, upload creative assets, and build a new ad. Write tools that publish are gated behind an explicit plan-and-confirm step, so the user reads what will change and confirms it before anything is created.

Every account is connected by the customer through OAuth in the Ad Superpowers dashboard. The app only reaches accounts that customer has connected, and tools for platforms they have not connected are not offered at all.
plugin_asdk_app_698a0208e7d881919cc8d521.longDescriptionZh:
Ad Superpowers 将 ChatGPT 连接到营销人员已经运行的广告和分析帐户：Meta Ads、Google Ads、Google Analytics 4、Google Search Console、Google Tag Manager、Google Merchant Center、LinkedIn Ads 和 TikTok Ads。

阅读工作流程：跨平台提取广告系列结果并进行比较，找出哪些广告素材令人疲劳，检查广告系列停止支出的原因，协调平台和 GA4 之间不同的转化数字，将付费关键字与有机 Search Console 查询进行比较，并在发布前审核跟踪代码管理器容器。

编写工作流程：暂停或调整超支的广告系列，修复实时广告上错误的着陆页 URL，同时不丢失其社交证明，将获胜广告复制到新变体中，上传创意资源，以及制作新广告。发布的编写工具受到明确的计划和确认步骤的限制，因此用户可以在创建任何内容之前阅读将要更改的内容并进行确认。

每个帐户均由客户通过 Ad Superpowers 仪表板中的 OAuth 连接。该应用程序仅覆盖客户已连接的帐户，并且根本不提供用于未连接的平台的工具。

plugin_asdk_app_6a68bab4bdcc8191bc64c15e.productIntro: Crisphive 是面向应用程序、AI 代理和现场操作平台的开发人员优先的调度基础设施。 开发人员无需从头开始构建复杂的调度逻辑，而是可以使用 Crisphive 作为其产品背后的智能层来确定工作何时可以进行、谁应该做、他们应该去哪里，以及当一天不按计划进行时应该改变什么。
plugin_asdk_app_6a68bab4bdcc8191bc64c15e.productIntroEn: Crisphive is developer-first scheduling infrastructure for applications, AI agents, and field operations platforms. Instead of building complex scheduling logic from scratch, developers can use Crisphive as the intelligence layer behind their product to determine when work can happen, who should do it, where they should go, and what should change when the day does not go according to pla…
plugin_asdk_app_6a68bab4bdcc8191bc64c15e.longDescription:
Crisphive is developer-first scheduling infrastructure for applications, AI agents, and field operations platforms.
Instead of building complex scheduling logic from scratch, developers can use Crisphive as the intelligence layer behind their product to determine when work can happen, who should do it, where they should go, and what should change when the day does not go according to plan.

Crisphive helps developers build workflows that:
- Match customer requests against real business availability.
- Prevent double-booking and phantom availability.
- Assign the right person based on availability, location, skills, and operational constraints.
- Route field teams while reducing unnecessary travel and idle time.
- Automatically cascade schedule changes when jobs run long or emergency work is inserted.
- Notify affected customers and team members when schedules change.
- Support deterministic, explainable scheduling decisions that applications and agents can confidently act on.

Build solutions for real operational pain
Applications powered by Crisphive can help field operations teams address problems including:
- Lost bookings: Reduce phone-tag and callback gaps by exposing real-time availability to applications, booking experiences, and AI agents.
- After-hours revenue loss: Allow voice agents, chat experiences, and booking interfaces to find and reserve valid availability even when the office is closed.
- Wrong-person dispatch: Match jobs to personnel based on skills, certifications, geography, and availability.
- Excessive windshield time: Improve workforce utilization by intelligently routing the day instead of treating travel as an afterthought.
- Schedule disruption: Automatically recalculate downstream work when an emergency is added or a job takes longer than expected.
- Customer communication failures: Notify affected parties as the schedule changes instead of leaving customers wondering where their technician is.
- Under-utilized teams: Identify usable capacity and help businesses complete more work with the resources they already have.

Crisphive's core scheduling capabilities include:

Availability Matching
Determine whether a requested appointment can actually be fulfilled based on customer and business availability.

Routing + Skills Assignment
Assign the appropriate personnel based on availability, geography, skill set, and operational requirements while optimizing the working day.

Cascade Rescheduling + Notifications
Insert emergencies or react to schedule drift, recalculate affected appointments, and notify the people whose schedules have changed.

Scheduling infrastructure, not another system to replace
Crisphive is designed to sit underneath the applications businesses already use.
Developers can add scheduling intelligence to CRMs, field-service applications, marketplaces, customer portals, voice agents, internal tools, vertical SaaS products, and autonomous AI workflows without requiring customers to replace their existing operational stack.
Your application owns the experience.

Crisphive provides the scheduling intelligence underneath it.
Build scheduling into your product — without building the scheduling engine yourself.
plugin_asdk_app_6a68bab4bdcc8191bc64c15e.longDescriptionZh:
Crisphive 是面向应用程序、AI 代理和现场操作平台的开发人员优先的调度基础设施。
开发人员无需从头开始构建复杂的调度逻辑，而是可以使用 Crisphive 作为其产品背后的智能层来确定工作何时可以进行、谁应该做、他们应该去哪里，以及当一天不按计划进行时应该改变什么。

Crisphive 帮助开发人员构建以下工作流程：
- 将客户请求与实际业务可用性相匹配。
- 防止重复预订和虚拟可用性。
- 根据可用性、位置、技能和操作限制分配合适的人员。
- 为现场团队提供路线，同时减少不必要的旅行和闲置时间。
- 当作业运行时间较长或插入紧急作业时，自动级联计划更改。
- 当时间表发生变化时，通知受影响的客户和团队成员。
- 支持确定性、可解释的调度决策，应用程序和代理可以放心地执行这些决策。

为实际操作难题构建解决方案
Crisphive 支持的应用程序可以帮助现场运营团队解决以下问题：
- 丢失预订：通过向应用程序、预订体验和人工智能代理提供实时可用性，减少电话标签和回电差距。
- 下班后收入损失：即使办公室关闭，语音代理、聊天体验和预订界面也能找到并预订有效的可用性。
- 错误的人员派遣：根据技能、认证、地理位置和可用性将工作与人员相匹配。
- 挡风玻璃时间过长：通过智能地安排一天的时间而不是将旅行视为事后的想法来提高劳动力利用率。
- 计划中断：当添加紧急情况或作业时间比预期长时，​​自动重新计算下游作业。
- 客户沟通故障：当时间表发生变化时通知受影响的各方，而不是让客户想知道他们的技术人员在哪里。
- 未充分利用的团队：确定可用容量并帮助企业利用现有资源完成更多工作。

Crisphive 的核心调度能力包括：

可用性匹配
根据客户和业务可用性确定请求的约会是否实际上可以完成。

路由+技能分配
根据可用性、地理位置、技能组合和操作要求分配适当的人员，同时优化工作日。

级联重新安排+通知
插入紧急情况或对日程漂移做出反应，重新计算受影响的约会，并通知日程发生变化的人员。

调度基础设施，而不是另一个系统来取代
Crisphive 旨在位于企业已使用的应用程序之下。
开发人员可以将调度智能添加到 CRM、现场服务应用程序、市场、客户门户、语音代理、内部工具、垂直 SaaS 产品和自主 AI 工作流程中，而无需客户更换现有的操作堆栈。
您的应用程序拥有这种体验。

Crisphive 提供了其底层的调度智能。
将调度构建到您的产品中 - 无需自己构建调度引擎。

plugin_asdk_app_6a33955cc65c819187f06301.productIntro: lemlist 是一个销售参与平台，用于通过单一序列跨电子邮件、LinkedIn、电话、WhatsApp 和 SMS 运行多渠道推广。
plugin_asdk_app_6a33955cc65c819187f06301.productIntroEn: lemlist is a sales engagement platform for running multichannel outreach across email, LinkedIn, calls, WhatsApp, and SMS from a single sequence.
plugin_asdk_app_6a33955cc65c819187f06301.longDescription:
lemlist is a sales engagement platform for running multichannel outreach across email, LinkedIn, calls, WhatsApp, and SMS from a single sequence.

Campaigns and sequences: create campaigns, draft and preview personalized multichannel sequences step by step, set up A/B variants and AI-generated variables, validate a campaign before launch, and start, pause, or resume it.

Leads and prospecting: search your existing campaign leads, add or import leads, update their data and custom variables, and search the lemlist leads database to build new lists. Enrichment tools can look up a lead's professional email and phone number, individually or in bulk, using enrichment credits from your plan.

Signals and watch lists: build watch lists that track buying signals on companies you care about, browse the signal library, and turn a watch list into a campaign.

CRM and contacts: create and update contacts and companies, organize them into lists, import them from CSV, and push campaign leads into your contact database.

Conversations and activity: read your unified inbox, follow up on conversations, reply to a lead, review call activity and outcomes, and work through your task list.

Deliverability and sending infrastructure: check the deliverability and DNS health of your sending domains, review and configure DNS records, run a deliverability audit and inbox placement tests, and connect, test, and manage the mailboxes you send from.

Reporting: track how campaigns perform with detailed stats and reports across channels.

Account: review your team, users, sending settings, unsubscribe list, and webhooks.

All actions run on your own lemlist workspace with your own data, using the permissions granted to the connected account.
plugin_asdk_app_6a33955cc65c819187f06301.longDescriptionZh:
lemlist 是一个销售参与平台，用于通过单一序列跨电子邮件、LinkedIn、电话、WhatsApp 和 SMS 运行多渠道推广。

营销活动和序列：创建营销活动，逐步起草和预览个性化多渠道序列，设置 A/B 变体和 AI 生成的变量，在启动前验证营销活动，以及启动、暂停或恢复营销活动。

潜在客户和勘探：搜索现有的营销活动潜在客户、添加或导入潜在客户、更新其数据和自定义变量，以及搜索 lemlist 潜在客户数据库以构建新列表。丰富工具可以使用您计划中的丰富积分单独或批量查找潜在客户的专业电子邮件和电话号码。

信号和观察列表：建立观察列表来跟踪您关心的公司的购买信号，浏览信号库，并将观察列表转变为营销活动。

CRM 和联系人：创建和更新联系人和公司，将它们组织到列表中，从 CSV 导入，并将营销活动线索推送到您的联系人数据库中。

对话和活动：阅读统一收件箱、跟进对话、回复潜在客户、查看通话活动和结果，以及处理任务列表。

送达率和发送基础设施：检查发送域的送达率和 DNS 运行状况，查看和配置 DNS 记录，运行送达率审核和收件箱放置测试，以及连接、测试和管理您发送的邮箱。

报告：通过跨渠道的详细统计数据和报告来跟踪营销活动的执行情况。

帐户：查看您的团队、用户、发送设置、取消订阅列表和网络钩子。

所有操作均使用授予连接帐户的权限，在您自己的 lemlist 工作区上使用您自己的数据运行。

plugin_asdk_app_6a71e92fd3dc8191908bcc2c.productIntroEn: O Controlle é uma plataforma de gestão financeira para pequenas e médias empresas brasileiras, com foco no setor de serviços.
plugin_asdk_app_6a71e92fd3dc8191908bcc2c.longDescription:
O Controlle é uma plataforma de gestão financeira para pequenas e médias empresas brasileiras, com foco no setor de serviços.

Com este plugin, você acessa o financeiro da sua empresa direto na conversa. Consulte saldo por conta, contas a pagar e a receber por período, lançamentos por categoria e a projeção de fluxo de caixa. Também é possível registrar novos lançamentos e atualizar informações, sempre com confirmação antes de gravar.

Exemplos de uso: "quanto tenho a pagar essa semana?", "como ficou meu fluxo de caixa em julho?", "quais clientes estão em atraso?", "lance uma despesa de energia de R$ 1.200 com vencimento dia 15".

É necessário ter uma conta ativa no Controlle. No primeiro uso, você conecta sua conta e autoriza o acesso.

使用示例：“本周我需要支付多少钱？”、“7 月份我的现金流量如何？”、“哪些客户拖欠款项？”、“输入 15 日到期的能源费用 1,200 雷亚尔”。

您必须拥有有效的 Controll 帐户。首次使用时，您需要连接您的帐户并授权访问。

plugin_asdk_app_6a89d92aea648191a628dc00.productIntro: Reecopedia 搜索欧盟纺织品可持续发展法的主要文本，并返回匹配的段落及其源文件和页面，因此可以根据文档检查答案而不是信任答案。该语料库涵盖 ESPR（法规 (EU) 2024/1781）、数字产品护照、CSRD、CBAM、EU ETS、CWA 18291 (CIRPASS-2) 和 JRC 纺织品预备研究。
plugin_asdk_app_6a89d92aea648191a628dc00.productIntroEn: Reecopedia searches the primary texts of EU textile sustainability law and returns the matching passages with their source file and page, so answers can be checked against the document instead of trusted. The corpus covers ESPR (Regulation (EU) 2024/1781), the Digital Product Passport, CSRD, CBAM, EU ETS, CWA 18291 (CIRPASS-2) and the JRC preparatory studies for textiles.
plugin_asdk_app_6a89d92aea648191a628dc00.longDescription: Reecopedia searches the primary texts of EU textile sustainability law and returns the matching passages with their source file and page, so answers can be checked against the document instead of trusted. The corpus covers ESPR (Regulation (EU) 2024/1781), the Digital Product Passport, CSRD, CBAM, EU ETS, CWA 18291 (CIRPASS-2) and the JRC preparatory studies for textiles. Typical workflows: ask a compliance question and get cited passages; browse a result list and open a full document page; walk the outline of a standard and jump to the section you need; locate an exact wording such as an article number inside one document. It never browses the open web and never writes the answer itself. When the retrieved passages match poorly it says so, and when the only match is a EUR-Lex national-transposition register card it warns that the date on that card is a notification date and not an entry into force. No account and no personal data are required.
plugin_asdk_app_6a89d92aea648191a628dc00.longDescriptionZh: Reecopedia 搜索欧盟纺织品可持续发展法的主要文本，并返回匹配的段落及其源文件和页面，因此可以根据文档检查答案而不是信任答案。该语料库涵盖 ESPR（法规 (EU) 2024/1781）、数字产品护照、CSRD、CBAM、EU ETS、CWA 18291 (CIRPASS-2) 和 JRC 纺织品预备研究。典型的工作流程：提出合规性问题并获取引用的段落；浏览结果列表并打开完整文档页面；浏览标准大纲并跳至您需要的部分；找到准确的措辞，例如一份文档中的商品编号。它从不浏览开放的网络，也从不自己写出答案。当检索到的段落匹配不佳时，它会这样说；当唯一匹配是 EUR-Lex 国家换位登记卡时，它会警告该卡上的日期是通知日期，而不是生效日期。无需帐户，也无需个人数据。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7ae2565a148191802be85a.productIntro: Postify 是一款面向团队的社交媒体日程安排工具：您发布到的帐户的一个日历，草稿、日程安排和交付分析都集中在一个地方。 Postify 插件可让 ChatGPT 与您一起使用该日历：列出帖子并打开特定帖子、查看连接了哪些频道、起草新帖子、将预定帖子移至其他时间、在媒体库中搜索已上传的图像、询问建议的发布时间、立即发布帖子或删除帖子。它还可以提取已交付帖子的性能数据，并在您需要了解某些内容如何工作时搜索 Postify 自己的文档。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ae2565a148191802be85a.productIntroEn: Postify is a social media scheduling tool for teams: one calendar for the accounts you publish to, with drafts, scheduling, and delivery analytics in one place. The Postify plugin lets ChatGPT work that calendar with you: list posts and open a specific one, see which channels are connected, draft a new post, move a scheduled post to a different time, search your media library for an imag…
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ae2565a148191802be85a.longDescription:
Postify is a social media scheduling tool for teams: one calendar for the accounts you publish to, with drafts, scheduling, and delivery analytics in one place. The Postify plugin lets ChatGPT work that calendar with you: list posts and open a specific one, see which channels are connected, draft a new post, move a scheduled post to a different time, search your media library for an image you already uploaded, ask for a suggested posting time, publish a post immediately, or delete one. It can also pull performance figures for posts already delivered, and search Postify's own documentation when you need to know how something works.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, and issued tokens are bound to the Postify MCP endpoint. You choose scopes on the consent screen, and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never registered for the session, so the assistant cannot see it. Connected apps are listed in Settings and can be revoked there, and every tool call is written to an audit log you can read in the app.

The two irreversible actions — publishing and deleting — are deliberately gated twice. First, an organization setting controls whether an AI assistant may perform them at all, and that setting can only be turned on by a person inside Postify; no AI credential carries the scope needed to enable it. Second, with the setting on, the first call returns a confirmation request with a short-lived token bound to the exact arguments, which must be echoed back on a second call before anything is published or deleted. Expect that first response — it is the safety step working, not an error.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7ae2565a148191802be85a.longDescriptionZh:
Postify 是一款面向团队的社交媒体日程安排工具：您发布到的帐户的一个日历，草稿、日程安排和交付分析都集中在一个地方。 Postify 插件可让 ChatGPT 与您一起使用该日历：列出帖子并打开特定帖子、查看连接了哪些频道、起草新帖子、将预定帖子移至其他时间、在媒体库中搜索已上传的图像、询问建议的发布时间、立即发布帖子或删除帖子。它还可以提取已交付帖子的性能数据，并在您需要了解某些内容如何工作时搜索 Postify 自己的文档。

访问通过带有 PKCE 的 OAuth 2.1 运行，并且颁发的令牌绑定到 Postify MCP 端点。您在同意屏幕上选择范围，并且您未授予其范围的工具永远不会在会话中注册，因此助手无法看到它。连接的应用程序在“设置”中列出，并且可以在那里撤销，并且每个工具调用都会写入您可以在应用程序中读取的审核日志。

发布和删除这两个不可逆转的操作被故意设置了两次门控。首先，组织设置控制 AI 助手是否可以执行这些操作，并且该设置只能由 Postify 内部的人员打开；没有任何人工智能证书具备实现它所需的范围。其次，启用该设置后，第一次调用将返回一个确认请求，其中包含绑定到确切参数的短期令牌，在发布或删除任何内容之前，必须在第二次调用中回显该请求。期待第一个响应——这是安全步骤正在发挥作用，而不是错误。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8db0425790819187dd2fb0.name: Lito
plugin_asdk_app_6a8db0425790819187dd2fb0.productIntro: Litera 的 Lito 插件将您公司的集体知识和经验带入 ChatGPT。用简单的英语提出问题，并从您公司的经验数据中获得引用的答案，而无需离开对话。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8db0425790819187dd2fb0.productIntroEn: Litera's Lito plugin brings your firm's collective knowledge and experience into ChatGPT. Ask questions in plain English and get cited answers drawn from your firm's experience data, without leaving the conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8db0425790819187dd2fb0.longDescription:
Litera's Lito plugin brings your firm's collective knowledge and experience into ChatGPT. Ask questions in plain English and get cited answers drawn from your firm's experience data, without leaving the conversation.

- Natural language search: ask questions like "Show me M&A deals for banking clients in Japan" and get results with entity links across matters, clients, people and experience records.
- Tabular results: view paged, sortable tables from any search to quickly scan and compare results.
- Matter profiles: pull up full matter details by drilling into a specific matter from your search results.
- Client profiles: retrieve complete client profiles to understand relationship history and related experience.
- People profiles: look up individuals to find their expertise, matter history and firm roles.
- Marketing packet profiles: access full experience packets to support pitches, proposals and RFPs.
- Conversational refinement: chain any of the above together with follow-up questions to narrow down exactly what you need.

All answers include citations and respect firm security permissions, ethical walls, and user entitlements, so professionals only see what they are authorised to access. Litera’s Lito helps lawyers and business professionals tap into firm knowledge with deterministic accuracy, Raising The Bar™ on a process that would otherwise require navigating multiple systems or relying on institutional memory.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8db0425790819187dd2fb0.longDescriptionZh:
Litera 的 Lito 插件将您公司的集体知识和经验带入 ChatGPT。用简单的英语提出问题，并从您公司的经验数据中获得引用的答案，而无需离开对话。

- 自然语言搜索：提出“向我显示日本银行客户的并购交易”等问题，并获得包含跨事务、客户、人员和经验记录的实体链接的结果。
- 表格结果：查看任何搜索中的分页、可排序表格，以快速扫描和比较结果。
- 案件概况：通过从搜索结果中钻取特定案件来获取完整的案件详细信息。
- 客户资料：检索完整的客户资料以了解关系历史和相关经验。
- 人员概况：查找个人以了解他们的专业知识、事务历史和公司角色。
- 营销数据包简介：访问完整的体验数据包以支持推介、提案和 RFP。
- 对话细化：将上述任何内容与后续问题联系起来，以准确缩小您需要的范围。

所有答案均包含引用，并尊重公司安全许可、道德墙和用户权利，因此专业人士只能看到他们有权访问的内容。 Litera 的 Lito 帮助律师和商业专业人士以确定性的准确性利用公司知识，提高流程中的标准™，否则需要导航多个系统或依赖机构记忆。

plugin_asdk_app_6a95f81c026081918845945f.name: Everlaw
plugin_asdk_app_6a95f81c026081918845945f.productIntro: Everlaw 提供安全、标准化的模型上下文协议 (MCP) 服务器，允许 OpenAI 连接到 Everlaw 并代表经过身份验证的用户处理实时事件数据。
plugin_asdk_app_6a95f81c026081918845945f.productIntroEn: Everlaw provides a secure, standardized Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows OpenAI to connect to Everlaw and work with live matter data on behalf of an authenticated user.
plugin_asdk_app_6a95f81c026081918845945f.longDescription:
Everlaw provides a secure, standardized Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows OpenAI to connect to Everlaw and work with live matter data on behalf of an authenticated user.

Through the connector, a connected agent can understand a user’s Everlaw project structure, translate natural-language requests into Everlaw search logic, retrieve responsive documents and document text, and analyze metadata and Bates driven result sets. The connected agent can also support natural-language reporting and analysis workflows, while Everlaw remains the governed evidence layer and system of record for case materials, metadata, and work product.

Access to Deep Dive via this connector complements search and retrieval tools, as well as Everlaw’s native Deep Dive experience. It is intended to support broader, semantic, evidence-backed questions while preserving Everlaw’s permissions and the integrity of the underlying matter record.

The connector is designed to operate within the user’s existing Everlaw permission level. Every request is authenticated and authorized against the user’s Everlaw permissions, so the agent can access only the projects, documents, and data that user is already permitted to view. Deep Dive will also be available through the connector, allowing a user to query Deep Dive over eligible Everlaw project data and retrieve evidence-backed results without changing the underlying matter record.

Using the connector, an agent can:

Use Deep Dive to ask broader investigative questions and return evidence-backed results, once the Deep Dive tools are available.

Convert a natural-language request into a structured Everlaw search. 

Generate structured reports about project contents, document volumes, custodians, dates, Bates ranges, and other returned data. 

Search by document text, metadata, Bates or Control number, binder, coding, redactions, productions, processing criteria, and other supported terms. 

Identify the metadata fields, datasets, and processed uploads available in a project. 

Retrieve matching documents with Bates numbers, metadata, review links, document-text links, and extracted values. 

Summarize and analyze retrieved documents or result sets in natural language.
plugin_asdk_app_6a95f81c026081918845945f.longDescriptionZh:
Everlaw 提供安全、标准化的模型上下文协议 (MCP) 服务器，允许 OpenAI 连接到 Everlaw 并代表经过身份验证的用户处理实时事件数据。

通过连接器，连接的代理可以了解用户的 Everlaw 项目结构，将自然语言请求转换为 Everlaw 搜索逻辑，检索响应文档和文档文本，并分析元数据和 Bates 驱动的结果集。连接的代理还可以支持自然语言报告和分析工作流程，而 Everlaw 仍然是案件材料、元数据和工作产品的受控证据层和记录系统。

通过此连接器访问 Deep Dive 可以补充搜索和检索工具以及 Everlaw 的原生 Deep Dive 体验。它旨在支持更广泛的、语义的、有证据支持的问题，同时保留 Everlaw 的权限和基础事项记录的完整性。

该连接器设计为在用户现有的 Everlaw 权限级别内运行。每个请求都会根据用户的 Everlaw 权限进行身份验证和授权，因此代理只能访问用户已被允许查看的项目、文档和数据。 Deep Dive 还将通过连接器提供，允许用户在符合条件的 Everlaw 项目数据上查询 Deep Dive，并检索有证据支持的结果，而无需更改基础事项记录。

使用连接器，代理可以：

一旦 Deep Dive 工具可用，就可以使用 Deep Dive 提出更广泛的调查问题并返回有证据支持的结果。

将自然语言请求转换为结构化的 Everlaw 搜索。 

生成有关项目内容、文档量、保管人、日期、贝茨范围和其他返回数据的结构化报告。 

按文档文本、元数据、贝茨或控制编号、活页夹、编码、编辑、作品、处理标准和其他支持的术语进行搜索。 

识别项目中可用的元数据字段、数据集和已处理的上传。 

检索具有贝茨编号、元数据、审阅链接、文档文本链接和提取值的匹配文档。 

用自然语言总结和分析检索到的文档或结果集。
defaultPrompts: Find relevant documents from a vague description
Prepare for a deposition
Answer a matter-level question and identify evidence gaps
defaultPromptsZh: 从模糊的描述中查找相关文档
准备取证
回答问题并找出证据差距

Bu plugin Pazarus hesabınızı ChatGPT'ye bağlar; mağaza verilerinizi sohbet içinde sorgulayıp analiz edersiniz.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8ada2e49408191a0e9861b.longDescription:
Pazarus, Trendyol, Hepsiburada, Amazon, n11, Çiçeksepeti, PttAVM, Pazarama, İdefix ve e-ticaret sitelerinizi tek panelde yöneten pazaryeri entegrasyon platformudur. Bu plugin Pazarus hesabınızı ChatGPT'ye bağlar; mağaza verilerinizi sohbet içinde sorgulayıp analiz edersiniz.

Neler yapabilirsiniz:
• Satış: "Dünkü satışlarımı pazaryerine göre analiz et", "Bu hafta en çok satan ürünlerim"
• Sipariş: "Dün gelen siparişlerin kaçı kargolandı?", "TY-100234 numaralı sipariş hangi durumda?"
• İade: "Son 30 günde iade oranım ve en sık iade sebepleri"
• Stok: "Stoğu biten ürünler", "14 gün içinde tükenecek ürünler"
• Müşteri soruları: "Cevap bekleyen pazaryeri soruları"
• Kâr: "Bu ayki kâr-zarar özetim, komisyon ve kargo payı"
• Durum: "Pazaryeri bağlantılarımda sorun var mı, son gönderim hataları neler?"

Yanıtlar gerçek mağaza verinizden gelir ve ilgili panel sayfasına bağlantı içerir. Bağlantı OAuth ile kurulur, yalnızca Pazarus panelinde yetkili olduğunuz verileri kapsar, müşteri kişisel bilgileri maskelenir ve tüm araçlar salt okunurdur (stok, fiyat veya sipariş değiştirmez). Bağlantıyı panelden istediğiniz an kesebilirsiniz. Pazarus hesabı gerekir; ücretsiz plan dahil tüm planlarda kullanılabilir.

• Satış：“Dünkü satışlarımı pazaryerine göre analiz et”、“Bu hafta en çok satan ürünlerim”
• Sipariş：“Dün gelen siparişlerin kaçı kargolandı？”、“TY-100234 numaralı siparişhangi durumda？”
• Iade：“Son 30 günde iade oranım ve en sık iade sebepleri”
• Stok：“Stoğu biten ürünler”、“14 gün içinde tükenecek ürünler”
• Müşteri soruları：“Cevap bekleyen pazaryeri soruları”
• Kâr：“Bu ayki kâr-zarar özetim, komisyon ve kargo payı”
• 杜鲁姆：“Pazaryeri bağlantılarımda sorun var mı，son gönderim hataları neler？”

更改面板的设置。 Bağlantı OAuth ile kurulur、yalnızca Pazarus panelinde Yetkili olduğunuz verileri kapsar、müşteri kişisel bilgileri maskelenir ve tüm araçlar salt okunurdur（stok、fiyat veya sipariş değiştirmez）。 Bağlantıyı panelden istediğiniz 和 kesebilirsiniz。帕扎鲁斯 hesabı gerekir; ücretsiz plan dahil tüm planlarda kullanılabilir。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8b5dbaf2b881918d86b6b1.description: 检查装备、人员和时间表
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b5dbaf2b881918d86b6b1.productIntro: Made In Show (MIS) 是活动制作公司（音频、视频和灯光服务提供商）的管理平台。此连接器将 ChatGPT 链接到您公司的 MIS 安装，以便您的团队可以用简单的语言处理实时生产数据。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b5dbaf2b881918d86b6b1.productIntroEn: Made In Show (MIS) is the management platform for event production companies — audio, video and lighting service providers. This connector links ChatGPT to your company's MIS installation so your team can work with live production data in plain language.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b5dbaf2b881918d86b6b1.longDescription:
Made In Show (MIS) is the management platform for event production companies — audio, video and lighting service providers. This connector links ChatGPT to your company's MIS installation so your team can work with live production data in plain language.

Ask about productions and their schedules, check warehouse availability for specific dates, spot material and crew conflicts before they happen, review how complete a production is, and read production notes and supplier statistics — and, when your administrator allows it, act on the data: reserve equipment, add locations, create productions, and draft estimate texts.

Access is off by default and controlled per user by your MIS administrator: each user's AI access can view data, view and act, or nothing at all. Write operations follow the same per-user permission, enforced server-side on every call; tools designed for impactful changes (such as creating a production) add their own two-step confirmation. The connector authenticates with OAuth against your installation; data flows only between ChatGPT and your MIS backend, is never used for model training by Made In Show, and tool calls are logged for 90 days for audit purposes (responses are never stored).

Requires an account on a Made In Show installation with AI access enabled by the administrator.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b5dbaf2b881918d86b6b1.longDescriptionZh:
Made In Show (MIS) 是活动制作公司（音频、视频和灯光服务提供商）的管理平台。此连接器将 ChatGPT 链接到您公司的 MIS 安装，以便您的团队可以用简单的语言处理实时生产数据。

询问生产及其时间表，检查特定日期的仓库可用性，在发生之前发现材料和人员冲突，检查生产的完成程度，并阅读生产注释和供应商统计数据 - 并且，当您的管理员允许时，根据数据采取行动：预留设备，添加位置，创建生产和起草估算文本。

默认情况下，访问权限处于关闭状态，并由 MIS 管理员按用户进行控制：每个用户的 AI 访问权限可以查看数据、查看和操作，或者什么都不做。写入操作遵循相同的每用户权限，在每次调用时在服务器端强制执行；专为有影响力的更改（例如创建产品）而设计的工具添加了自己的两步确认。连接器根据您的安装使用 OAuth 进行身份验证；数据仅在 ChatGPT 和您的 MIS 后端之间流动，绝不会用于 Made In Show 的模型训练，并且工具调用会记录 90 天以用于审计目的（从不存储响应）。

需要在 Made In Show 安装中拥有一个由管理员启用 AI 访问权限的帐户。

plugin_asdk_app_6a75e3594c608191acf0f48a.productIntroEn: Stratyfix is an AI-driven sales intelligence platform. This plugin lets managers and reps ask about their own Stratyfix data in the chat they already use. Are we going to make the quarter? Who needs my attention this week? The answers come from the live platform.
plugin_asdk_app_6a75e3594c608191acf0f48a.longDescription:
Stratyfix is an AI-driven sales intelligence platform. This plugin lets managers and reps ask about their own Stratyfix data in the chat they already use. Are we going to make the quarter? Who needs my attention this week? The answers come from the live platform.

Every person connects as themselves. A rep sees their own book and a manager sees their team, with the same permissions as the app itself. It is read only, so nothing in Stratyfix can be changed from chat. And it does not bluff. When Stratyfix withholds a number on purpose, because the odds are not calibrated yet or a target is not set, the plugin says exactly that instead of guessing.

You need a Stratyfix workspace, with the connector enabled by your administrator.
plugin_asdk_app_6a75e3594c608191acf0f48a.longDescriptionZh:
Stratyfix 是一个人工智能驱动的销售智能平台。该插件允许经理和代表在他们已经使用的聊天中询问他们自己的 Stratyfix 数据。我们要完成这个季度吗？这周谁需要我的关注？答案来自直播平台。

每个人都像自己一样相互联系。代表可以看到自己的书，经理可以看到他们的团队，具有与应用程序本身相同的权限。它是只读的，因此无法通过聊天更改 Stratyfix 中的任何内容。而且它不会虚张声势。当 Stratyfix 由于尚未校准赔率或未设定目标而故意保留某个数字时，该插件会准确地说出这一点，而不是猜测。

您需要一个 Stratyfix 工作区，并由管理员启用连接器。
defaultPrompts: Which of our deals have a strategy brief today?
What's our chance of hitting this quarter's target?
Who should I coach this week, and why?
defaultPromptsZh: 今天我们的哪些交易有策略简介？
我们实现本季度目标的机会有多大？
这周我应该指导谁，为什么？

plugin_asdk_app_6aa86795f1188191b8e6dcd2.productIntro: Clera 帮助公司招聘团队根据职位搜索经过审查的候选人、审查推荐、请求介绍、跟踪招聘进度以及管理职位、上市公司简介和私人联系人。搜索结果掩盖了候选人姓名，但保留了职业历史；语义搜索可能会将搜索输入发送到 Azure。基于角色的搜索显示不阻止介绍的咨询适合标记。在先前命名的共享过期或被撤销后，详细的个人资料仍然可用，并且专业的自由文本可能包含个人详细信息。介绍请求可以发送电子邮件并向连接的招聘系统提交申请。反馈通过 Slack 发送，带有用户和公司身份。
plugin_asdk_app_6aa86795f1188191b8e6dcd2.productIntroEn: Clera helps company hiring teams search vetted candidates against a role, review recommendations, request introductions, track hiring progress, and manage roles, public company profiles and private contacts. Search results mask candidate names but retain professional history; semantic search may send search inputs to Azure.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa86795f1188191b8e6dcd2.longDescription: Clera helps company hiring teams search vetted candidates against a role, review recommendations, request introductions, track hiring progress, and manage roles, public company profiles and private contacts. Search results mask candidate names but retain professional history; semantic search may send search inputs to Azure. Role-based searches show advisory fit flags that do not block introductions. Detailed profiles can remain available after an earlier named share expires or is revoked, and professional free text may contain personal details. Introduction requests can send emails and submit applications to a connected hiring system. Feedback is sent through Slack with user and company identity. Private call logs retain caller identity, inputs and results without automatic expiry.

plugin_asdk_app_6960e27ea6488191898f73e8.productIntro: 我们的平台允许用户根据角色、地点、经验、薪资和技能等多种标准探索工作机会。用户可以查看详细的职位描述，包括职责、要求和公司信息，以做出明智的决策。该平台使您可以轻松地在一处发现和比较相关机会。一旦找到合适的工作，用户就可以无缝转移到我们的平台继续他们的旅程。他们可以毫无摩擦地申请该职位或继续招聘流程的后续步骤。该体验旨在为用户提供简单、快速且直观的体验。我们确保职位列表具有相关性并定期更新。该平台支持用户从最初的工作发现到申请完成。
plugin_asdk_app_6960e27ea6488191898f73e8.productIntroEn: Our platform allows users to explore job opportunities based on multiple criteria such as role, location, experience, salary, and skills. Users can view detailed job descriptions, including responsibilities, requirements, and company information, to make informed decisions. The platform makes it easy to discover and compare relevant opportunities in one place.
plugin_asdk_app_6960e27ea6488191898f73e8.longDescription: Our platform allows users to explore job opportunities based on multiple criteria such as role, location, experience, salary, and skills. Users can view detailed job descriptions, including responsibilities, requirements, and company information, to make informed decisions. The platform makes it easy to discover and compare relevant opportunities in one place. Once a suitable job is found, users can seamlessly move to our platform to continue their journey. They can apply for the job or proceed with the next steps in the hiring process without friction. The experience is designed to be simple, fast, and intuitive for users. We ensure that job listings are relevant and regularly updated. The platform supports users from initial job discovery to application completion. It helps reduce effort and improves clarity during the job search process. Our goal is to make job exploration and application more efficient and transparent for every user.

plugin_asdk_app_6a96acbac9388191b2bd896b.description: 寻找匹配并雇用候选人
plugin_asdk_app_6a96acbac9388191b2bd896b.productIntro: Talentin 帮助招聘人员和招聘团队在 ChatGPT 内完成整个寻源流程：根据粗略的招聘要求起草职位描述，使用职位描述或简单的英语简介搜索 Talentin 候选人数据库，查看紧凑的候选人卡，打开完整的工作历史档案，并运行详细的匹配分析，根据职位要求范围、优点、缺点和摘要对一名或多名候选人进行评分。用户还可以粘贴简历，以获得针对特定职位描述的招聘人员风格的适合度分析。
plugin_asdk_app_6a96acbac9388191b2bd896b.productIntroEn: Talentin helps recruiters and hiring teams work an entire sourcing pass inside ChatGPT: draft a job description from a rough hiring requirement, search the Talentin candidate database with a job description or plain-English brief, review compact candidate cards, open full work-history profiles, and run detailed match analyses that score one or several candidates against the role with req…
plugin_asdk_app_6a96acbac9388191b2bd896b.longDescription: Talentin helps recruiters and hiring teams work an entire sourcing pass inside ChatGPT: draft a job description from a rough hiring requirement, search the Talentin candidate database with a job description or plain-English brief, review compact candidate cards, open full work-history profiles, and run detailed match analyses that score one or several candidates against the role with requirement coverage, pros, cons, and a summary. Users can also paste a resume to get a recruiter-style fit analysis against a specific job description. Each user connects with their own Talentin API key, so all searches and analyses run against their own Talentin account and quota.

plugin_asdk_app_6aa989fc5a6c8191987f1c2f.productIntro: 粘贴提案、报价、估算、合同或电子邮件线索。 ScopeLinq 将其读入其实际陈述的术语中，每个术语都可追溯到其来源，并告诉您文本中未提及的内容。确认已同意的行，然后询问是否包含新请求、附加工作或需要澄清 - 答案仅引用您确认的行。适用于发送文档或接收文档的人。免费，无需帐户。

plugin_asdk_app_6a95ea328884819188f027ea.productIntro: PayCanvas 帮助授权薪资团队根据预订和运营数据计算和审查复杂的薪资。它从配置的来源收集数据，显示每个结果背后的记录，通过内置检查运行工资计算，帮助操作员解决标记的数据问题，并可以从上一个付款周期结转选定的手动调整。
plugin_asdk_app_6a95ea328884819188f027ea.productIntroEn: PayCanvas helps authorized payroll teams calculate and review complex payroll from booking and operational data. It collects data from configured sources, shows the records behind each result, runs payroll calculations with built-in checks, helps operators resolve flagged data issues, and can carry forward selected manual adjustments from a prior pay period.
plugin_asdk_app_6a95ea328884819188f027ea.longDescription:
PayCanvas helps authorized payroll teams calculate and review complex payroll from booking and operational data. It collects data from configured sources, shows the records behind each result, runs payroll calculations with built-in checks, helps operators resolve flagged data issues, and can carry forward selected manual adjustments from a prior pay period.

It is designed for businesses where pay depends on trips, bookings, passenger counts, roles, commissions, tips, or other operating rules. Any payroll-changing action requires additional verification, an exact preview, and confirmation, with an audit record for accountability.

PayCanvas does not approve, submit, export, email, or pay payroll.
plugin_asdk_app_6a95ea328884819188f027ea.longDescriptionZh:
PayCanvas 帮助授权薪资团队根据预订和运营数据计算和审查复杂的薪资。它从配置的来源收集数据，显示每个结果背后的记录，通过内置检查运行工资计算，帮助操作员解决标记的数据问题，并可以从上一个付款周期结转选定的手动调整。

它专为薪酬取决于行程、预订、乘客数量、角色、佣金、小费或其他运营规则的企业而设计。任何薪资变更行动都需要额外的验证、准确的预览和确认，并附有问责审计记录。

PayCanvas 不批准、提交、导出、通过电子邮件发送或支付工资。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9facd4ab6481919a2b14c3.name: Onsa
plugin_asdk_app_6a9facd4ab6481919a2b14c3.description: 寻找 B2B 潜在客户，发送外展服务
plugin_asdk_app_6a9facd4ab6481919a2b14c3.productIntro: Onsa 会找到真正的 B2B 潜在客户（拥有 LinkedIn 个人资料的实际人员），根据您的理想客户资料进行评分，并将每次搜索作为您可以返回的营销活动。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9facd4ab6481919a2b14c3.productIntroEn: Onsa finds real B2B prospects — actual people with LinkedIn profiles — scored against your ideal-customer profile, and keeps every search as a campaign you can come back to.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9facd4ab6481919a2b14c3.longDescription:
Onsa finds real B2B prospects — actual people with LinkedIn profiles — scored against your ideal-customer profile, and keeps every search as a campaign you can come back to.

Ask for leads in plain language and Onsa's agent runs a live search, returning each person with their title, company, a 1–5 score and the written reasoning behind that score. Every search becomes a campaign, so you can grow it, steer it toward a different segment, or compare it against earlier ones to see which profile actually produced replies.

Onsa carries the outreach side too. It returns what prospects wrote back — the actual text, not just counts — alongside the funnel: invites sent, invites accepted, messages sent, and replies split by sentiment. When a draft reads like a mail-merge, you can pull up the research memo Onsa already wrote about that person and rewrite the message around one specific, checkable fact.

Sending is deliberately hard to do by accident. Queueing a LinkedIn message reaches a real human, so the tool refuses unless the exact draft text and the recipient's name are quoted back to it, it puts a confirmation in front of the person at the keyboard, and each approval is single-use and bound to one recipient and one draft. A client that cannot show a confirmation dialog sends nothing — Onsa returns a link to approve inside the app instead.

Requires an Onsa account. New workspaces start on a free trial with a prospect allowance; when the allowance runs out, every campaign, lead and reply already in the workspace stays readable.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9facd4ab6481919a2b14c3.longDescriptionZh:
Onsa 会找到真正的 B2B 潜在客户（拥有 LinkedIn 个人资料的实际人员），根据您的理想客户资料进行评分，并将每次搜索作为您可以返回的营销活动。

用简单的语言询问线索，Onsa 的经纪人会进行实时搜索，返回每个人的头衔、公司、1-5 的分数以及该分数背后的书面推理。每次搜索都会成为一个活动，因此您可以扩展它，将其引导到不同的细分市场，或者将其与之前的搜索进行比较，以查看哪个配置文件实际产生了回复。

Onsa 也负责外展工作。它会在漏斗旁边返回潜在客户回写的内容（实际文本，而不仅仅是计数）：发送的邀请、接受的邀请、发送的消息以及按情绪划分的回复。当草稿读起来像邮件合并时，你可以调出 Onsa 已经写过的关于该人的研究备忘录，并围绕一个具体的、可检查的事实重写该消息。

故意发送是很难偶然发生的。排队的 LinkedIn 消息到达真人，因此该工具会拒绝，除非引用确切的草稿文本和收件人姓名，它会在键盘前的人面前放置一个确认，并且每个批准都是一次性的，并且绑定到一个收件人和一份草稿。无法显示确认对话框的客户端不会发送任何内容 - Onsa 会返回一个链接以在应用程序内进行批准。

需要 Onsa 帐户。新的工作空间开始免费试用，并提供潜在客户津贴；当津贴用完时，工作区中已有的每个营销活动、线索和回复都保持可读。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9add18e7b4819195580062.description: 为企业量身定制人工智能
plugin_asdk_app_6a9add18e7b4819195580062.productIntro: ModelVault 为企业设计和构建定制的人工智能解决方案：自主人工智能代理、RAG 系统和知识库、预测模型（预测、流失、维护）、异常检测、自动化管道、文档处理和集成。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9add18e7b4819195580062.productIntroEn: ModelVault designs and builds tailored AI solutions for business: autonomous AI agents, RAG systems and knowledge bases, predictive models (forecasting, churn, maintenance), anomaly detection, automation pipelines, document processing and integrations.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9add18e7b4819195580062.longDescription:
ModelVault designs and builds tailored AI solutions for business: autonomous AI agents, RAG systems and knowledge bases, predictive models (forecasting, churn, maintenance), anomaly detection, automation pipelines, document processing and integrations.

With this app, right in chat, you can: find which services fit your case, match a business problem to the most suitable solution, see published projects and evidence, understand the process, pricing and deployment options, open the live demos on the website, and prepare a quote request (a ready-to-send email draft that you review and send). Infrastructure in Italy, pay-as-you-go.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9add18e7b4819195580062.longDescriptionZh:
ModelVault 为企业设计和构建定制的人工智能解决方案：自主人工智能代理、RAG 系统和知识库、预测模型（预测、流失、维护）、异常检测、自动化管道、文档处理和集成。

借助此应用程序，在聊天中，您可以：找到适合您的案例的服务，将业务问题与最合适的解决方案相匹配，查看已发布的项目和证据，了解流程、定价和部署选项，打开网站上的实时演示，并准备报价请求（您审阅并发送的准备发送的电子邮件草稿）。意大利的基础设施，即用即付。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7a5ec817c48191b918826e.productIntro: Icelook 将客户与独立美容专家联系起来——美甲师、睫毛师、眉毛师、美发师和化妆师。预订专家，而不是沙龙。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7a5ec817c48191b918826e.productIntroEn: Icelook connects clients with independent beauty specialists — nail techs, lash and brow artists, hairdressers, and makeup artists. Book the specialist, not the salon.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7a5ec817c48191b918826e.longDescription:
Icelook connects clients with independent beauty specialists — nail techs, lash and brow artists, hairdressers, and makeup artists. Book the specialist, not the salon.

Clients can check a specialist's real availability, book an appointment, and reschedule or cancel it — all in chat. Specialists can review their day, manage bookings, clients, and services, and check how their business is doing.

Every booking action confirms the details first, and nothing on your calendar is ever changed silently.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7a5ec817c48191b918826e.longDescriptionZh:
Icelook 将客户与独立美容专家联系起来——美甲师、睫毛师、眉毛师、美发师和化妆师。预订专家，而不是沙龙。

客户可以检查专家的真实空闲时间、预约、重新安排或取消——所有这些都可以在聊天中完成。专家可以回顾他们的一天，管理预订、客户和服务，并检查他们的业务进展情况。

每次预订操作都会首先确认详细信息，并且您的日历上的任何内容都不会悄无声息地更改。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9d5b122fbc8191a7be2fa5.productIntroEn: Radarkit tracks how AI assistants answer the questions your customers ask. It asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Google AI Mode and Google AI Overviews the prompts you care about on a schedule, stores every answer, and tells you whether your brand was mentioned, where it ranked, how it was described, which competitors appeared instead, and which websites the answer relied on.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9d5b122fbc8191a7be2fa5.longDescription:
Radarkit tracks how AI assistants answer the questions your customers ask. It asks ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, Google AI Mode and Google AI Overviews the prompts you care about on a schedule, stores every answer, and tells you whether your brand was mentioned, where it ranked, how it was described, which competitors appeared instead, and which websites the answer relied on.

With this plugin you can ask ChatGPT about your Radarkit data in plain language:

- How visible is my brand in AI answers this month, by model and by day?
- Which competitors and which source websites show up most for my prompts?
- What is the sentiment of the answers that mention us?
- Did the models search the web, and what did they search for?
- Show me the answers that left us out, with the full answer text as Markdown.
- Add new prompts to track, group them into topics, or re-ask a prompt right now.
- Export every answer, source, ranking or competitor mention for a date range as a CSV file.

Sign in with your Radarkit account and choose what the plugin may do: read data, add prompts and create exports, or create content. Every call is listed on your API usage page with what it did and what it cost. You can disconnect at any time from Settings, API keys.

A Radarkit subscription is required. Reads spend API credits from your plan; data exports spend Export rows.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9d5b122fbc8191a7be2fa5.longDescriptionZh:
Radarkit 跟踪人工智能助手如何回答客户提出的问题。它会按计划向 ChatGPT、Gemini、Perplexity、Copilot、Google AI Mode 和 Google AI Overviews 询问您关心的提示，存储每个答案，并告诉您您的品牌是否被提及、排名在哪里、如何描述、出现了哪些竞争对手以及答案依赖于哪些网站。

有了这个插件，您可以用简单的语言向 ChatGPT 询问您的 Radarkit 数据：

- 本月，按型号和日期，我的品牌在人工智能答案中的可见度如何？
- 哪些竞争对手和哪些来源网站最常出现在我的提示中？
- 提到我们的答案有何感想？
- 模特们是否搜索过网络？他们搜索了什么？
- 显示我们没有找到的答案，完整的答案文本为 Markdown。
- 添加新的提示进行跟踪，将它们分组到主题中，或者立即重新询问提示。
- 将某个日期范围内的每个答案、来源、排名或竞争对手提及导出为 CSV 文件。

使用您的 Radarkit 帐户登录并选择插件的功能：读取数据、添加提示和创建导出或创建内容。每个调用都会在您的 API 使用页面上列出，其中包含其执行的操作和费用。您可以随时断开与“设置”、API 密钥的连接。

需要订阅 Radarkit。从您的计划中读取支出 API 积分；数据导出花费导出行。

plugin_asdk_app_6a14cb48a90081918ef75f9c.productIntro: InsightSignal 是一个经过多源验证的私有知识图谱，适用于 B2B 公司和联系人情报。用户工作区中的每个数据点都由两个或多个独立来源（实时网络基础的人工智能分析、专业网络数据、网络搜索和电子邮件/电话验证器）进行验证，带有数字置信度分数，并链接到验证值的引文页面。
plugin_asdk_app_6a14cb48a90081918ef75f9c.productIntroEn: InsightSignal is a private, multi-source-verified knowledge graph for B2B company and contact intelligence. Every data point in a user's workspace is verified by two or more independent sources (AI analysis with live web grounding, professional-network data, web search, and email/phone validators), carries a numeric confidence score, and links to the citation page where the value was ver…
plugin_asdk_app_6a14cb48a90081918ef75f9c.longDescription:
InsightSignal is a private, multi-source-verified knowledge graph for B2B company and contact intelligence. Every data point in a user's workspace is verified by two or more independent sources (AI analysis with live web grounding, professional-network data, web search, and email/phone validators), carries a numeric confidence score, and links to the citation page where the value was verified.

With this plugin, ChatGPT can query the user's own verified data: search and filter companies and people, read company profiles with A-F quality grades and operational status, pull contact details with email deliverability and phone validity scores, summarize multi-source research reports with verdicts and evidence links, explore business relationships in the knowledge graph (competitors, partners, subsidiaries, key people), compare companies side-by-side, and track how verified data changed over time through immutable snapshots.

Users can also trigger actions with explicit confirmation: verify a new company through the multi-source pipeline, generate or refresh research reports, enrich contacts, re-score companies against a stated business intent (sales prospecting, competitor analysis, partner fit, investment screening), and push verified records to their connected CRM.

All data is strictly scoped to the signed-in user's InsightSignal account and organization. The plugin never exposes other users' data, and paid actions always present a cost estimate and require confirmation before executing.
plugin_asdk_app_6a14cb48a90081918ef75f9c.longDescriptionZh:
InsightSignal 是一个经过多源验证的私有知识图谱，适用于 B2B 公司和联系人情报。用户工作区中的每个数据点都由两个或多个独立来源（实时网络基础的人工智能分析、专业网络数据、网络搜索和电子邮件/电话验证器）进行验证，带有数字置信度分数，并链接到验证值的引文页面。

通过这个插件，ChatGPT 可以查询用户自己的验证数据：搜索和过滤公司和人员，读取具有 A-F 质量等级和运营状态的公司简介，通过电子邮件送达率和电话有效性分数提取联系方式，通过结论和证据链接总结多源研究报告，探索知识图谱中的业务关系（竞争对手、合作伙伴、子公司、关键人员），并排比较公司，并通过不可变的快照跟踪验证数据如何随时间变化。

用户还可以通过明确确认来触发操作：通过多源管道验证新公司，生成或刷新研究报告，丰富联系人，根据既定业务意图（销售勘探、竞争对手分析、合作伙伴适合、投资筛选）对公司重新评分，并将经过验证的记录推送到其连接的 CRM。

所有数据的范围严格限于登录用户的 InsightSignal 帐户和组织。该插件永远不会公开其他用户的数据，付费操作始终会提供成本估算，并在执行前需要确认。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9b9403e84c8191851b6666.productIntroEn: LeyNova da acceso al derecho boliviano vigente verificado: normas artículo por artículo con su sello de vigencia —Constitución, doce códigos, leyes, decretos y reglamentos sectoriales— y jurisprudencia del Tribunal Constitucional Plurinacional y del Tribunal Supremo de Justicia. plugin_asdk_app_6a9b9403e84c8191851b6666.longDescription:
LeyNova da acceso al derecho boliviano vigente verificado: normas artículo por artículo con su sello de vigencia —Constitución, doce códigos, leyes, decretos y reglamentos sectoriales— y jurisprudencia del Tribunal Constitucional Plurinacional y del Tribunal Supremo de Justicia. Cada norma y cada fallo se devuelven con una URL pública que el usuario puede abrir y verificar.

Está pensado para abogados, estudiantes de derecho y personas que necesitan ubicar la norma o el precedente que gobierna un caso. Busca por la función de la regla, no solo por su número, y advierte cuando un artículo está derogado o abrogado.

LeyNova entrega fuentes verificadas para fundamentar un análisis; no sustituye el criterio de un abogado habilitado.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9b9403e84c8191851b6666.longDescriptionZh:
LeyNova 提供经过验证的玻利维亚现行法律：带有有效性标志的逐条法规 - 宪法、十二部法典、法律、法令和部门法规 - 以及多民族宪法法院和最高法院的判例。每个规则和每个错误都会返回一个公共 URL，用户可以打开并验证该 URL。

它适用于律师、法学院学生以及需要查找管辖案件的规则或先例的人。按规则的功能（而不仅仅是其编号）进行搜索，并在文章被废除或废除时发出警告。

LeyNova 提供经过验证的来源来支持分析；它不能取代合格律师的判断。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9f190af51c81919c0d94d6.productIntroEn: Markty is an AI marketing team for small businesses: a manager and department experts for social media, SEO and blog, e-commerce and email, working from your brand's research, voice and strategy. plugin_asdk_app_6a9f190af51c81919c0d94d6.developerName: MARKTYAI YAPAYZEKA TEKNOLOJİLERİ VE YAZILIM ANONİM ŞİRKETİ
plugin_asdk_app_6a9f190af51c81919c0d94d6.longDescription: Markty is an AI marketing team for small businesses: a manager and department experts for social media, SEO and blog, e-commerce and email, working from your brand's research, voice and strategy. Ask for what you would ask a colleague: today's marketing brief, three Instagram posts about a launch, a blog outline, an image for a weekend sale, a check on how visible your brand is in AI answers, or to schedule a post. Everything Markty creates is saved to your Markty account, and nothing is published until you approve it in the Markty calendar. Requires a paid Markty plan. Each request to the team costs one Markty credit; images and other paid actions cost the same credits as in the Markty app, and reading your brand data is free.

plugin_asdk_app_6a974423e52081918e9fc544.name: Atlas
plugin_asdk_app_6a974423e52081918e9fc544.description: 在聊天中发送并签署合同
plugin_asdk_app_6a974423e52081918e9fc544.productIntro: Atlas 是您的人工智能合约代理。无限电子签名是免费的，无需信用卡。
plugin_asdk_app_6a974423e52081918e9fc544.productIntroEn: Atlas is your AI contract agent. Unlimited e-sign is free, with no credit card required.
plugin_asdk_app_6a974423e52081918e9fc544.longDescription:
Atlas is your AI contract agent. Unlimited e-sign is free, with no credit card required.

Draft an agreement in the conversation, or share a PDF or DOCX, and Atlas turns it into a signable document: it detects signature lines, dates, and fields, and works out who signs what. You get a review link, click Send, and signers get a clean signing page on any device with no account needed.

Ask things like "send this MSA to sarah@acme.com for signature," "who still hasn't signed?", "remind them," or "pull the payment terms from the signed contract." Repeat sends run from saved templates in one message.

Atlas is review-first: it prepares everything and a human approves before any signature request goes out. Every signed document includes a completion certificate and a full audit trail.
plugin_asdk_app_6a974423e52081918e9fc544.longDescriptionZh:
Atlas 是您的人工智能合约代理。无限电子签名是免费的，无需信用卡。

在对话中起草协议，或共享 PDF 或 DOCX，Atlas 将其转换为可签名文档：它会检测签名行、日期和字段，并计算出谁签署了什么。您将获得一个审核链接，单击“发送”，签名者无需帐户即可在任何设备上获得干净的签名页面。

询问诸如“将此 MSA 发送至 sarah@acme.com 进行签名”、“谁还没有签名？”、“提醒他们”或“从已签署的合同中删除付款条款”等问题。在一封消息中重复发送已保存模板的运行。

Atlas 是审核优先的：它会准备好一切，并在任何签名请求发出之前由人工批准。每一份签署的文件都包含一份完成证书和完整的审核跟踪。

Pull the contract terms from the Software Services Agreement
Whats the signing status of the NDA?
defaultPromptsZh: 显示我所有的合同
从软件服务协议中提取合同条款
NDA 的签署情况如何？

plugin_asdk_app_6a87785314348191bc6b215a.name: Trainual
plugin_asdk_app_6a87785314348191bc6b215a.description: 了解您的公司如何运作
plugin_asdk_app_6a87785314348191bc6b215a.productIntro: 培训是成长型公司运营业务运营的地方——工作应该如何完成，以及工作实际上是如何进行的。
plugin_asdk_app_6a87785314348191bc6b215a.productIntroEn: Trainual is where growing companies run the operating side of the business — how work should be done, and how it is actually going.
plugin_asdk_app_6a87785314348191bc6b215a.longDescription:
Trainual is where growing companies run the operating side of the business — how work should be done, and how it is actually going.

This plugin provides read access to your Trainual account so answers are grounded in your company’s own documented practice and current operating context rather than generic advice.

From the Training suite: search documented processes, policies, and role expectations. See what training has been assigned and who has completed it. Look up what a role is responsible for and which tools a team uses.

From the Operations suite: pull goals and progress against them, scorecard metrics and trends, meeting records and action items, and recurring team updates.

Together that means you can ask how something is supposed to work and how it is actually going in the same conversation — the connection Trainual is built around.

Common uses include onboarding support, answering "how do we do this here" without interrupting a colleague, preparing for a meeting or a one-on-one, checking training completion across a team, and drafting content that stays consistent with documented process.

Access follows Trainual’s existing permission model. Users only reach content their Trainual account already permits, and the plugin never modifies data.
plugin_asdk_app_6a87785314348191bc6b215a.longDescriptionZh:
培训是成长型公司运营业务运营的地方——工作应该如何完成，以及工作实际上是如何进行的。

This plugin provides read access to your Trainual account so answers are grounded in your company’s own documented practice and current operating context rather than generic advice.

从培训套件中：搜索记录的流程、政策和角色期望。查看分配了哪些培训以及谁完成了培训。查找角色负责什么以及团队使用哪些工具。

From the Operations suite: pull goals and progress against them, scorecard metrics and trends, meeting records and action items, and recurring team updates.

Together that means you can ask how something is supposed to work and how it is actually going in the same conversation — the connection Trainual is built around.

Common uses include onboarding support, answering "how do we do this here" without interrupting a colleague, preparing for a meeting or a one-on-one, checking training completion across a team, and drafting content that stays consistent with documented process.

访问遵循 Trainual 现有的权限模型。用户只能访问他们的培训帐户已经允许的内容，并且该插件永远不会修改数据。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8775bba6348191a2150441.longDescription:
Connect to Assembled, the workforce management platform for modern support teams. 

Inspect schedules, forecasts, and real-time performance across queues, agents, and sites. Diagnose SLA misses, run what-if scenarios, and analyze trends without exporting a single report. 

Take action directly from chat: adjust forecasts ahead of peak events, publish overtime when you're trending hot, or open VTO when you're overstaffed. 

Combine Assembled data with your HRIS, BI tools, or Slack to answer cross-system questions no single tool can. 

Built for WFM teams and support leaders who need answers in seconds, not hours.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8775bba6348191a2150441.longDescriptionZh:
连接到 Assembled，这是现代支持团队的劳动力管理平台。 

检查队列、代理和站点的计划、预测和实时性能。诊断 SLA 缺失、运行假设场景并分析趋势，而无需导出单个报告。 

直接从聊天中采取行动：在高峰活动之前调整预测，在热门趋势时发布加班时间，或在人满为患时打开 VTO。 

将组装数据与 HRIS、BI 工具或 Slack 相结合，以回答单一工具无法回答的跨系统问题。

plugin_asdk_app_6a877c804f9881918cfbc576.name: Rntor
plugin_asdk_app_6a877c804f9881918cfbc576.productIntro: RNTOR 将 ChatGPT 连接到您灵活的工作区管理平台，使授权团队能够即时访问运营数据以进行报告、会员支持、账单审核和日常决策。
plugin_asdk_app_6a877c804f9881918cfbc576.productIntroEn: RNTOR connects ChatGPT to your flexible workspace management platform, giving authorized teams instant access to operational data for reporting, member support, billing review, and everyday decision-making.
plugin_asdk_app_6a877c804f9881918cfbc576.longDescription:
RNTOR connects ChatGPT to your flexible workspace management platform, giving authorized teams instant access to operational data for reporting, member support, billing review, and everyday decision-making.

Ask questions in natural language and get answers from the RNTOR data you’re permitted to access—without switching dashboards or building reports manually.

Key capabilities:
• Review networks, locations, resources, and bookings.
• Look up customers and companies, including membership and account status.
• Explore plans, subscriptions, invoices, contracts, and contract templates.
• Review shop categories, products, orders, benefits, and benefit applications.
• Access published member guides and operational information.

RNTOR in ChatGPT is read-only. It can retrieve and analyze authorized data, but it cannot create, update, delete, approve, send, charge, sign, or trigger workflows. Access follows RNTOR user permissions, network isolation, and live/test boundaries.
plugin_asdk_app_6a877c804f9881918cfbc576.longDescriptionZh:
RNTOR 将 ChatGPT 连接到您灵活的工作区管理平台，使授权团队能够即时访问运营数据以进行报告、会员支持、账单审核和日常决策。

用自然语言提出问题，并从您有权访问的 RNTOR 数据中获取答案，而无需切换仪表板或手动构建报告。

关键能力：
• 查看网络、位置、资源和预订。
• 查找客户和公司，包括会员资格和帐户状态。
• 探索计划、订阅、发票、合同和合同模板。
• 查看商店类别、产品、订单、福利和福利申请。
• 访问已发布的会员指南和运营信息。

ChatGPT 中的 RNTOR 是只读的。它可以检索和分析授权数据，但无法创建、更新、删除、批准、发送、收费、签名或触发工作流程。访问遵循 RNTOR 用户权限、网络隔离和实时/测试边界。
defaultPrompts: Show unpaid invoices and subscriptions renewing in the next 30 days, grouped by location.
Summarize this month’s bookings by location and status, and highlight the busiest resources.
Give me today’s operations overview across all locations: bookings, shop orders, and active benefits.
defaultPromptsZh: 显示未来 30 天内未付的发票和续订的订阅，按位置分组。
按地点和状态总结本月的预订，并突出显示最繁忙的资源。
请向我提供今天所有地点的运营概览：预订、商店订单和有效福利。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9657ce7b348191b04834c3.longDescription: AIclicks tracks how a brand shows up across AI search engines and assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, AI Overviews, and more). Connect to read your aiclicks account data: tracked domains, prompts, competitors, citations, mentions, visibility and sentiment time-series, brand rankings, the model leaderboard, GA4 AI-referral traffic, and ChatGPT ads. plugin_asdk_app_6a96994fdee48191b6086e25.productIntro: Wask 将您的广告帐户连接到 ChatGPT。询问 Google Ads 和元广告中的广告系列效果、支出、关键字和搜索字词；比较时期；找到表现最好和最差的人；深入了解广告组、广告和创意表现；并检查您的优化自动化。当您决定采取行动时，Wask 使用安全的两步确认流程：助手首先显示确切更改的试运行预览（广告系列暂停/开始或预算更新；关键字暂停或搜索词包含/排除），并且仅在您确认后才应用它。所有操作的范围都在您的工作空间内，受 OAuth 2.
plugin_asdk_app_6a96994fdee48191b6086e25.productIntroEn: Wask connects your advertising accounts to ChatGPT. Ask about campaign performance, spend, keywords, and search terms across Google Ads and Meta Ads; compare periods; find top and bottom performers; drill into ad group, ad, and creative performance; and review your optimization automations.
plugin_asdk_app_6a96994fdee48191b6086e25.longDescription: Wask connects your advertising accounts to ChatGPT. Ask about campaign performance, spend, keywords, and search terms across Google Ads and Meta Ads; compare periods; find top and bottom performers; drill into ad group, ad, and creative performance; and review your optimization automations. When you decide to act, Wask uses a safe two-step confirmation flow: the assistant first shows a dry-run preview of the exact change (campaign pause/start or budget update; keyword pause or search-term include/exclude), and only applies it after your confirmation. All actions are scoped to your workspace, protected by OAuth 2.1, and fully audit-logged.

plugin_asdk_app_6a971dee7028819187a366c7.name: Hyros
plugin_asdk_app_6a971dee7028819187a366c7.productIntro: Hyros 跟踪每次广告点击、潜在客户和销售，以便您可以了解哪些广告系列、广告和关键字实际产生了收入。该应用程序将该数据导入 ChatGPT。
plugin_asdk_app_6a971dee7028819187a366c7.productIntroEn: Hyros tracks every ad click, lead, and sale, so you can see which campaigns, ads, and keywords actually produce revenue. This app brings that data into ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a971dee7028819187a366c7.longDescription:
Hyros tracks every ad click, lead, and sale, so you can see which campaigns, ads, and keywords actually produce revenue. This app brings that data into ChatGPT.

Ask in plain language and get answers from your live Hyros account:

• "Which Meta campaigns had the best ROAS last month?"
• "What were my best performing ads last month?"
• "Where did last week's revenue actually come from?"
• "Show me an overview of the last 7 days"

ChatGPT can pull attribution reports, spend and ROAS by campaign or ad set, lead and customer journeys, revenue and LTV breakdowns, and call and booking data, then chart it, summarize it or drop it into the doc you're already writing.

Built for media buyers, agencies, and growth teams who spend their days reconciling ad platform numbers against what actually hit the bank account.

Requires an active Hyros account. You connect with your Hyros login, and ChatGPT only sees data that account already has access to.
plugin_asdk_app_6a971dee7028819187a366c7.longDescriptionZh:
Hyros 跟踪每次广告点击、潜在客户和销售，以便您可以了解哪些广告系列、广告和关键字实际产生了收入。该应用程序将该数据导入 ChatGPT。

用简单的语言提问并从您的实时 Hyros 帐户中获得答案：

•“上个月哪些元广告系列的广告支出回报率最高？”
• “上个月效果最好的广告是什么？”
• “上周的收入实际上来自哪里？”
•“显示过去 7 天的概览”

ChatGPT 可以提取归因报告、营销活动或广告组的支出和 ROAS、潜在客户和客户旅程、收入和 LTV 细分以及通话和预订数据，然后将其绘制成图表、进行总结或将其放入您已经编写的文档中。

专为媒体买家、代理机构和增长团队打造，他们每天都需要将广告平台数据与实际到达银行账户的数据进行核对。

需要一个活跃的 Hyros 帐户。您使用 Hyros 登录名进行连接，ChatGPT 只能看到该帐户已有权访问的数据。

plugin_asdk_app_6a99cfc321cc8191bfd2b9c3.productIntro: Guest-Ready Score 帮助人们设置、准备、评估、改进和维护用于短期住宿和付费客人的房产。它专为 Airbnb 房东、短期租赁业主、度假租赁运营商、小屋和小木屋业主、湖滨别墅、海滨别墅、小木屋、公寓、公寓、宾馆、小屋、别墅、滑雪场、海滨出租、乡村别墅、小型住宅、带家具的出租、度假出租和其他住宿而设计。
plugin_asdk_app_6a99cfc321cc8191bfd2b9c3.productIntroEn: Guest-Ready Score helps people set up, prepare, assess, improve and maintain properties used for short-term stays and paying guests. It is designed for Airbnb hosts, short-term rental owners, vacation rental operators, cottage and cabin owners, lake houses, beach houses, chalets, condos, apartments, guest houses, lodges, villas, ski properties, waterfront rentals, country homes, tiny hom…
plugin_asdk_app_6a99cfc321cc8191bfd2b9c3.longDescription:
Guest-Ready Score helps people set up, prepare, assess, improve and maintain properties used for short-term stays and paying guests. It is designed for Airbnb hosts, short-term rental owners, vacation rental operators, cottage and cabin owners, lake houses, beach houses, chalets, condos, apartments, guest houses, lodges, villas, ski properties, waterfront rentals, country homes, tiny homes, furnished rentals, holiday rentals and other guest accommodation.

The tool is relevant for people asking how to start an Airbnb, how to prepare a property for guests, what to buy or stock, what amenities to provide, how to improve guest reviews, how to create a better guest experience, how to check whether a property is ready to list, or how to benchmark an existing rental against strong hospitality standards.

The 12-question assessment reviews core areas of the guest stay, including arrival and check-in, beds and sleeping comfort, bathrooms, kitchen readiness, lighting, temperature and climate comfort, Wi-Fi, cleanliness, restocking, guest communication, safety and local information. It then provides a practical Guest-Ready Score to help identify what is already working well and where additional attention may improve the stay.

Use Guest-Ready Score for first-time setup, pre-opening checks, pre-arrival preparation, rental audits, hospitality reviews, property readiness checks, host checklists, Airbnb setup questions, STR checklists, vacation rental standards, guest-experience improvement and ongoing quality control.
plugin_asdk_app_6a99cfc321cc8191bfd2b9c3.longDescriptionZh:
Guest-Ready Score 帮助人们设置、准备、评估、改进和维护用于短期住宿和付费客人的房产。它专为 Airbnb 房东、短期租赁业主、度假租赁运营商、小屋和小木屋业主、湖滨别墅、海滨别墅、小木屋、公寓、公寓、宾馆、小屋、别墅、滑雪场、海滨出租、乡村别墅、小型住宅、带家具的出租、度假出租和其他住宿而设计。

该工具适用于那些询问如何创办 Airbnb、如何为客人准备房产、购买或库存什么、提供哪些便利设施、如何改善客人评论、如何创造更好的客人体验、如何检查房产是否已准备好上市或如何根据严格的酒店标准对现有租金进行基准测试的人们。

包含 12 个问题的评估审查客人住宿的核心领域，包括抵达和入住、床铺和睡眠舒适度、浴室、厨房准备情况、照明、温度和气候舒适度、Wi-Fi、清洁度、补货、客人沟通、安全和当地信息。然后，它会提供实用的宾客就绪分数，以帮助确定哪些方面已经运作良好，以及哪些方面的额外关注可以改善住宿体验。

使用宾客准备分数进行首次设置、开业前检查、抵达前准备、租赁审核、接待审查、物业准备情况检查、房东清单、Airbnb 设置问题、STR 清单、度假租赁标准、宾客体验改进和持续质量控制。

plugin_asdk_app_6a90e9da4ad08191a201cbfc.longDescription: Tassyir is the back office of e-commerce merchants in Algeria. Once a merchant connects their Tassyir business, ChatGPT can review sales (orders, confirmation and delivery rates, delivered revenue, ad spend, best sellers and top wilayas), work the order queue (list pending orders, confirm, cancel, schedule, assign and comment on them, dispatch confirmed orders to delivery and follow parcels until delivered or returned), manage the catalog (create and update products with sizes, colors and per-variant prices, categories and stock levels) and keep the books (record expenses and capital transactions). Every action runs with the merchant’s own Tassyir role permissions, on the one business they connected. Amounts are in Algerian dinars (DZD).
